article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan officiel consolidé à 1 333 cas et 399 décès, la gratuité des soins lancée dans quatre zones de l'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the consolidated official toll stands at 1,333 cases and 399 deaths, free healthcare launched in four zones of Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: the 17th outbreak has 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths (29.7% fatality), with 609 in care and 189 recovered. Data updated after DHIS2 cleaning; 26 new cases detected on 29 June in Ituri and North Kivu, with 9 new recoveries. Ituri is the epicenter with 23 health zones; North Kivu 11; South Kivu 3 cases and 1 death, no transmission since May 26. Free healthcare launched in four Ituri zones (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Rwampara); a site for an Ebola treatment center planned in Bunia. Contact tracing is 82.7% across three provinces. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; Ervebo covers Zaïre. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir announced in Geneva; care remains largely symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：確認症例1,333件、死亡399件の公式集計、イトゥリ州4地区での医療無償化を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（1,333症例、死亡率29.7%）、地域内国際拡大リスク（ルワンダへの拡大可能性）、国際的な治療試験の展開（ジュネーブでの臨床試験）があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的なスケール拡大の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでジュネーブでの臨床試験言及があるが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。ルワンダはコンタクトトレーシング対象地域であるが、記事では能動的な症例報告なし。South Kivu Province では5月26日以降の感染伝播なく、現在の主要感染地域はIturi。このアウトブレイクはBundibugyo株で、ワクチン（Ervebo）は非適応株であり治療オプション限定という重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: Confirmed Ebola Cases Rises To 1,333
article.articleSummary: As of 01 July 2026, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have risen to 1,333, with 399 deaths. The DRC declared the current Ebola outbreak in mid-May. Kinshasa reports confirm the ongoing outbreak nationwide and highlight persistent challenges to response efforts from community transmission, population movement, and limited access to some affected areas. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or any imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the need for sustained surveillance and comprehensive public health measures to curb transmission across affected districts, as health authorities work to reach difficult-to-access communities and interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：確認されたエボラ患者数が1,333人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（確認患者1,333人、死亡399人）は継続中であり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: エボラは高い致死率を持つクラス1病原体。DRCは5月中旬にアウトブレイクを宣言。コミュニティ感染、人口移動、限定的なアクセスが対応の課題。国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 transmission rises as gov't steps up vaccinations at care homes
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 transmission is rising as authorities mobilize vaccination in nearly 50 elderly care homes, rehabilitation centers, and day centers using the LP.8.1 vaccine. The shot is described as providing strong protection against current strains, prioritizing the elderly, those with chronic conditions, and the immunocompromised. The SSM notes sustained Covid-19 and influenza activity, with positivity above the 14.5% alert threshold for the past month. The first severe Covid-19 case of the year, a 64-year-old unvaccinated woman, has been reported. Medical teams are redeployed to facilities to vaccinate unvaccinated residents, with antiviral medications prescribed promptly for eligible individuals. At Obra das Mães, 12 residents were vaccinated yesterday; the March round covered 1,227 residents, and vaccination coverage now exceeds 70%, mainly frail elderly with comorbidities. A school cluster yielded 22 positive rapid tests; all are stable. Health Chief Alvis Lo previously said vaccination isn’t necessary for the public, but urged protection for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の感染が上昇、政府が高齢者ケアホームでのワクチン接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とインフルエンザの持続的な活動が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で異常性と長期曝露が認められるが、記事サマリーでは致命的な新規脅威の出現ではなく、既知疾患の継続的管理と評価される。社会政治的関心の程度が記事から直接には不明であるため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: マカオは香港同様、中国（China ID: 1814991）に含めるとの指示に従い、マカオ特別行政区は検証済みロケーション上で中国として統合。記事はマカオの高齢者施設におけるCOVID-19とインフルエンザの継続活動を報告。陽性率が14.5%のアラート閾値を超えており、学校でのクラスター（22件の陽性）が報告されている。ただし、重症例は1件（64歳未接種女性）と限定的。既知病原体の周期的活動であり、国内の感染症管理の枠組み内で対応中。国際的な懸念よりもマカオ・中国の地域的な公衆衛生対応の事例と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Sampel Telat Diambil, Anjing yang Serang 3 Anak di Buleleng Tak Bisa Dipastikan Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Late samples taken, the dog that attacked three children in Buleleng cannot be confirmed to have rabies.
article.articleSummary: Three children were attacked by a dog in Jalak Putih neighborhood, Banyuasri, Buleleng, Bali. The incident cannot be scientifically confirmed as rabies because brain-tissue samples could not be tested; laboratory confirmation requires brain tissue analysis within two hours after the dog is euthanized. CCTV footage showed the dog biting the children without provocation, suggesting possible rabies, but the delay in sampling prevents definitive diagnosis. Nevertheless, the Buleleng Regency government is taking precautionary measures by conducting rabies vaccination for animals in the area and designating the locality as a vaccination priority, given the uncertainty about potential contact or further spread. Officials urge pet owners to vaccinate dogs and cats regularly, noting vaccines are available at the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food Security or local extension centers in each district.

triage.headline_ja: 遅れて採取されたサンプル、ブレレンで3人の子どもを攻撃した犬の狂犬病を確認できない
triage.triage_reason: バリ州ブレレンでの犬による3人の子どもへの攻撃事件で、狂犬病の可能性があるが科学的確認ができず、情報が限定的である。地域レベルの予防措置が講じられているが、国家的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響やWHO報告義務の閾値判断には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では狂犬病の確定診断ができていない状況が強調されている。バリ州ブレレンでの単一の犬咬傷事件であり、複数事例の流行状況ではない。地域政府は動物への予防接種と公衆衛生啓発で対応中。狂犬病は人獣共通感染症として国際的な関心事であるが、本事案の国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報で確定診断または追加事例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng tăng nhanh ở Khánh Hòa, bác sĩ khuyến cáo người dân không chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease on the Rise in Khánh Hòa Province, doctors warn residents not to be complacent.
article.articleSummary: 2,937 hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were reported in Khánh Hòa Province, Vietnam, as of 26 June, across 68 outbreaks. Local clusters are most notable in Cam Lâm (207 cases), Diên Điền (116), Tây Nha Trang ward (295), and Bắc Nha Trang ward (193). Several cases are severe (grade 2a–2b) and referred to the Khánh Hòa Infectious Disease Hospital for treatment per national guidelines. The Khánh Hòa CDC is conducting ongoing surveillance, distributing supplies and disinfectants, and training frontline staff; communication campaigns encourage prevention. Emphasis is placed on environments with many children — nurseries and kindergartens — with coordinated actions to sanitize toys, equipment, and classrooms. Parents of children under 6 are urged to practice handwashing and avoid adults pre-chewing food for children; prompt medical evaluation is advised for fever, irritability, or oral/mucosal lesions. Most mild cases are managed outpatient with adherence to medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ハンドフット・アンドマウス病がカイン・ホア省で急増、医師が住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのカイン・ホア省でエンテロウイルス71による手足口病が2,937例報告されており、複数の地域クラスター形成と重症例（Grade 2a-2b）の発生が確認されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、公衆衛生的インパクトと異常性が明確。
triage.notes: エンテロウイルス71はアジア太平洋地域で周期的に流行する重要な病原体。68件のアウトブレイク、複数の地域クラスター、重症例の報告、および自治体による積極的なサーベイランスと対応が実施されていることが確認された。子ども（6歳以下）の多い施設（保育園・幼稚園）での環境対策も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan officiel s'établit à 1 333 cas confirmés et 399 décès au 29 juin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the official tally stands at 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths as of June 29.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths as of June 29, in the seventeenth outbreak there. Lethality stands at 29.7%. There are 609 patients under care and 189 recovered; contact follow-up across three affected provinces is 82.7%. Data were updated after revalidation and harmonization of the DHIS2 database. On June 29, 26 new confirmed cases were detected in Ituri and North Kivu, with 9 new recoveries. Ituri remains the epicenter with 23 health zones affected, followed by North Kivu with 11 zones; South Kivu has three cases and one death, with no new transmission since May 26. These figures come from the INSP situation report dated June 30. The outbreak is localized to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：2026年6月29日時点で確認例1,333例、死亡者399例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,333確認例、399死亡）で死亡率29.7%の深刻な公衆衛生影響、DRCでの17番目のアウトブレイク発生という異常事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。記事サマリーに基づき実際の発生地はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に入頂。609例の治療中患者、複数州での継続的な新規感染、82.7%の接触追跡により高い管理可能性を示唆。死亡率29.7%は深刻度を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в ДРК достигло 399 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola fever death toll in the DRC has reached 399.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths as of June 29, with 189 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 29.7%. The data come from the DRC Ministry of Communications and Media. The World Health Organization described the situation in DRC and Uganda as extraordinary and posing a danger to other countries, with regional risk assessed as high. Media reports indicate the outbreak could spread to two additional provinces within the DRC. No symptoms, transmission sources, or laboratory details are provided in the report; counts are official tallies. The outbreak represents ongoing international public health concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱の死亡者数が399人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は4つのIHR基準すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的危険性を明示している。WHOが「状況は並外れており他国への危険を呈している」と評価し、地域リスク高と判定。確認症例1,333例、死亡399例の重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの言及があるが（「DRCとウガンダの状況は並外れている」と述べられている）、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。エボラ出血熱は対象国リストに含まれるDRCでの確定された大規模感染であり、WHOが地域的・国際的リスク高と評価。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 1,333
article.articleSummary: 1,333 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 399 deaths per government data dated June 30, 2026. The outbreak, declared May 15, is centered in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Authorities are tracing exposures in two additional provinces, Tshopo and Haut-Uele, amid fears of wider spread. In Ituri's Niania health zone, the body of a pregnant woman who died on June 27 was transported about 300 km to Kisangani in Tshopo, where a morgue sample tested positive for Ebola, triggering expanded contact tracing. Separately, two contacts from Niania fled to Haut-Uele; one tested positive and the other awaiting confirmatory testing. Both have been located and are being returned to Niania as health teams continue tracing across eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ確定患者数が1,333人に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（確定患者1,333人、死亡399人）で、複数州での拡大と国際的リスク懸念があり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最優先シグナル。DRC東部での多地域への拡大（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopo、Haut-Uele）と、葬儀に伴う遺体輸送による新たな地域への波及が確認されている。接触者追跡継続中。国際的な感染拡大リスクは現在のところ限定的だが、公衆衛生上の極めて深刻な状況。Mali（Koulikoro Region）は検出地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでの言及がないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Could Threaten Over Million Livelihoods, Put 300,000 Jobs At Risk, Cost African Economies Up To $3.6 Bn If Crisis Spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has surpassed 1,400 confirmed cases and 350 deaths, with more than 90% of infections centered in Ituri province, a major cross-border trading hub with Uganda. The UN Development Programme (UNDP) warns the crisis could push nearly one million people into poverty, threaten about 300,000 jobs, and cost African economies up to $3.6 billion if the outbreak spreads and regional shocks intensify. Even if contained, the DRC alone could lose over $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs. The situation is already affecting livelihoods, markets, and access to basic goods, with women bearing a disproportionate share of impacts and challenges to education and healthcare services. UNDP is supporting health response and economic recovery in collaboration with authorities, as of July 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行が100万人以上の生計を脅かし、300,000人の雇用を危険にさらし、危機が拡大した場合アフリカ経済に36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、1,400症例350死亡、国際境界での拡大リスク、区域横断的な貿易中心地での発生）。WPROスクリーニング基準も4項目以上該当（異常、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（ウガンダ国境のイトゥリ州で90%以上の感染が集中）での流行が主題。ウガンダは「隣接国」として言及されているが、実際の症例発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州が中心。Bluedot APIはウガンダも発生地域として記載しているが、サマリー上ではウガンダでの確認症例の具体的記述がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）の重症度、感染力、境界地帯での流行という点で全てのリスク基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو... تعقب انتشار إيبولا من جديد بسبب ارتفاع الحصيلة إلى 377 وفاة - اليوم 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo... Ebola outbreak tracked again as death toll rises to 377 - Today 24
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 1,307 laboratory-confirmed cases and 377 deaths, as of 1 July 2026; 615 patients are in treatment and 180 have recovered; case fatality rate 28.8%. Transmission remains concentrated in eastern provinces, especially Ituri, which accounts for over 90% of cases, with North Kivu and South Kivu also affected. The outbreak center involves Ituri’s Nyanya health zone where a pregnant woman died of Ebola; her body was transported 300 km west by motorcycle to Kisangani for an autopsy; the morgue sample confirmed Ebola, elevating cross-regional transmission risk. Two contacts identified in Nyanya fled to Haut-Uele; one tested positive, the other awaiting confirmation; both were found and returned to Nyanya as contact tracing continues. Ongoing efforts focus on rapid laboratory confirmation, infection control, and cross-provincial exposures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ... 死者377人に増加しエボラ拡大を再び追跡 - Today 24
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も全5項目該当。対象国DRCでの現在進行中のエボラ大規模感染症として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ感染症の発生地はDRCの複数州（イトゥリ州90%以上、北キブ州、南キブ州）に確認。死者377人、実験室確認症例1,307例の大規模感染症。イトゥリ州ニャンニャ保健地区から遺体がキサンガニに運ばれ、オートプシーサンプルでエボラ確認され、広域感染拡大リスク増加。南スーダンは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー上では具体的な発生報告がないため対象から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : derrière les 1 333 cas et 399 décès, ce que disent les indicateurs du 29 juin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: beyond 1,333 cases and 399 deaths, what the indicators show as of June 29.
article.articleSummary: As of June 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak has 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths (case fatality 29.7%), per INSP. The rise reflects data-cleaning and DHIS2 harmonization, with delayed-reported cases now included; 26 new cases were recorded on June 29 in Ituri and North Kivu. The CFR and totals reflect Bundibugyo lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; Ervebo protects only Zaïre. WHO notes persistent diagnostic delays and access barriers amid insecurity in the East. There are 189 recoveries and 609 patients in care. Contact tracing stands at 82.7% across three provinces; Ituri has 23 health zones affected, North Kivu 11, while South Kivu has 3 cases and 1 death and no new transmission since May 26. Free care is being offered in four priority Ituri zones to promote early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ熱：1,333例と399例の死亡の背後にある2026年6月29日時点での指標が示すもの
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当（異常性、高い重症度、継続的な曝露、流行しやすさ、管理上の課題）。確認された1,333例、399例の死亡、CFR 29.7%であり、アフリカ地域での大規模エボラ出血熱流行として国際的な保健上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラ出血熱流行。Bundibugyo系統で、Ervebo（ザイール系統用）以外に承認されたワクチンや特定の治療がない。Ituri州23保健区、North Kivu州11保健区が影響を受けており、東部の不安定性により診断遅延とアクセス障害が継続。2026年6月29日時点の情報であり、現在の状況把握にはWHO報告等の最新情報確認が必須。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus symptoms listed as UK hospital thrown into lockdown
article.articleSummary: One suspected Ebola case at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow, Scotland, triggered a lockdown after a patient who had recently returned from an Ebola-affected country developed symptoms. Isolation began Tuesday afternoon; medical tests were conducted and, by Wednesday, officials confirmed the patient tested negative for Ebola. Ebola is a rare but serious disease caused by orthoebolaviruses and spreads through close contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or contaminated materials. The virus was first identified in 1976 during outbreaks in what is now the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Sudan (now South Sudan); there have been sporadic outbreaks, including the large West African epidemic between 2014 and 2016. Imported cases into the UK remain extremely rare. No further cases or deaths reported; the incident emphasizes the low likelihood of UK Ebola cases despite travel-related risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの症状 英国病院がロックダウン
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例は検査で陰性確認され、実際のエボラ発症者は確認されていない。英国への輸入例であり、対象国での発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは英国における疑い例であり、患者は既に陰性確認されている。DRCはサマリー内で歴史的背景（1976年のエボラ初発）として言及されているのみであり、現在の発生地ではない。イベントは主題としてはスコットランド/英国での検査対応に限定されており、シグナルの基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh khống chế thành công ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh successfully contained the Dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province’s health sector and local authorities have contained a dengue fever outbreak in Hoành Sơn Ward, with 22 laboratory-confirmed cases from May 3 to June 14, 2026; the outbreak was officially declared ended on June 30. There were no fatalities. The Hà Tĩnh CDC, Hoành Sơn Ward Health Station, and local government implemented epidemiologic investigations, zoning, and comprehensive vector-control measures, including environmental sanitation, waste collection, removal of standing water containers, larviciding, and targeted mosquito spraying in affected areas and schools. Vector surveillance and daily case monitoring continued under 24/7 readiness, and public awareness campaigns were intensified. Vector indices declined and no new cases were recorded during monitoring, meeting regulatory criteria to end the outbreak. An additional dengue outbreak remains active in Vũng Áng Ward, with ongoing surveillance and control to prevent further spread. Citizens are urged to eliminate standing water, cover water containers, and seek medical care promptly for suspected dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省がデング熱流行の封じ込めに成功
triage.triage_reason: ハティン省はデング熱流行の封じ込めに成功し、2026年6月30日に流行は終了宣言された。死亡者なし、確定症例22件、新規症例なし。地域的かつ管理可能な既知の疾患で、国際的拡大リスク低い。
triage.notes: 記事はハティン省のデング熱流行が既に封じ込められ、終了宣言されたことを報じている。22例の確定症例、死亡者なし、新規症例なし、ベクトル指数の低下を報告。ウングアン地区では別のデング熱流行が継続中とも記載されているが、全体的には既知疾患の通常の地域流行対応であり、シグナルトリアージの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в Конго возросло до 399 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus disease in Congo has risen to 399 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries, according to a Ministry bulletin as of July 1, 2026. The reported case fatality rate is 29.7%. The bulletin notes ongoing transmission within the DRC and across the border into Uganda. WHO representatives have declared the current Ebola situation in the DRC and Uganda an emergency posing a threat to health in other countries. Reuters reports the outbreak could spread to two additional provinces within the DRC. The brief does not provide further details on laboratory confirmation methods or infection sources, but the figures indicate sustained cross-border transmission, underscoring the need for continued surveillance and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の死亡者数が399人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準全5項目該当。WHOが「他国の健康に脅威をもたらす緊急事態」と宣言。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「DRC内での継続的な感染伝播および国境を越えてウガンダへの伝播」と明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない（DRCのみが対象国）。1,333確認症例、399死亡、CFR 29.7%という高い死亡率。WHO緊急宣言あり。DRC内で追加2州への拡大可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : 1.333 cas confirmés, les agences mettent en garde contre les retombées socioéconomiques
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: 1,333 confirmed cases, agencies warn of the socioeconomic fallout.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths. Of these, 609 are in isolation or hospitalized and 189 have recovered; contact tracing in the three affected provinces stands at 82.7%. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, remains active with sustained transmission in several high‑intensity areas. The WHO report notes gains in laboratory capacity, follow‑up, and cross‑border coordination, but warns the response remains insufficient to interrupt transmission quickly, with rising cases and hospital strain and gaps in infection prevention. A case imported to France involved a doctor returning from the RDC; the patient was clinically stable. UNDP warns the crisis could push about 985,000 more Congolese into poverty, with up to $3.6 billion in regional losses. CDC Africa calls for urgent funding to launch therapeutic trials in Bunia, Ituri; vaccines exist neither nor approved treatments. Ten million dollars mobilized; $16 million needed for post‑exposure prophylaxis and $2-3 million for enhanced tracing.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：1,333例の確定患者、国際機関が社会経済的影響を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: フランスへの輸入症例報告あり（医師）。WHO報告で治療法不足、ワクチン未承認を指摘。$16-18百万ドルの追加資金が必要と報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による。Ituri州Buniaでの集中的な流行継続。国際的な支援・資金動員の呼びかけが活発。

article.articleHeadline: 重庆看非结核分枝杆菌感染，为什么推荐找重庆感染科专家刘敏？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Non-tuberculous mycobacterial infection in Chongqing: why consult Liu Min, a Chongqing infectious-disease specialist?
article.articleSummary: Non-tuberculous Mycobacteria (NTM) infections in Chongqing present diagnostic and treatment challenges due to TB-like symptoms. NTM, environmental mycobacteria found in soil, water, and dust, comprises over 200 species; infections can be severe in immunocompromised people (HIV, organ transplant recipients, long-term immunosuppressants). In Chongqing, Liu Min, deputy director of the Infectious Diseases Department at Chongqing Public Health Medical Rescue Center (Gele Mountain Campus), leads a program spanning from precise laboratory diagnostics to individualized therapy. The center's 1300 m2 lab uses GeneXpert and BD960 automated culture and drug-susceptibility testing, with 33 staff; Li Tongxin is a core technologist. Clinically, HIV co-infection requires balancing anti-NTM and antiretroviral therapies, considering drug interactions and IRIS. The team emphasizes a clinical-laboratory collaboration chain: problem identification → exact identification → personalized treatment → feedback optimization. Referral advised for diagnostic uncertainty, poor response to TB therapy, HIV co-infection, resistant NTMs, or extrapulmonary disease.

triage.headline_ja: 重慶における非結核分枝杆菌感染症：なぜ重慶感染症専門医劉敏医師への相談が推奨されるのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は非結核分枝杆菌感染症の診療ガイダンスおよび医療機関の紹介記事であり、新たな感染症アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または公衆衛生上の重大な事象を報告するものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の医療サービス提供者による診療プログラムの紹介であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常発生、または感染症危機を示唆する情報は含まれていない。NTM感染症は環境由来の常在菌であり、HIV患者における重症化リスクは記載されているが、新たな流行状況の報告ではない。Bluedot APIが'Tuberculosis'と'HIV'をタグ付けしているが、記事の主題は診療ガイダンスであり、感染症イベント監視対象としてのシグナル価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra cracks down on unsafe blood banks amid rise in HIV cases, plasma racket
article.articleSummary: HIV infections linked to contaminated transfusions spur Maharashtra’s crackdown on unsafe blood banks. After two Mumbai closures—the Sir J J Metropolitan Blood Centre at JJ Hospital and the Maya Blood Centre in Badlapur—the Maharashtra SBTC ordered audits of all government and private blood centres, with the FDA issuing a stop-work order on the JJ Hospital unit. Inspectors flagged deficiencies in storage and control of blood components, improper handling of reactive and expired bags, biohazard disposal lapses, malfunctioning equipment, and missing sterilisation controls; Badlapur centre showed gaps in transport records, traceability, a transfusion officer, calibrated equipment, quality testing, and biomedical waste management. In May, CDSCO directed 4,200 licensed centres to join a national digital portal to curb HIV infections from transfusions. Gujarat police seized over a thousand units of adulterated plasma; more than 550 of 1,670 units from five Maharashtra banks were spurious. SBTC warned against bulk transfers for profit and possible licence cancellations.

triage.headline_ja: HIV症例の増加の中、マハラシュトラ州が不安全な血液銀行に対する取り締まりを強化、血液製剤の違法取引問題
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染症に関連する血液製剤の汚染による公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な事態（偽造血液製剤・不適切な血液銀行運営）、複数州にわたる拡大傾向が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。重度の管理上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はマハラシュトラ州およびグジャラート州におけるHIV感染と血液製剤の汚染に関する事案。複数の血液銀行の閉鎖、偽造血液製剤の押収（1000以上のユニット）、不適切な血液製剤管理の複数の欠陥が報告されている。政府による全血液センターへの監査命令と国家デジタルポータルへの登録指示が出されており、当局による対応が進行中である。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航・貿易制限リスクは現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: RN segue abaixo da meta de vacinação contra o sarampo - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Norte trails behind the measles vaccination target
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination in Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, remains below the 95% target for the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) at 88.41% and 69.83% for the second dose, with no suspected cases and no virus circulation detected, yet a risk of imported cases persists due to low two-dose coverage. Natal shows 81.82% first-dose and 63.79% second-dose coverage. The state emphasizes broader vaccination across municipalities to prevent reintroduction, including active school outreach and microplanning. Officials warn of import risk given tourism and international flights. Typical measles symptoms include high fever, sore throat, dry cough, runny nose, fatigue, Koplik spots, and a red rash after 3–5 days. Dose zero (6–11 months) is not offered in RN due to no circulation, and is recommended only after three confirmed cases in the São Paulo area. The vaccination program remains ongoing.}

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドノルテ州、麻疹ワクチン接種目標を下回る状態が継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの麻疹ワクチン接種率が目標（95%）を下回っており、輸入症例のリスクが指摘されているが、現在の循環症例なし。情報は主に予防接種戦略に関するもので、アクティブな流行ではない。
triage.notes: サマリーから、現在ブラジル（リオグランデドノルテ州とサンパウロ）で麻疹の疑い症例や循環は報告されていない。懸念は不十分なワクチン接種カバー率（第1回線88.41%、第2回線69.83%）と観光・国際線を通じた輸入症例リスクである。アクティブな流行ではなく、公衆衛生的準備状況の記事と判断される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: تقرير: خضوع شخص يُشتبه في إصابته بفيروس إيبولا للفحص في مستشفي ببريطانيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report: A person suspected of Ebola virus infection is tested at a hospital in Britain.
article.articleSummary: June 30, 2026 – A patient in Britain is undergoing testing for Ebola at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow, after being admitted on Tuesday, BBC reports. The patient is currently undergoing the necessary laboratory tests to determine if Ebola infection is present. If confirmed by laboratory results, this would be Britain's first Ebola case since outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda in May. The BBC report provides no further details on symptoms, travel history, or exposure. No further clinical details are disclosed. The original report is dated June 30, 2026, with publication on July 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 報告: エボラウイルス感染の疑いがある人物がイギリスの病院で検査を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。イギリスでのエボラ疑い患者発見は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、異常かつ予想外であり、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限のリスクがある。DRC/ウガンダでの流行との関連性も確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイギリスの疑い患者についているが、対象国リストではイギリスは含まれていない。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に列挙した。疑い患者の接触源がDRCやウガンダの流行との関連を示唆している。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。追加情報として患者の症状、旅行歴、具体的な接触源が記事に記載されていない点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm màng não do phế cầu có thể trở nặng trong vài giờ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumococcal meningitis can worsen within a few hours.
article.articleSummary: Pneumococcal meningitis can rapidly worsen within hours after fever, cough, or a respiratory infection. In Vietnam, Streptococcus pneumoniae accounts for 86.1% of bacterial meningitis cases in children under five at Children's Hospitals No. 1 and No. 2 during 2012–2021. A 2025 dataset from National Children's Hospital shows about 1 in 11 invasive pneumococcal infections requiring hospitalization ends in death. Pneumococcus colonizes the nasopharynx and can invade the bloodstream to reach the meninges, causing inflammation and raised intracranial pressure. In children, symptoms include severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, lethargy, seizures, or altered consciousness; younger infants may present with irritability, poor feeding, sleepiness, fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or bulging fontanelle. Adults present with rapid onset of fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, and photophobia. Prevention relies on vaccination (PCV13/PCV15/PCV20; PCV23 for ages 2 and older) and hygiene: handwashing, covering the mouth when coughing, avoiding shared utensils, cleaning toys, and keeping living spaces ventilated; ill children should avoid crowds.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌髄膜炎は数時間で悪化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌髄膜炎は既知の疾患であり、ベトナムにおける疫学情報と予防対策についての一般的な医学情報が記事の主体。新規の異常発生イベントや流行の初期段階を示すシグナルではなく、医学教育的な内容と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムにおける肺炎球菌髄膜炎の臨床的特徴と予防対策についての教育的な情報提供。2012-2021年および2025年のデータに基づく疫学情報が含まれるが、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、流行の急速な拡大、または異常な発生パターンを示唆する具体的なシグナルは記事に明示されていない。既知の疾患の重症性と管理についての医学情報として扱われているため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Amid outbreak, Ebola's origins still a mystery
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Congo, detected since April, has grown to more than 1,200 confirmed cases and 360 deaths, ranking as the third-largest epidemic in the disease's 50-year history. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, one of three Ebola species. Scientists favor the view that the virus normally resides in animals and spills over into humans intermittently. Yet after years of searching, researchers have been unable to determine where Bundibugyo hides when it is not infecting people. 'We don't have anything at all about Bundibugyo,' said Mekala Sundaram, ecologist at the University of Georgia. The lack of knowledge leaves humanity vulnerable; Bundibugyo could trigger more outbreaks, and the same is true for other Ebola-causing viruses and related pathogens that have not yet jumped to people.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の発生の中で、エボラウイルスの起源は依然として謎のままである
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。1,200件以上の確定症例と360人の死亡を伴う大規模エボラウイルス感染症の流行であり、フルRRA評価を要する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo種）の確定例1,200件超、死亡360人は過去50年間で3番目の規模。4月以降検出され継続中。動物からのスピルオーバー機構が未解明のため再流行リスク高い。国際的支援および医学的対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго увеличилось до 399
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has risen to 399.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 1,333, with 399 deaths, according to the Congolese Ministry of Health. The outbreak is reported in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with authorities tracing contacts in two provinces not previously affected to curb spread. The DR Congo–Uganda outbreak was first recorded in early May. Officials attribute rapid growth to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no licensed vaccines or therapeutics. Ongoing armed conflict in the eastern region further complicates surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が399人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。確認患者数1,333、死者399人の大規模流行であり、複数州で拡大し、ウガンダへの国際的波及リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC-ウガンダ流行と記載されており、確認患者・死者統計はDRCに限定。対象国リスト内のDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株、武力紛争による対応困難が懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Золотистый стафилококк нашли в мясных чипсах производителя из Приморья
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staphylococcus aureus found in meat chips from a Primorye manufacturer.
article.articleSummary: Staphylococcus aureus (golden staph) detected in a 10 kg batch of meat chips made from cured pork at a Primorsky Krai (Primorye) manufacturer, according to the Primorye branch of APK NACR YBA under Rosselkhoznadzor. Veterinary inspectors sampled the batch during internal quality checks; 24 microbiological, organoleptic and other indicators were evaluated, and labs confirmed S. aureus, a highly hazardous cause of severe food poisoning. The non-conforming batch will be disposed of. This marks the first 2026 detection of golden S. aureus in meat products by the Primorye branch. The article recalls prior 2026 incidents: a 27-ton batch of imported chicken drumsticks from China in Vladivostok failed microbiological control with Salmonella detected; separate Primorsky producer’s products yielded E. coli (shishkebab). Overall, seven pathogen detections in meat semi-finished products have occurred since early 2026.

triage.headline_ja: プリモルスキー地方の製造業者による肉チップスから黄色ブドウ球菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 検出されたのは食品製品の単一バッチ内の黄色ブドウ球菌（S. aureus）であり、既に廃棄処分対象となっている。チフス・パラチフス・大腸菌は記事の歴史的背景として言及されているのみで、現在のイベントではない。国際的な拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染による流行リスクは極めて低い。
triage.notes: 記事の疾患名フィールドにはParatyphoid、E. coli、Typhoidが列挙されているが、実際の記事サマリーで現在のイベントとして報告されているのはStaphylococcus aureusの検出のみである。過去の2026年の事例として他の病原体（Salmonella、E. coli）が言及されているが、これらは比較対照であり、本イベントの主題ではない。発生地はロシア（プリモルスキー地方・ウラジオストク）であり、評価対象の11ヶ国（GeoNames IDで指定）に含まれない。中国からのインポート製品への言及がありますが、検出されたのはロシア国内での食品検査結果であり、中国での感染症発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dataiku dukung prediksi bencana dan wabah dengan AI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dataiku supports predictions of disasters and outbreaks with AI.
article.articleSummary: Dataiku and Singapore Red Cross (SRC) join under Dataiku's AI-for-Good program to enhance disaster response and public health preparedness in Southeast Asia. Dataiku provides access to its AI platform and pro bono support from data scientists and engineers to SRC's Humanitarian Innovation and Technology team, enabling data-driven decisions. Automating disaster monitoring across Southeast Asia replaces labor-intensive data collection with an integrated workflow that combines weather and climate data for improved risk assessment and response planning. The collaboration also applies a machine-learning model trained on environmental and weather data to predict leptospirosis outbreaks in Thailand, guiding earlier interventions and resource mobilization. The effort aims to shift from reactive to more proactive decision-making, accelerating timely aid distribution and strengthening community resilience against disasters and health crises.

triage.headline_ja: Dataikuは人工知能を使用した災害と流行の予測を支援
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の予測モデル開発に関する記事だが、実際の発生報告ではなく、予測ツールの実装プロジェクトに関する内容である。実際の患者発生や流行状況の報告がなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はDataikuとシンガポール赤十字が東南アジアにおける災害・感染症予測のための機械学習モデルを開発する協力関係に関するもの。タイでのレプトスピラ症予測モデルの適用が言及されているが、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、予測ツールの実装に関する報道である。シンガポール（対象国外）も発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーではタイのみがレプトスピラ症との関連で記述されている。続報で実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- Aumentan a cerca de 400 los muertos por ébola en RDC, con...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC - Ebola deaths rise to nearly 400 in DR Congo, with...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with nearly 400 deaths and over 1,300 confirmed cases since mid-May in the northeast. As of June 29, 2026, the country reports 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases, 399 deaths, 189 recoveries, and 609 patients in treatment. Since the last update, 26 new cases and 9 recoveries were recorded, yielding a case fatality rate of 29.7%. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, where intensified surveillance and community mobilization are underway. A June 20, 2026, photo shows an Ebola patient being escorted to a treatment center in Mongbwalu, Ituri. The Democratic Republic of the Congo, which declared the end of its last Ebola outbreak in Kasai in December 2025, has extensive experience with the virus, first identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River. No imported/exported cases are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ出血熱による死者が400人近くに増加、確認患者数は1,300人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者1,333人、死亡399人という大規模流行がDRCで継続中。IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも複数項目が該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を要する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。DRCは2025年12月のカサイ州での流行終息を宣言したばかりだが、2026年5月中旬からイトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で新規流行が発生。1,333人の確認患者、399人の死亡（CFR 29.7%）という深刻な状況。国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性あり。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Funding delays threaten Ebola clinical trials
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, Africa CDC warned that delays in financing critical Ebola clinical trials could hamper efforts to contain the rapidly expanding outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). An urgent USD 18 million funding gap jeopardizes key elements of the emergency response, including trial activities and access to vaccines and therapeutics. The warning comes days after global health partners unveiled an ambitious strategy to ensure vaccines and treatments for rare Ebola strains are developed before rather than during future outbreaks, aiming to shorten response times and bolster preparedness. Without prompt funding, progress on evaluating candidate vaccines and therapeutics and rapid deployment could be hindered, potentially allowing transmission to continue in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 資金不足がエボラ臨床試験を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは極めて高い死亡率を持つため公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確（IHR基準1つ目）。DRCでの急速な拡大流行が報告されており国際的拡大リスクが存在（IHR基準3つ目）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理能力の低さが複数該当し、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの急速な拡大エボラ流行、資金不足による臨床試験への影響、ワクチン・治療薬へのアクセス阻害を報告。Africa CDCの公式警告を引用しており信頼性が高い。IHR基準とWPRO基準ともに全項目該当する最高リスクシグナル。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan a cerca de 400 los muertos por ébola en RDC, con más de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the DRC rises to around 400, with more than ....
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues since mid-May in the northeast, with about 400 deaths and more than 1,300 confirmed cases. As of 29 June 2026, the DRC Ministry of Communications reports 1,333 confirmed cases, 399 deaths, 189 recoveries, and 609 patients in treatment. The epidemic is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with reinforced care, surveillance, and community mobilization in those provinces. The case fatality rate is about 29.7%. The country, which declared the end of its previous Ebola outbreak in Kasai in December 2025, remains among the most experienced responders to Ebola, first identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River. No infection source or imported/exported case details are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が約400人に増加、確認患者数が1,300人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、400人の死亡、1,300人以上の確認患者という規模は直ちにフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO・CEPRの最優先監視疾患。2025年12月にカサイ地域の流行終息宣言から6ヶ月以内に新規大規模流行が発生。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州での多点発生。症例致死率29.7%。DRC保健当局は対応経験あるも国際支援が必要。直ちにフルRASに進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК выросло до 399
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the DRC has risen to 399.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,333 confirmed cases, 399 deaths, and 189 recoveries, with a reported fatality rate of 28.7%. The National Institute of Public Health noted on June 27 that deaths reached 360, with Ituri Province remaining the epicenter, accounting for 91.4% of cases and 83.6% of fatalities. The European Union is providing €493 million to combat the outbreak, including frontline medical response, humanitarian aid in the Great Lakes region and Uganda, vaccine and therapeutics research, and long-term health-system readiness. The article also references sensational claims that the outbreak could spread to Europe and the UAE within 30 days, and that 65% of infected individuals might be able to travel on international flights from Congo and Uganda despite controls.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ熱の死亡者数が399人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。EUの大規模支援投入と国際的な関心の高さから、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはオーストラリア、UAE、ウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCが主要な発生地であり、他国への拡大リスク（sensational claims）については未確認段階。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。記事配信日は2026年7月1日（未来日付、テスト環境と推定）。

article.articleHeadline: طبيبٌ ينقلُ "إيبولا"... فما التّدابير في لبنان؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor transmits Ebola... what measures are in place in Lebanon?
article.articleSummary: Lebanon has reinforced Ebola surveillance and border controls after news that a doctor transmitted Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to France. Measures, aligned with WHO guidance, include banning entry of non-Lebanese travelers from DRC and Uganda during outbreaks, enhanced health checks for arrivals from affected countries, and a clear protocol for suspected cases: pre-arrival reporting of symptomatic passengers, immediate transfer to airport quarantine, and coordination with the Lebanese Red Cross to move confirmed/suspected patients to facilities. No Ebola cases have been reported in Lebanon. Travelers must complete electronic forms before arrival; airlines must notify authorities; arrivals undergo health screening and 21-day monitoring after return. Hotline 1787 is provided. The procedures are regularly updated with WHO status and aim to prevent importation while maintaining vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がエボラを伝播...レバノンではどんな対策が講じられているのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC→フランス）が確認され、複数国への波及リスクが高い。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCからフランスへの医師経由の伝播が主要な事象。レバノン、ウガンダはリスク軽減措置を講じている国として言及されるが、実際の感染事例報告はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみが該当。フランスはWPRO対象外のため検証地域から除外。本イベントは国際的なエボラ集団発生の新展開であり、2次以上の拡大リスク評価が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dataiku Gandeng Palang Merah Singapura, Manfaatkan AI untuk Percepat Respons Bencana dan Prediksi Wabah di Asia Tenggara - Industry.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dataiku Teams Up with the Singapore Red Cross, Leveraging AI to Accelerate Disaster Response and Predict Disease Outbreaks in Southeast Asia
article.articleSummary: Dataiku and Singapore Red Cross have teamed to strengthen disaster response and health preparedness in Southeast Asia by applying AI-for-Good, notably to improve predictions of leptospirosis outbreaks in Thailand. Dataiku provides full access to its AI platform to SRC's Humanitarian Innovation and Technology team, with pro bono data science and engineering support. The collaboration automates disaster monitoring that previously relied on manual data collection, cleaning, and consolidation, reducing processing time and data inconsistencies, and enhances data quality and analysis by incorporating climate trends and weather patterns. The AI system supports faster, more accurate decision-making and better resource planning during events. In health, the model forecasts leptospirosis spread — a waterborne disease endemic in Thailand — enabling early interventions for high-risk communities. Dataiku's AI-for-Good program, launched in 2019, aims to scale impact for nonprofits across the region.

triage.headline_ja: Dataikuがシンガポール赤十字と提携、AIを活用して東南アジアの災害対応と感染症流行予測を加速
triage.triage_reason: 記事はレプトスピラ症予測システムの開発・協力に関する技術パートナーシップの発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく、災害対応と疫学予測ツール導入の報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する具体的な公衆衛生上の危機を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はDataikuとシンガポール赤十字による協力協定であり、レプトスピラ症の流行そのものではなく、予測モデル開発のための技術提携について述べている。シンガポール（1880251）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため、参考情報として記載した。ただし本記事は感染症イベントのシグナル検出対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mandaluyong's Greenfield District maintains sanitation protocols amid nearby mpox case
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed near Greenfield District, Mandaluyong City, Philippines. As of June 30, 2026, Greenfield District maintains enhanced cleaning after the adjacent condominium reported a confirmed mpox case; the property management and local health authorities are coordinating, with contact tracing and monitoring of close contacts already conducted. Earlier in the week, Avida Towers Centera circulated a memo about a confirmed mpox case in Tower 4. The country had no mpox cases reported earlier this year; the last headlines were June 2025. Mpox spreads primarily through close contact and is not typically airborne; common symptoms include a rash lasting two to four weeks, fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue and swollen lymph nodes. Prevention includes handwashing, alcohol sanitizers, avoiding contact with the infected's rash, and avoiding close contact with unwell individuals.

triage.headline_ja: マンダルヨン市グリーンフィールド地区がMpox患者の発生近隣で衛生プロトコルを維持
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでMpoxが確認され、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性が該当。年初以降報告がなかった国での新規事例であり、スクリーニング基準の異常性・管理可能性も該当。社会的関心が現地メディアで報道されており、接触者追跡が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月のシナリオ設定。フィリピンは年初以降Mpox報告がなく、最後の報告は2025年6月。現在、マンダルヨン市内の隣接するコンドミニアムで確認された事例。接触者追跡と監視が進行中。ヒト-ヒト感染性があり、疫学的価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases rise to 1,333 as agencies warn of wider socioeconomic fallout
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo virus) totals 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 609 patients in isolation or hospitalised and 189 recovered. Contact follow-up is 82.7% across three affected provinces, as transmission persists in several hotspots, including Ituri Province’s Bunia epicenter. Despite gains—decentralized laboratories, expanded treatment capacity, and stronger cross-border coordination—the response remains below what is needed to interrupt transmission rapidly, with near-saturation of facilities and gaps in infection prevention and control. Beyond health, UNDP warns the crisis could push 985,000 into poverty, disrupt education and health services, and shave GDP by over $1 billion, potentially reaching $3.6 billion with broader shocks. Africa CDC urges funding for therapeutic trials; Bunia hosts trials for Bundibugyo strain, with $10M secured for therapeutics, seeking $16M for post-exposure prophylaxis and $2–3M to boost tracing. Cross-border risks persist.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ患者数が1,333人に増加、機関が広範な社会経済的影響に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、1,333確定患者と399死亡は異常かつ深刻。国際的な拡大リスク（越境感染）が明示されており、渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）の継続的な流行。患者数1,333人、死亡399人は極めて深刻。複数州で伝播が続いており、特にIturi州Buniaがエピセンター。施設の飽和、感染管理のギャップ、越境リスク継続。国連開発計画が985,000人の貧困化を警告。Africa CDCが治療薬試験資金を要求。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo deja cerca de 400 muertos y más de 1.300 contagios en seis semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo leaves nearly 400 dead and more than 1,300 infections in six weeks.
article.articleSummary: Over six weeks, the Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 399 deaths among 1,333 confirmed cases, with 609 patients in treatment and 189 recovered, as of June 29. The epidemic is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 26 new infections and 9 new discharges reported in the latest day. The case fatality rate is 29.7%. The DRC—long the most experienced country in Ebola response—has strengthened hospital care, enhanced epidemiological surveillance, and intensified community mobilization to detect cases early and limit transmission. The outbreak follows the region’s persistent challenge of Ebola since its 1976 identification, with Yambuku among the origin sites; mere months after Kasai’s outbreak ended in December 2025, the country faces continued health-system strain. Transmission mainly occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected or deceased persons.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、6週間で約400人の死亡と1,300人以上の感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響（400死亡、1,333確認症例）、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示唆する。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスクの病原体。6週間で400死亡、CFR 29.7%、確認症例1,333、609人が治療中。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州に集中。DRCは過去のエボラ対応経験が豊富だが、Kasaiの流行終息からわずか数ヶ月での再発生。国際的な関心と支援が必要。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | الكونغو الديمقراطية تحظر التجمعات بداعي مكافحة انتشار إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo bans gatherings in an effort to curb the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Public gatherings are banned in Kinshasa and three other provinces to curb the Ebola outbreak in the north‑east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Interior Minister Shabani ordered the measure as the country confronts its 17th Ebola outbreak, with government data showing 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, though humanitarian workers warn the true toll may be higher. Kinshasa, a city of over 17 million, has reported no infections to date. The ban precedes an opposition rally planned for July 8 over perceived attempts to extend President Tshisekedi’s rule. Earlier protests on June 12 were suppressed, and the U.N. rights office condemned at least one fatality, highlighting civil tensions while authorities emphasize public health efforts to contain Ebola in the northeast.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染拡大抑制を名目に集会を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（重大な公衆衛生上の脅威）の発生であり、IHR基準において深刻な影響（1,333確定患者、399死亡）と国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスクが認められ、4基準中3つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は17番目のエボラ流行に関するもの。北東部での主要な発生区域に加え、キンシャサを含む複数州で集会禁止措置が発令されている。政府公式統計では1,333確定患者、399死亡だが、人道支援労働者は実数がより高い可能性を警告している。国際的支援・懸念レベルは高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Негативен се оказа тестът за ебола на пациент в болница в Шотландия
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola test for a patient in a hospital in Scotland turned out negative.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-01, Ebola test for a patient at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital, Glasgow, Scotland, returned negative; health officials isolated part of the emergency department to prevent potential spread if positive. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in Scotland or the United Kingdom. The only confirmed European case was in France. Globally, outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with more than 700 laboratory-confirmed cases of the novel deadly Ebola strain and 138 deaths reported in the two African nations to date. The precautionary isolation illustrates ongoing hospital infection-control vigilance amid ongoing transmission in Africa and ongoing public health monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: スコットランドの病院の患者のエボラ検査が陰性に
triage.triage_reason: スコットランドの患者検査は陰性であるため直接的な脅威ではないが、アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での活発な流行により国際的拡大リスクが存在。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 本件はスコットランドの検査は陰性で直接的な新規症例ではないが、アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での700例以上の確定症例と138死亡が報告されている。IHR基準2つ該当、WPRO基準4つ該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただしスコットランドは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国に該当するため含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में बढ़ सकता है डेंगू, मलेरिया और चिकनगुनिया का खतरा; डॉक्टरों से जानिए बचाव के आसान और सटीक तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon may increase the risk of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya; doctors share easy and accurate ways to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in India heightens the risk of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya as water-logging and contaminated food accelerate mosquito breeding and pathogen spread. Dr. Sonia Rawat of Sir Ganga Ram Hospital stresses that fever with chills, body pains, weakness, or persistent headache after monsoon exposure should prompt medical evaluation rather than being dismissed as a viral flu. Prevention focuses on eliminating standing water around homes, wearing long sleeves, using repellents, and sleeping under mosquito nets. Drink only clean water, boiled or filtered. Maintain food hygiene by washing fruits and vegetables and avoiding street foods. Practice thorough handwashing (20 seconds) before meals, after using the toilet, and on returning home. Vaccination for Hepatitis A and Typhoid is advised where indicated. Avoid walking in floodwater due to leptospirosis risk, and seek care if high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or jaundice occurs.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期間中にデング熱、マラリア、チクングニアのリスクが増加する可能性があります。医師からの簡単で正確な予防法を学びましょう。
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア）と水系感染症（レプトスピラ症、A型肝炎、腸チフス）について、モンスーン期のリスク増加を扱う予防啓発記事。イベント確認というより医学的ガイダンス記事であり、具体的な患者数や新規発生の報告がないため、情報不足のため要経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイク事象ではなく、モンスーン季節に伴うリスク増加に対する医学的予防啓発。具体的な患者数、新規感染ケース、異常な増加傾向の報告がないため、シグナル（PICKUP）ではなく継続監視（WATCH）とした。ただしインドの複数媒介感染症は流行季節性が高いため、今後具体的な患者数や新規クラスター報告があれば即座にPICKUPへ昇格すべき。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Rumah sakit di Glasgow selidiki kasus dugaan Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A hospital in Glasgow investigates an alleged Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case is under investigation at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow after a patient admitted late June 30 was tested for Ebola. The patient had recently returned to Glasgow from an Ebola-affected country. The hospital’s Emergency Reception Unit was closed and isolated as precautionary measures to protect staff and the public, while officials have not confirmed a diagnosis. If confirmed, it would be the United Kingdom’s first Ebola case since the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted a WHO health emergency. The DRC outbreak, centered in Ituri Province in the eastern region, has spread to neighboring areas and prompted increased surveillance in Uganda. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, and transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. France has reported an imported Ebola case from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴーの病院がエボラウイルスの疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ワクチン無しのBundibugyo株による多国間での流行と、英国初の疑い例として高い社会的・政治的関心が想定される。
triage.notes: グラスゴー（英国）とウガンダはサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国かつ記事の中心（流行の発生地、Ituri Province の報告、Bundibugyo株）として確認される。フランスの輸入例はDRCからの輸入であり、記事の副次的情報。スクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当し、IHR基準4項目全て該当する高リスクシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: PBB Peringatkan Wabah Ebola Dapat Mendorong Hampir Satu Juta Orang ke Kemiskinan di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Warns Ebola Outbreak Could Push Almost One Million People into Poverty in the Congo
article.articleSummary: UNDP warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could push nearly one million more people into poverty. From Kinshasa, UNDP Permanent Representative Damien Mama said more than 1,400 cases and 350 deaths have been confirmed in the DRC and Uganda through the week ending 1 July 2026, with over 90% of confirmed cases centered in Ituri province, a major cross-border trade hub. The outbreak poses a broader economic threat: Africa could lose about $3.6 billion in GDP and over 300,000 livelihoods; the DRC could lose more than $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs, even if contained. The continent's GDP could shrink by roughly $2.37 billion. Some families have already violated isolation measures amid mounting economic pressures, underscoring that medical response alone may be insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行がほぼ100万人を貧困に追い込む可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を示し、DRCとウガンダで既に確認されており、国際的警戒が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク感染症。DRC（Ituri州中心）で1,400例以上、350死亡が確認されており、ウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。隔離措置違反が報告されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。UNDP等国連機関による警告も発出されており、国際的な注視が集まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Expanded PhilHealth coverage for leptospirosis to begin on July 15
article.articleSummary: Philippines: PhilHealth expands leptospirosis benefit package ahead of the rainy season, with implementation on July 15, 2026. Eligible patients can receive up to P63,000 for hospital care, P170,000 for hemodialysis, and P230,000 for peritoneal dialysis, totaling up to P411,000 for those needing combinations such as hemodialysis, mechanical ventilation, and pulmonary rehabilitation. Leptospirosis is a bacterial disease caused by Leptospira, transmitted via water or soil contaminated by urine of infected animals (rats, dogs, livestock). DOH reported a 6% rise in cases from January 4 to June 6, 2026, with 2,177 total. The initiative aligns with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.'s directive to keep healthcare accessible and affordable. The rainy season is a key risk period in the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健省、レプトスピラ症の保障拡大を7月15日から開始
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで確認されたレプトスピラ症患者数増加（6%上昇、2,177例）は単独では国際的脅威の閾値に達しないが、雨季前の対策強化と患者数の増加傾向は経過観察の価値がある。情報不足が多いため判定が保守的となる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は保険カバレッジの拡大政策であり、疾病の流行状況の詳細（重症度、致命率、新規患者の詳細）は不明。雨季における長期曝露リスク（水・土壌経由の感染）と流行性について評価された。フィリピン政府の対応継続状況を監視する必要がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK tests for Ebola amid Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: UK screens Ebola as central Africa's Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, with Congo and Uganda reporting nearly 1,300 infections and over 360 deaths; one case outside the region has been a French doctor in Congo. In Glasgow, a patient arrived June 30 at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital for Ebola testing; Public Health Scotland says there are no confirmed UK cases and the public risk remains low. If confirmed, it would be the United Kingdom’s first Ebola case during the current DRC outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatments, fueling rapid research for therapy. Officials have struggled to trace contacts and contain spread amid insecurity, hunger, conflict, and weak disease surveillance in affected areas; UK hospital procedures are in place to detect and manage such cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのアウトブレイクを受けて英国がエボラをテスト
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の中央アフリカにおける大規模アウトブレイク（1,300例以上、360人以上の死亡）が進行中であり、複数のIHR基準を満たしている。英国での疑い症例出現は国際的な懸念を示唆している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストにはGlasgow、Scotland、UK、Franceが含まれているが、記事サマリーの詳細な読解により、実際の大規模アウトブレイク発生地はDRCおよびウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。英国の疑い症例は検査段階であり確定していない。DRCの事例が対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国机构警告刚果（金）埃博拉疫情将冲击地区经济
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN agencies warn that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo will hit the region's economy
article.articleSummary: On June 30, 2026, UNDP and WHO warned that the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak is accelerating beyond current response capacity, with active transmission across multiple provinces and a response level below what is needed to halt spread. As of June 30, cumulative confirmed cases reached 1,333 with 399 deaths; 609 patients remain in isolation or treatment, and 189 have recovered. Africa CDC urged urgent funding to advance clinical trials of candidate therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, set to begin this week in Ituri Province’s capital Bunia, the outbreak’s epicenter. UNDP estimated the crisis could push 985,000 people into poverty and potentially cost the Africa region up to $3.6 billion. Congolese President Tshisekedi announced a $319 million comprehensive outbreak response plan and mobilized initial funds on June 29.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関が警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は地域経済に打撃を与える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病の活発な流行で、複数州での継続的伝播、高い死亡率、国際的な対応要請が確認される。
triage.notes: 確定症例1,333件、死亡399件（致命率約30%）、複数州での活発な伝播報告。国連機関（UNDP、WHO、Africa CDC）が緊急対応と国際的支援を要請。大統領も対応計画を発表。Bundibugyo-type ebolavirus（第4種）の臨床試験が開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: Châu Phi thiết lập cơ chế điều phối chung chống dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa establishes a joint coordinating mechanism to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Africa launches the Incident Management Support Team (IMST) to coordinate Ebola response amid Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and spillover risk to Uganda and neighboring states. The IMST, unveiled at Makerere University in Kampala by Africa CDC, WHO, and Uganda government, provides unified leadership with a 'one team, one plan, one budget' framework to offer technical oversight, surveillance, testing, case management, infection prevention, logistics, risk communication, information management, and partner coordination. It aims to support DRC and Uganda and border countries to strengthen cross-border readiness. Separately, UN warns the epidemic could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and threaten hundreds of thousands of jobs, risking a regional development crisis. Since May 15, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus has infected 1,307 people and caused 377 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports a few cases. WHO tests MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir in DRC to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカがエボラ流行に対抗するための統一調整メカニズムを確立
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率と地域的脅威を呈し、アフリカ的地域調整機構の確立は国際関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのBundibugyo Ebolaウイルス流行（1,307人感染、377人死亡）とウガンダへの流出リスクに焦点。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。アフリカCDC、WHO、ウガンダ政府が主導する統一調整機構（IMST）の立ち上げは地域的対応強化の重要な施策。経済的影響（36億ドル）と失業リスクも指摘。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 1333
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: confirmed Ebola cases rise to 1,333.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, government data report Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rising to 1,333 confirmed cases, with 399 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The report provides no additional details on symptoms, transmission chains, laboratory confirmation methods, or infection sources. The figures indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak affecting communities in these three provinces. The update underscores the sustained burden on local health authorities and the need for continued surveillance, case management, and infection prevention and control measures in eastern DRC. No information on imported or exported cases is given in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルス確定症例が1,333件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なアウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルスの進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（1,333確定症例、399死亡）は最高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: 2026年7月1日時点のエボラウイルス確定症例数1,333件、死亡399件は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。東部州（Ituri、South Kivu地域）での集中発生。高い致死率（約30%）と複数地域での流行継続は国境を越えた拡大リスクを示唆。国際的な支援体制と監視強化が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Châu Phi thiết lập cơ chế điều phối chung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Africa establishes a common coordinating mechanism.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, Africa launches the Incident Management Support Team (IMST) to strengthen coordination for the Ebola outbreak. The initiative, unveiled at Makerere University in Kampala, Uganda, is led by Africa CDC, the World Health Organization, and the Ugandan government. IMST will provide integrated technical support, coordinate operations, and mobilize multidisciplinary experts to assist Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and neighboring countries at risk from Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Based on the 'one team, one plan, one budget' principle, it brings in specialists in epidemiology, diagnostics, case management, infection prevention and control, emergency logistics, risk communication, information management, and coordination. The platform aims to boost continental readiness, cross-border cooperation, and sustained outbreak response, with country-led action at its core. Separately, on 30 June, the United Nations warned the Ebola outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and threaten hundreds of thousands of jobs, risking a regional development crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：アフリカが共通調整メカニズムを確立
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地域拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5つ全て該当。複数国での同時発生、国際支援体制構築、大規模な経済的影響が報告されている。フルRRAに進むべき高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による多国間アウトブレイク。Africa CDC、WHO、ウガンダ政府主導の統合支援メカニズムが発足。国連により経済的影響が36億ドルに達する可能性が警告されている。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、DRCのみが対象国として確認できるが、記事の主題はウガンダでの発生・対応にも重点があるため両国を verified_locations に列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو والسلطات تكثف جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases in the Congo as authorities intensify containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: 1,333 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases with 399 deaths were reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to government data issued on Tuesday. The outbreak is centered in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where authorities are intensifying containment efforts to curb transmission. The report notes ongoing transmission across multiple eastern provinces, but provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation procedures, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The data underscore a sustained escalation of EVD in the region, highlighting continued surveillance and public health response needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数増加、当局が封じ込め努力を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる大規模・致命的な集団発生（1,333確認例、399死亡）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。複数州での継続的な伝播と当局の集中的対応により、WPRO基準も全項目で該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高致死性（CFR約30%、現在は約30%）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州における複数地点での継続的伝播と、当局による集中的な封じ込め努力が報告されている。国際的な公衆衛生懸念事項として最高レベルのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果、烏干達伊波拉疫情未歇　疾管署：4機場「免費採檢」至8／30
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda show no signs of abating; Taiwan CDC: Free testing at four airports until August 30.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda persist, with Taiwan’s CDC extending free voluntary testing for asymptomatic travelers returning from DRC or Uganda to August 30 at Taipei Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung airports. As of June 27, DRC reports 1,274 confirmed cases, 360 deaths, 178 recoveries; Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected (1,165; 106; 3 cases respectively) across 35 health zones, with ongoing spread. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, 15 recoveries, mainly in Kampala and Wakiso, linked to cross-border movement and medical exposure; no community transmission yet. France reports an imported case from DRC, patient stable, five contacts traced. WHO risk: DRC very high; Uganda high; other regions low. Measures include border controls, Level 3 travel warnings, and 21-day health management for returnees. Free airport testing offered; 20 travelers with exposure complied, 6 tested (4 negative, 2 pending); 1922 hotline available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダのエボラ疫情未だ終息せず　台湾疾病管理署：4空港で8月30日まで「無料検査」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、既に複数国での患者発生と国際的な対応体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は既知の重大感染症。DRCで1,274確認患者（360死亡）、ウガンダで20確認患者（2死亡）、フランスで輸入症例1例が報告されている。複数国での同時流行、国際的な症例輸出、各国の積極的な対応（台湾でのスクリーニング強化など）が確認される。対象国リスト内ではDRCとウガンダが該当；台湾での対応は言及されているが台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱の流行、アフリカの損失最大36億ドルの恐れ＝ＵＮＤＰ試算
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion, UNDP estimates.
article.articleSummary: UNDP’s June 30 report warns the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola could trigger Africa-wide development losses up to $3.6 billion and cost hundreds of thousands of jobs. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded 1,307 infections and 377 deaths; Uganda has also reported cases. Experts fear spread to South Sudan and other neighbors (Rwanda, Angola) is possible. There are no proven effective vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola. UNDP Congo Representative Damien Mama urged rapid containment to avert deeper regional and continental impacts. The report outlines three scenarios: best case—containment in Congo with about $1 billion GDP loss; worst case—spread to additional countries causing Africa-wide GDP decline of $3.6 billion and about 328,000 jobs lost.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行、アフリカの損失最大36億ドルの恐れ＝ＵＮＤＰ試算
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラの多国感染、高い死亡率、有効治療薬なし、さらなる地域拡大の懸念があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはAngola（GeoNames ID 3351879）、Rwanda（49518）、Uganda（226074）、Sudan（366755）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主たる発生地がDRCであり、他国への拡大は「懸念」または「可能性」の段階。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は希少で毒性が高く、有効なワクチン・治療薬がない点で極めて重大。UNDPによる公式な経済影響評価が報告されており、政治的・国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo deja ya cerca de 400 muertos y más de 1.300 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed nearly 400 lives and more than 1,300 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths (case fatality rate 29.7%), with 189 recovered and 609 in treatment. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, with 26 new infections and 9 recoveries reported recently. Authorities are intensifying surveillance, healthcare, and community mobilization, continuing contact tracing, diagnostics, and treatment to curb transmission. The DRC has long experience with Ebola, dating back to the 1976 first identified outbreak near the Ebola River in Yambuku. The country had declared the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025 before this northeast episode emerged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、既に約400人の死者と1,300人以上の確定症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、1,333確定症例・399死亡は深刻な影響を示す。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが存在し、迅速なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高水準の公衆衛生脅威。記事サマリーは2026年6月29日時点で1,333確定症例、399死亡、致死率29.7%を報告。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu各州に集中しているが継続的な監視と対策が進行中。DRC内での歴史的な流行経験（1976年Yambuku）があるも、新興株系統による現在の流行は懸念される。国際的支援・監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: گسترش احتمالی ابولا به دو ولایت جدید در کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Probable spread of Ebola to two new provinces in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 1,307 cases and 377 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. In Ituri’s Nyania Health Zone, a pregnant woman became ill on June 18 and died June 27; her body was transported by motorcycle about 300 km to Kisangani in neighboring Tshopo Province. Cadaver sampling in a morgue tested positive for Ebola, prompting expanded contact tracing in Tshopo. Separately, two Nyania contacts in quarantine escaped to Haut-Uele; one tested positive and the other awaits results. Both individuals were located and returned to Nyania, while health teams continue tracing contacts in Haut-Uele, a border province adjacent to South Sudan and the Central African Republic, raising concern for broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラの2つの新しい州への拡大の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威であり、新しい州への拡大は異常である。国際的に拡大するリスク（南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国との国境地域での事例）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な内容はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）でのエボラ発生である。発生地域に含まれるGhanaについては、記事サマリーに明示的な言及がないため除外を検討したが、Bluedot APIの発生地域に含まれている。サマリー内容はDRCの複数州（Ituri、Tshopo、Haut-Uele）での事例に焦点があり、南スーダンと中央アフリカ共和国との国境地域での拡大懸念が述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا إلى 1333 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: The number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 1,333.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,333 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with infections in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The rising tally follows indications that the virus has circulated for months before official confirmation on May 15. Health authorities warn frontline workers have faced elevated exposure risk amid shortages of basic protective equipment, including gloves and masks, hindering outbreak response. The report does not provide a death toll. The update signals ongoing transmission in eastern provinces and highlights challenges in containment due to PPE gaps and delayed recognition, underscoring the need for strengthened infection prevention, logistics, and worker protection to curb further spread. Source: Reuters, citing local authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ確定患者数が1,333例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。1,333例の確定患者、複数州での流行、医療従事者の曝露リスク増加、PPE不足による対応困難により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致命率を持つClass A感染症。複数州への拡大、医療従事者の保護装備不足、数ヶ月間の認識遅延がある状況は管理困難性を示唆。フルRRA実施が必須。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Rumah Sakit Glasgow Selidiki Kasus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Glasgow Hospital Investigates Ebola Case.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease test is underway at Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital after a patient was admitted early Tuesday (30 Jun) following a return from an Ebola-affected country. The patient was taken to the Emergency Receiving Unit, which was closed and isolated from the rest of the hospital as precautions are implemented; officials have not confirmed a diagnosis. If confirmed, it would mark the first UK Ebola case since the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern by the World Health Organization. Last week France reported its first imported Ebola case after a humanitarian doctor returned from Congo. The Congo outbreak, centered in Ituri province, has spread to neighboring areas, prompting tighter surveillance in Uganda. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine; transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴー病院がエボラ症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い例が英国で報告され、コンゴの流行との関連、フランスの輸入症例、ウガンダでの監視強化が記載されており、国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴのイツリ州での流行を中心に論じており、英国（グラスゴー）とフランスに輸入症例が発生している状況を報告。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラは高危険度病原体であり、複数国での確認・疑い例報告であるため、フルRRA進行が必須。ワクチンなしのブンディブギョ株という点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Un parassita sta colpendo una persona su tre: di cosa si tratta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite is affecting one in three people: what is it?
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Toxoplasma gondii infects about one third of the global population with toxoplasmosis. Most healthy individuals are asymptomatic, but ocular toxoplasmosis is the world’s most common eye infection and can cause vision loss. Justine Smith, ophthalmologist at Flinders University in Australia, notes toxoplasmosis is a major infection with limited health agenda attention, and that WHO recognition could boost prevention and management; João Furtado of the University of São Paulo, Brazil, underscores well-characterized transmission routes. Humans acquire the infection mainly via undercooked meat contaminated with the parasite or eggs from cat feces. Public health measures urged include safer food, access to potable water and sanitation, and improved prenatal care. The statement calls for integrating toxoplasmosis prevention into WHO’s neglected tropical diseases framework, and into maternal–child health, food safety systems, and primary health care, to reduce the burden in Australia, Brazil, and worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫が3人に1人に影響を与えている：それは何か？
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は世界人口の約3分の1に影響する既知の感染症だが、記事は主に疫学的背景と予防啓発が中心であり、新規発生やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報に乏しい。IHR基準の該当が限定的で、社会政治的関心は不明であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはトキソプラズマ症の既知の疾病負荷と予防戦略の必要性に関する啓発記事。オーストラリアはBluedot発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジル（サンパウロ大学の研究者言及）と世界的背景であり、Australiaは対象国でないため除外。新規発生やアウトブレイク、緊急の公衆衛生対応の必要性を示す証拠がないため、シグナルトリアージ（PICKUP）ではなく経過観察（WATCH）と判定。

article.articleHeadline: France confirms its first Ebola case as DRC outbreak continues to grow
article.articleSummary: France records its first Ebola case, a healthcare worker for ALIMA who contracted the Bundibugyo variant in the Democratic Republic of Congo and returned to France. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, involves 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths, with no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. WHO notes nearly 80 health workers have been infected; the global risk remains low. In France, the patient arrived at illness onset; he was asymptomatic during the flight, developed headaches and notified crew, and is now in hospital isolation. Five passengers from the flight are designated potential contacts under isolation. ALIMA reports ongoing contamination-prevention measures while investigating possible transmission. Ebola is zoonotic, with animal sources not yet identified; human-to-human spread occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and is possible once symptoms appear. By June 24, over 100 people had recovered; a two-therapeutics trial is planned to begin in DRC next week.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが初のエボラウイルス症例を確認、DRC感染症流行は引き続き拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、国際的な拡大が既に確認されている。Bundibugyo変種による前例のない地理的拡大と、治療法・ワクチンの欠如により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、フランスで症例が確認されたと記述されているが、患者はDRCで感染し、フランス帰国後に症状を呈している。実際の流行発生地はDRCである。フランスは二次感染の初期段階にある。対象国リストにはフランスが含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。治療法・ワクチンが存在しない点、医療従事者への感染が多い点（80名以上）、Bundibugyo変種による国際的拡大が前例のない状況である。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub Typhus Alert: सिर्फ बुखार नहीं, लिवर और किडनी को भी गंभीर नुकसान पहुंचा सकता है स्क्रब टायफस, KGMU-PGI शोध में बड़ा खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scrub Typhus Alert: Not just fever, Scrub Typhus can also cause serious damage to the liver and kidneys; major revelation in KGMU-PGI study.
article.articleSummary: Scrub Typhus can cause severe liver and kidney injury, according to a joint study by King George's Medical University (KGMU) and Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGI) in Lucknow, India. In 22 patients confirmed by IgM ELISA, liver enzymes ALT and AST were markedly elevated, and urea and creatinine levels rose well above normal, indicating hepatic and renal impairment. Orientia tsutsugamushi, transmitted by chigger bites, drives the infection. Many patients initially present with nonspecific viral-fever symptoms, delaying diagnosis. Clinicians should consider scrub typhus when fever coexists with elevated liver enzymes, jaundice, thrombocytopenia, or kidney dysfunction. Early identification and targeted antibiotics can control infection and prevent organ damage, a finding highlighted by the European Journal of Tropical Medicine and International Health.

triage.headline_ja: スクラブチフス警告：発熱だけでなく、肝臓と腎臓にも深刻なダメージを与える可能性がある。KGMU-PGI研究での大きな発表
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるスクラブチフスの臨床研究報告であり、重症度と管理可能性の懸念が認識される。ただし、イベント（確定症例22例）の規模が限定的で、新規発生または流行を示す直接的な証拠が不足しており、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が明確でないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究報告（22例の臨床データ分析）であり、新規流行の警告ではない。スクラブチフスはチグガーダニによって媒介される既知の風土病であり、インドでの常在疾患である。肝腎機能障害を含む重症化パターンの認識は臨床的価値があるが、急速な拡大や国際的脅威を示唆する情報は記事に含まれていない。SFTS（発熱出血性疾患）も疾患リストに含まれているが、記事本文ではスクラブチフスのみが言及されている。
