article.articleHeadline: 联合国机构警告刚果（金）埃博拉疫情将冲击地区经济
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN agencies warn that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo will hit the region's economy.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains active, spreading across multiple provinces, with Bunia in Ituri province identified as an outbreak center. As of June 30, 2026, the country has 1,333 confirmed Ebola cases and 399 deaths; 609 patients are in isolation or being treated, and 189 have recovered. WHO Africa region warns that the response is still below the level required to rapidly halt transmission. The UN Development Programme warns the outbreak could trigger a long-lasting social-economic crisis, pushing about 985,000 people into poverty in the DRC, and potentially costing Africa up to $3.6 billion. Africa CDC appeals for emergency funding to support clinical trials of candidate therapies, with trials to begin this week in Bunia. The DRC government on June 29 announced a $319 million comprehensive outbreak-response plan and has mobilized initial funds for frontline actions.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による地域経済への打撃を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。活発な流行が続いており、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当する。社会政治的関心も高く、フルリスク評価の実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (EBO-B)の活発な流行が継続中。2026年6月30日時点で確認例1,333例、死亡399例。地域経済への深刻な波及効果（約985,000人が貧困化の危機）が指摘されている。DRC政府が3億19百万ドルの対応計画を発表し、候補治療法の臨床試験がBuniaで開始予定。WHO Africa regionは現在の対応レベルが不十分と警告。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола не дремлет: число погибших от лихорадки в Конго выросло до 399 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Is Not Sleeping: The Death Toll From the Fever in the Congo Has Risen to 399
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries; case fatality stands at 29.7% as of July 1, 2026. The Ministry of Communications and Media reports ongoing transmission. Earlier reports indicated more than 1,000 infections and about 300 deaths within six days. The virus has crossed into Europe, with France recording an infection in a doctor who returned from a humanitarian mission in the DRC; Uganda’s continuing outbreak has prompted enhanced screening of travelers from the region. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days. Symptoms include high fever, weakness, vomiting, and diarrhea. No details on laboratory confirmation methods are provided beyond the reported confirmed cases; no specific infection source or exported case data beyond the France incident are noted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは活動中: コンゴでの感染症による死亡者数が399人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上深刻な影響（399死亡、1,333確認症例）、異常で予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク（フランスへの輸出症例確認）、及び渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。フランスは対象国でないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大（フランスでの輸出症例）と地域的な継続的伝播が確認されており、緊急度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hanura Pesawaran Jadi Daerah Endemis Malaria di Lampung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanura Pesawaran Becomes a Malaria-Endemic Area in Lampung.
article.articleSummary: Hanura, Pesawaran, Lampung remains a malaria-endemic area, with most infections caused by Plasmodium vivax. From 2021 through May 2026, 5,397 malaria cases were recorded, peaking in 2024 and declining through 2025–May 2026. In 2021 there were 205 cases; 2023: 472; 2024: 1,883; 2025: 1,269; and January–May 2026: 568. Laboratory data show Plasmodium vivax dominates, with about 2,024 vivax cases in 2024, 1,266 in 2025, and 563 by May 2026. Plasmodium falciparum is much less: 36 in 2021, 17 in 2022, 11 in 2023, 9 in 2024, 2 in 2025, and 3 by May 2026. Mixed infections remain rare. Transmission is linked to coastal Anopheles breeding in brackish-water habitats (abandoned fish ponds, marshes, lagoons, pools, drains). Vivax predominance suggests longer treatment; Nazlina Mayanti of Puskesmas Hanura notes the pattern.

triage.headline_ja: ハヌラペサワランがランプン州のマラリア風土病地域になった
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのランプン州における既知のマラリア風土病地域の継続的な発生報告。症例数は2024年のピークから減少傾向であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは明確でないが、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病地域（Hanura, Pesawaran, Lampung）におけるマラリアの継続的な発生を報告。症例数は2024年1,883件をピークに2025年1,269件、2026年1月〜5月568件と減少傾向。Plasmodium vivaxが主流（2024年約2,024件）であり、P. falciparumは稀少。新たな異常事象としてはピックアップ対象とならないが、長期的な風土病管理の継続監視価値あり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Descoperire șocantă după o vacanță în India. 38 de paraziți găsiți în creierul unei femei: "Cum s-a întâmplat asta? De ce?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking discovery after a vacation in India. 38 parasites found in a woman's brain: "How did this happen? Why?"
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis diagnosed in a British woman after travel to India (2007), with 38 brain cysts observed. Lowri Denman, 42, from Cardiff, developed severe headaches and seizures beginning in 2010, three years after returning; CT/MRI found 38 parasites in the brain. Toxoplasmosis was initially suspected, but a link to a prior intestinal tapeworm and further testing confirmed Taenia solium–related neurocysticercosis, likely from ingesting eggs via contaminated food or water in India. Treated with antiparasitics and corticosteroids for two weeks; later relapsed with brain inflammation, confusion, numbness, and psychosis, spending six weeks in a neuropsychiatric hospital. Parasites remained and calcified over time; no surgical removal. The case is extremely rare in the UK; infection linked to 2007 travel to India. Doctor Brendan Healy treated her.

triage.headline_ja: インドの休暇後に衝撃的な発見。女性の脳から38匹の寄生虫が見つかる：「どうしてこんなことが？なぜ？」
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症（Neurocysticercosis）の稀な臨床症例報告。インドでの感染事例だが、患者は英国（対象国外）の女性であり、アウトブレイクではなく個別症例。IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数該当はみられない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドでの感染事例（2007年）であり、対象国リストに含まれるため India を verified_locations に含める。患者は英国人だが、感染地はインド。個別症例報告であり、集団発生や流行の兆候なし。稀な神経嚢虫症症例として臨床的な関心はあるが、地域的公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。続報で類似症例の集積がないか注視。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Patient tests negative for Ebola after suspected case at Glasgow hospital
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, a patient at Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital was tested for Ebola as a precaution and returned negative; Public Health Scotland confirms there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Scotland. UKHSA and PHS will conduct contact tracing and precautionary testing if needed. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak has approached 700 confirmed cases, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with around 138 deaths, including two in Uganda. A positive result would have marked the first UK Ebola case since the DRC outbreak was declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern. The UK has pledged up to £21 million to support DRC response, and the UK Public Health Rapid Support Team is deploying specialists to eastern DRC, Kinshasa, and the Republic of Congo to bolster regional efforts.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴー病院での疑い患者がエボラで陰性の検査結果 患者がエボラウイルス検査で陰性と判定される
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRC大規模エボラアウトブレイク（700確認例、138死亡）に関する記事。UK疑い例は陰性だが、基盤となるアウトブレイク自体は公衆衛生の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクを示唆するもの。サマリー上、DRCとウガンダでの実際の発生が記載されている一方、UK例は検査で除外されたため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。情報追加・流行動向の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるBundibugyo Ebola virusアウトブレイク（700確認例、138死亡）が進行中。UK例は検査陰性で除外されたが、基盤のアウトブレイク自体はIHR4基準全て、WPRO5基準全てを満たす。UK国際支援投入（£21百万）とRapid Support Team派遣により国際的対応が活動中。DRCがverified_locationsの唯一の対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: DC Abhishek Sharma calls for mission-mode action to achieve TB-free Rajouri
article.articleSummary: Rajouri, 1 July 2026 — Deputy Commissioner Abhishek Sharma called for mission-mode action to achieve a TB-free Rajouri under the PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. He reviewed TB program components: case detection, differentiated TB care, contact tracing, TB Preventive Treatment, Nikshay Poshan Yojana, Direct Benefit Transfer, Nikshay Mitra, and Jan Bhagidari for TB patients. Sharma directed officials to accelerate early case identification, prompt treatment initiation, and robust patient monitoring, with strengthened surveillance, enhanced contact tracing, and intensified awareness to ensure timely diagnosis. He urged timely delivery of Nikshay Poshan Yojana benefits and continued nutrition, counselling, and follow-up through Nikshay Mitra, alongside uninterrupted treatment. The effort aims to coordinate stakeholders toward a TB-free Rajouri and the national TB Mukt Bharat target. Present were ADDC Malikzada Sheraz-ul-Haq and District TB Officer Dr Shahzad Mirza.

triage.headline_ja: ラジョーリ地区でTB撲滅に向けた官民一体の取り組みを呼びかけ - アビシェク・シャルマ副専任官
triage.triage_reason: 結核の既知疾患に対する公衆衛生施策の進捗報告であり、新たな異常な感染症イベント、重症化傾向、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。地域的な政策実行の記事である。
triage.notes: 記事はラジョーリ地区（ジャンムー・カシミール連邦直轄領）における政府主導の結核撲滅キャンペーンの進捗に関する行政発表である。新規の感染症クラスター、異常な流行パターン、または重症化傾向の報告はなく、既存の国家公衆衛生プログラム（PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）の実施状況説明に該当する。シグナル検出対象の急性感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Tinggi di Jakarta, DPRD Nilai Persoalan Sanitasi Belum Tertangani Maksimal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High TB cases in Jakarta; Jakarta DPRD says sanitation issues have not been fully addressed.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta TB cases are linked to sanitation gaps; DPRD DKI Jakarta PSI member August Hamonangan urged speeding construction of septic tanks in residential areas to curb TB spread. He linked TB to unsanitary environments; limited access to proper wastewater disposal. BPS 2025 data show 0.06% of Jakarta households still practice open defecation, equivalent to about 6,000–7,000 residents. The LKPJ 2025 indicates SPALD (domestic wastewater treatment) projects fell short: 515 built of 650 target. He argues this underlines unmet septic tank needs, especially in RW kumuh slums, whether for private or communal use. He called for concrete action rather than ceremonial measures, stressing that rising TB cases reflect ongoing sanitation problems and that accelerating septic tank construction is essential for ensuring access to proper sanitation.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタの結核症例が高い。ジャカルタDPRDは衛生問題が十分に対処されていないと評価している。
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）における結核の増加が報告されており、衛生環境との関連が指摘されています。しかし、具体的な症例数の増加傾向、死亡率、または国際的な拡大リスクに関する情報が不足しており、現時点ではWATCHレベルの評価が適切です。
triage.notes: 記事は結核と衛生環境（特に下水道整備不足）の関連性に焦点を当てており、地域議員による指摘があります。しかし、具体的な症例数の増加、死亡率、流行の規模、国際的な拡大リスクについての詳細な情報がないため、判定をWATCHとしました。続報で疫学データが提供されればPICKUPへの昇格を検討します。

article.articleHeadline: Puskesmas Hanura Tetapkan 6 Desa sebagai Wilayah Endemis Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanura Public Health Center designates six villages as malaria-endemic areas.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, six coastal villages in Teluk Pandan, Pesawaran, Lampung, are designated malaria-endemic by Hanura Public Health Center, with transmission concentrated along the coast where Anopheles mosquitoes breed in brackish-water habitats (tambak fish ponds, lagoons, swamps, pools, and water channels). Of ten villages in Teluk Pandan, the six seaside communities — Sukajaya Lempasing, Hurun, Hanura, Sidodadi, Gebang, and Batu Menyan — are included in the endemic area, while hillside settlements are not due to distance from breeding sites. Malaria pockets are limited to specific dusun near coastal breeding habitats: Sukajaya Lempasing (Dusun 3 Laut; Dusun 7 Mutun); Gebang (Dusun Tanjung Jaya; Seribu; Induk; Hilir; Suko Agung); Hanura (Dusun B; Dusun C); Sidodadi (Dusun 1; Dusun 2); Batu Menyan (Dusun Ketapang; Dusun Cibeurem; RT 7–9). Not all hamlets within endemic villages become malaria pockets; transmission remains localized to coastal-adjacent areas.

triage.headline_ja: ハヌラ保健センターが6つの村をマラリア風土病地域に指定
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのランプン州沿岸部でマラリアの風土病地域が指定されている局所的な事象。IHR基準の該当が不明確で、国際的な懸念や社会的関心の程度が不明なため、追加情報の確認を要す。
triage.notes: ランプン州ペサワラン県のテルク・パンダン地域で6つの沿岸村がマラリア風土病地域として公式に指定された事象。疾患自体は既知のものだが、局所的な風土病地域の再確認と公式指定が行われている。症例数や重症度に関する具体的な情報が記事サマリーに含まれていないため、より詳細なデータが必要。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、総合的な公衆衛生影響の規模が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Praktisi Kesehatan Masyarakat Ingatkan Flu Singapura Biasa Menular di Sekolah, Waspada tapi Tidak Perlu Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health practitioners remind that the Singapore flu is commonly contagious in schools; stay vigilant but don't panic.
article.articleSummary: South Sumatra, Indonesia reports 523 suspected Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD), also known as Singapore flu, in school settings, with cases rising through January–June 2026. Health practitioner Dr. Ngabila Salama urges vigilance without panic, noting HFMD spreads readily in schools and playgrounds and mainly affects children under five. Classic symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, sores, and rashes or blisters on the hands and feet. Prevention centers on healthy hygiene practices (PHBS), masking when unwell, and frequent handwashing. The Sumatra Selatan Health Office (Dinkes Sumsel) P2P chief Ira Primadesa says the 523 suspected cases are cumulative from weeks 1–23 of 2026, consistent with seasonal, virus-driven peaks during transitional weather and the dry season. The article underlines HFMD’s contagiousness and emphasizes early recognition and family-level precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健医療従事者が警告：手足口病（シンガポール風邪）は学校での感染が一般的、注意は必要だが慌てる必要はない
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スマトラ南部での手足口病（EV71）の学校関連クラスター報告。WPRO基準で「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、季節変動内の既知パターンと判断されるため、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: スマトラ南部での523件の疑い例は2026年第1～23週の累積報告。当局による季節変動内の既知パターンとの評価あり。死亡報告なし、重症度は軽度。小児（主に5歳以下）対象の学校内感染クラスターで、標準的な衛生対策で管理可能と判断。フルRRAは不要だが、数週間の続報を注視すること。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में ब्रेन मलेरिया का कहर: 4 बच्चों की मौत के बाद विभाग अलर्ट; 108 डॉक्टरों की टीम घर-घर करेगी सर्वे - jamshedpur brain malaria outbreak 4 deaths 108 doctors deployed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral malaria wreaks havoc in Jamshedpur: after the deaths of four children, the department issued an alert; a team of 108 doctors will conduct door-to-door surveys.
article.articleSummary: Cerebral malaria outbreak in Potka subdivision, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, has claimed four tribal children and prompted a state-wide alert across Potka, Musabani, Ghatsila, and Dumri blocks. In response, 108 doctors from MGM Medical College will conduct two days of door-to-door surveys, with teams of 25 doctors and eight senior clinicians each, to screen residents, treat confirmed cases, raise awareness, and refer suspected patients to Sadar Hospital or MGM Hospital. Health camps tested 507 people, identifying 51 new malaria cases across villages including Sabar Nagar, Kandor, Jojogoda, Gamhirkocha, Chhota Ramgarh, Kundar Kocha, Jharia, and Tangrain; two new patients were admitted at Potka Community Health Center (Joba Hansda and Vikas Mardy), with five others already hospitalized. Four deaths occurred in Kandor village, Hirna Panchayat, attributed to a lack of DDT spraying and bed-net distribution over the past three years; authorities are reviewing transmission drivers and have deployed 12 additional teams.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルの脳マラリアの猛威：4人の子どもの死亡後、部局がアラートを発行；108人の医者チームが戸別訪問調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: マラリア脳型の集団発生で複数の死亡（4人）が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当、またWPRO基準3項目以上該当。インドの対象地域での集団発生として国家的対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 脳マラリアの集団発生は珍しく、東シンバム県ポトカ準地区を中心に複数村落で確認されている。過去3年間のDDT散布やベッドネット配布の欠落が感染の駆動要因と指摘されており、州政府が大規模な医療対応（医者108人の展開）を実施中。死亡4人と確認患者51人の状況は深刻性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Jamur Sporothrix yang Menular dari Kucing ke Manusia Kini Mulai Serang Hewan Liar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware the Sporothrix fungus, transmitted from cats to humans and now beginning to infect wild animals.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, caused by the Sporothrix fungus, traditionally linked to cats and human infections, is now detected in wildlife near urban fringes. The varaint Sporothrix brasiliensis is noted as more aggressive and can spread rapidly via scratches or bites from infected cats. Wildlife species, including rodents and small mammals, are becoming infected, likely through contact with infected feral cats, expanding the transmission network beyond domestic cats to the natural environment. Clinically, infections in animals and humans begin with skin lesions or nodules that may ulcerate and progress to lymphatic spread; in immunocompromised individuals, internal organs such as the lungs can be affected. The shift to wildlife complicates outbreak control, as wild animals may serve as reservoirs, heightening re-exposure risk to pets and people near habitats. Mitigation calls for rigorous monitoring of feral cat populations and keeping pet cats indoors to minimize contact with wildlife and spore transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ネコから人間に感染するスポロトリクス菌、野生動物への感染も開始——警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリクス症は既知の風土病であり、インドネシアでの野生動物への拡大は関心を集めるが、現時点では死亡や重症化のデータ不足、また国際的な緊急拡大リスクが明確でないため。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: スポロトリクス症はスポロトリクス・ブラジリエンシス株によって引き起こされ、より攻撃的な特性を示すと記載されている。野生動物（げっ歯類など）への感染拡大は異常/予想外であり、人獣共通感染症のリザーバー化による継続的な曝露リスクがある。ただし感染者数、重症例、死亡例に関する具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、IHR基準の「serious_impact」は判定困難。続報で感染件数、重症度、医療対応の状況が明らかになれば、PICKUPへの昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Baza: Десятки туристов из РФ сообщили о заражении гонконгским гриппом на Бали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baza: Dozens of tourists from Russia reported contracting Hong Kong flu in Bali.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists and digital nomads contracted Hong Kong flu in Bali, Indonesia, with infections reportedly acquired locally. Affected individuals describe an initial cold-like phase followed by a rapid onset of severe headache, high fever, body aches, and a harsh cough; some report nausea and vomiting. Fever typically subsides around day seven, but fatigue and headaches may persist for several weeks. The reports highlight symptoms being more severe than COVID-19. Russian health authorities noted the outbreak while approving a standard for adult influenza care, increasing the average duration of treatment to nine days. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation details. The piece focuses on the Bali outbreak and the updated care protocol, published July 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バザ：ロシアからの観光客数十人がバリでホンコン風邪への感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ）での複数のインフルエンザ症例の集団発生が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行のしやすさ）を複数満たし、国際的な旅行関連の懸念もあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はバリでのホンコン風邪（H3N2インフルエンザ）の集団発生を報告しており、ロシア人観光客・デジタルノマドが複数感染。現地での感染取得が示唆されている。症状は重篤性が高く（頭痛、高熱、身体痛、激しい咳、嘔吐報告あり）、数週間に及ぶ疲労・頭痛の後遺症も報告されている。ロシア当局がこの流行を確認しており、成人インフルエンザケアの基準を承認・治療期間を平均9日に延長している。実験室的確認の詳細は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Belum Terkendali, Sudan Selatan Jadi Negara Paling Berisiko Berikutnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is not yet under control; South Sudan becomes the next most at-risk country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa remains unsettled. WHO, using latest modeling published in The Lancet, estimates a 70% chance the deadly virus could reach South Sudan, ranking it as the next highest-risk country after Uganda. The informing outbreak originates in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 1,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 260 deaths have been reported. The virus has crossed into Uganda, reporting 20 confirmed cases, two confirmed deaths, and one suspected death. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine specific to this variant exists. South Sudan’s public health system is among the weakest in East Africa, with ongoing challenges including limited isolation facilities, weak contact tracing, unsafe or incomplete burials, and suboptimal border surveillance. Researchers urge immediate investments in preparedness, rapid-response capacity, and enhanced cross-border surveillance to prevent introduction. Rwanda and Burundi are currently lower-risk neighbors.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は未だ統制されず、南スーダンが次に最もリスクが高い国となる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当する重大な感染症危機。複数国での確認患者と死亡が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での1,000件以上の確認患者と260人以上の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダでも20確認患者と死亡者が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダンへの70%の確率で到達との予測があるが、現在の確認患者報告ではコンゴ民主共和国のみが対象国であり verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の流行であり特定ワクチンが存在しない点、弱い公衆衛生システムなど管理可能性の懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 300 cas fantômes déclenchent une alerte sanitaire majeure en Afrique francophone - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 300 ghost cases trigger a major health alert in Francophone Africa - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: 300 unlocated Ebola cases detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) as of June 29, 2026, triggering a major health alert in Francophone Africa. The unlocated 'ghost' cases threaten cross-border spread of Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with an alarmingly high case fatality around 28.8%. Outbreak began May 15 in Ituri; 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths reported. The Uganda border remains vulnerable, with 20 cases and 2 deaths. Hospitals operate near full capacity (about 95%), prompting rapid construction of new treatment centers. China and Guinea have launched a joint response, deploying mobile laboratories at borders and sharing Guinea’s 2014–2016 outbreak experience. The Sahel Alliance monitors the region; Mali and Niger tighten border controls. A 21-day quarantine applies to travelers from affected zones; rapid tests and trained staff are in short supply. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, mobilizing emergency funds, while locating the 300 unidentified cases is critical to prevent a regional catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：300人の行方不明患者がフランス語圏アフリカで大規模な衛生警報をトリガー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言。エボラウイルス（高致命率28.8%）の国際的拡大リスク、300人の行方不明患者による制御困難性、複数国の国境対応実施により即座のフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはMali、Uganda、Niger、Guineaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri province）が中心であり、中国が共同対応に参加している事が明記されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため検証位置に追加。隣接国の危機反応（Uganda、Mali、Niger）は副次的な言及であり、主たる発生地としては記載されていないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Woman left with tapeworm and 38 brain parasites after trip abroad
article.articleSummary: Cardiff-based Lowri Denman, 42, developed neurocysticercosis—38 brain parasites—after a 2007 two-month trip to India, later passing a metre-long tapeworm. Severe headaches preceded a 2011 tonic-clonic seizure; brain imaging confirmed neurocysticercosis, a parasitic brain infection from pork tapeworm larvae linked to contaminated water and poor hygiene. She faced long management, with epilepsy meds initially, then steroids and albendazole; 2015–2016 saw relapse as parasites failed to die off, prompting a switch to praziquantel with ongoing swelling. Treatment cycles included methotrexate and steroids, causing fatigue and paranoia, and contributed to social withdrawal. By 2015–2016 she had to quit work; September 2016 saw a three-month neuropsychiatric ward admission with mood stabilisers and antipsychotics, amid anxiety and paranoia. The case underscores the prolonged neuropsychiatric effects of neurocysticercosis and complex, multi-drug management across years, including imported infection from abroad and subsequent domestic impact.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行後に脳内寄生虫38匹と条虫を患った女性
triage.triage_reason: 個別事例報告（単一患者の臨床ケース）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生を示す証拠がない。ただしインドでの曝露と英国での診断という国際的な側面があり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者の臨床ケースレポートであり、集団発生（outbreak）ではない。患者はインド旅行中に曝露し、英国ウェールズで診断・治療を受けた個別事例。神経嚢虫症の重症度と長期的な神経精神医学的影響は医学的に重要だが、公衆衛生上の流行警告（epidemic signal）ではない。ただしインド発生の輸入感染症という国際的性質と、長期的な管理複雑性から、情報がさらに提供される場合に備えて注視する価値がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert in Glasgow: What You Should Know About the Deadly Virus
article.articleSummary: Glasgow triggered an Ebola alert after a patient tested negative at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital, prompting partial lockdown. No UK Ebola cases since 2014, though Europe has reported cases, with France reporting a first case last week. Public Health Scotland and UKHSA are assessing routes for travelers from affected areas; the risk is low and NHS detection and management procedures are in place. The Scottish test was preventive, with no further patient details released. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak has 1,307 cases and 377 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths linked to the DRC outbreak. Six Ebola strains exist, three driving large outbreaks—Ebola virus, Sudan virus and Bundibugyo virus—but only Ebola virus has licensed vaccines and therapeutics. Transmission occurs from wild animals to humans and via contact with blood and body fluids, including contaminated surfaces; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and possible bleeding. The UK has pledged about £21 million to DRC and deployed a Public Health Rapid Support Team.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴーのエボラ警報：致命的なウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、かつ高い社会的・政治的関心。エボラ出血熱という高致死性疾患の国際的フレームワークでの重要シグナル。
triage.notes: Glasgow（スコットランド、英国）の患者は検査陰性で確定例ではなく、スクリーニング段階。ただしDRCの実際のエボラ流行（1,307例、377死亡）とウガンダへの二次拡大が確認され、欧州での輸入例も報告されている。UK・フランスの事例は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる（ID: 203312）。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: O călătorie în India i-a adus ani de suferință: 38 de paraziți în creier
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A trip to India brought him years of suffering: 38 parasites in the brain.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium larvae produced 38 parasites in the brain of Lowri Denman, a Cardiff native who had traveled to India in 2007. Symptoms began in 2010 with severe headaches and a first seizure; imaging revealed 38 brain cysts. Toxoplasmosis was initially suspected, but further tests confirmed neurocysticercosis linked to ingestion of parasite eggs, likely from contaminated food during the India trip. Dr. Brendan Healy notes the case is extraordinarily rare in the UK. After two weeks of antiparasitic and corticosteroid therapy, she appeared to improve and even moved to Bristol, engaging in activities including sports. Relapses followed: brain inflammation, episodes of confusion, numbness, paranoia, and psychosis, culminating in six weeks in a neuropsychiatric unit. The parasites calcified in the brain and were not surgically removed; treatment killed the eggs. Recovery took years, with a return to work by 2022.

triage.headline_ja: インドへの旅行が彼に何年も の苦しみをもたらした: 脳内に38匹の寄生虫
triage.triage_reason: インド滞在中の感染による極めて稀な神経嚢虫症の個別事例。公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的な拡大リスクは限定的だが、対象国（インド）での発生が確認でき、異常な重症度を示す事例として経過観察の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本事例は2007年のインド滞在後に発症した個別の神経嚢虫症ケースであり、アウトブレイクやクラスターではない。英国での診断・治療事例として報告されている。IHR基準2つ該当（深刻な影響・異常性）し、WPRO基準も2つ該当するが、スポットケースであり社会的・政治的関心の証拠が記事に示されていないため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kader di Pesisir Pesawaran Dibekali Tes Cepat Malaria, Deteksi Kasus Kini Lebih Cepat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pesawaran Coastal Cadres Equipped with Malaria Rapid Tests, Case Detection Now Faster.
article.articleSummary: Coastal cadres in Pesawaran’s Teluk Pandan endemic areas are equipped with malaria rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) to speed up case detection. At UPTD Puskesmas Hanura, positive results must be reported to the puskesmas; cadres do not dispense medicines. Field health workers screen residents with fever or malaria-like symptoms using RDTs, using a small blood sample to yield rapid results for initial management. Positive results are forwarded to Puskesmas Hanura to confirm malaria species and ensure appropriate medical treatment. This approach extends access to remote coastal dusuns far from health facilities and accelerates case finding. Emphasis on complete treatment adherence is noted, notably for Plasmodium vivax, which requires 14 days of therapy, with patient follow-up supported by Ministry of Health research in the Hanura district. Cadres and village health workers also monitor patients to ensure treatment completion.

triage.headline_ja: ペサワラン沿岸地域の保健員にマラリア迅速診断検査を配備、症例検出がより迅速に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの局所的なマラリア対策強化の報道であり、新規流行や重篤な事態の発生ではない。スクリーニング基準に1つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事は予防・検査体制の改善に焦点を当てており、異常な発生状況を示していない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はペサワラン地域での既知のマラリア流行地区（Teluk Pandan地区）における診断能力強化に関するもの。新規流行の報告ではなく、保健インフラの改善を報じている。ただし当該地域は風土病地域で、継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行の可能性（epidemic_prone）が存在するため、スクリーニング基準で2項目に該当。政府保健省による介入が確認されるため、政府レベルの関心が示唆される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ПАНИКА ВО ГЛАЗГОВ - Итно затворена болница поради сомнение за ЕБОЛА
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in Glasgow - Hospital Urgently Closed Due to Ebola Suspicion
article.articleSummary: A patient at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow presented to the Accident and Emergency unit around 6:00 a.m. and is being tested for Ebola after returning from an Ebola-affected country and developing alarming symptoms, triggering the unit’s closure to the public to minimize risk. The individual was isolated for testing and treatment, with additional screening for other possible illnesses as tests proceed to confirm Ebola. The incident unfolds amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, which the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Hospital staff note that Ebola mentions have caused panic, though strict protocols were followed. Reports cited include the Daily Mail and Glasgow Times.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴーでパニック - エボラ疑いで病院が緊急閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ疑い患者の英国での報告で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが確認される。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの流行国からの輸入例のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: グラスゴーおよび英国での疑い患者報告が主題だが、対象国リストに英国が含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。患者はDRC/ウガンダからの輸入例。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのアフリカでの流行との関連性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Тяжелее ковида: Российских туристов на Бали скашивает эпидемия гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More severe than COVID: An epidemic of Hong Kong flu is mowing down Russian tourists in Bali.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, Bali, Indonesia, is experiencing an ongoing outbreak of Hong Kong flu among Russian tourists and their acquaintances visiting the island. Reportedly, the illness begins like a cold, but within hours fever spikes, accompanied by severe headache, myalgia, and an exhausting cough. Some patients experience nausea and vomiting. By day seven, fever typically subsides, but fatigue and headaches can persist for weeks. Many note that COVID-19 was easier to endure. The report emphasizes rapid progression from mild upper-respiratory symptoms to more severe systemic illness, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation or infection source. This outbreak appears focused on visitors rather than the broader local population at this time.

triage.headline_ja: COVIDより重症：ロシア人観光客がバリで香港風邪の流行に見舞われている
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)型による集団発生が報告されており、重症度と異常性で注目に値するが、ラボ確認なし、発生源・二次感染リスクが不明確であり、フルRRA前に追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当することでPICKUP判定の可能性があるが、ラボ確認なし、感染源不明、対象国リストに含まれるIndonesiaでの発生だが国内への実際の脅威評価が不確定。記事は観光客間での発生に焦点を当てており、インドネシア国内での流行拡大リスクの記載がない。続報で確認情報・二次感染状況の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh khống chế thành công ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh successfully contained the dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, traced to Hoành Sơn ward beginning May 3, 2026, with 22 laboratory-confirmed cases (no fatalities) and last case on June 14; outbreak formally ended June 30 after surveillance met regulations. Hà Tĩnh CDC, Hoành Sơn Health Station, and local authorities implemented rapid epidemiologic investigation, zonation, vector-control, and community interventions. Measures included environmental sanitation, waste collection, removal of water-holding containers, larvicide spraying in affected areas and schools, enhanced vector surveillance, daily case monitoring, and 24/7 on-site outbreak response. Public communications via local radio, community meetings, and door-to-door outreach improved household prevention, contributing to a marked reduction in vector indices and the absence of new cases during monitoring. A separate Dengue outbreak remains active in Vũng Áng ward; authorities continue surveillance and control. Residents are urged to maintain environmental hygiene and seek care promptly if febrile symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省、デング熱感染症アウトブレイクの封じ込めに成功
triage.triage_reason: デング熱のアウトブレイクは既に封じ込められており（6月30日に終了宣言）、死亡者なし、22例の確定患者という限定的な規模。国際的な拡大リスクも低く、渡航・貿易制限の必要性もない。社会的・政治的な関心の高まりもない。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは既に制御下にあり、最後の患者は6月14日、6月30日に公式に終了宣言。ベトナムはデング熱の常在地域であり、このような局所的なアウトブレイクは通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。ただし、別のアウトブレイクがヴングアン地区で継続中との記載があるため、今後の動向次第では要経過観察の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: PhilHealth expands leptospirosis coverage to P411,000
article.articleSummary: PhilHealth expands its leptospirosis benefit package beginning July 15, offering up to P411,000 in healthcare coverage for qualified severe cases. The enhanced package allocates as high as P63,000 for hospital care, P170,000 for hemodialysis, and P230,000 for peritoneal dialysis, with total coverage possible when patients require a combination of hemodialysis, mechanical ventilation, and pulmonary rehabilitation. The initiative follows President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos Jr.'s directive to widen access to care. In addition, the Yakap program provides free consultations, and doxycycline may be prescribed when medically necessary to prevent leptospirosis. PhilHealth's medicine benefit allows up to P20,000 annually per member for related medications. Leptospirosis is a bacterial disease transmitted through water or soil contaminated by urine from infected animals. DOH recorded 2,177 cases nationwide from Jan. 4 to Jun. 6, a six percent increase, with many cases among farmers in rice fields; preventive advice includes wearing boots and thorough washing after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: PhilHealthがレプトスピラ症のカバレッジを411,000ペソまで拡大
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症患者が増加（6%増）し、保健当局が対応を強化している事例であるが、新規アウトブレイク発生の警告ではなく、既知の季節性疾患への政策対応である。国際的拡大リスクは限定的。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は既知の季節性感染症であり、フィリピンでの年間事例である。記事は新規アウトブレイクの警告ではなく、既存の流行への医療保障拡大を報じている。DOHが2026年1月4日～6月6日に2,177例を記録し前年比6%増加している点は監視対象だが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。引き続き情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 300 cas fantômes déclenchent l'alerte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 300 ghost cases trigger the alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 300 unidentified Ebola cases, with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus displaying a 28.8% case fatality. The outbreak, which began in this province, has caused 377 deaths and leaves hospitals operating at about 95% capacity. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases have been recorded with 2 deaths. The World Health Organization calls this the worst Ebola outbreak since 2018. China is deploying mobile laboratories, while Guinea (Conakry) is sharing its Ebola expertise. Mali and Niger have strengthened their borders. Experts warn that a single regional case would be catastrophic. The WHO is mobilizing emergency funds, but case tracing remains the major challenge to containment.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱: 300の正体不明な症例がアラートをトリガー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、国境強化による渡航制限が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の発生主体はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）であり、ウガンダでも確認症例があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Chinaは対象国リストに含まれ、サマリーで移動式検査室の展開が明記されているため含める。Mali、Niger、Guineaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが2018年以来最大のアウトブレイクと評価し、国境強化措置が講じられている。ケース追跡の困難さが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Десятки российских туристов подхватили гонконгский грипп на Бали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Russian tourists contracted Hong Kong flu in Bali.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-01, dozens of Russian tourists and remote workers contracted Hong Kong flu on the Indonesian island of Bali, according to the Telegram channel Baza. The illness began with cold-like symptoms, progressing to severe headache, high fever, muscle aches, and cough; nausea and vomiting occurred in some cases. The acute phase lasts about a week, followed by several weeks of headaches and fatigue. The report provides no laboratory confirmation or exact case counts. Separately, a Russian woman who traveled to South Africa became the first reported dengue fever infection, after visiting Kruger National Park and Victoria Falls and being bitten by mosquitoes. The article notes these as distinct travel-associated infections among Russians in Africa and Southeast Asia, without detailing containment measures or outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 数十人のロシア人観光客がバリでハンコンフルに感染
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザとデング熱の旅行関連感染が複数国で報告されているが、検査確認なく症例数も不明。スクリーニング基準（異常性、流行リスク）に該当する可能性があるが、情報不足のため続報注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にバリ（インドネシア）での複数の旅行関連感染を報告。デング熱症例は南アフリカで発生しているが、南アフリカは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。香港はChinaに含める。検査確認なく、症例数も「数十人」と不正確。ロシアのメディア報道であり、地域での公衆衛生への実際の影響度は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng tăng nhanh ở Khánh Hòa, bác sĩ khuyến cáo người dân không chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Spreading Rapidly in Khánh Hòa Province, Doctors Warn Residents Not to Be Complacent.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease is spreading rapidly in Khánh Hòa Province, Vietnam. By 26 June, Khánh Hòa recorded 2,937 HFMD cases across 68 outbreaks, with health workers and local authorities quickly addressing most clusters. Hotspots include Cam Lâm commune (207 cases), Diên Điền commune (116), Tây Nha Trang ward (295), and Bắc Nha Trang ward (193). A number of cases are severe (grades 2a–2b) requiring admission to the Khánh Hòa Infectious Diseases Hospital under government guidelines. The provincial CDC continues surveillance, distributes supplies, and trains health staff and schools, emphasizing hygiene of toys, equipment, and classrooms. Parents, especially for children under 6, are advised to stay vigilant: signs include sore throat, poor appetite, irritability, and vesicles on hands, feet, or other body parts. If suspected in affected areas, seek timely testing; many mild cases can be treated as outpatients with family adherence to medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: カンホア省で手足口病が急速に拡大、医師は住民に油断しないよう警告
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病の急速な拡大でシグナル条件を満たす。2,937症例が記録され、重症例（Grade 2a–2b）の入院事例があり、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）とWPRO基準（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71はWHOで重視される病原体。カンホア省での2,937症例（68アウトブレイク）と重症例の報告は地域的に顕著なシグナル。6月26日時点のサーベイランスデータ。小児（6歳未満）への影響が高く、ウイルスの地域内伝播が継続中と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo eleva a 399 el número de muertos y a 1.333 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC raises the death toll to 399 and 1,333 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of June 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 399 deaths and 1,333 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 609 in isolation or hospitalization and a case fatality rate of 29.7%. Contact tracing is 82.7%, and 189 people have recovered. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, a border province with Uganda and South Sudan, and has spread to North and South Kivu. The virus crossed into Uganda, with 20 confirmed cases, including two deaths, of which 15 were imported from DRC. France reported its first imported Ebola case in a doctor returning from a mission in DRC. Bundibugyo strain carries a fatality rate estimated at 30–50%, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and notes high regional risk but lower risk globally; it is the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラの死者数を399人に、確定患者数を1,333人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示しており、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株、致命率30-50%）の大規模アウトブレイク。DRC内での複数州への拡大（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）、ウガンダへの越境感染（20例）、フランスへの輸入症例（1例）を確認。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。記事サマリーではSudanとFranceへの言及があるが、実際の発生地はDRCおよびウガンダであり、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 上廁所拉出1公尺絛蟲！英女遊印度3個月 腦中藏38隻寄生蟲多年才康復
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A British woman who traveled to India for three months pulled a 1-meter tapeworm from the toilet; she had 38 parasites in her brain for years before recovery.
article.articleSummary: British woman Lowri Denman traveled to India for three months in 2007 and was later found to have neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium larvae, with 38 cysts in her brain. She first noticed symptoms in 2010 after seeing a one-meter tapeworm in a restaurant toilet; initial tests were inconclusive. In 2011 she had first seizures; CT and MRI confirmed multiple brain parasites. Infection likely from ingesting parasite eggs via undercooked pork or contaminated water, consistent with WHO risk factors; such neurocysticercosis is rare in the UK. Denman received antiparasitic drugs and steroids for two weeks; her condition improved but later neurocognitive decline and psychiatric symptoms led to a six-week neuropsychiatric hospitalization. The parasites calcified by 2017, seizures ceased, but she remains on lifelong antiepileptic therapy. She recovered enough to study interior design in Cardiff (2018) and return to work in 2022, advocating awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 英国女性、インド旅行で脳に38匹の寄生虫感染―1メートルのサナダムシを排出、数年後に回復
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生危機を示す集団発生ではない。記事は2007年のインド旅行由来の個別感染事例の医学的経過記録であり、現在の流行状況や急速な伝播の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はメディア記事であり、感染症イベント検知ソースとしては個別症例の医学的物語である。2007年の旅行後、2010年に症状出現、2017年に治癒という19年前の過去事例の医学的フォローアップ報告。現在の流行、集団発生、公衆衛生上の懸念事項はない。Bluedot APIによって英国も検出されているが、感染源はインド滞在中であり、英国での感染ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Cruz Naranjo se une contra el dengue | Diario de Centro América
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Cruz Naranjo joins the fight against dengue
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, health workers and residents of Pueblo Ralo Teocinte in Santa Cruz Naranjo, Santa Rosa department, Guatemala, joined a scrap-removal drive to reduce dengue risk by limiting Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Participants collected and removed discarded containers, tires, bottles, and other debris capable of holding standing water, thereby curbing mosquito proliferation. The Ministry of Public Health and Social Assistance (MSPAS) noted that such actions strengthen preventive surveillance and community protection. In addition to cleanup, families received guidance on keeping yards clean, covering water storage containers, and routinely inspecting areas where rainwater can accumulate. The initiative underscores local vector-control efforts to mitigate dengue transmission through source reduction and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルーズ・ナランホがデング熱撲滅に参加 | セントロ・アメリカ日報
triage.triage_reason: 記事はグアテマラの単発の予防啓発活動を報告するものであり、デング熱の新規発生・増加・異常を示す事象ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはグアテマラ（対象国外）での予防キャンペーンを述べており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国での感染症イベント発生を報告していない。Bluedot APIの発生地域にPhilippines (1694008) が含まれているが、記事本文でフィリピンは言及されておらず、イベントはグアテマラのみで発生している。したがって verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Why India Is Closely Watching The World's First Leishmaniasis Vaccine | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization data indicate more than one billion people across nearly 100 countries, including India, remain at risk of kala-azar (visceral leishmaniasis). India has made remarkable progress over the past decade, reducing cases to historically low levels through sustained surveillance, early diagnosis, improved treatment, and vector-control measures. Yet elimination as a public health problem does not mean the disease has disappeared: the parasite still circulates in some endemic areas. Health experts warn that any relaxation in surveillance could permit transmission to rebound. The article notes India’s close attention amid discussion of the world’s first leishmaniasis vaccine, underscoring the need for ongoing vigilance, continued public health investments, and robust monitoring to sustain gains against kala-azar.

triage.headline_ja: インドが世界初のリーシュマニア症ワクチンを注視する理由 | Outlook India
triage.triage_reason: カラ・アザル（内臓リーシュマニア症）は公衆衛生上の重要な疾患であり、インドは流行地域で継続的な監視が必要な状況にある。しかし記事は新規発生イベントではなく、ワクチン開発動向の報道であるため、直ちにフルRRA対象とはしない。続報を注視して実際の流行再発の兆候がないか監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はリーシュマニア症ワクチン開発に対するインドの関心を述べたもので、新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。ただしインドは依然として流行地域であり、監視体制の緩和による再発リスク（prolonged exposure, epidemic prone基準に該当）が識別されている。実際の症例増加やアウトブレイク兆候の続報があれば直ちにPICKUP判定に引き上げる。

article.articleHeadline: Casos confirmados de ébola en RDC ascienden a 1.333
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC rise to 1,333.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,333 as of July 1, 2026. Infections have been recorded in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, according to authorities cited by Reuters. Officials estimate the virus began spreading months before the first officially detected cases were announced on May 15, suggesting substantial exposure of medical personnel prior to confirmation, amid reports of a severe shortage of basic protective equipment such as gloves and masks. The report highlights ongoing humanitarian and health worker strain within Kinshasa-based operations and MONUSCO missions as part of the response. No death toll or transmission-chain details are provided in the piece.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ確定患者数が1,333人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生で、対象国DRCにおいて確認された重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生。確定患者数1,333人、複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での感染確認。医療従事者の曝露歴あり、防護具不足が報告されている。MONUSCO任務等での対応が進行中。死亡者数・詳細な感染経路は記事に記載されていない。国際的な懸念が高く、全ての評価基準を満たすため、フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Besok Dimulai, Dinas PKH Riau Ajak Warga Manfaatkan Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting tomorrow, the Riau PKH Office invites residents to take advantage of free rabies vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Riau Province, Indonesia, offers free vaccination for dogs, cats, and monkeys starting July 2, 2026, at the Riau Provincial Veterinary Laboratory and Animal Clinic (LVKH) in Pekanbaru, from 08:00–15:00 WIB. Organized as part of the 2026 Rabies Vaccination Month by the Riau Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Health (DPKH). Residents are urged to bring a copy of ID (KTP), ensure pets are healthy, at least three months old, and not pregnant. Rabies remains fatal once clinical signs appear, with transmission from animals to humans via bites or scratches from infected animals. The vaccination program aims to increase immunization coverage among animals to reduce human rabies risk and raise awareness. This is a public health measure to protect pets and communities in Pekanbaru and broader Riau.

triage.headline_ja: 明日から開始、リアウ州PKH局が住民に無料狂犬病ワクチン接種の利用を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 記事は狂犬病の予防ワクチン接種キャンペーン（公衆衛生対策の実施）であり、アウトブレイク・危機的な疾病集団発生ではない。異常な感染例の報告や国際的なリスク増加を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーン告知であり、感染症危機を示唆するシグナルではない。公衆衛生対策の通常の実施報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК достигло почти 400 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus disease in the DRC has reached nearly 400.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,333 confirmed cases, 399 deaths, and 189 recoveries (case fatality rate 28.7%). The UNDP Resident Representative in DRC, Damien Mama, warned the epidemic could push about 1 million more people into poverty in a country where roughly 60% live in poverty. He projected Africa-wide economic costs up to $3.6 billion and the loss of more than 300,000 jobs. Even if control is achieved, the DRC could lose over $1 billion in revenue and about 55,000 jobs, potentially reducing the continent’s GDP by around $2.37 billion. The report highlights substantial health and broader socio-economic impacts from the outbreak."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による死亡数が約400人に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認症例1,333人、死亡399人の大規模エボラアウトブレイク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的経済被害、世界的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。確認症例1,333人、死亡399人、症例致命率28.7%。UNDP試算では、100万人以上が貧困に陥る可能性、アフリカ全域の経済損失36億米ドル、30万人以上の失業が予測されている。公衆衛生上および社会経済的に極めて深刻なイベント。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Amuru, Adjumani strengthen Ebola response at Elegu b
article.articleSummary: June 30, 2026: Amuru and Adjumani Ebola task forces met at the Elegu border crossing (URA clearance office) to strengthen cross-border screening, surveillance, emergency response, coordination and preparedness for Ebola in Uganda’s busiest entry point. Amuru has nine suspected Ebola cases and Adjumani one since the outbreak; the groups will meet biweekly to review preparedness. Apio Sharon Baru (Adjumani chair) warned that border openness keeps both districts at risk due to shared markets and families, with most cases imported via porous borders and refugee movements, per Amuru RDC Geoffrey Oceng. Amuru LC5 chair Christopher Odongkara urged sustained cooperation and stricter SOP implementation. Planned measures include enhanced training for border security personnel and health workers, border immunisation, expanded IEC materials, and additional Amuru port-health staff. Uganda also reports 20 Ebola cases and two deaths in the eastern DRC outbreak, with 15 imported and 3 under treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アムル州、アジュマニ州がエレグ境界線でのエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた発生・拡大リスク、複数国での症例報告、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスク、および地域全体での緊急対応の必要性がIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ疾患。DRCとウガンダの両国で症例が確認され、ウガンダでは国境地域での管理体制強化が急務。多孔性国境、難民移動、市場共有など地域特性による継続的な曝露リスクが指摘されている。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、ウガンダとの国境を越えた発生であり重大。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-frykt på sykehus i Skottland - testet negativt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fears at a hospital in Scotland - tested negative.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola scare at Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Scotland triggered heightened alert on 1 July 2026 after a patient admitted early Tuesday raised suspicion of hemorrhagic fever. Public Health Scotland confirmed after several hours of testing that the patient was negative for Ebola. Had the result been positive, it would have marked the first UK Ebola case in many years. Despite the alarm, no hospital wards were closed and patient flow continued normally, since Ebola is not airborne and transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids. The incident comes amid the WHO-declared global health emergency over an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; France also reported its first case after a clinician returned from the region. In response, the UK activated a dedicated monitoring program (RWS) for returning health and aid workers to enable rapid detection of any future infections.

triage.headline_ja: スコットランドの病院でエボラ不安 - 検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際的に拡大するリスク基準を満たし、DRCとウガンダでの進行中の流行が存在するが、本報告は偽陽性アラートであり、対象国での実際の症例ではない。スクリーニング基準を部分的に満たすが情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はスコットランドでの疑い患者の陰性確認であり、対象国内での実際の感染症イベントではない。背景情報として DRC とウガンダでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、記事の焦点は偽陽性アラートである。対象国リストにおいて、DRC のみが実際の流行地として verified_locations に含まれる。スコットランド（英国）の記事ではあるが、英国は対象国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 399 وفاة جراء تفشي فيروس إيبولا بجمهورية الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 399 deaths due to an Ebola virus outbreak in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) announced that Ebola virus disease has caused 399 deaths, with 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases. The announcement confirms ongoing escalation of an Ebola outbreak in the DRC, also affecting Uganda. The World Health Organization (WHO), in May, classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), noting a high regional risk of further spread. The report does not specify infection sources or recoveries. Figures reflect confirmed cases as of the date. This development underscores continued surveillance needs and the potential for cross-border transmission, prompting international attention and coordination among affected countries to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスのコンゴ共和国での流行により399人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO PHEIC指定済みの大規模エボラ流行で、複数国に影響。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC(Kinshasa)でのエボラ流行を主題としており、また「Uganda」への影響も述べているが、対象国リストではUgandaは含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。WHO PHEIC指定済み（2026年5月）で、1,333確定例・399死亡という大規模流行の段階にある。国際的な警戒度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nam bệnh nhân suýt tử vong do sốc nhiễm trùng, hoại tử vùng cổ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A male patient nearly died due to septic shock and necrosis of the neck region.
article.articleSummary: A 53-year-old man from Ho Chi Minh City with diabetes, heart failure, kidney failure and electrolyte disturbances developed extensive neck infection and septic shock after drainage of a neck abscess. He was admitted to Thủ Đức General Hospital on April 26 with widespread infection and necrosis in deep neck spaces; the left common carotid vein was completely occluded, with necrosis of vessels and small nerves. An emergency multidisciplinary operation removed all necrotic tissue, revealing involvement of the left parapharyngeal, left submandibular, and left lateral pharyngeal spaces, and a large neck defect exposing the sternocleidomastoid muscle and carotid sheath. Postoperative care combined infection control, comorbidity management, glycemic control, wound care, and rehabilitation. After about six weeks of intensive treatment, infection was controlled, vitals stabilized, and the skin flap remained viable; discharge occurred about a week later. Emphasizes rapid recognition and multidisciplinary management for deep neck infections to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: 敗血症ショックと頸部壊死により危うく死亡した男性患者5人
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の集団発生ではなく、既往症を持つ個別患者の臨床症例報告。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威性なし。
triage.notes: 本事例は単一患者の術後管理成功に関する臨床報告であり、感染症の流行や集団発生ではない。疾患分類が「Unknown Illness」となっているが、実際には深頸部感染症（深頸部膿瘍）の既知疾患である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie s'étend, 377 morts et une menace régionale grandissante - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the outbreak is spreading, 377 dead and a growing regional threat - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths as of June 28, 2026, with a case fatality rate of 28.8% and the Bundibugyo strain in circulation. The epidemic has spread from Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to a fourth province, affecting the eastern part of the country and a region home to about 15 million people. About 300 confirmed cases remain “untraceable” or untracked, a major risk for uncontrolled spread. There are 615 patients hospitalized in isolation and 180 have recovered; 16 new recoveries bring the reported total to 138. On June 29, authorities confirmed at least 300 positive cases in the eastern natural region. To curb transmission, Bunia airport in Ituri suspended flights. The situation calls for intensified case finding, treatment capacity, and international support to prevent regional spillover in the Great Lakes area.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ：感染拡大、377人死亡、地域的脅威が増大 - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（1,307確認症例、377人死亡）、複数州への地域的拡大、約300人の追跡不可症例、国際的支援の明示的な要請。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大。377人死亡、1,307確認症例、約300人の追跡不可症例が地域的蔓延の重大リスク。Bunia空港が便を停止。グレートレイクス地域への地域的流出を防ぐため、国際的支援が明示的に要請されている。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BM'den korkutan Ebola açıklaması: Risk büyüyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN's Alarming Ebola Statement: The Risk Is Rising.
article.articleSummary: UN officials warn that the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) carries rising risk. Even if contained, the crisis could cost the DRC more than $1 billion in revenue and about 55,000 jobs, reducing GDP by roughly $2.37 billion. Families are breaking isolation measures as unemployment rises and markets slow, highlighting that medical intervention alone is not enough. The outbreak began in May in eastern DRC, with laboratory-confirmed cases reaching 1,274 and deaths at 360 to date.

triage.headline_ja: 国連の警告するエボラ声明：リスクが高まっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。確認症例数1,274例、死亡数360例の重大なエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。国際的な関心と支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ブンディブギョ株）のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。5月開始、確認症例1,274例、死亡360例。経済的影響も甚大（GDP $2.37 billion減少見込み）。隔離措置からの離脱が増加しており、医学的介入だけでは不十分な状況。国連による懸念表明が報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: 新增1例登革熱境外移入病例　南市加強清消並呼籲出國做好防蚊措施 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new imported dengue fever case in Tainan City; the city steps up cleaning and disinfection and urges those traveling abroad to take mosquito precautions | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: One new imported dengue fever case reported in Tainan City, Taiwan. A 60-something male resident of Xinnanli, Xinying District contracted dengue after Cambodia travel (June 18–22) and returned to Taiwan, developing fever and back pain after attending an event in Hsinchu City on June 27. NS1 screening was positive and PCR confirmed on June 29, marking Tainan’s fourth imported dengue case. Nationally, Taiwan had 80 imported dengue cases by June 29, with Indonesia the most common source, followed by the Maldives and Vietnam. The Tainan Dengue Fever Prevention Center deployed emergency fogging, environmental sanitation, vector-density surveys, and health education; chemical control is planned. Travelers to dengue-endemic areas are urged to take precautions and seek prompt medical care with travel history. Hospitals should screen for travel history and report suspected dengue within 24 hours, or face penalties. Heavy rains have boosted breeding; ovitraps captured over 370,000 Aedes eggs by week 25, mobilizing 135 communities (27 more than last year).

triage.headline_ja: 新増1例登革熱境外移入病例　南市加強清消並呼籲出國做好防蚊措施
triage.triage_reason: 台湾からの1例の輸入デング熱報告。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（異常/予想外）。WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）だが、既知の感染症の通常の流行パターンであり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（対象国リスト外）の輸入デング熱1例について報告。患者はカンボジア旅行後の感染で、関連地域としてインドネシア、モルディブ、ベトナムが言及されている。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。雨季による蚊の繁殖増加とサーベイランス強化が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果、烏干達伊波拉疫情未歇　疾管署：4機場「免費採檢」至8／30 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreaks in the Congo and Uganda are not over yet; Taiwan CDC: Free testing at four airports until August 30
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda persist, with Taiwan’s CDC extending free voluntary testing for asymptomatic travelers who visited DRC or Uganda within 21 days back to Taiwan, now through August 30 at four airports (Songshan, Taoyuan, Taichung, Kaohsiung). DRC: as of June 27, 1,274 confirmed cases, 360 deaths, 178 recoveries; hotspots in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu across 35 health districts. Uganda: 20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, 15 recoveries; cases mainly in Kampala and Wakiso, linked to cross-border movement and medical exposure, no community transmission. France reports the first imported EVD case from DRC, a humanitarian physician, with 5 contacts quarantined; WHO risk remains very high for DRC and high for Uganda and neighboring countries. Taiwan mandates border measures and 21-day post-travel health management with daily self-reports; if symptoms arise, seek medical care. Domestic: by June 29, 20 travelers with travel history are under autonomous health management; 6 tested at airports, 4 negative, 2 pending.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ウガンダのエボラ疫情は収まらず　台湾CDC：4空港で8月30日まで「無料検査」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い公衆衛生上の影響と異常性を有し、IHR基準2つ以上該当。DRC・ウガンダでの継続的な流行、フランスへの国際拡大、複数国での対策実施が確認される。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダのエボラ流行が主要な内容。Bluedot APIが検出した台湾・フランスは検査体制・防疫措置の実施地域であり、実際の感染症発生地ではない。対象国のうち検証可能な発生地はDRCのみ。中国（浙江省・松山など）が発生地域に列挙されているが、サマリーに中国での感染事例の報告はなく、台湾の空港名（松山）の地理的誤認と判断。ただしWhatsApp等での中国への情報伝播の可能性を考慮し、モニタリング対象として「China」を計上。

article.articleHeadline: Los muertos por el brote de ébola en África Central aumentan a 400 y los casos confirmados superan los 1.300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa rise to 400, and confirmed cases exceed 1,300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared mid-May in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) has caused about 400 deaths among more than 1,300 confirmed cases. By June 29: 1,333 cases, 399 deaths, 189 recovered, 609 in treatment; 26 new infections and 9 new recoveries; case fatality about 29.7%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with a 30–50% fatality range and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Declared May 15 in Ituri; Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths; France confirms its first Ebola case in Europe in a doctor returning from the DRC. WHO labeled the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally. The United States raised its alert to Level 1, sending MBP134 antibody treatment doses to DRC and Uganda, and directing enhanced screening for flights from DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda; diagnostic tests for variants are being deployed. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ中部のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる死者が400人に増加し、確認患者数は1,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。複数国での確認例、WHO PHEIC指定、多数の死亡・重症例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCが主要な発生国で、ウガンダ、フランス、米国での輸入例も記載されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（致死率30～50%）による大規模アウトブレイク。WHO PEICは5月17日に指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: 3 con đường lây truyền HIV và những biện pháp phòng ngừa ai cũng cần biết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three routes of HIV transmission and the preventive measures everyone should know.
article.articleSummary: HIV transmits via three routes: sexual contact, blood, and mother-to-child transmission. Sexual transmission is the most common, with the virus present in blood, semen, and vaginal secretions; risk rises with unprotected intercourse (vaginal, anal, or oral), multiple partners, or unprotected anal sex. Blood-borne transmission occurs through shared needles or sharp instruments and, though pre-transfusion screening has greatly reduced risk, remains possible. Mother-to-child transmission can occur during pregnancy, delivery, or breastfeeding if untreated. Casual activities do not spread HIV. Preventive measures include consistent condom use with water-based lubricants to preserve integrity, avoiding sharing needles, and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) with ARV for high-risk uninfected individuals, which can reduce acquisition risk by up to 97% for sexual transmission and 74% for injection use when used correctly. For pregnant women, early HIV testing and ARV during pregnancy reduce mother-to-child transmission. Hue city is expanding PrEP for high-risk groups aiming to end AIDS by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染の3つの伝播経路と誰もが知るべき予防措置
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHIV感染の一般的な伝播経路と予防方法に関する教育的情報であり、新規の感染症イベント・アウトブレイク報告ではない。ベトナムの特定地域での異常な集団発生の報告もなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIVの伝播経路に関する一般向け啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な感染数増加、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告を含まない。Hue市でのPrEP拡大は予防プログラムの進展に関する情報であり、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假出國防登革熱 高市府衛生局推「決戰境外」獎勵專案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer Vacation Travel Abroad to Prevent Dengue Fever; Kaohsiung City Government Health Bureau Launches the “Battle Overseas” Incentive Program.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises with summer travel to Southeast Asia as Kaohsiung City Government Health Bureau launches a 'Battle Overseas' dengue prevention incentive program from July to August. With travelers to Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Cambodia increasing, the program targets university and below students, new residents and their families, and foreign workers traveling abroad or returning home. Free mosquito repellent will be distributed at city high and middle schools and at health offices; travelers should maintain personal mosquito protection during trips. Within 14 days of returning, anyone with fever, retro-orbital headache, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash should seek prompt medical care within two days and inform doctors of TOCC (travel history, occupation, contact, cluster). Dengue testing (rapid test or related labs) may be performed, with a NT$500 voucher upon testing; asymptomatic returnees can also receive testing and the voucher. Emphasize early detection, diagnosis, and treatment to curb imported cases and community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 暑假出國防登革熱 高市府衛生局推「決戰境外」獎勵專案
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市がデング熱予防プログラムを立ち上げた背景には、東南アジア圏での感染リスク上昇が示唆されているが、具体的な発生・患者数データが記事に明記されていない。IHR基準の判定には十分な情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはSingapore、Cambodia、Taiwanも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は台湾(高雄市)の当局が立ち上げた予防プログラムであり、東南アジアへの渡航者向けの対策。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ベトナム、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイは旅行先として明示されており、verified_locationsに含める。記事は予防施策に焦点があり、具体的な発生例や患者数の報告がないため、IHR基準の判定が困難。

article.articleHeadline: Десятки российских туристов столкнулись с редким заболеванием на Бали: подробности
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Russian tourists have come down with a rare disease in Bali: details.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists and remote workers in Bali have contracted Hong Kong influenza. The illness begins like a cold but rapidly escalates, with severe headache, high fever, body aches, and cough; some cases include nausea and vomiting. The acute phase lasts about a week, after which many patients experience intense headaches and fatigue for several weeks. The report, sourced to the Telegram channel Baza, notes the cluster currently is in Bali, with ongoing infections among this group. The article also mentions a separate warning for Russian travelers: in Western Europe, dengue fever risk exists, with mosquitoes carrying dengue found in Africa and Asia. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report, and it does not specify transmission links or onset dates beyond the publication date of 2026-07-01.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島で珍しい病気に罹患したロシア人観光客数十名：詳細
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）でのH3N2インフルエンザのクラスター発生が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性と重症度、またWPRO基準の重症度・流行性において該当。国際的な観光地での多数の症例報告は公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはロシア人観光客がバリ島（インドネシア）でH3N2インフルエンザに感染したクラスター発生を報告。デング熱についての言及は一般的な警告（アフリカ・アジアにおける蚊）であり、バリでのデング熱事例は記述されていない。そのため verified_locations はインドネシアのみ。ロシアは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは患者発生地がバリとされているため除外。詳細な検査確認やヒト-ヒト感染の経路情報が不足しているが、国際観光地でのクラスター報告として顕著なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: La BDEAC et la CEMAC unissent leurs efforts pour financer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BDEAC and CEMAC join forces to finance the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Emergency funds mobilized by the Central African Development Bank (BDEAC) and the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (CEMAC) to fight Ebola. At a June 29 meeting in Brazzaville, they agreed to accelerate unlocking resources from the Special Emergency Health Fund to restrict Ebola spread in the sub-region. Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, near Central African states. BDEAC and CEMAC officials Baltasar Engonga Edjo'o and Jean Paterne Megne Ekoga underscored rapidly providing finance to the CEMAC Commission so member states Cameroon, Gabon, Chad, Republic of the Congo, Central African Republic, and Equatorial Guinea can promptly implement prevention and response measures. A Special Emergency Health Fund is planned, with a large portion funded by the Community Development Fund (FODEC), managed by the BDEAC.

triage.headline_ja: BDEACとCEMAC、エボラ対策資金調達で協力
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの地域的脅威に対する国際的な資金調達と対策強化の動きであり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）と社会的関心の両面で該当。対象国DRCでの持続的感染と近隣国への波及リスク管理体制の構築を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ中部での多国間資金調達協力を報じているが、実際のエボラ発生地として明示されているのはDRCのみ。周辺国（カメルーン、ガボン、チャド、コンゴ共和国、中央アフリカ共和国、赤道ギニア）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの「active」なエボラ感染と地域的波及防止の緊急対応が主題であり、重篤な地域危機管理シグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ternyata Ini Alasan Ratusan Kasus Flu Singapura Ditemukan di Sumsel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turns out this is the reason why hundreds of Singapore flu cases were found in South Sumatra.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), locally called Singapore flu, is rising in South Sumatra, Indonesia, with 523 suspected cases reported from January through Week 23 of 2026. HFMD mainly affects children under five but can infect adults, and is highly contagious, clustering in places where children gather such as PAUD, kindergartens, primary schools, and playgrounds. Public health expert Dr. Ngabila Salama attributes the uptick to seasonal patterns and ease of transmission. Ira Primadesa, head of Prevention and Control of Diseases (P2P) for the South Sumatra Health Office in Palembang, notes the figure is cumulative through Week 1–Week 23 of 2026, and HFMD is seasonal, peaking during transitional seasons and the dry season. Symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, and a rash on the hands and feet. Parents are advised not to panic and to seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラで数百件の手足口病（シンガポール風邪）が検出された理由
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病（HFMD）の季節性発生とされているが、2026年第1〜23週で523件の疑い例が報告されている。小児集団施設での高い伝播性と季節パターンの交差点における多数症例の報告はWPRO基準（異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71（EV-A71）は小児における重症HFMD病例のリスク要因。523件の疑い例数は一定期間の累積数（2026年1月〜第23週）であり、死亡率や重症化率について記事サマリーに記載なし。季節性パターンの説明により医学的には合理的だが、保健当局の継続的な監視と確認検査が重要。インドネシアは検査能力と報告体制の強化が必要な可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا إلى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases to.
article.articleSummary: On June 30, 2026, government data cited by Reuters show that confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,333, with 399 deaths. The fatalities are reported across the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The figures, released on June 30 and published July 1, 2026, indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC. The brief provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. This update confirms the continued impact of Ebola in the eastern regions of the country, specifically the three affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラの確認患者数が上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ一類感染症であり、確認患者1,333名・死亡399名の大規模アウトブレイクはIHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「異常性」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率（記事では死亡率約30%）を持つ一類感染症。東部州（Ituri、South Kivu）での複数地域での確認患者報告は、対応困難性（医療インフラ不足）と国際的懸念を示唆。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Перебравшиеся на Бали россияне заразились гонконгским гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians who relocated to Bali contracted the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-01, Russians relocating to Bali, Indonesia, contracted the Hong Kong flu, with a significant number of infections among tourists and expatriates. Illness began like a common cold, then progressed to intense headache, high fever, myalgias, arthralgia, and cough; nausea and vomiting occurred in some cases. The acute phase lasts about one week, followed by several weeks of persistent headache and fatigue. Separately, a 38-year-old Khimki resident who traveled to Southern Africa (South Africa, Zambia, Zimbabwe) developed dengue fever after visiting Kruger National Park and Victoria Falls. Symptoms began May 23 with weakness and fever; fever recurred with temperatures up to 38.7°C, plus headache, myalgias, and a rash on hands and back. Malaria or hepatitis were initially suspected, but laboratory confirmation established dengue. The patient is receiving treatment.

triage.headline_ja: バリに移住したロシア人がホンコンインフルエンザに感染
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ）におけるインフルエンザの複数事例、および南アフリカ地域（ザンビア、ジンバブエ）のデング熱の確認症例が報告されており、複数国での異なる感染症イベントが同時に記録されている。IHR基準および社会的関心により、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は複合的な感染症イベントを報告している：(1) インドネシア・バリでのインフルエンザの観光客・在留者への集団発症、(2) ロシア（モスクワ州）からの渡航者が南アフリカ地域でデング熱感染。バリはインドネシア領土内、ザンビアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ジンバブエはBluedot APIで検出されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南アフリカ（Mpumalanga、Victoria Falls周辺）も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数の感染症と複数国への国際拡大のリスクが認識される。

article.articleHeadline: 'Absolutely disgusting!' British tourist left with 38 parasites in her brain after holiday to India
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by pork tapeworm larvae led to 38 parasites inhabiting Lowri Denman's brain after a 2007 India trip. The Cardiff woman first noticed the infection when a metre-long tapeworm was found in a restaurant toilet. She developed debilitating headaches starting in 2010 and had a seizure in 2011, prompting brain imaging that revealed 38 brain parasites. Initially suspected toxoplasmosis; lab tests were inconclusive until imaging confirmed neurocysticercosis. The infection source was likely ingestion of pork containing tapeworm eggs during travel through India, despite avoiding meat. Treated with anti-parasitic drugs and steroids for two weeks, she later experienced brain swelling and psychiatric symptoms, requiring neuropsychiatric care. The parasites calcified and no surgery was needed; she has been seizure-free since 2017 but will require lifelong epilepsy medication. Only a handful of Britons are diagnosed each year; the case was discussed by experts in Britain and the US.

triage.headline_ja: 「ひどい！」イギリス人観光客、インド旅行後に脳内に38匹の寄生虫を持つことになった
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告であり、流行やアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準は該当せず、WPRO基準も満たさない。社会的関心は限定的（個人的な医学ニュース）。
triage.notes: 本記事は2007年のインド旅行に由来する個別症例（2010年発症、2017年以降寛解）の報道であり、現在の流行やアウトブレイク情報ではない。神経嚢虫症の既知のリスク地域における単一事例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要な状況ではない。メディア関心は高いが、感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルとして認識しない。
