article.articleHeadline: Alertă în Marea Britanie: suspiciune de Ebola într-un spital din Glasgow
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in the United Kingdom: suspicion of Ebola at a hospital in Glasgow.
article.articleSummary: Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital is testing a patient for suspected Ebola; results are pending. If positive, it would be the United Kingdom's first Ebola case since outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda in May. WHO declared the Congo/Uganda outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde said no hospital sections were closed and visitors need not avoid the facility. Public Health Scotland, working with the UK Health Security Agency, is assessing routes by which travelers from affected countries could reach the UK. No confirmed Ebola cases in Scotland; risk to the general population remains low. Authorities are prepared to conduct epidemiological investigations and preventive testing for contacts if needed. France confirmed its first Ebola case last week, a doctor returning from DRC. In 2014, Scottish nurse Pauline Cafferkey contracted Ebola after returning from Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: 英国アラート：グラスゴーの病院でエボラが疑われている
triage.triage_reason: WHO が宣言した国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態（DRC/ウガンダでのアウトブレイク）に関連し、複数国での検査・確認症例があり、国際的拡大リスクが明白である。IHR基準で3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主題はグラスゴー（英国）とDRC/ウガンダでの確認アウトブレイク関連の検査である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地である。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み、フランスでも確認症例あり、複数国での疑い例検査が進行中。これはシグナル拾い上げの典型例。

article.articleHeadline: Health ministry raise alarm on cholera risk after Accra floods - The Herald ghana
article.articleSummary: Cholera risk heightened in Ghana after Accra floods. Health Ministry warns that contaminated water sources, stagnant water, overflowing drains, and poor waste disposal raise the likelihood of a cholera outbreak, with coastal communities as hotspots due to sanitation challenges and high population density. A three-month plan will bolster disease surveillance, case management, community engagement and risk communication to prevent transmission during the rainy season. Public advice includes drinking safe water, washing hands with soap, using hygienic toilets and promptly reporting severe diarrhoea and vomiting to health facilities. Government allocated GHS 300 million from the Contingency Fund for flood relief and mitigation (GHS 150m emergency relief, GHS 150m mitigation). Ghana Armed Forces and Police deployed to support NADMO relief operations; President Mahama emphasises prevention and protection of lives.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アクラの洪水後のコレラリスク警告 - ザ・ヘラルド・ガーナ
triage.triage_reason: コレラ（高致死率病原体）が洪水による水系汚染で発生リスク高まっており、IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）および WPRO基準複数該当。政府・国際的関心も確認され、シグナル認定。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域はガーナのアクラおよびグレータ・アクラ地域を示しており、記事サマリーもガーナに限定。洪水による水系汚染がコレラ発生リスクを直接的に高めている。政府が300百万セディの対応予算を配置し、保健省が積極的な3ヶ月計画を実施中。雨季中の感染拡大リスク高い。ただし、対象国リストにガーナ（GeoNames ID 2300660）が含まれているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de Ebola hızla yayılıyor: 1274 vaka, 360 ölü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in KDC: 1,274 cases, 360 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began May 15 in Ituri, with 1,274 confirmed Ebola cases and 360 deaths in the first month. The Bundibugyo virus variant underlies the outbreak; Ituri is the epicenter, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. No approved vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; early diagnosis and intensive supportive care are essential. Health authorities report ongoing transmission and emphasize contact tracing, while security barriers and late presentation hinder response. WHO and Africa CDC warn of cross-border spillover risk to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Congo, Tanzania, Zambia, and Kenya, urging stronger border controls, surveillance, and laboratory capacity. Historical major outbreaks include 2018-2020 North Kivu/Ituri and the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが急速に拡大：1,274件の症例、360人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異体による大規模outbreak、高い致命率、多数の隣接国への越境リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（South Kivu、Ituri州）が主な発生地。越境リスク国として複数列挙されているが、サマリー上で実際の症例が確認されている対象国はDRCのみ。Zambiaは越境リスク警告対象として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。2026年7月1日時点で1,274症例360死亡（致命率28.3%）という極めて深刻な状況。ワクチンなし、サポーティブケアのみが治療法という厳しい背景。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假出遊警戒！越南腸病毒肆虐高達78%為EV71 醫籲打疫苗預防
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer vacation travel advisory! Enteroviruses ravage Vietnam, with up to 78% being EV71; doctors urge vaccination for prevention.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces a nationwide hand-foot-mouth disease surge driven by enteroviruses, with cases rising from 34,000 to 55,000 and 10 deaths; EV71 accounts for 78% of detections and about 80% of severe illnesses. Northern Vietnam’s National Children’s Hospital has admitted nearly 3,000 cases, about one-third severe; Ho Chi Minh City reports rapid deterioration with delayed care. In Taiwan, domestic enterovirus activity is rising (Week 25 ED/OPD visits 6,837, up 8.3%); Coxsackie A6 is most common, followed by A4 and EV-D68, with five severe cases including one death this year. Nearby regions show higher activity: Mainland China over 390,000 cases by June 14 (A16 predominates); Thailand over 17,000 cases with 1,851 hospitalizations; Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Singapore rising. Taiwan’s pediatric societies urge EV71 vaccination and designate July 1 as 'EV71 Stabilization Day.' An available EV71 vaccine offers long-term protection; dosing is three doses before age 2, or two doses (56 days apart) for ages 2–6, lasting at least five years.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休み外出警報！ベトナムで腸病毒蔓延、EV71が78%を占める 医師がワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: EV71を主体とした腸病毒の多国的な急速な拡大（ベトナム5.5万例、死亡10例、中国39万例超、タイ1.7万例以上）。国際的な流行の兆候が明らかで、複数の対象国での重症例発生が報告されており、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の対象国でのEV71/腸病毒流行を報告しており、ベトナムでの症例急増（34,000→55,000）と死亡例、重症化率（約80%）、中国での39万例超、タイでの1.7万例超が記載されている。対象国リストに含まれるHong Kong（China扱い）、Taiwan（非対象国だが記事で言及）、Japan、Korea、Singaporeも活動上昇が報告されているが、記事主題はベトナム中心の流行危機。台湾の記事掲載元（udn.com）だが内容はアジア広域の流行状況を網羅している。夏休み時期の国際移動による感染拡大リスクが明示的に警告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana declares war on dengue: Free platelets in every district hospital, free testing across state
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, Haryana announced a statewide anti-dengue push amid monsoon-driven risk, offering free platelet transfusions at district Civil Hospitals and free dengue testing at 27 government laboratories. Health Minister Aarti Singh Rao launched 'Let's Stop Dengue Together' and designated July as Anti-Dengue Month, urging public participation and private-sector price caps: ELISA NS-1 and IgM dengue tests in private labs capped at ₹600. The strategy targets Aedes mosquitoes breeding in clean stagnant water, with campaigns for water-management at homes and offices, Dry Day observances, and removal of containers, tyres, and other breeding sites. Citizens experiencing fever with severe headache, muscle/joint pain, or retro-orbital pain should seek free blood testing at government facilities; self-medication is discouraged. The initiative emphasizes community action, surveillance, and free diagnostics to curb dengue in Haryana.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州、デング熱に対する宣戦布告：各地区病院で無料血小板、州全体で無料検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な流行に対する公衆衛生対策の発表。通常の予防キャンペーンのため、現在のところ異常性や重症度の高さを示す情報は確認できず、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は公式な予防キャンペーンの発表であり、流行状況や症例数の詳細は記載されていない。モンスーン時期のデング熱は南アジアで周期的に発生する通常の季節性疾患。ハリヤナ州はインドの対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Daftar Desa dengan Habitat Terbanyak Nyamuk Penyebab Malaria di Pesawaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: List of Villages with the Most Malaria-Carrying Mosquito Habitats in Pesawaran
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, malaria remains concentrated along coastal Teluk Pandan in Pesawaran, Lampung, Indonesia, with six of ten villages designated endemic by the UPTD Puskesmas Hanura: Sukajaya Lempasing, Hurun, Hanura, Sidodadi, Gebang, and Batu Menyan. Hillside villages are not endemic due to distance from Anopheles breeding sites. Anopheles mosquitoes breed in brackish coastal waters, especially around ponds, lagoons, swamps, and water channels. Within these coastal pockets, transmission is focal rather than widespread: cases cluster in Dusun 3 Laut and Dusun 7 Mutun in Sukajaya Lempasing, and in Dusun Tanjung Jaya, Dusun Seribu, Dusun Induk, Dusun Hilir, and Dusun Suko Agung in Gebang. Nazlina Mayanti, head of the Hanura health center, notes endemic pockets align with habitats near ponds and waterways, not across all Teluk Pandan villages.

triage.headline_ja: ペサワラン地区におけるマラリア媒介蚊の最多生息地域の村リスト
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるマラリアの地域的な集中確認だが、既知の風土病地域における焦点的な伝播であり、新規の大規模流行や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: マラリアは周知の風土病であり、本記事はペサワラン地区における既知の風土病地域での焦点的伝播を報告している。死亡数や重症例の報告がなく、管理可能性も高い。地方保健当局による実施可能な対策（蚊の生息地の特定と管理）が既に実行されている。スクリーニング基準2つ該当（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）するが、社会的関心や国際的懸念の根拠が薄いため、WATCHレベルで継続監視する。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli. Pacjent z podejrzeniem wirusa w brytyjskim szpitalu. Znany jest już wynik testu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic. A patient with suspected Ebola virus infection in a British hospital. The test result is already known.
article.articleSummary: Public Health Scotland reported that one person in Scotland was tested for Ebola as a precaution after a patient at Glasgow’s Queen Elizabeth University Hospital was suspected of infection. The result was negative; there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Scotland. Scotland has travel- and case‑assessment protocols for travellers from Ebola-affected areas, and health workers monitor potentially exposed individuals; organisations sending staff to outbreak zones should register them in a dedicated program. Had the Glasgow case been confirmed, it would have been the first UK Ebola case since the WHO declared a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the current Ebola outbreak has 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths as of Monday evening. Begun May 15, it is the 17th outbreak since 1976 and has reached Uganda. Ebola is highly infectious and spreads through contact with blood, secretions and waste from infected people; Africa has recorded over 15,000 Ebola deaths in 50 years, with the 2018–2020 DR Congo outbreak responsible for about 2,300.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行。英国病院でエボラウイルス感染の疑いのある患者。検査結果は既に判明している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、DRCでの活動的なエボラ流行（1,307確定例、377死亡）が背景にあり、国際的監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なイベントはDRC内のアクティブなエボラ流行（1,307確定例、377死亡、5月15日開始）。英国での疑い例は陰性で、記事の文脈では背景情報として機能している。DRCはEBS対象国であり、17番目のアウトブレイク（1976年以来）であり、既にウガンダにも到達。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDC Rastreia Possível Propagação do Vírus Para Duas Novas Províncias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DRC Traces Possible Spread of the Virus to Two New Provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Democratic Republic of Congo health authorities are tracing potential exposures in two new provinces as the latest outbreak, declared May 15, has infected 1,307 people and caused 377 deaths in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu as of June 29, 2026. In Tshopo, health workers are tracing exposed individuals linked to a pregnant woman who died of Ebola in Niania, Ituri. She fell ill June 18 and died June 27; her body was transported by motorcycle about 300 km west to Kisangani (Tshopo), where a morgue sample tested positive. The transport through multiple health zones raised transmission risk, triggering wider contact tracing in the province. Separately, two contacts in Niania who had been isolated escaped to Haut-Uele; one tested positive and the other awaits confirmation. Both are being brought back to Niania as teams trace contacts in Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国がウイルスの2つの新しい州への拡大の可能性を追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,307人感染、377人死亡）が複数州に拡大中であり、新たな州への感染例確認と接触者追跡が進行中。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としている。マリ共和国はBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では言及されていないため除外。流行は5月15日宣言、現在複数州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）に加えTshopo州とHaut-Uele州への拡大が確認されている。死体運搬による広域接触者曝露のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde rekor hızla büyüyen Ebola salgını endişe yaratıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak growing at record speed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is causing concern.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus reaches 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths, with Ituri province as the epicenter and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO cites rapid growth due to late detection, delayed health-seeking, security constraints, and misinformation; armed groups hinder responders. No approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; intensive supportive care is the mainstay for survival. Regional risk remains high, with Africa CDC warning the outbreak could extend beyond DRC to Uganda and neighboring nations with substantial cross-border movement. At-risk countries include Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, and Kenya, necessitating enhanced border screening, strengthened contact tracing, and expanded laboratory capacity. Ebola emerged in 1976 in DRC and Sudan; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak was the largest, with transmission via contact with infected body fluids and contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的速度で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行が懸念を呼んでいる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo）の急速な拡大（1,274確認患者、360死亡）、地域的スプレッド、多数の隣接国への越境リスク、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数の隣接国がリスク国として列挙されているが、実際の発生地域は DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）。ザンビアは Bluedot API の発生地域リストに含まれており、かつ WPRO スクリーニング対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。他の隣接国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、CAR、コンゴ共和国、タンザニア、アンゴラ、ケニア）は記事では潜在的なリスク国として言及されているが、実際の発生地域ではなく、かつ対象国リストに限定されているため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による DRC でのエボラ出血熱流行は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: الطاعون.. علماء يبحثون عن الجذور التاريخية للموت الأسود - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague: Scientists Seek the Historical Roots of the Black Death - Al-Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: Ancient plague Yersinia pestis emerged in Siberia around 5500 years ago, predating Europe’s Black Death by millennia. In four cemeteries near Lake Baikal, north Siberia, researchers recovered dental DNA from 46 individuals and detected Y. pestis in 18. The study, published in Nature by a Copenhagen-Cambridge team, combined ancient DNA, radiocarbon dating, and burial records to map early spread among hunter-gatherer groups. The ancient strains lacked several mutations seen in later rodent-flea–associated lineages, yet possessed a potent toxin-related antigen (superantigen) likely triggering severe immune responses and fatalities. Anomalously high child mortality in early cemeteries suggests abrupt outbreaks in small, closely related communities. Radiocarbon dating indicates the pathogen may have originated in central/east Asia before moving into Eurasia, with possible involvement of wild marmots in direct human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：科学者たちが黒死病の歴史的起源を求める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代のペスト菌の考古学的・遺伝学的研究に関する歴史的分析であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではない。現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は5500年前のシベリアにおけるYersinia pestisの古代感染について、考古学的DNAと放射能年代測定に基づいた学術研究の発表である。バイカル湖北部の埋葬地の遺骨から検出された古代病原体の遺伝学的特性に関する歴史的調査であり、現在の感染症イベント（現在進行中のアウトブレイク）ではない。Bluedotが付与した複数の発生地域（タイ、中国、デンマーク、英国など）は記事の主題地域の参考情報であり、これらの国で現在ペスト感染が報告されているわけではない。したがって、公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要なシグナルに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: De la o vacanță exotică la un diagnostic rar: 38 de paraziți găsiți în creierul unei femei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From an exotic vacation to a rare diagnosis: 38 parasites found in a woman's brain.
article.articleSummary: A 42-year-old woman from Cardiff, UK developed neurocysticercosis after a three‑month trip to India in 2007, with 38 brain parasites identified. First symptoms appeared three years post-travel (2010); seizures began in 2011. Initial testing suggested toxoplasmosis, but neurocysticercosis was confirmed, caused by Taenia solium larvae acquired abroad. She was treated with antiparasitics and corticosteroids; parasites died and calcified in the brain, with no surgical removal. Later, inflammation around the parasites led to confusion, severe anxiety, panic attacks, and psychosis, prompting a six‑week neuropsychiatric hospitalization. Recovery was slow, and she has had no seizures since 2017, though lifelong epilepsy treatment is required. She now advocates awareness of this rare travel‑associated infection, aiming to inform others about risks, recognition, and management of neurocysticercosis.

triage.headline_ja: エキゾチックな休暇から稀な診断へ：女性の脳から38匹の寄生虫が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 個別の症例報告であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。英国での症例は対象国外であり、インドへの旅行は2007年と過去のイベント。現在の流行・蔓延リスクはなく、公衆衛生上の急迫した脅威と判断されない。
triage.notes: 本件は過去（2007年の旅行）の個別症例報告であり、集団発生ではない。患者はカーディフ（英国）在住で、インドは旅行地としてのみ登場。対象国はインドのみだが、現在進行中のアウトブレイク、集団発生、異常流行の報告ではなく、感染症危機管理シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: What Ebola and Marburg are teaching us about the next pandemic
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda exposes diagnostic gaps: GeneXpert tests for Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV) fail to reliably detect BDBV, allowing transmission to persist after initial negative results. The epidemic has surpassed 1,300 confirmed cases and 375 deaths in DRC and spread into Uganda. Ugandan authorities report suspected Marburg virus disease amid the Ebola response; it remains unclear whether this signals a larger outbreak or isolated spillovers. The authors warn that pathogens do not respect testing algorithms and that simultaneous circulation of multiple high-consequence pathogens is possible in regional emergencies. They critique the reactive, pathogen-specific diagnostic model and call for a shift toward pan-pathogen or syndromic diagnostics and proactive surveillance, accounting for climate change, conflict, urbanization, and increased human-animal contact, especially in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとマールブルグ病が次のパンデミックについて私たちに教えていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,300例以上と375死亡、異常性：複数の高リスク病原体の同時流行、国際拡大：DRCからウガンダへ、渡航制限リスク：重症な出血熱），WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRAが必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)のDRCおよびウガンダでの発生、ならびにウガンダでのマールブルグウイルス疑い例を記述している。DRCは対象国（ID:203312）に含まれる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし、サマリー内でウガンダが主要な発生地として言及されているため、注視が必要。GeneXpert検査の診断ギャップ、1,300例以上の確定症例、375死亡、複数の高リスク病原体の同時流行という記述から、異常性、重症度、拡大性が明確。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: I came back from India with a metre-long tapeworm and 38 brain parasites - doctors didn't know what to do
article.articleSummary: Cardiff-based 42-year-old Lowri Denman contracted a metre-long tapeworm during a 2007 visit to India, later developing neurocysticercosis with 38 brain parasites. After years of headaches, she suffered a tonic-clonic seizure in 2011 and was diagnosed with a parasitic brain infection caused by pork tapeworm larvae; the infection is linked to water contamination or poor hygiene per the World Health Organization. She underwent epilepsy treatment while doctors consulted tropical disease experts to eliminate the parasites. Treatments included albendazole and steroids, with later praziquantel; swelling shifted within the brain as she weaned off medication. A severe flare-up around 2015–2016 led to worsening illness, job loss, isolation, and a three-month neuropsychiatric ward admission, with mood stabilisers and antipsychotics, and later methotrexate. Long-term mental health effects included paranoia and anxiety, and she faced ongoing disability, including loss of driving license and dependence on PIP.

triage.headline_ja: インドから帰国した女性、1メートルの寄生虫と脳内38匹の寄生虫を持ち帰る - 医師も対応に困惑
triage.triage_reason: 個人の臨床事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常な疫学状況を示していない。発症は2007年で、診断・治療は2011年以降であり、現在の疫学的なシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者の臨床経過報告（症例報告）である。記事サマリーには感染源地としてインドが言及されているが、現在のアウトブレイクやクラスターを示す証拠はない。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウェールズ・カーディフ・イギリスも含まれているが、これは患者の現住地であり、発症地（インド2007年）とは異なる過去の旅行履歴である。神経嚢虫症は既知の寄生虫感染であり、予想外の疾患ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Death Toll Hits 399
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 29.7%. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, and remains active as of June 29, with 26 new confirmed cases in Ituri and North Kivu. There are 609 patients in isolation or hospital care, and 189 recoveries. Ituri remains the epicenter, across 23 health zones including Aru, Bunia, Mongbwalu, Komanda and Mambasa; North Kivu reports heightened surveillance in 11 zones such as Beni, Butembo and Goma; South Kivu has 3 confirmed cases and 1 death linked to Miti-Murhesa, with no new transmission since May 26. Response includes free medical treatment in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde and Wapinda; a site for an Ebola Treatment Centre is planned in Bunia. Nine more recoveries (total 189); hotline 151; surveillance fully operational. Regional concerns in the Great Lakes.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ死亡者数が399人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（399死亡、CFR 29.7%）、異常性（大規模発生）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示す。DRCにおける進行中の大規模流行としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は致命的な感染症であり、1,333確認症例、399死亡、CFR 29.7%は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。イトゥリ州が震源地であり、北キブ、南キブにも拡大。6月29日時点で26新規確認症例が報告されており、進行中の流行。DRCの複数州にまたがる地理的広がり、高い死亡率、継続的な症例発生により、多基準で高いリスク評価。大湖地域への地域的懸念も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rata-rata 520 Kasus Per Tahun, Jemi Yusuf Minta Pemkab Seriusi Penanganan TBC di Tolitoli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An average of 520 TB cases per year, Jemi Yusuf asks the regency government to seriously address TB treatment in Tolitoli.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Tolitoli Regency, Indonesia, averages about 520 cases annually from 2022 to 2024, with 189 new cases recorded by May 2025 — nearly 40 percent of the yearly average. Golkar legislator Jemi Yusuf of the Tolitoli Regency DPRD urged the local government, via the Health Department, to strengthen early-detection efforts and ensure patients complete their treatment, noting the lengthy TB course (roughly six months to one year). This push supports national aims under Presidential Regulation No. 67 of 2021: eliminating TB by 2030 and making Indonesia TB-free by 2050. The government has promoted the TB Find, Treat Until Healed (TOSS TB) strategy, offering free screening and medicines at public facilities. Yusuf called for secured funding and, if needed, use of Unexpected Expenditure (BTT) to counter potential surges, stressing that budgets must not impede saving lives.

triage.headline_ja: 1年平均520件のTB症例、ジェミ・ユスフがトリトリでTB対策の真摯な取り組みを自治体に要求
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、地域内での平均的な症例報告。国際的拡大リスク、異常性、重大な公衆衛生上の危機の証拠がなく、通常の保健行政の枠組みでの対応事例。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアの風土病であり、520件/年という症例数は既知の発生パターン内と考えられる。記事は地方議員による予算確保と行政体制強化の呼びかけであり、公衆衛生上の危機というより通常の疾病管理の枠組み。国家レベルでの対策方針（2030年までのTB排除、2050年までのTB-フリー達成）の存在も、この事象が標準的な保健システムの一部であることを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 決戰登革熱！3類人出國前「可免費領防蚊液」　返國篩檢再領500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Showdown! Three Categories of People Eligible for Free Mosquito Repellent Before Traveling Abroad; NT$500 After Re-entry Screening
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention drive in Kaohsiung City runs July–August, targeting three groups: teachers and students at university level or below, new immigrant families, and migrant workers who travel to Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Cambodia) or return home. Eligible individuals can collect free mosquito repellent before departure at designated high schools or health centers. After returning, if fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle or joint aches, or rash appears within 14 days, visit a doctor within 2 days and report TOCC (travel, occupation, contact, cluster); dengue rapid testing or related exams may yield a NT$500 voucher. If no symptoms within 14 days, individuals can still voluntarily undergo dengue testing at Kaohsiung district health centers, with the same NT$500 voucher upon completion. The initiative aims to curb imported dengue amid summer travel.

triage.headline_ja: 決戰登革熱！3類人出國前「可免費領防蚊液」　返國篩檢再領500
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（高雄市）における登革熱予防キャンペーンの記事であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な疾患発生、国際的な拡大リスクは明記されていない。予防啓発施策の通常的な運用の範囲内。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄市）における登革熱予防キャンペーンの案内であり、東南アジア諸国（ベトナム、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイ、シンガポール、カンボジア）への渡航者を対象としている。ただし、実際の疾患発生イベント（確認例の増加、流行警報等）ではなく、予防施策の通常的な展開である。対象国リストに含まれるベトナム（1562822）、インドネシア（1643084）、フィリピン（1694008）、タイ（1605651）においても、本記事は予防啓発の文脈であり、これら国での疾患発生イベントの報告ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Diduga Tertular Flu Babi Afrika, 83 Ekor Babi Ternak di Polman Mati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected African swine fever infection: 83 farm pigs die in Polman.
article.articleSummary: Suspected African swine fever (ASF) infection traced to 83 farm pigs that died in Dusun Salupaku, Indomakombong Village, Matakali District, Polewali Mandar Regency, West Sulawesi, Indonesia. A total of 312 pigs were kept in the hamlet; 5 more died that day, raising the toll to 83. The mortality began after a pig from Mamasa Regency arrived on June 3, 2026, and showed illness by June 9–10. Investigators from PKM Mapilli/Disbuntarnak Polman collected organ, blood, nasal swab, and fecal samples and sent them to Balai Besar Veteriner Maros, South Sulawesi; results are expected within five working days, with follow-up testing possibly taking up to two weeks. In the meantime, authorities have provided ASF serum, supportive treatment, vitamins, traditional remedies, and enhanced biosecurity, and are educating farmers via advisory letters. A similar ASF episode occurred in Polewali Mandar in 2023 but Salupaku was not affected then.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）感染の疑い：ポルマン地域で養豚83頭が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西スラウェシ州での疑わしい野生動物アフリカ豚熱の集団発生。312頭の飼育豚中83頭の死亡、国内の農業動物集団への実質的な影響があり、IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準に複数該当。
triage.notes: インドネシア西スラウェシ州ポルマン県での養豚群でのアフリカ豚熱疑い例。312頭中83頭の死亡が報告され、6月3日に感染した豚が到着した後に発症。検査結果は5営業日以内に判明予定。同地域では2023年にも同様の集団発生があったが、今回の発生地では初めて。動物衛生当局と獣医検査機関が関与し、バイオセキュリティ強化と農民への啓発が実施されている。アフリカ豚熱は家畜感染症として経済的および社会的影響が高く、地域の豚肉生産に対する脅威。

article.articleHeadline: هشدار درباره گسترش سریع ابولا در کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning About the Rapid Spread of Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern region reports an Ebola outbreak since May 15, Africa's fastest wave to date. WHO reports 1,274 cases and 360 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Early diagnosis and intensive supportive care offer the best survival chances. WHO and Africa CDC warn that cross-border movement, armed groups, weak health infrastructure, and delays in case detection raise regional risk. At-risk countries include Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, and Kenya; they are urged to strengthen borders, contact tracing, and laboratory capacity. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids, not airborne. Incubation is 2-21 days; symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pains, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea; CFR around 50% but varies by outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラの急速な拡大に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生影響深刻、異常、国際拡大リスク高、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、死亡率50%、1,274例・360死亡の規模、複数国への拡大リスク、脆弱な保健インフラの存在により、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数の隣接国を「リスク国」として言及しているが、サマリーの主題となっている実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri Province、North Kivu、South Kivu）である。Zambiaは対象国リストに含まれており、DRCからの地理的近接性と記載されたリスク国として含める。その他のリスク国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、タンザニア、アンゴラ、ケニア）については、現在の発生地ではなく潜在的リスク国として記載されているため、対象国リストに含まれる場合でも実際の発生地ではないため除外する判断も考慮されるべき。ただし、記事の主要な警告内容が地域的拡大リスクであることから、Zambiaは検証地域として妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tiga Anak di Buleleng Bali Diserang Anjing, Kasus Gigitan HPR di Bali Tembus 34 Ribu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Children in Buleleng, Bali Attacked by Dogs; Rabies Bite Cases in Bali Reach 34,000.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a pressing public health threat in Bali, Indonesia. A recent incident in Lingkungan Jalak Putih, Banyuasri, Buleleng saw three children bitten by a stray dog suspected of rabies; emergency care included wound cleaning and vaccination with Rabies Vaccine (VAR) and, when indicated, Rabies Immune Serum (SAR). Bali’s Health Office reports a cumulative 34,561 dog-bite rabies cases on Bali from January–June 2026, averaging about 205 bites per day. Badung tops the counts with 6,599 cases, followed by Karangasem (4,403), Denpasar (4,214), and Buleleng (3,930). Health authorities emphasize post-bite management and rapid VAR administration (26,106 victims so far), with coordination to agricultural services for dog control. The data underscore ongoing exposure risk and the need for vaccination and animal-control measures to prevent neural infection.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ブレレン県の3人の子どもが犬に襲われる、バリ州の狂犬病咬傷事例が3万4千件を超える
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）で2026年1月～6月に34,561件の狂犬病咬傷事例が報告され、1日平均205件と極めて高い発生率を示している。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常な規模の流行、継続的な曝露リスク、動物制御における管理上の課題が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月配信という未来日付だが、報告された統計は2026年1月～6月の実績。バリ州の狂犬病咬傷件数が月平均5,760件（1日205件）という極めて高い水準にあることが特筆される。既に26,106人がワクチン接種を受けているが、継続的な動物制御と公衆衛生対策が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Agencia de salud de la Unión Africana: "El brote de ébola en RDC no está fuera de control"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union Health Agency: "The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is not out of control."
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak is not deemed “out of control” by Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya, though it remains the deadliest and most extensive in its first month. As of now, 399 deaths and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, with spillover into Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). Ituri province is the epicenter, amid insecurity and large internally displaced populations—over 1.15 million people in camps—creating severe access challenges for responders. There are no approved vaccines or medicines for the Bundibugyo strain, though four vaccine candidates exist and an approval could come by year-end if current efforts persist. France reported a first Ebola case in a doctor returning from DRC; Europe’s risk is considered low and travel bans are not seen as beneficial. The interview emphasizes Africa’s need to invest in health systems as external support wanes, and notes that vaccines and treatments would likely be available sooner if the outbreak had occurred in Europe or the United States.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合保健機関：「コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能ではない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重大な感染症事象。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への極度の脅威であり、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、フランスへの波及）、渡航制限の可能性、および異常な流行規模を呈している。フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの波及（20例、2死亡）が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。ただし国際的な波及の事実は IHR基準「国際的な拡大リスク」および WPRO基準「流行しやすさ」の評価に反映されている。フランスでの医師の確認例は医療関連者の国際移動リスクを示唆する。制御可能性に関する楽観的な見方（「制御不能ではない」）があるが、初月での死者数399名、確認例1,333例、不安定な社会状況、大規模避難民キャンプの存在、医学的対策の不備（ワクチン/治療法未承認）を考慮すると、シグナル認識は妥当。

article.articleHeadline: A Risky Burial in the Heart of an Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Mongbwalu. As of Sunday, 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths nationwide. The report follows the burial of Innocent Mandro Likpa (56) and notes another Ebola victim, Sifa Dime (25), with bodies handed to families and non-Red Cross burials. WHO official Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaire warns unsafe, undignified funerals can seed new transmission chains. The scene shows mourners touching coffins, barriers of mosquito nets, and communal meals served near the coffin; health workers wore PPE but lapses in crucial safety protocols are alleged. WHO protocols require protective gear for anyone handling infected corpses, and attendees should be monitored for 21 days as high-risk contacts. The outbreak remains ongoing in Mongbwalu, the epicenter of transmission, in a gold-mining region of DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の大流行の真っ最中での危険な埋葬
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模流行で、1,274確認患者、360死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、不適切な埋葬慣行による新規感染チェーン形成の危険性が存在。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模流行。Mongbwalu（金鉱採掘地域）が流行の中心地。不適切な埋葬慣行（Red Cross外での埋葬、遺体への接触、防護具の着用不徹底）により、新規感染チェーン形成のリスクが高い。WHO公式医師Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaireの警告あり。21日間の経過観察対象者多数。フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Drastyczny wzrost zgonów przez ebolę! Część chorych nie chce się leczyć. Myślą, że ebola nie istnieje!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drastic rise in Ebola-related deaths! Some patients refuse treatment. They think Ebola doesn't exist!
article.articleSummary: 1307 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 29, with 377 deaths, marking a dramatic rise in roughly a month. The outbreak centers in eastern Congo, notably the Ituri region, following prior data of 321 confirmed and 116 probable cases (Bundibugyo strain) with 41 deaths and six recoveries reported by WHO in late May. This is the 17th outbreak in DR Congo since 1976, with the latest announcement on May 15. Widespread fear and conspiracy theories—some residents believe Ebola doesn’t exist or was created by politicians or foreigners for money—drive avoidance of hospitals. Treatment centers are often tents with staff in protective gear, and about half of patients may not survive such facilities. Ongoing conflict, displacement, distrust of authorities, and unsafe burial practices hinder containment; Red Cross burial teams face threats and violence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死亡者が急増！治療を拒否する患者も。エボラは存在しないと考えている者もいる！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（1307例、377死亡の急増）、予想外の流行、地域を越えた拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがある。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国で確認された17番目のエボラ流行。1ヶ月で劇的な増加（321例→1307例）。地域紛争、医療不信、陰謀論による治療拒否が懸念事項。WHO報告あり。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Supporting surveillance and response priorities for the 2026 DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak - Population movements to and from affected health zones, based on privacy-secure analysis of mobile operator data from Vodacom Congo (DRC)
article.articleSummary: An anonymised mobile operator analysis from Vodacom Congo (DRC) tracks population movements from Ituri (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Rwampara) and Nord-Kivu (Beni, Butembo, Katwa) during the 2026 Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak to identify importation risk and guide surveillance priorities. Using 4 May–17 May 2026 as reference and 18 May–8 June 2026 as follow-up, it estimates subscriber-days per cohort member in destination zones. Ituri top recipients are Lita, Nizi, Bambu, Tchomia, Kilo, Gety, Damas, Komanda, Drodro; Katwa is the first non-Ituri rank, followed by Butembo, Beni, Watsa, Makiso Kisangani. Nord-Kivu top recipients are Musienene, Kalunguta, Oicha, Kyondo, Mabalako; beyond, Watsa and Makiso Kisangani. By 25 Jun 2026, all top Ituri destinations have confirmed cases; 21/30 have cases; 6/31–60 do. In Nord-Kivu, 14/30 have confirmed cases, including all top five; exportation risk is uncertain due to low counts. Nord-Kivu’s urban connectivity is stronger to Goma, Bukavu, Lubumbashi. Recommend prioritising surveillance in high-ranked zones without confirmed cases; monitor Mandima, Mutwanga, Lubero, Makiso Kisangani if Nord-Kivu exportation occurs; ten zones rank top-30 in both cohorts, signaling compounded importation pressure.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年DRCエボラ・ブンディブギョアウトブレイク対応：携帯事業者データ分析による集団移動追跡と感染リスク評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中アウトブレイク（DRC）であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性）し、リアルタイム流行監視情報として優先度が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはRomania、Costa Rica、Italyなど複数国が含まれていますが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州、Nord-Kivu州）内の人口移動追跡が主題です。2026年のEbola Bundibugyo outbreakは進行中の確認済みアウトブレイクで、複数地域で二次感染が報告されています。国際拡大リスク評価用のモバイルデータ分析報告のため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めます。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Tuyên Quang xuất hiện dịch cúm gia cầm A/H5N1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza A/H5N1 outbreak appears in Tuyen Quang
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A/H5N1 outbreak declared in Dong Tam Commune, Tuy Quang Province, Vietnam, after detection in Chang village. Household of Nguyen Ngoc Huong kept 200 ducks about 60 days old; by 23 June birds showed anorexia and diarrhea, with progressive deaths despite treatment. On 28 June authorities were alerted; samples were sent to the Central Veterinary Diagnostic Center I. According to lab result 6160/CĐXN1 dated 29 June, the ducks tested positive for avian influenza A/H5N1. In response, local government culled the affected flock, established quarantine checkpoints, and restricted movement of poultry and poultry products from the outbreak area. Disinfection and decontamination were carried out around the farm, nearby households, and routes through Chang hamlet. Residents were urged to report suspicious signs, avoid transporting or slaughtering sick birds, and to consume poultry only from safe sources after cooking. Health authorities note the zoonotic risk and urge adherence to control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ツエン・クアン州でA/H5N1鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクが発生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで確認された高病原性H5N1鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイク。IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、動物-ヒト感染の管理可能性）に該当し、人畜共通感染症として公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 高病原性H5N1は過去のパンデミック潜在性を有する重要な病原体。当記事ではツエン・クアン州ドン・タム・コミューン・チャン村で200羽のアヒルが感染し、当局により殺処分されている。動物での検出だが、ヒト感染のリスクが明示されており、人畜共通感染症対策として重要なシグナル。動物領域でのアウトブレイク確認であるが、ヒト侵襲性が高いため、全IHR基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases traced to Congo province bordering on South Sudan
article.articleSummary: Three people exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, have been traced to Haut-Uele near the South Sudan border. They were contacts of a confirmed Ituri case; two of them traveled to Haut-Uele and were diagnosed there, underscoring ongoing surveillance. Ituri reports 1,165 cases and 301 deaths. The spread to Haut-Uele heightens risk of cross-border transmission to South Sudan, a high-risk country due to proximity and population movement. South Sudan endures acute food insecurity and a cholera outbreak since Sept 2024 with more than 105,000 cases and over 1,600 deaths. UN OCHA warns of high transmission risk; the country has a 15-county preparedness plan but urgently needs more funding and stronger health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、南スーダン国境近くのコンゴ州で確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数国にまたがる高リスク病原体（エボラ、コレラ）の同時流行、国際的拡大リスク、死亡者が出ている重篤な状況。
triage.notes: エボラ（Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし）とコレラの同時流行が報告されている。Ituri州で1,165症例、301死亡。南スーダンとの国境近接により国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。南スーダンはコレラアウトブレイク中（2024年9月以降、105,000症例以上、1,600死以上）で健康基盤が脆弱。UN OCAHが高い伝播リスクを警告。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nelayan Akui Penyakit Malaria Masih Jadi Ancaman Warga Pesisir Pesawaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fishermen Acknowledge Malaria Still Poses a Threat to Pesawaran's Coastal Residents
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains an endemic threat to coastal communities in Teluk Pandan, Pesawaran Regency, as of July 1, 2026. Fisherman Mawar Riyadi from Teluk Pandan reports recurrent malaria infections among residents working along the coast and at sea, noting he has been infected several times. Symptoms start with fever plus joint and body pains and headaches. The fever pattern is intermittent: mornings may feel better, but fever returns in the afternoon and evening with chills and rising temperature. Additional effects include fatigue and dry mouth. When fever occurs, many residents first self-treat; if symptoms persist, health workers perform a blood test for confirmation. A positive test leads to specific anti-malarial treatment. The account highlights the ongoing vulnerability of coastal livelihoods to malaria transmission in the area.

triage.headline_ja: 漁民がマラリアがペサワラン海岸住民への脅威であり続けることを認める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアはマラリア流行地であり、本記事は地域的なエンデミック疾患の継続的な脅威を報道しているもので、異常な疾病クラスターや国際的な拡大リスク、重症度の上昇を示唆していない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: インドネシアのペサワラン地域における地域的なマラリアエンデミック現象の報道。漁民からの個人的な健康報告であり、新規クラスターの報告ではない。既知の地域流行疾患として通常の医療対応が実施されている状況。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Супергрипп в разгар жары. Что за гонконгский штамм поражает туристов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superflu in the Heat of Summer. Which Hong Kong Strain Is Affecting Tourists?
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, Bali reports Hong Kong influenza (influenza A H3N2) infections among travelers, including dozens of Russian tourists who fell ill with a severe form dubbed the 'superflu' after mutation. The strain, while not new, has mutated this season. In Bali, the virus circulates year-round as a seasonal pathogen, with outbreaks peaking during the rainy season (November–March). The Hong Kong flu tends to be more severe than ordinary ARVI, presenting with abrupt high fever, marked myalgia, dry cough, weakness, and headaches, and lasting up to two weeks. An expert notes that high solar irradiance can suppress immunity, advising sun protection. Travelers are urged to carry medical insurance that includes hospitalization and to seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の最中のスーパーインフルエンザ。香港株がツーリストを襲う
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ）および中国（香港）でH3N2インフルエンザA型の変異株による感染が報告され、重症化（スーパーフル）が観察されている。国際的な旅行者への影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準2項目以上に該当するとともに、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: バリ島はインドネシア内の発生地。香港は中国に含める。記事は変異H3N2株による「スーパーフル」現象を報道しており、重症度および国際的関心が高い。ロシア観光客への影響が強調されており、渡航関連の懸念あり。ただし死亡報告は記事に明記されていないため、影響の深刻度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 1.890 Kasus Gigitan Anjing Terjadi di Buleleng, Vaksinasi Rabies Baru 23 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,890 Dog Bite Cases Occurred in Buleleng, Rabies Vaccination Only 23 Percent
article.articleSummary: 1,890 dog bite cases were recorded in Buleleng, Bali, from January 1 to June 23, 2026. With an estimated dog population of 68,748, only 16,438 (23.9%) have received rabies vaccination, leaving about 52,310 unvaccinated. The highest bite incidences occurred in Buleleng District (301), followed by Banjar and Tejakula (each 278); Kubutambahan reported the lowest (130). Concurrently, 93 brain samples from suspected rabies cases were sent for laboratory testing, yielding 64 positives and 29 negatives. Officials urge community involvement for effective rabies control and stress routine vaccination of dogs, cats, and monkeys. Vaccines remain available, and owners can vaccinate at the PKPP office or the Agricultural Extension Center (BPP) in nine districts, rather than awaiting mass vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ブレレン地区で1,890件の犬咬傷事例が発生、狂犬病ワクチン接種は23%のみ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）で狂犬病関連の複数の懸念事項が確認された。狂犬病の陽性確認（64件）、低いワクチン接種率（23.9%）、多数の犬咬傷事例（1,890件）により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が示唆される。IHR基準で少なくとも2項目（深刻な影響、異常性）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的疾患であり、ワクチン接種率の低さ（23.9%）と高い犬咬傷発生件数は重大な公衆衛生の脅威。実験室確認例（64件）の存在により異常性が確認される。複数地区での発生報告あり。インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: "El brote de ébola en el Congo no está fuera de control", según la Unión Africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo is not out of control, according to the African Union.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is not out of control, according to Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya. The outbreak, declared May 15, has 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with Ituri province as the epicenter. It has spread to Uganda, with 20 infections and 2 deaths. A French doctor who returned from DRC later tested positive, highlighting cross-border risk but not justifying travel bans. Africa CDC notes this is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its first month, yet it remains potentially controllable if adequate support is provided. Contributing factors include lack of approved vaccines or medicines for the Bundibugyo strain, insecurity in the region, and high internal displacement — over 1.15 million people in camps, impeding access. Four vaccine candidates exist, with hopeful approval by year-end if efforts continue; Europe risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合によると、コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能になっていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。確定症例1,333件、死亡399件の大規模な流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの2次感染（20例、死亡2例）およびフランスへの輸出例が言及されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。本レポートは2026年7月時点で、5月15日に宣言された流行で最初の1ヶ月としては最も致命的とされている。ワクチン候補4種が存在し、年末までの承認を見込んでいる。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: I had a metre long tapeworm and 38 more in my brain... I nearly died
article.articleSummary: Two months in India in 2007 preceded a lifelong battle with neurocysticercosis. After returning to Cardiff, Lowri Denman only learned in 2011 that she carried 38 Taenia solium tapeworm larvae in her brain, the writhing parasite she had been carrying for four years. The resulting neurocysticercosis caused crippling headaches, seizures, and later psychosis. Neurocysticercosis is the severe form of tapeworm infection in the central nervous system and a common cause of seizures; US estimates cite about 4,000 cases annually. The infection stems from tapeworm eggs, often via contaminated water or poor hygiene, and can affect those who avoid meat. Denman received steroids, albendazole, and later praziquantel; swelling and seizures fluctuated, with relapses over years that led to job loss, dependence on care, and eventually disability payments. By 2026-07-01 she remains in recovery and remains under medical management for ongoing symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 脳に38個の寄生虫を持つ長さ1メートルのサナダムシ…死にそうになった
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症は重篤な疾患であり、米国では年約4,000例とされているが、当該記事は個人の症例報告（2007年のインド訪問後の長期経過観察）であり、新規アウトブレイクを示唆する情報がない。スクリーニング基準の該当は限定的だが、対象国（インド）との関連があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2007年のインド訪問に遡る個人の症例報告であり、現在の活発なアウトブレイク状況を示すものではない。神経嚢虫症は通常の医学的問題として認識されているが、新規集団発生の証拠は記事に含まれていない。メディア関心は高いが公衆衛生上の新規危機を示唆しない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Γυναίκα ταξίδεψε στην Ινδία και κόλλησε θανατηφόρα λοίμωξη - Βρέθηκαν 38 παράσιτα στον εγκέφαλο της
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman Traveled to India and Contracted a Fatal Infection — 38 Parasites Found in Her Brain
article.articleSummary: Cardiff-born Lori Denman developed neurocysticercosis after a three-month trip to India in 2007. She later found a cestode worm in her pelvis (2010). By 2011 she suffered severe headaches and a first seizure; initial toxoplasmosis tests missed the cause. The diagnosis was made after she disclosed the pelvic worm history, revealing 38 parasites in her brain. The World Health Organization notes infection stems from undercooked pork, contaminated water, or poor hygiene; it is exceedingly rare in the UK and Europe, affecting migrants from endemic regions. Denman was hospitalized for two weeks, then endured years of headaches, psychiatric symptoms, and brain edema, leading to a move to Carmarthen and time off work. She received egg-destroying therapies and steroids; by 2022 she had recovered enough to return to work, with no seizures since 2017, and lifelong medication. No brain surgery was needed; the parasites are now inactive.

triage.headline_ja: インドに旅行した女性が致命的な感染症に感染 - 脳内に38匹の寄生虫が発見
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は2007年のインド旅行による古い個別症例であり、現在の流行集団発生ではない。記事は歴史的な医学的興味事象であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2007年のインド旅行による個別の患者ケーススタディであり、新規流行や集団発生ではない。患者はウェールズ（英国）在住のCardiff生まれで、2022年までに回復済みである。シグナル対象外の歴史的医学事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux morts dont un policier dans l'attaque d'un centre de traitement à Nia-Nia (Ituri), des patients en fuite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: two dead, including a police officer, in the attack on a treatment center in Nia-Nia (Ituri); patients fled.
article.articleSummary: Two people died in Ituri, DRC, after an attack on the Bafwabongo Ebola Treatment Centre in Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, on June 30 amid community tensions. A civilian and a police officer were killed, the officer lynched while trying to restore order. The center housed two laboratory-confirmed Ebola patients and seven suspected cases at the time; after the fire, these individuals dispersed into the community, raising the risk of further transmission. Local officials led by Dr. Joseph Pemakanakue warned that handling of a suspected case’s body by residents is a major contamination risk. Security around treatment facilities remains inadequate despite repeated calls for reinforcement. The 2026 Ebola outbreak in Ituri, declared May 15, has seen prior incidents in Mongbwalu and near Bunia (Rwampara health zone), underscoring the need for stronger security and community engagement to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イトゥリ州ニア・ニアの治療センター攻撃で2人死亡（警察官を含む）、患者が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行中における治療施設への攻撃により患者が逃亡し、コミュニティ感染リスクが急増。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: 2026年のエボラ流行中（5月15日宣言）における重大インシデント。治療施設への武装攻撃、確認患者2名と疑い患者7名の逃亡、不十分なセキュリティ体制が特に懸念される。遺体の不適切な取扱いによるさらなる感染拡大リスク。DRC当局の外部支援要請が緊急に必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: РСТ выступил с заявлением о повальном заражении гонконгским гриппом на Бали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST issued a statement about a mass outbreak of Hong Kong flu in Bali.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, the Russian Union of Travel Industry (RST) issued a statement regarding a mass outbreak of Hong Kong influenza in Bali. RST said Russian tourists in Bali had not reported to tour operators with Hong Kong flu symptoms, and there had been no official confirmations from local authorities or the WHO. No client complaints have been received, and all travelers heading to Bali are covered by medical insurance with round-the-clock support available to assist in illness. A Telegram channel, Baza, claimed dozens of Russian travelers were infected. Reported symptoms include cold-like onset followed by high fever within hours, severe headache, persistent cough, and muscle aches. The article provides no verified case counts or laboratory confirmation, and the situation remains unconfirmed by authorities or international health agencies.

triage.headline_ja: バリでの香港風邪の大規模感染に関するRSTの声明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）でのインフルエンザの大規模感染の報告であるが、公式確認がなく情報が未検証である。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行可能性）の複数に該当する可能性があるが、当局やWHOからの確認がないため、続報を注視すべき段階である。
triage.notes: 記事はバリ州（インドネシア）でのインフルエンザ感染報告が主題。ロシアの旅行業界団体（RST）による声明が出ているが、当地当局やWHOからの公式確認がなく、ケース数や検査確認も提示されていない。Telegramチャネルによる未検証の情報報告も含まれている。公式確認待ちの状態。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Becomes Third-Largest on Record as Cases Near 1,300
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern provinces reports 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths; regional toll 1,295 confirmed, 362 deaths across DR Congo, Uganda and France. No licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. Ituri accounts for 1,165 cases in 23 health zones; North Kivu 106; South Kivu 3, with Mandima in Ituri added June 27. Outbreak declared May 15; by June 22 confirmed cases passed 1,000, making it the third-largest on record per CDC; WHO declared a PHEIC May 17. Uganda has 20 cumulative confirmed cases as of June 30 (15 imported, 5 local) with two deaths; 821 contacts completed 21-day checks. France confirmed a case (doctor returned from DR Congo); a US citizen was evacuated to Germany for treatment in May. Transmission via direct contact with blood/secretions/organs or contaminated surfaces; incubation 2–21 days. CEPI backs vaccines (IAVI, Moderna, Oxford with Serum Institute of India); Bunia hosts an antiviral trial with Oxford/WHO/INRB. DRC budget $319M ($20M released); continental plan $518M for surveillance, labs, care, logistics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症 歴史上3番目の規模に 症例数1,300近くに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC既時発出。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行で、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランス、米国の退避）があり、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際の発生国はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）とウガンダが主要。Bluedot APIが付与した米国、フランス、ドイツはいずれも輸入症例・退避患者の受け入れ国であり、発生地ではない。インドはCEPI支援のワクチン開発国（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているため included。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため excluded。WHO PHEIC既時発出（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo型エボラは治療薬なし。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Vacanță în India cu urmări dramatice pentru o femeie din Marea Britanie. A fost diagnosticată cu 38 de paraziți la nivelul creierului
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vacation in India with dramatic consequences for a woman from the United Kingdom. She was diagnosed with 38 parasites in her brain.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis diagnosed in a UK resident after a three-month trip to India in 2007. Lowri Denman, 42, from Cardiff, developed severe neurological symptoms years after her return, including seizures and speech difficulties, with the first seizure in 2011. CT and MRI revealed 38 brain cysts, confirming Taenia solium larvae infection. Toxoplasmosis was considered but ruled out. Neurocysticercosis results from Taenia solium larvae reaching the central nervous system and is more common in parts of Asia, Africa, and Latin America where sanitation and food safety can facilitate transmission. Symptoms can emerge years after exposure and include headaches, seizures, speech problems, and cognitive changes. This case represents an imported infection in the United Kingdom.

triage.headline_ja: インドの休暇が劇的な結果に。イギリスの女性が脳内に38個の寄生虫が寄生していると診断される
triage.triage_reason: 輸入感染症（神経嚢虫症）の個別症例報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当及びスクリーニング基準の明確な該当は認められない。ただし、寄生虫疾患の国際的移動例として情報価値があるため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は2007年のインド渡航に関連する個別の輸入感染症事例（神経嚢虫症）であり、インドでの活動中の疾病流行ではなく、帰国後の患者個人の診断である。スクリーニング基準では重症度（脳内38個の嚢胞、発作、神経学的後遺症）と異常性（輸入感染症）で2つ該当するが、公衆衛生上の集団影響、国際的拡大の懸念、流行可能性の証拠がない。したがってWATCHレベルの判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Riposte " robuste " des autorités face au virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Authorities' "robust" response to the virus.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province around Bunia and Mongbwalu. As of end-June, official counts exceed 1,200 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 320 deaths; the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC was declared May 15, with initial spillover in late March in Mongbwalu before spreading to North Kivu and South Kivu and crossing into Uganda. A doctor infected in DRC was diagnosed in France after returning. The Bundibugyo variant drives the current wave, presenting with fever, diarrhea, and fatigue and often proving less recognizable than Zaïre, delaying detection and fueling social distrust. Community resistance persists, fueled by rumors and perceived lack of vaccine or treatment. The response includes safe and dignified burials by the Red Cross—over 300 in a month near Shari—handwashing stations, reduced gatherings, and ongoing public health measures; authorities tout a “robust” mobilization, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ウイルスに対する当局の「強力な」対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。1,200件以上の確認症例と320人以上の死亡を伴う大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行で、既に複数州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境および国際的な感染事例（フランス）が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、North Kivu、South Kivu）が主体。ウガンダへの越境例およびフランスでの輸入例が記載されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo変異株による第17次エボラ流行（5月15日宣言）、社会的不信と検出遅延のリスクが指摘されており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chandauli News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Chandauli News: विशेष संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान का शुभारंभ, स्वच्छता और जनसहभागिता पर जोर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandauli News: Launch of Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign, Emphasis on Sanitation and Community Participation
article.articleSummary: Chandauli district launched a Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign on July 1, 2026, at the Collectorate, with BJP district president Kashi Nath Singh flagging off the initiative. Senior officials, representatives, and staff from multiple departments attended. The drive targets dengue, malaria, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and other communicable diseases, aiming to raise public awareness and curb transmission. Officials noted that monsoon-induced waterlogging and dirt increase mosquito breeding, heightening disease risk, making timely sanitation and protective measures essential. The program calls for coordinated efforts across health, urban bodies, Panchayati Raj, education, agriculture, and animal husbandry, with each department fulfilling its responsibilities. Residents are urged to keep homes and surroundings clean, prevent water stagnation, routinely clean coolers and water storage, and adopt mosquito precautions. Any fever or illness should be promptly evaluated at the nearest health center. Community participation is highlighted as the campaign’s strongest asset to safeguard Chandauli.

triage.headline_ja: Chandauli News: 特別な感染症対策キャンペーンの開始、衛生管理と地域参加に重点
triage.triage_reason: インドのUttar Pradesh州Chandauli地区でデング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱、日本脳炎などの感染症対策キャンペーンが開始されたもので、既知の疾患の予防・啓発活動であり、新たな流行や異常な事例報告ではない。記事サマリーは対策の必要性を述べているが、具体的な患者数、死亡、または予想外の発生状況は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の流行報告ではなく、インド地方自治体による公式な予防キャンペーンの発表である。WPRO基準で「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」に該当するのは、モンスーン季節における蚊媒介感染症の継続的リスク背景であるが、具体的な患者発生数や異常な増加は報告されていない。情報が限定的なため、続報監視（WATCH）が適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: WFP Response to the Ebola Outbreak - External Situation Report (26 June 2026)
article.articleSummary: More than a month after the Ebola outbreak was declared, transmission remains confined to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with spillovers in Uganda and France. The DRC accounts for the majority of cases, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, where WFP maintains a substantial operational footprint. The DRC also faces a severe food crisis, with about 26.5 million people acutely food insecure, including 10 million in eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tanganyika. Ituri, the outbreak epicentre, has around 1.9 million people—over a third of the population—in IPC Phase 3 or worse. The Hunger Hotspot Report designates DRC as a hotspot of very high concern, with acute food insecurity expected to persist through the second half of 2026. Cross-border restrictions threaten markets, livelihoods, humanitarian access, and food security for vulnerable communities.

triage.headline_ja: WFPのエボラアウトブレイク対応 - 外部状況報告書（2026年6月26日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスク、および食糧危機との複合危機により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダとフランスでのスピルオーバーが言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。DRC内での複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tanganyika）での感染および食糧危機との複合危機が報告されており、高い公衆衛生リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Berpotensi Seret Afrika ke Jurang Krisis Ekonomi Global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Could Drag Africa into the Abyss of the Global Economic Crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda threatens Africa's economy, according to a UNDP report. The Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak could trigger up to $3.6 billion in regional GDP losses and push about 985,000 people into poverty, while tens of thousands of jobs could be eliminated. Disruptions to education and health services, plus cross-border trade and transport delays, are expected to compound the economic pain across Africa, with potential contraction of about $2.37 billion in regional GDP. In a baseline containment scenario within DRC and Uganda, DRC would still face real GDP losses exceeding $1 billion and around 55,000 jobs lost. The report warns of reduced consumption among the poorest 20% of households. WHO had previously declared the outbreak in DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern; as of now, 377 deaths and 1,307 confirmed cases are reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがアフリカを世界的経済危機の淵に引き込む可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の発生は、WHO国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）に指定されており、死亡377人、確認患者1,307人と重大な公衆衛生影響を示す。国際的な経済的波及リスクと貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生している確認的なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて述べており、両国が対象国に含まれる。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、クロスボーダー感染リスク、地域経済への甚大な影響が記述されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose faz quase 86 mil novos casos no Brasil; vacina BCG protege bebês das formas mais graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis accounts for nearly 86,000 new cases in Brazil; the BCG vaccine protects infants from the most severe forms.
article.articleSummary: Brazil continues to grapple with tuberculosis as a major public health issue. In 2024 the country reported 85,936 new TB cases, an incidence of 40.1 per 100,000, with the majority being pulmonary. BCG vaccination at birth remains the primary protection for infants against the most severe forms (miliary TB and tuberculous meningitis). The vaccine offers about 74% protection against all TB forms and up to 90% against these severe manifestations; vaccination is recommended as early as possible after birth once the newborn weighs over 2 kg. However some clinicians delay due to newborn screening for inborn immunodeficiencies. TB is airborne; 84% of cases are pulmonary. Social determinants—poverty, overcrowding, homelessness, incarceration, and HIV—drive transmission and delayed diagnosis. Rapid identification, treatment, and contact tracing reduce spread. TB treatment is free through Brazil's Unified Health System with high cure rates when properly adhered. July 1 marks BCG Vaccination Day.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで結核が新規患者ほぼ86,000件を占める;BCGワクチンは乳幼児を最も重症な形態から保護
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける結核の疾病負荷（年間約86,000件の新規患者、人口10万人当たり40.1例）は公衆衛生上重要であるが、予想外の事象ではなく、国際的な拡大リスクも限定的である。情報は十分であるが、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。
triage.notes: 結核は世界的に既知の疾病であり、ブラジルの定期的な報告は予想される。BCGワクチン接種日（7月1日）を記念した報道記事。国内の保健システム（SUS）により治療が提供されており、国際支援の必要性は低い。ただし社会的決定要因（貧困、過密、ホームレス、受刑者、HIV）が継続的な感染動向を示しているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo traces possible Ebola spread to two new provinces, sources say
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15, has infected 1,307 people and killed 377 across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu as of a June 29 government summary. Health authorities are tracing potential exposures in two additional provinces not previously affected: Tshopo and Haut-Uele. In Tshopo, a pregnant woman from Ituri's Niania health zone fell ill on June 18 and died June 27; her body was transported by motorcycle about 300 km to Kisangani, where a morgue sample tested positive for Ebola, prompting extensive contact tracing. Separately, two identified contacts of Ebola cases in Niania fled to Haut-Uele; one has tested positive and the other awaits confirmation. Both have been located and are being returned to Niania as teams trace others who may have encountered them in Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の2つの新しい州への拡大の可能性を追跡、情報筋が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,307人感染・377人死亡、異常・予想外な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。確認された死亡者・感染者多数、新規地域への拡大が進行中。
triage.notes: 2026年7月1日報道のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州での既知の流行に加え、Tshopo州とHaut-Uele州への新規拡大が確認されている。妊娠女性の死体搬送がキサンガニでの感染を引き起こし、広範な接触者追跡が実施中。国際的なエボラ出血熱フルRRA対応を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais: saiba sintomas, transmissão e diferenças entre os tipos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Hepatitis: Symptoms, Transmission, and Differences Between the Types.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis viral infection comprises Hepatitis A, B, C, D, and E, each with distinct transmission, progression, and prevention patterns. With the July Yellow national awareness campaign underway, the article underscores the importance of understanding these differences to protect liver health. While shared symptoms such as fatigue, nausea, and jaundice may appear, many infections are asymptomatic in early stages, complicating diagnosis. It highlights the role of testing and vaccination where available, alongside hygiene and preventive practices to interrupt transmission. Each type manifests differently and has unique implications for disease course, necessitating awareness of transmission routes and protective measures. The piece promises practical guidance on how each hepatitis type presents and how individuals can reduce risk, aiming to prevent progression to serious liver disease.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎：症状、感染経路、および各型の違いについて
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は肝炎の一般的な情報提供・啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクやクラスターの報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの「July Yellow」キャンペーン期間中の肝炎啓発キャンペーンに関連した教育的コンテンツ。具体的な患者数、死亡例、アウトブレイク調査報告などがなく、パンデミック対応に関連した新規シグナルではない。Bluedot APIがBrazilを検出しているが、記事サマリーでは具体的なブラジル国内の感染症イベント（患者クラスター、致死例、地域的拡大など）に関する報告はなく、一般的な感染症情報提供である。したがって対象国リストでの検証後も該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू-मलेरिया से बचाव के लिए जन सहभागिता जरूरी : ब्रजेश पाठक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public participation is essential for dengue and malaria prevention: Brijesh Pathak
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, July 1, 2026 – Deputy Chief Minister Brijesh Pathak inaugurated the vector-borne disease control campaign at Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences. He noted substantial reductions in vector-borne illnesses, including dengue and malaria, but stressed that public participation is essential to achieve complete suppression. The government conducts three campaigns annually, with 13 departments coordinating at the state level. Pathak urged residents to prevent mosquito breeding by eliminating water stagnation, keep surroundings clean, practice regular handwashing, drink clean water, and limit open foods and excess cold drinks. He warned that dengue can cause rapid platelet decline and highlighted larval control as the most effective prevention. The event also featured MBBS first-year and BSc nursing students; the director was tasked with regular meal quality checks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とマラリア予防に向けた公的参加が必要:ブリジェシュ・パターク
triage.triage_reason: インドのウッタル・プラデーシュ州ラクナウでのデング熱とマラリアに関する政策キャンペーン記事。公式な疾病削減が報じられており異常性は低いが、ベクター媒介性疾患の継続的な活動と公衆衛生上の関心があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既知のデング熱・マラリア対策キャンペーンに関する政策発表。疾患削減が報じられており深刻な公衆衛生危機の兆候は見当たらない。しかし対象国インドにおけるベクター媒介性疾患の継続的な曝露と流行易性が確認され、政府レベルの対応が進行中であるため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы подхватили гонконгский грипп на Бали -- Вечерняя Казань
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists contracted the Hong Kong flu in Bali
article.articleSummary: On Bali, Indonesia, several Russian tourists and relocants have contracted the Hong Kong flu (influenza A). The illness starts like a cold but progresses to severe headache, fever, muscle pains, and cough, with nausea and vomiting developing later. In many cases fever subsides by day seven, but weakness and intense headaches can persist for weeks; patients report the illness was harder to endure than COVID-19. The report does not provide exact case counts or outcomes. It highlights travel-associated infectious disease risk for visitors to Bali. No laboratory confirmation details are given for these Bali cases. The piece is dated 1 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がバリでホンコンフルを感染 - 夜のカザン新聞
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型（ホンコンフル）の輸入症例が報告されているが、症例数が不明で詳細な疫学情報が欠けており、国際的な危機レベルを判断する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は バリ（インドネシア）でのロシア人観光客によるインフルエンザA型の輸入症例を報告している。ホンコンフル（香港型）という言及から中国（香港含む）の関連性もある。ただし、正確な症例数、発症日、実験室確認、疫学的調査結果などの詳細が欠けており、公衆衛生上の影響度を判断することが困難である。観光地での散発的な輸入症例であり、現時点ではコミュニティ内での流行の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: UN projects $3.6 billion cost for Africa in worst case
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda persists, with 379 deaths confirmed by the World Health Organization. A United Nations Development Programme report outlines several economic scenarios as of 2026-07-01. Best-case: the epidemic remains contained to DRC and Uganda; Uganda reports no new cases in the past week, while DRC transmission continues and a case was confirmed in Mandima, Ituri Province, potentially keeping DRC GDP growth up to $1 billion. Worst-case: spread to neighboring countries such as South Sudan, Rwanda or Angola, compounded by an Iran-related fuel crisis, could push Africa’s total cost to about $3.6 billion and cause up to 328,000 job losses continent-wide. The analysis highlights ongoing outbreak status and broader regional and macroeconomic impacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：国連は最悪シナリオでアフリカに36億ドルの費用を計上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱というNPHI疾患の複数国での継続的な流行である。既に379人の死亡が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが明確に指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの継続的なエボラアウトブレイクを述べているが、サマリー上でウガンダでの新規患者報告がないと記載されており、アウトブレイクの主体はDRCであることが明確。South Sudan、Rwanda、Angolaへの潜在的拡大が言及されているが、記事の時点では確認されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Ituri州はDRC内の行政区画。エボラ出血熱はNPHIのカテゴリIAであり、自動的にシグナルとされるべき疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Experts warn Nigerians against Ebola misinformation
article.articleSummary: Public health experts warn Nigerians against Ebola misinformation, urging verification of health messages and reporting false information after a Lagos webinar, 'Tracking Outbreak: How Data and Facts Keep Us Safe from Ebola Rumours.' Ebola is a severe viral disease with multiple strains; the strain circulating in the DRC differs from the Zaire strain behind Nigeria's 2014 outbreak, and there is no cure for the current strain, with vaccine research ongoing for other variants. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids of an infected person, not airborne. Early symptoms—fever, headache, sore throat, muscle and joint pain, and body weakness—can resemble malaria or typhoid, so testing is essential. Nigeria's 2014 response included surveillance, contact tracing, lab testing, isolation, and communication; about 900 contacts across three states and 20 confirmed cases. First case arrived July 2014 in Lagos from Liberia. Rely on verified sources (NCDC, WHO, Doctors Without Borders); avoid unverified messages and home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア国民にエボラ出血熱の誤情報に対する警告を発する専門家
triage.triage_reason: 記事は過去のエボラ流行（2014年）に関する公衆衛生教育と誤情報対策に焦点を当てており、現在進行中の疾病発生ではなく歴史的な事例と一般的な予防啓発に関するもの。ただしナイジェリアでのエボラに関する議論は社会的・政治的関心が存在する可能性があるため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは過去2014年のナイジェリアにおけるエボラ流行の歴史的記録と現在の誤情報対策に関する内容。DRCでの現在の流行状況も言及されているが、記事の主眼はナイジェリアでの啓発活動。実際の進行中の感染症アウトブレイクというより公衆衛生コミュニケーション関連の事例。

article.articleHeadline: DRC bans gatherings in Kinshasa and other provinces to curb Ebola
article.articleSummary: DRC bans public gatherings in Kinshasa and the provinces of Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo to curb an Ebola outbreak linked to the Ituri province. More than 1,200 people have been infected and at least 360 have died since last month. The Interior Minister said the restriction aims to prevent further transmission, as health workers operate in a conflict-affected eastern corridor where the outbreak is spreading. The ban comes ahead of planned countrywide protests on July 8 by opposition parties; authorities say gatherings will not be allowed under containment measures. The Ebola outbreak in a conflict zone compounds containment challenges for health workers, with the government tying the measures to preventing spread amid broader political tensions surrounding President Tshisekedi.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ拡大を抑えるためキンシャサおよび他州での集会を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,200人以上の感染、360人以上の死亡；予想外：紛争地帯での大規模発生；国際拡大リスク：東部回廊での拡大傾向；渡航制限：集会禁止など対応措置実施）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントはDRC国内（キンシャサ、Haut-Uele、Bas-Uele、Tshopo、Ituri各州）での エボラ発生と明確に特定される。1,200人以上の感染と360人以上の死亡という極めて深刻な公衆衛生状況、紛争地帯での拡大、政治的緊張との重なりが特徴。WHO通知対象となる重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 80 Tahun Mengabdi, Polres Tegal Fokus pada Pelayanan Masyarakat dan Penanganan TBC - Suara Merdeka Pantura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80 Years of Service, Tegal Police Focus on Public Service and TB Treatment - Suara Merdeka Pantura
article.articleSummary: TB control features prominently as Polres Tegal actively participates in public health, notably tuberculosis (TB) containment, during the 80th Hari Bhayangkara anniversary on 1 July 2026 in Kabupaten Tegal, Indonesia. Police leadership, including AKBP Bayu Prasatyo, reiterated that Polri should serve the community with rapid, humane, professional service. The police have implemented concrete actions in public health and welfare, such as health and social service outreach centered at a temporary shelter in Desa Padasari, distribution of hundreds of staple food packages to the underprivileged, and regular provision of clean water to drought-affected villages. A forthcoming basketball competition aims to identify young athletic talent. The event aligns with the theme '80 Years of Serving the Community' and underscores the institution's commitment to health and safety in the district.

triage.headline_ja: 80年間の奉仕、テガル警察は公共サービスと結核治療に焦点を当てる - スアラメルデカパントゥラ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核に関する警察の公衆衛生施策紹介イベントであり、アクティブな結核流行・アウトブレイクを報じたものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準への該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は結核に関連した警察庁舎の80周年記念イベント報道であり、結核流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生啓発活動の紹介であり、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Puskesmas Hanura Petakan Tambak hingga Laguna sebagai Lokasi Perindukan Nyamuk Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanura Public Health Center Maps Fish Ponds to Lagoons as Malaria-Carrying Mosquito Breeding Sites.
article.articleSummary: Malaria transmission is concentrated in coastal Pesawaran Regency, Teluk Pandan District, Indonesia, with Anopheles mosquitoes breeding in abandoned brackish ponds. Puskesmas Hanura’s mapping identifies six coastal villages as malaria loci: Sukajaya Lempasing, Gebang, Hanura, Sidodadi, Batu Menyan, and Hurun. Not all hamlets within these villages are endemic; only specific hamlets near the coast and close to breeding sites are affected. In Sukajaya Lempasing, endemic hamlets are Hamlet 3 Laut and Hamlet 7 Mutun. In Gebang, hamlets Tanjung Jaya, Seribu, Induk, Hilir, and Suko Agung. In Hanura, Hamlets B and C; in Sidodadi, Hamlets 1 and 2; in Batu Menyan, Hamlets Ketapang, Cibeurem, and RT 7–9. Habitats include lagoons, swamps, pools, ditches, canals, and nearby ponds, with abandoned shrimp ponds cited as prime breeding grounds. The article does not provide case or death counts; published 2026-07-01.

triage.headline_ja: ハヌラ保健センター、ウナギ池からラグーンまでをマラリア媒介蚊の繁殖地として地図化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのラムプン州沿岸部における局所的なマラリア伝播が確認されており、ウナギ蚊の繁殖地特定は公衆衛生上の関心がある。しかし具体的な症例数や死亡数がなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ラムプン州ペサワラン県の沿岸部6村におけるマラリア伝播の地図化に関するもの。具体的な患者数や死亡数が記載されていないため、重症度の評価が困難。局所的な伝播地域であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。政府（公衆衛生センター）による能動的な調査・対応が進行中であることから WATCH レベルでの経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Болота выдали тайну вымирания народов Сибири 7-8 веков назад -- за ними пришла чёрная смерть
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The swamps revealed the secret of the extinction of the Siberian peoples during the 7th–8th centuries — the Black Death came for them.
article.articleSummary: Scientists from Novosibirsk State University found signs of a demographic catastrophe in Western Siberia soils dating to around 700–800 years ago. By examining charcoal residues in bogs in the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug, researchers modeled population activity over millennia and linked nonuniform charcoal deposition to major climate events. They note that while global catastrophes increased charcoal briefly, after the 12th century charcoal levels collapsed and did not recover for a long period. The researchers consider the most plausible cause to be a plague pandemic that spread across Eurasia in the mid-14th century as trade expanded in the Mongol Empire, suggesting the Black Death created conditions for rapid spread and drastically reduced Siberian populations. Although the Mongols could not wipe out all forest inhabitants, their networks likely facilitated the epidemic's reach.

triage.headline_ja: 沼地がシベリア民族の7〜8世紀前の絶滅の秘密を明かした――黒死病がやってきた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は14世紀の黒死病パンデミックの歴史的分析・考古学的研究であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。科学的な過去の事象の検討であるため、現在の公衆衛生上の危機とは無関係である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（Bangkok, Novosibirskaya Oblast, Russian Federation, Thailand）は誤検出。記事サマリーを詳細に読むと、本記事は考古学的研究報告であり、現在のペストのアウトブレイク情報ではなく、14世紀の黒死病パンデミックについての歴史分析である。シグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tanda Bahaya Ini Perlu Diwaspadai, Dokter Anjurkan Orang Tua Jangan Sepelekan Gejala Flu Singapura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These warning signs should be heeded; doctors urge parents not to underestimate the Singapore flu symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, South Sumatra, Indonesia is grappling with an outbreak of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), commonly known as Singapore flu, with 523 suspected cases, many among children under 5. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses, including Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71. Key symptoms reported: fever, mouth ulcers, and rashes or blisters on the palms and soles. Health professionals urge parents not to underestimate signs and seek care early to prevent more serious illness. Urgent warning signs requiring immediate hospital evaluation include very lethargic or unable to drink (risk of dehydration), seizures, breathing difficulties, persistent drowsiness or loss of consciousness, and cold hands or feet. Most pediatric cases recover in about 7–10 days with supportive care and adequate fluids. The article emphasizes vigilance and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: これらの危険な兆候に注意が必要です。医師は親たちに「シンガポール風邪の症状を軽く見ないように」と促しています。
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スマトラ州でHFMD(エンテロウイルス71)の集団発生が確認され、523件の疑いケース（多くが5歳以下の小児）が報告されています。IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「重症化リスク」を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「重症度」「長期曝露リスク」「流行のしやすさ」の複数基準に該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（南スマトラ州）での手足口病（HFMD）の発生を明確に述べており、対象国リストに含まれるインドネシアで実際に発生しているイベントです。523件の疑いケース、小児患者の多さ、神経系症状（けいれん、意識障害）などの重症化警告が含まれており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高いと判断されます。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Germogli, nuovo focolaio di Salmonella in Europa con 100 casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sprouts: New Salmonella outbreak in Europe with 100 cases.
article.articleSummary: 109 confirmed cases of Salmonella Bovismorbificans ST377 have been reported across 10 EU/EEA countries and the United Kingdom from January to May 2026, with 18 hospitalizations and at least one death in Finland. Finland accounted for 35 cases, the United Kingdom 30, the Netherlands 17, and Germany and Ireland 6 each. The outbreak is linked to alfalfa sprouts, with seeds imported from India and distributed by an Italian supplier to several European sprout producers. Contamination was detected in the production water at two plants—one in the Netherlands and one in Northern Ireland—and Finland linked multiple cases to a local sprout producer. Italy acted as importer/distributor of Indian alfalfa seeds in October 2025; however, evidence points to contamination before arrival in Europe, with no Italian cases reported. Measures included recall of seed lots, sprouts, and destruction of suspect products; subsequent cases declined, with no new infections reported by June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: もやし：100例を伴う欧州での新しいサルモネラ大流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行可能性）。多国間にまたがる確認例109件、死亡1件、複数国での入院を含む国際的食品汚染事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインドが含まれ、サマリーでインド由来のアルファルファ種子が汚染源として明示されている。欧州の複数国（フィンランド、英国、オランダ、ドイツ、アイルランド、イタリア）での二次伝播は確認されているが、対象国リストではインドのみが該当。109確認例、18入院、1死亡、5月〜6月にかけて沈静化。国際的食品供給チェーン汚染事案として重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie atteint 1.333 cas confirmés
