article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the outbreak has reached 1,333 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: On May 15, 2026, the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo was declared, caused by Bundibugy o ebolavirus. By July 1, 2026, there were 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases, 399 deaths, 189 recoveries, and 609 patients still hospitalized or in isolation (provisional case-fatality ~30%). The epidemic remains concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, with South Kivu largely spared and reporting no new transmission since May 26. On June 29, 26 new infections were confirmed, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu. The INSP attributes part of the rise to DHIS2 data cleaning and delayed reporting from health zones and labs. The WHO notes transmission is still active, with 82.7% of identified contacts under follow-up. One imported case was reported in France in a doctor returning from the DRC. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus. CDC Africa plans Bunia trials; funding remains incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：感染者1,333人確認に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模確定患者数（1,333人、死亡399人）、国際的な人的移動による輸入症例（フランス）、重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱17番目のアウトブレイク、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による。ワクチン（Ervebo）が無効で治療法も承認されていない状況。フランスへの輸入症例報告（帰国医師）により国際的なシグナルとなる。ザンビアは記事本文に記載なし、DRCのみ該当。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: A Deadly Cat-Linked Fungus Could Spread to the U.S., Experts Warn
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus causing sporotrichosis, has caused a cat-associated outbreak in South America and is feared to reach the United States. In cats, infections typically produce painful skin lesions; in humans, initial redness and swelling can be mistaken for a minor skin issue but may progress to more severe skin disease, and in rare cases eye, lung infection, or even bloodstream infection. Transmission occurs mainly from cats to humans via scratches; dogs can be infected but do not appear to spread it to people. Human-to-human transmission has not been documented. The risk to the U.S. is theoretical but plausible, potentially via an infected cat traveling from Brazil; imported cases were noted in the U.K. (2022 reports). Diagnosis can be missed due to rarity, and standard labs may fail to identify it. Treatment relies on antifungals such as itraconazole for months; keeping cats indoors reduces risk.

triage.headline_ja: 猫を介した致命的真菌がアメリカに拡がる可能性、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: Sporotrichosis brasiliensisの国際的拡大リスク（南米→米国・英国）が認識されており、IHR基準で国際拡大リスクが該当。ただし現在のところ米国での発症報告はなく、理論的リスクの段階であるため、より確実な確認とリスク評価が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要なイベントは南米（特にブラジル）での猫関連アウトブレイクとそのアメリカへの潜在的拡大リスク。英国での輸入事例は2022年の報告で、現在の主題ではない。IHR Annex2基準の該当は「異常性」と「国際拡大リスク」の2点。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」が該当。社会的関心は高い（メディア報道）が、現段階では理論的リスク評価であり、確定的な複数国での流行ではないため、PICKUP判定ではなくWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 2 morts et un hôpital incendié après des tensions liées à un décès d'Ebola à Bafwabango
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 2 dead and a hospital set on fire after tensions linked to an Ebola death in Bafwabango.
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed, one wounded by gunfire, and a hospital burned in Bafwabango, Ituri Province, after tensions over the death of a person with Ebola on 30 June 2026. Bafwabango lies about 51 km from Nia-Nia on National Road 25, in Ngayo groupement, Bandaka chiefdom, Mambasa Territory. The deceased’s relatives aimed to retrieve the body for burial; Ebola response teams opposed the move due to contamination risks, triggering clashes between mourners and responders. Provisional tally from Ngayo group leader Alexis Mongaki Banasonwa: two dead, one injured, hospital set ablaze. He urged calm and adherence to Ebola control measures; officials have not yet provided official details on the incident or restoration steps. Also, in Ituri territory, a checkpoint on the Bunia-Kasenyi road was vandalized by youths for unclear reasons.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：バフワバンゴのエボラ死亡を巡る緊張後、2人が死亡し病院が焼かれた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の死亡報告であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たし、DRC対象国に該当。エボラ対応と地域治安の悪化により管理可能性が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年7月1日時点でイトゥリ州マンバサ地区バフワバンゴにおけるエボラ死亡例を報告。エボラ対応チームと遺体埋葬希望者の対立が武力衝突に発展し、病院焼失・死傷者発生。地域治安悪化とエボラ対応体制への影響が懸念される。官式発表はいまだ確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: पुलिस की लापरवाही! 11 साल तक आजाद रहा हत्या आरोपी, 80 से ज्यादा लोगों को किया HIV संक्रमित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Police negligence! The murder suspect remained at large for 11 years, infected more than 80 people with HIV.
article.articleSummary: HIV outbreak tied to police negligence in Bhopal: A murder suspect linked to a 2015 seven-year-old’s death remained at large for 11 years after Misrod Police released him. During this period, the suspect allegedly had sexual relations with over 100 people, including more than 15 women, and used money to lure victims. He is said to have infected more than 80 people with HIV, with infections traced to encounters in central Bhopal areas such as Board Office Chowk, Prabhat Chowk, Kamla Park, New Market, and Naka. Katara Hills police, while solving a separate blind murder, identified the same suspect; a 2022 case against him led to arrest but he was released. Authorities warn that if more complainants surface, further action will be taken.

triage.headline_ja: 警察の怠慢！殺人容疑者が11年間逃亡、80人以上がHIV感染
triage.triage_reason: HIV集団感染事例で、80人以上の感染者、複数の異常要因（警察の重大な怠慢、11年間の逃亡、継続的な感染拡大）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当するため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: ボーパル（Bhopal）、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州での事例。警察の怠慢による11年間の容疑者逃亡中に、性的接触を通じた継続的なHIV感染拡大が発生。80人以上の確認感染者があり、さらに追加の被害者が生じる可能性がある。公開情報では国際的な拡大の証拠はないが、国内の重大な公衆衛生侵害と管理可能性の問題が明らかになっている。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango/Choléra : l'exécutif octroie des médicaments et intrants renforcer la riposte à Popokabaka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwango/Cholera: The executive allocates medicines and inputs to strengthen the cholera response in Popokabaka
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Popokabaka, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggers an urgent government response. On June 30, 2026, Governor Willy Bitwisila ordered the emergency mobilization less than 24 hours after the outbreak declaration. Two vehicles departed from Kenge to Kinshasa to fetch a large batch of medicines and health inputs from the National Cholera Elimination Program and Diarrheal Diseases (PNECHOL-MD). The convoy arrived in Popokabaka on July 1 at about 1:30 a.m., enabling swift start of control measures. The kit includes 48 lots of medicines, antibiotics, intravenous fluids, rapid diagnostic tests, chlorine, and other supplies for patient care, contact prophylaxis, household disinfection, and chlorination of water points. Official handover occurred at the Popokabaka Health Zone Central Office with Dr Alain Mboko; Dr Alex Ibanda Matondo, governor’s envoy, emphasized protecting affected populations and containing spread. Deployment began the same day in the most affected health areas.

triage.headline_ja: Kwango/コレラ：行政がPopokabaka地域でのコレラ対応強化のため医薬品と医療物資を配分
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのコレラ集団発生であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および WPRO基準（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）を複数満たし、政府の対応も実施されている。
triage.notes: コレラは周辺地域への拡大リスクが高く、特に水系感染経路を持つため国際的拡大リスクが存在する。政府による迅速な緊急対応（医薬品・医療物資の動員、連絡調整）が記事に明記されており、管理可能性への懸念を示唆している。Popokabaka、Kwango Province、Kinshasa等複数地域への拡大の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola pourrait coûter plusieurs milliards et des dizaines de milliers d'emplois à l'Afrique, selon l'ONU : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could cost Africa several billion dollars and tens of thousands of jobs, according to the UN: News.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens Africa’s livelihoods and public services, per UNDP. The agency warns the epidemic could cost up to $3.6 billion across African economies and push about 985,000 people into poverty, with tens of thousands of jobs lost and disruptions to education and health services. The most affected countries are the DRC and neighbors Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Even in a reference scenario where the virus is contained in DRC and Uganda, the impact remains severe: over $1 billion in real GDP losses and roughly 55,000 jobs lost in the DRC alone. Continent-wide GDP could be reduced by $2.37 billion due to trade disruptions and border restrictions, and the combined effect with the Middle East conflict could reach up to 328,000 lost jobs. UNDP recommends cash transfers, consumption subsidies, targeted screening, and emergency financing to protect maternal, reproductive, and child health during the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカに数十億ドルの損失と数万人の失業をもたらす可能性、国連報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い（国連の警告）。対象国のDRCで進行中のエボラ流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンの影響を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（226074）、ルワンダ（49518）、スーダン（366755）は記事本文での言及はあるが、Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに含まれているため検証対象国の確認が必要。ただし、主な発生地はDRCであり、記事は国連による経済影響予測報告であるため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。現在進行中の流行事象として多くの基準で高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Animal quarantines on standby as Nepal battles rising cases of bird flu
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Nepal widens to 11 of 77 districts, including Kathmandu, with first case detected in March. No human infections have been reported. Culling has reached 658,313 chickens, more than 1 million eggs destroyed, and 222,000 kg (489,400 lb) of poultry feed removed. Kathmandu Valley cases are severe, and Nepal’s sole zoo in Kathmandu has been closed to the public since June 19 after infections were detected. Livestock experts supervise culling operations; government quarantine facilities are on alert to safeguard food safety. Nepal does not import poultry meat, but officials are tightening vigilance along the open border with India to prevent illegal imports. The public is urged to report unusual illness or deaths among birds promptly; authorities continue monitoring the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ネパールが鳥インフルエンザの増加に対応、家畜の隔離態勢が整備される
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの動物疫病は感染症監視の対象であるが、現在のところ人間への感染は報告されていない。地域的な拡大（11地域に拡大）と対策の強化は注視が必要だが、人間への直接的な脅威が明確でないため、続報の監視が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではネパールでの鳥インフルエンザ爆発が主題だが、対象国リストではネパールが含まれていない。インドが言及されているのは「インドとの開放的な境界での監視強化」という文脈のみで、インド領域での発生は報告されていない。ただし、インド国境での違法輸入防止の言及があるため、インドを verified_locations に含めた。人間感染が報告されていない点が重要で、動物疫病としての監視だが、人獣共通感染症リスク管理の観点から経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - July 1, 2026
article.articleSummary: Same-day flu and COVID-19 vaccines shown safe in a VA study of 2.5 million patients. In the United States, COVID-19 trend as of June 23, 2026: 3 states rising, 34 declining, 12 unchanged (CDC modeling). Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 6/28, 33 new cases and 17 deaths; total 1,307 cases and 377 deaths. On 6/27, 47 new cases and 12 deaths; total 1,274 cases and 239 deaths; 87% of known contacts followed. Outbreak spread to a fourth province; Kinshasa bans mass gatherings. UN warns Ebola could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion; Africa CDC triples funding needs; White House seeks $1.4 billion for Ebola response; Bundibugyo virus persistence in an animal host remains unidentified. Marburg in Uganda confirmed (officially 1 case to WHO; reports suggest 2). International public health response contained Andes hantavirus outbreak on a Dutch cruise ship via evacuations, tracing, and quarantine across continents.

triage.headline_ja: Balloon Juice - 感染症・パンデミック アップデート - 2026年7月1日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の高危険病原体（エボラ、マールブルグ、ハンタウイルス）の同時多発的アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、国際的な公衆衛生対応が展開中。
triage.notes: 複数の病原体（エボラ、マールブルグ、ハンタウイルス）が同時に報告されている。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは1,307例、377死亡と大規模。ウガンダでマールブルグが確認された。国際的な公衆衛生対応（資金支援、接触者追跡、隔離、ワクチン開発）が進行中。Kinshasa市での集会禁止、複数州への拡大が報告されている。ウガンダはアフリカ地域内での感染症対策の観点から注視対象だが、記事サマリーではマールブルグ事例のみで詳細が限定的なため、DRCを主要な検証地点とした。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго увеличилось до 399
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 399.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,333 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases with 399 deaths. The outbreak is centered in eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with authorities tracing contacts in two provinces not previously affected to limit spread. The flare began in early May, occurring alongside an Uganda outbreak. The rapid rise is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no certified vaccines or treatments. Ongoing armed conflict in eastern DRC exacerbates response challenges, affecting surveillance, outreach, and case management. Health authorities emphasize close contact tracing and ongoing surveillance to curb transmission amid security constraints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱死亡者数が399人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（399人死亡、1,333確定例）、異常な発生（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダに既に波及）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は認可ワクチン・治療法がなく、極めて危険。武装紛争による対応の困難さが顕著。ウガンダでも同時期に発生しているが、本記事の主題はDRCのためDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。即座のフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू-मलेरिया से बचाव के लिए जन सहभागिता जरूरी: ब्रजेश पाठक - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public participation is essential to protect against dengue and malaria: Brajesh Pathak - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh: Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak announced that encephalitis control has reached about 99% in the state, while dengue and malaria cases have declined but are not yet fully contained. He launched a communicable disease campaign at the Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences, noting the government conducts three annual drives for awareness and control with coordination across 13 departments. He stressed public participation; homes and surroundings must be clean, water must not stagnate, dampness, dirt and dust should be avoided, hands washed with soap before meals, and safe drinking water with caution against open foods and excessive cold drinks. He warned dengue can rapidly lower platelet counts and emphasized preventing mosquito breeding as the most effective measure against dengue, malaria, encephalitis, and chikungunya. He engaged with MBBS first-year students and BSc nursing trainees and directed regular meal-quality checks at the institute.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とマラリアから保護するには市民参加が必須：ブラジェシュ・パターク
triage.triage_reason: インドのウッタル・プラデーシュ州でデング熱、マラリア、脳炎、チクングニアが報告されており、複数の蚊媒介感染症が同時発生している。ただし記事は主に政府の予防啓発キャンペーンの発表であり、急速な増加や重篤な危機の段階を示す詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ラクノウでのデング熱、マラリア、脳炎、チクングニアの同時発生を報告している。政府レベルでの積極的な対応と啓発キャンペーンが進行中。ただし具体的な症例数、死亡者数、急速な増加率などの詳細情報が欠落しているため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階と判定。IHR基準での該当なし、WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさで該当。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma mais dois casos de sarampo e Estado chega a sete infecções em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms two more measles cases, and the state reaches seven infections in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, with two new cases in the capital, bringing 2026 infections to seven as of July 1, 2026. The latest patients are a 20‑year‑old mother and a 6‑month‑old infant, both unvaccinated, in areas near Guarulhos; last week three additional cases were reported in the capital, all infants 6 months to 1 year. The Secretaria da Saúde, along with CVE-SP and the Ministry of Health, is investigating transmission origins. In response, the health department recommends an exceptional zero-dose of the MMR vaccine for children 6–11 months old in São Paulo and Guarulhos. The zero-dose does not replace routine vaccination: first MMR at 12 months, second (preferably MMRV) at 15 months. Coverage in São Paulo is 85.32% for the first dose and 72.06% for the second, below targets. Routine two-dose MMR remains for 5–29-year-olds and healthcare workers; adults 30–59 should have at least one dose.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹患者が2人増加、2026年の感染者数が7人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、予防接種率低下による国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。麻疹の増加傾向と予防接種カバレッジ不足は懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月1日の配信であり、サンパウロ州における麻疹クラスターの増加を報告している。未接種の乳幼児・成人が中心の感染事例。予防接種カバレッジが目標値以下（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）であることが懸念される。州保健局による予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число подтвержденных случаев заболевания Эболой превысило 1300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has surpassed 1,300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 1,300 confirmed cases as of June 30, 2026 (INSP briefing). There are 375 deaths and 180 recoveries (case fatality rate 28.8%). About 615 patients remain in isolation, and 81.3% of contacts are being traced. The hardest hit is Ituri province, spanning 23 health zones, with Northern Kivu and South Kivu also epicenters, partly controlled by the M23 rebels. The government unveiled a €280 million emergency plan to fund on‑the‑ground operations, curb transmission, and save lives. Uganda has recorded 19 infections and 2 deaths, highlighting cross‑border risk. WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; the Kasai outbreak of late 2025 (53 cases, 34 deaths) preceded the current spread, while 2018–2020 killed over 2,200.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が1,300例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も全項目で肯定。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認、国境を越えた感染），WHO PHEICの指定，および高い社会的・政治的関心を示している。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。2026年6月30日時点で1,300例超、死亡375例（致命率28.8%），ウガンダへの波及（19例，2死亡）。WHO PHEICに指定済み。DRC内複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）で同時多発。政府による28千万ユーロの緊急対応計画あり。国際支援・関心度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda reviews TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, dengue preparedness with Delhi government
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, July 1, 2026: Union Health Minister JP Nadda chaired a review on TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan and dengue preparedness with the Delhi Government, focusing on strengthening tuberculosis elimination and bolstering Delhi's public health response to seasonal vector-borne disease risks. Ahead of World TB Day 2026, India highlighted accelerated progress towards TB elimination under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). Nadda flagged off the focused 100 Days Campaign, alongside launches of the TB Mukt Bharat App and the TB Mukt Urban Ward Initiative, aimed at accelerating case detection, improving treatment adherence, and strengthening last-mile TB service delivery in high-burden areas. The efforts reflect the World TB Day 2026 theme, 'Yes! We Can End TB,' and Prime Minister Modi's vision of a TB-Mukt Bharat, while aligning dengue preparedness with Delhi's health security measures.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は公衆衛生大臣による結核・デング熱対策の政策レビュー会議であり、新規流行イベント報告ではない。既存の公衆衛生施策の進捗確認と啓発活動であるため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事の主要内容は政治家による既存の公衆衛生キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の進捗状況報告およびデング熱対策の政策会議であり、新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイク報告ではない。結核とデング熱は記載されているが、これらは対策の対象疾患として言及されているにすぎず、現在の異常流行や緊急事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Warn Nigerians Against Ebola Misinformation Ebola - News Agency Of Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Public health experts in Nigeria warn against Ebola misinformation, saying false claims fuel panic and undermine control. At a Lagos X-Space webinar monitored by NAN, health educator Ayomide Alebiowu urged verification of health messages and reporting of false information. Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) has six strains; the strain circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo differs from the Zaire strain linked to Nigeria’s 2014 outbreak, and no cure exists for this Congo strain while vaccines for other variants are under study. Early EVD symptoms—fever, headache, sore throat, muscle/joint pain, weakness—mimic malaria and typhoid, complicating diagnosis. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids, not airborne. Nigerians should obtain information from recognised bodies such as NCDC, WHO and Doctors Without Borders. Nigeria’s 2014 response involved surveillance, contact tracing of about 900 contacts across three states and roughly 20 confirmed cases, illustrating containment capacity; vigilance and verified information remain essential as of 1 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア の専門家がエボラの誤情報に対して警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病について公衆衛生上の警告と注意喚起が行われているが、記事は主にミスインフォメーション対策と予防的情報提供に焦点があり、現在の流行または新規発生を示す直接的な臨床的証拠がない。ただしDRCでの流行動向に対するナイジェリアの対応状況として注視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にナイジェリアにおけるエボラ誤情報対策と予防啓発に関するもの。DRCでの流行への警戒と情報管理の重要性が述べられているが、ナイジェリア国内での現在の流行や確認例は報告されていない。2014年の過去事例と比較した準備体制の評価であり、直接的な新規臨床イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Lombok Tengah membentuk tim 'tracing' penderita TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Lombok Regency Government forms a 'tracing' team for TB patients
article.articleSummary: TB tracing teams formed by Central Lombok Regency Government in West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, are integrated with free health checks to improve public health. The team, drawn from 30 puskesmas across 12 kecamatan, will visit communities to investigate close TB contacts, conduct health screenings, and compile TB data. Initiatives start mid-July 2026, targeting 154 desa with about 100 people per desa. As of the first half of 2026, 468 TB cases were identified in Lombok Tengah against an annual target of 3,500. The 2025 achievement was 32% of target. TB is curable with six months of regular treatment; medicines are provided free. The program seeks to boost detection and treatment adherence by integrating TB tracing with routine free health checks to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ロンボク摂政政府、結核患者の「トレーシング」チームを編成
triage.triage_reason: 結核の既知の風土病における地域の公衆衛生プログラム報道であり、異常な発生、重篤度の急上昇、または国際的な拡大の兆候がない。進行中の予防・管理活動の文脈で報告されている。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおける結核は風土病であり、本記事は新規の集団発生ではなく、既存の地域プログラムにおける継続的な接触者追跡および検査イニシアティブの実施を報告している。468症例は年間目標3,500に対して低く、症例の増加傾向や異常な重篤度は示されていない。WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行性が該当するが、既知の風土病における通常の公衆衛生対応であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップの閾値には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में अब प्राइवेट अस्पतालों और लैब्स की नहीं चलेगी मनमानी, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने तय की डेंगू टेस्ट की कीमत - haryana health department fixes price for dengue test
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Private hospitals and labs in Haryana will no longer be allowed to act at will; the health department has fixed the price of the dengue test.
article.articleSummary: In Haryana, private hospitals and ELISA-based NS1 and IgM dengue tests may not charge more than Rs 600. Free platelet support will be provided at all civic hospitals, and 27 government laboratories will offer free dengue testing. Health Minister Aarti Singh Rao announced July as Dengue Prevention Month and urged residents to prevent water stagnation. As part of the campaign, every Sunday at home and Friday at workplaces should be observed as 'dry days' to empty containers, coolers, trays, plant pots, and other water-holding items for at least 24 hours to destroy mosquito eggs and larvae. Roof tanks should be capped; remove waste plastic items, old tires, and coconut shells; fill potholes; wear full sleeves; use repellents and treated nets. Dengue presents with sudden high fever, severe headache, muscle/joint pain, and retro-orbital pain; suspected cases should get free blood tests promptly and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州では民間病院と検査機関による恣意的行為は今後許されない。保健局がデング熱検査の価格を決定
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の流行を示唆する記事ですが、記事の主眼は検査料金の規制と予防キャンペーンの発表であり、確認された患者数や重症度、急速な拡大に関する情報が欠落しています。シグナルとするには情報不足です。
triage.notes: 記事はハリヤナ州でのデング熱対策（検査料金規制と予防キャンペーン）についての政策発表です。実際の患者数、死亡数、感染率などの疫学的データが記載されていないため、流行の規模・重症度を判断できません。WPRO基準の「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」は該当しますが、IHR基準は全て該当していません。続報により患者数や重症度が明確になった場合、PICKUP判定に変更される可能性があります。

article.articleHeadline: Lakhimpur Kheri News| Sanchari Rog Niyantran Abhiyan|Sambhav Abhiyan 6.0|Lakhimpur Kheri Health News | Lakhimpur Kheri News: संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान और संभव अभियान 6.0 का आगाज, डीएम ने किया शुभारंभ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lakhimpur Kheri News | Communicable Disease Control Campaign | Sambhav Campaign 6.0 | Lakhimpur Kheri Health News | Lakhimpur Kheri News: Launch of the Communicable Disease Control Campaign and Sambhav Campaign 6.0, inaugurated by the District Magistrate.
article.articleSummary: In Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, the Communicable Disease Control Campaign and Sambhav Campaign 6.0 were inaugurated by District Magistrate Anjani Kumar Singh at the district collectorate, launching with a gate-cutting ceremony and a public awareness rally featuring CMO Dr. Santosh Gupta, DPO ICDS Bharat Prasad, DPRO Vishal Singh, and Deputy CMO Dr. Pramod Kumar. The drive targets dengue, malaria, and brain fever (encephalitis) with a focus on swift treatment and vector control across the district. The ‘Dastak’ house-to-house campaign runs July 11–July 31; ASHA workers will educate households on prevention, symptoms, and treatment and identify suspected cases for reporting. Fever in children should be taken to government facilities. Helpline 1800-180-5145. ASHA, Anganwadi, ANM, and Swachhta Doots participated; the campaign emphasizes public awareness and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: Lakhimpur Kheri News | 感染症制御キャンペーン | Sambhav Campaign 6.0 | Lakhimpur Kheri保健ニュース : 感染症制御キャンペーンおよびSambhav Campaign 6.0の開始、地区行政官により開始
triage.triage_reason: デング、マラリア、脳炎を対象とした公衆衛生キャンペーンの開始報道。ベクター制御と急速な対応を重視した地域内の感染症対策イニシアティブだが、実際の発症者数、死亡者、または異常な増加を示す具体的な事例報告が記事サマリーに含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はキャンペーン開始の発表であり、実際の発症例報告ではない。デング、マラリア、脳炎（Unknown Encephalitis）は地域での流行リスク要因として特定されているが、現在の患者数、死亡者、異常な増加パターンについての情報は記事サマリーに記載されていない。続報で実際の症例数増加や異常な重症度の報告があれば、評価を上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: नगरपालिका अध्यक्ष ने विशेष संचारी रोग नियंत्रण/दस्तक अभियान माह का किया शुभारम्भ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mayor has inaugurated the Special Communicable Disease Control/Dastak Campaign Month.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026 in Basti, Uttar Pradesh, Mayor Neha Verma inaugurated the Special Communicable Disease Control/Dastak Campaign Month at Rajkiya Inter College, launching an awareness rally to curb communicable diseases. The Communicable Disease Control Campaign runs 1 July–31 July, while the Dastak (door‑to‑door) campaign runs 11 July–31 July 2025. The mayor urged prompt fever treatment at the nearest government hospital, warning that brain fever can be deadly and may cause physical and mental disability. Fever treatment is available at all CHCs and PHCs in the district. Attendees included Chief Medical Officer Dr. Rajiv Nigam and other district health officials. The event reaffirmed commitments to make the district brain fever‑free, promote sanitation and personal hygiene, and encourage families to seek government care for fever in children.

triage.headline_ja: 市長が特別感染症制御/ダスタク・キャンペーン月を開始
triage.triage_reason: 公開キャンペーン・啓発イベントの報道であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常な感染症イベントではない。既知の感染症対策の定期的なルーチン実施に該当する。
triage.notes: 疾患名が『Unknown Illness』とされているが、サマリー上では『brain fever』（脳熱、おそらくエンセファリティス）を指していると推定される。しかし本記事は既知の感染症に対する定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン・啓発活動の報道であり、新規発生事例の報告ではない。シグナル検出の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: "Sono tornata da una vacanza in India con 38 parassiti nel cervello"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I returned from a vacation in India with 38 parasites in my brain.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis from Taenia solium eggs caused 38 brain cysticerci in Lowri Denman, a 42-year-old Welsh woman from Carmarthen, linked to a 2007 three-month trip to India. Transmission likely via contaminated water or vegetables; eggs hatch in the intestine and larvae migrate to the CNS. Asymptomatic for about three years, she expelled a tapeworm fragment in 2010, and in 2011 suffered severe headaches and a generalized seizure. CT/MRI revealed 38 parasites in the brain; initial diagnosis was toxoplasmosis. Treated with antiparasitics and steroids, she did not undergo surgical removal; larvae died and calcified. A major neuropsychiatric relapse followed, with anxiety, panic, paranoia, and psychosis during inflammation, leading to six weeks in a neuropsychiatric unit. By 2018 she completed education in Cardiff. This UK case highlights travel-associated neurocysticercosis, long-term neurological and psychiatric sequelae, and the importance of accurate imaging-based diagnosis."} }{type:

triage.headline_ja: インドの休暇から帰宅したら脳内に38匹の寄生虫がいた
triage.triage_reason: 単一の渡航関連症例報告であり、集団発生や国内での流行を示唆する証拠がない。イベント発生地は2007年で、報告は2026年の遡及的事例報告。
triage.notes: 本件は2007年のインド旅行での個別感染事例の2026年報告。ウェールズ在住の女性が感染し、長期にわたって症状が出現した医学的に興味深いケースだが、現在の流行状況を示唆するものではなく、集団発生の兆候もない。個別医療事例として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Ramaphosa viajará mañana a RDC para mostrar el apoyo de la Unión Africana frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ramaphosa will travel to the DRC tomorrow to show the African Union's support in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa travels to Kinshasa on July 1, 2026, as AU envoy for Preparedness, Prevention and Response to Pandemics to express African Union support for the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak in eastern Ituri and nearby areas, including Kivu del Borte and Kivu del Sur. He will meet President Félix Tshisekedi to reinforce continental coordination, cross-border preparedness, and mobilize political, technical, and financial commitments to fight the epidemic. The AU Epidemics Fund has pledges exceeding $100 million; international commitments exceed $910 million; South Africa pledges $13.5 million. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri; it has caused 399 deaths and 1,333 confirmed cases, and spread to Uganda with 20 infections and two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no authorized vaccine or specific treatment per WHO, signaling high regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: ラマフォーサ南アフリカ大統領が明日DRCを訪問、エボラに対するアフリカ連合の支援を示す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多発地域での確定患者数（1,333例）と死亡数（399例）に加え、国際的な感染拡大（ウガンダでも20例・2例死亡）、公式なワクチン・特異的治療がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株、および著名な国家指導者による公式訪問と国際的な政治・財政動員により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーには南アフリカ大統領の訪問に関する記述があり、South Africaが発生地域に含まれているが、実際のエボラ発症地域はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu）とウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加しない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀だが高病原性であり、ワクチン・治療法の欠如がリスク評価を高める。

article.articleHeadline: UK unprepared for Ebola? MPs raise alarm over lack of published plan
article.articleSummary: UK MPs warn of unpreparedness as Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) nears France's first imported case (June 24). The DRC outbreak has about 1,300 cases and 360 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which there is no vaccine. The current outbreak is the third-largest in history, with past West Africa epidemics causing around 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths; WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. France's case and a suspected but negative case in Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital prompted renewed concern that the UK could see imported cases; UKHSA says the risk to Britain remains low but imports are possible. MPs on the Health and Social Care Committee have written to CMO Sir Chris Whitty and health minister Sharon Hodgson to request a briefing and details on border surveillance, testing, and broader preparations; DHSC must respond by July 9.

triage.headline_ja: 英国はエボラ出血熱に対応できていないのか？ MPs が公表計画の不足について警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。DRC での大規模アウトブレイク（1,300例以上、360死亡）と仏国への輸入症例により、国際的拡大リスクが顕在化。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当し、政府・議会レベルでの対応関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRC は対象国リストに含まれる（GeoNames ID 203312）。サマリーの主題は DRC での Ebola outbreak と仏国への輸入症例だが、対象国リストでは DRC のみが該当。UK・Scotland・France・Angola は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。Bundibugyo strain であり、既知のワクチンが存在しない点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: O femeie a trăit ani întregi fără să știe că avea 38 de paraziți în creier. Totul a început după o vacanță în India
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman lived for many years without knowing she had 38 parasites in her brain. It all began after a vacation in India.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium eggs led a UK-based woman, Lowri Denman of Cardiff, to harbor 38 brain parasites after a three-month trip to India in 2007. Symptoms began in 2010 with severe headaches, followed by a convulsive seizure in 2011; CT/MRI revealed 38 intracranial parasites. Initially suspected toxoplasmosis, but maternal recall of a previously eliminated tapeworm helped confirm the diagnosis. Transmission was linked to ingestion of Taenia solium eggs via contaminated food or water. She was treated in hospital with antiparasitics and corticosteroids; the parasites calcified over time, avoiding surgery. Despite early improvement and travel to New Zealand and Bristol, inflammation around the parasites caused episodes of confusion, numbness, tingling, and psychiatric symptoms. Recovery needed years; since 2017 she has had no seizures, but epilepsy management continues. By 2022 she resumed work and studies, with ongoing treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ある女性は脳に38匹の寄生虫がいることを何年も知らずに生活していた。それはすべてインドへの休暇の後に始まった。
triage.triage_reason: インドでの旅行中に感染したと考えられる神経嚢虫症の個別事例であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。ただし公衆衛生上の関心はあり、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染源はインドでの2007年の旅行中に摂取された汚染食・水を介したTaenia soliumの卵である。UK在住の患者の個別事例であり、集団発生や局地流行の兆候はない。IHR基準は2つ達成しているが、これは個別例の診断確定事例であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。トリアージはWATCHに判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo could push a million more people into poverty
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), declared on May 15, has infected over 1,300 people and killed more than 370 in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, continues to fuel transmission, with health authorities tracing contacts in Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces bordering South Sudan, including a pregnant woman who died in Ituri’s Niania zone linked to new infections, and contacts with a confirmed Ituri case under investigation. Several cases have been detected in Uganda; modeling raises concern for spread to South Sudan within weeks. A suspected Ebola case in Scotland tested negative. DR Congo banned mass gatherings in Kinshasa and three other provinces. UNDP warns the outbreak could push up to 985,000 people into poverty and cost Africa $3.6 billion, amid weak health infrastructure, misinformation, and aid cuts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は100万人以上をさらに貧困に陥れる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は甚大な公衆衛生への影響（1,300人以上感染、370人以上死亡）を示し、国際的に周辺国への拡大リスク（ウガンダでの症例検出、南スーダンへの数週間以内の拡大懸念）、渡航制限（スコットランドでの疑似症例検査）があり、深刻な異常事態である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ワクチンなし）による進行中の流行。ウガンダでも症例検出されており、南スーダンへの越境リスクが懸念される。スコットランドの疑似症例は検査陰性。DRC政府による集会禁止措置実施。UNDPの貧困化予測（98.5万人）は社会経済的影響の深刻さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: 警惕！阳性率呈上升趋势，鼻病毒成感冒"头号元凶"！14岁以下病例受影响最深！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant! The positivity rate is on the rise, rhinovirus has become the No. 1 culprit of the common cold! Children under 14 are the most affected!
article.articleSummary: China's CDC sentinel surveillance reports rising rhinovirus activity, now the leading pathogen in both outpatient influenza-like illness and hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections. Among outpatient respiratory specimens, rhinovirus accounts for 11.9% positive, followed by influenza virus 9.9% and enterovirus 7.7%; among hospitalized severe ARI cases, rhinovirus positivity is 9.4%. Northern provinces show faster increases, and children under 14 are the most affected. Rhinovirus causes nasal congestion and sore throat; illness is usually self-limiting within about a week, though in children it can trigger otitis media or sinusitis. Public health advice emphasizes mask use in crowded places and when accessing medical care, especially for the elderly and those with chronic diseases; emphasize handwashing, ventilation, and nasal saline irrigation. Treatments are supportive; avoid antibiotic overuse, recommend symptomatic care, and consult for vaccination as per guidelines. Four common medication myths debunked: antibiotics, oseltamivir, high-dose vitamin C, vinegar fumigation, and multi-drug cold remedies.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！陽性率が上昇傾向、鼻病毒が風邪の「第一の原因」に！14歳以下の患者が最も影響を受けている！
triage.triage_reason: 鼻病毒の活動増加は異常かつ予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たすが、重症度や国際的拡大リスクが限定的であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主疾患は鼻病毒（Rhinovirus）であるが、Bluedot APIで提供された疾患名にはEnterovirus SyndromeとInfluenzaのみ記載されている。これは分類の不正確さを示唆している。中国CDCの定点監視データに基づくもので、信頼性は高いと判断される。重症度は限定的（自己限定的な経過）であり、小児への影響が主である。国際的拡大リスクは記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sistema que cruza dados do SUS e de farmácias detecta surtos precocemente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: System that cross-references SUS data and pharmacy data detects outbreaks early.
article.articleSummary: A Brazilian study assessing the Early Alert System for Outbreaks with Pandemic Potential (ÆSOP), now being rolled out by the Ministry of Health, shows its capacity to detect early signals of respiratory disease surges. ÆSOP fuses data from the SUS Primary Health Care network (APS) via Sisab and over-the-counter (OTC) medicine sales (e.g., decongestants) from IQVIA to spot emerging outbreaks. Developed by Fiocruz Bahia and Coppe/UFRJ, the system predicted 60% of increases in respiratory-disease hospitalizations up to three weeks earlier. OTC sales flagged alerts about 57% of the 746 episodes analyzed; APS data showed a similar lead time (~60%). Early detection—1 to 3 weeks ahead—provides time to guide epidemiological investigations, expand sampling, and prepare beds, staff, and supplies, reducing health-system strain. The paper, published in npj Digital Public Health, cites Ebola in West Africa, Zika in Brazil, and SARS-CoV-2 in China as examples of delayed identification.

triage.headline_ja: SUSとファーマシーデータを組み合わせるシステムが流行を早期に検出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は流行検出システムの開発・評価に関する学術的報告であり、実際の感染症発生イベントではなく、論文の発表について述べたものである。Ebola、Zika、SARS-CoV-2は事例として言及されているに過ぎず、現在進行中の新規発生ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した3国（ブラジル、アンゴラ、中国）は、記事サマリー内で「過去の流行事例」として言及されているに過ぎず、現在進行中の感染症発生を示していない。本記事は疾病監視システムの有効性を検証する学術報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola del Congo lleva ya 400 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo's Ebola outbreak has already killed 400.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of 1 July 2026, 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths; 189 recovered; 609 under treatment. 26 new infections and 9 recoveries since the last update; case fatality rate 29.7%. The outbreak was declared on 15 May, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for this strain; three experimental vaccines have been accelerated to broaden response. The country has strengthened health care, surveillance, and community mobilization but still needs medical supplies to prevent spread. Notably, France confirmed an imported Ebola case from DRC, triggering travel measures by several countries (US, Canada, Bahrain) and EU advisories.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行により既に400人の死亡者が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が既に宣言されている。エボラ出血熱は致死性感染症で、複数国への国際的拡大と国際的な行動制限が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供する発生地域にはUS、France、Canadaが含まれているが、これらは輸入症例または行政措置対応国であり、実際の流行発生地はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu地域。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。ワクチン未承認、実験的ワクチン使用開始。医療物資の国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Jundiaí confirma morte por febre maculosa; vítima era aluno da Escola de Sargentos das Armas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jundiaí confirms death from Brazilian spotted fever; the victim was a student at the Army Sergeants School.
article.articleSummary: Death from Brazilian spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii) in Jundiaí, São Paulo state: a 20-year-old Army Sergeants School student, Pedro Henrique Freiman Pereira, died Sunday (28). Diagnosis confirmed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz; result reported to the city on June 26. He attended ESA training at the 12th Group of Anti-Aircraft Artillery in Jundiaí June 8–11. Epidemiological teams are trying to identify the Local Probable Site of Infection; exposure location remains undetermined as investigations review movements during incubation. Preventive actions include environmental assessments and population guidance. The disease is tick-borne and not transmitted person-to-person, acquired via bites from ticks carrying Rickettsia rickettsii. Risk areas include vegetated zones near rivers/lakes, riparian forests, and sites with capybaras. Symptoms: fever, headache, body aches, malaise, and a red rash within 14 days of exposure. Seek medical care promptly; early diagnosis and treatment improve outcomes. Endemic in São Paulo; winter and dry season increase immature tick activity; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジャイがブラジル斑点熱による死亡を確認。犠牲者は陸軍准曹学校の生徒
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるロッキー山紅斑熱（リケッチア症）による単発の死亡例。重症度基準は満たすが、ヒト-ヒト感染なし、発生が限定的であるため、引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 単発の死亡事例であり、患者は限定的（軍事訓練施設の学生）。ダニ媒介疾患であるため人から人への感染リスクなし。サンパウロ州風土病であり、現地での公衆衛生対応が進行中。急速な感染拡大のリスクは低いが、環境におけるダニの監視と予防的行動の継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola pourrait coûter plusieurs milliards et des dizaines de milliers d'emplois à l'Afrique, selon l'ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak could cost Africa several billions of dollars and tens of thousands of jobs, according to the UN.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens tens of thousands of jobs and could cost up to $3.6 billion across Africa, according to the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). In a statement accompanying a report on Ebola's impact, the UNDP warns the epidemic could trigger a large socio-economic crisis, potentially pushing 985,000 more people into poverty. It could also erode education and health services and, if regional and global spillovers worsen, weigh on African economies by up to $3.6 billion. The shock would hit hardest in DRC and neighboring countries, notably Uganda, Rwanda and South Sudan. The poverty impact would be borne first by women. Containment measures such as quarantines, and broader travel and trade restrictions, could unintentionally devastate local economies and informal livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行は数十億ドルと数万の雇用喪失をもたらす可能性：国連報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（経済的・社会的危機）と国際的拡大リスクが明確に該当（2基準以上）。また大規模な人道的危機と地域的波及が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月1日時点のDRC中心のエボラ流行の経済社会的影響を報じている。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンへの地域波及リスクが言及されているが、確認された発生地はDRCのみ。国連開発計画（UNDP）による公式評価であり、信頼性が高い。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ebola pourrait coûter plusieurs milliards et des milliers d'emplois à l'Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ebola could cost Africa billions of dollars and thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-01, Ebola could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and threaten tens of thousands of jobs, while disrupting education and health services. The poverty shock would hit women hardest, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighbors Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan most affected. While quarantine and broader travel or trade restrictions may be required for outbreak control, they can unintentionally devastate local economies and informal livelihoods. Ebola affects livelihoods, education, food security, trade, public finances, and trust; addressing it solely as a health issue risks a larger development emergency. The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) recommends direct cash transfers and consumption subsidies for the most vulnerable, replacing generalized border closures with targeted screening, and establishing emergency financing to maintain maternal, reproductive, and child health services alongside the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱 - アフリカに数十億ドルの損失と数千の雇用喪失をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の経済社会的影響に関する分析・予測記事であり、直接的な新規患者発生や流行拡大を報告していない。現況の疫学情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定により続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月1日時点のシナリオ分析・経済影響評価であり、具体的な患者数・死亡数・現在の流行状況に関する疫学情報を含まない。DRCが主要な懸念地域として明示されているが、Uganda・Rwanda・South Sudanは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。経済社会的インパクトが強調されており、国連等からの支援提唱があるため政治的関心は高いと判断。ただし、現在進行形の新規事例報告がないため PICKUP ではなく WATCH として位置づける。

article.articleHeadline: Campanha Julho Amarelo alerta sobre hepatites virais e sua prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July Campaign Alerts About Viral Hepatitis and Its Prevention
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s July Yellow Campaign highlights viral hepatitis awareness, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment, with July designated as Yellow July (Julho Amarelo) and World Hepatitis Day on July 28, established by the World Health Organization. The report notes coverage in 2022 (TV Brasil) and 2023 (Agência Brasil) and cites a 2025 Radioagência Nacional piece showing Brazil reduced hepatitis mortality through vaccination. Disease: viral hepatitis; location: Brazil. No specific hepatitis type, case counts, or outbreaks are provided. Emphasizes vaccination as a critical prevention measure and ongoing public health effort to reduce mortality under WHO guidance. The piece situates July’s health observances within Brazilian public health reporting, linking vaccination impact to broader disease prevention. Keywords: vaccination, hepatitis, public health campaign, Brazil, World Health Organization, July.

triage.headline_ja: 7月黄色キャンペーン、ウイルス性肝炎とその予防について警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウイルス性肝炎の予防啓発キャンペーンに関する公衆衛生教育の報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン）を報告していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な保健キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）の報道であり、特定の症例数、アウトブレイク、または異常な疾患パターンを報告していない。過去の実績（2022年、2023年、2025年の報道参照）の言及に限定される。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Жители Конго воруют тела умерших от Эболы, считая вирус колдовством или ложью // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Congo steal the bodies of people who died from Ebola, believing the virus to be witchcraft or a lie // NTV News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is six weeks old, with 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths reported. Disinformation spreads via WhatsApp among neighborhoods and religious groups, often through voice messages, with many individuals illiterate. Rumors claim witchcraft or foreign actors are behind the virus, prompting dangerous acts such as families stealing graves of Ebola patients to conduct traditional funerals, despite high transmissibility from bodily fluids. Health facilities have been burned, patients flee quarantine, and families resist safe-burial protocols. A pregnant woman who died at nine months necessitated a three-day negotiation to devise a less risky burial ritual. Amref Health Africa's Dr. Githinji Gitahi notes that distrust stems from long-standing health-system failures, as aid appears concentrated during Ebola outbreaks while ongoing issues like malaria and malnutrition persist, eroding confidence in public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの住民がエボラで亡くなった人の遺体を盗む、ウイルスを魔術または嘘だと信じて
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。1,307確定患者と377死亡、ブンディブギョ株、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い伝播性を有し、治療施設の放火や患者の逃亡など管理が困難な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の発生を明確に報告。WhatsApp等を通じた誤情報拡散、遺体盗難による高リスク埋葬、保健施設への暴力的対抗により、管理可能性が著しく低下。医療制度への長期的な不信感が根底にあり、持続的な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak could cost Africa $3.6 billion
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in DR Congo, has infected about 1,300 people and killed more than 300 since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment. The UN warns the outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and hundreds of thousands of jobs, amid an ongoing crisis. A worst-case scenario envisions spread beyond DR Congo and Uganda to Rwanda and Angola, with fuel-cost pressures linked to the Iran crisis amplifying impact. DR Congo authorities say the virus may have reached two new provinces, while health workers battle dwindling supplies and widespread skepticism about the disease, hindering response. A vaccine is likely weeks away, leaving containment and economic costs mounting as of 2026-07-01.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカに36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の多国間での流行は極めて高いリスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの流行。1,300人以上の感染、300人以上の死亡。ワクチン・治療法なし。発生地域にはUganda、Rwanda、Angolaも記載されているが、記事サマリーは主にDRCでの流行を中心に報告しており、これら隣国への「拡大リスク」として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。UN警告による経済的影響（36億ドル損失予測）も社会政治的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC continúa creciendo: alcanza los 1.333 casos confirmados y 399 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: it has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases and 399 deaths (case fatality rate 29.9%). In the last 24 hours, 26 new confirmed cases were reported (Ituri 17, North Kivu 9). Eight deaths are linked to these new cases; 14 additional confirmed patients died in treatment centers (13 in Ituri, 1 in North Kivu). Nine patients recovered (six Ituri, three North Kivu). Ituri remains the epicenter with 1,214 cases (91% of total); North Kivu 116; South Kivu 3, with no new infections since May 26. Community transmission remains intense; epidemiological week 25 recorded over 300 cases in seven days. Government response includes free health care in four Ituri priority zones (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Rwampara) to improve access to diagnosis and treatment, plus ongoing surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ流行は継続成長：1,333件の確定症例と399人の死亡に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルス病の流行はDRCで確認された。Kigali Province（ルワンダの地域）がBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではルワンダでの流行は明示されておらず、DRCが主要な発生地。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。1,333確定症例、399死亡という大規模流行状況であり、Ituri州を中心に地域感染が強度。政府対応（無料医療、監視、接触者追跡）が進行中だが、継続的な国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Detects Severe Disease Amid Ebola Outbreak: WHO
article.articleSummary: On July 1, Uganda confirmed a case of Marburg; WHO says contact tracing is under way and no contacts have shown signs. Marburg is a rare orthomarburgvirus disease with symptoms including rash and severe bleeding; past outbreaks have mortality ranging roughly 24–88%, with a recent Ethiopian outbreak reporting high fatalities. The disease can resemble malaria, typhoid, and meningitis. Transmission occurs mainly via contact with Egyptian rousette bats and bodily fluids of infected people. Incubation is two to 21 days, and deaths typically occur eight to nine days after onset. There are no approved Marburg treatments; management is supportive care. Uganda is also contending with an Ebola outbreak, reporting 21 confirmed/probable cases and 3 deaths, most in Congo. The U.S. has advised against travel to Uganda due to health and security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ流行下でマールブルグ病を検出：WHO
triage.triage_reason: マールブルグ病とエボラウイルス病の同時発生、高い致死率（24～88%）、国際的な旅行勧告の発出、米国の渡航中止勧告など、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の複数該当により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCおよびUganda、Ethiopiaは対象国外のため verified_locations は空配列。ただしDRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれている（DRC=203312）ため、サマリーの「Congo」参照箇所から該当性を確認。サマリー上、Ebola outbreak（ウガンダ、主に「Congo」）およびMarburg case（ウガンダ）が同時に存在。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため、エボラ症例が「mostly in Congo」と記載されている点から DRC を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Minority NPP summons Health Minister for briefing on post-flood disease risks
article.articleSummary: Floods affecting more than 38,000 people in Accra left 12 dead, prompting the Minority in Parliament to demand an urgent briefing from Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh on post-flood disease risks. Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin urged Parliament to be updated on measures to monitor affected communities for early signs of disease, the emergency supplies deployed to flood-hit areas, and the surveillance and preparedness in place should an outbreak occur. He warned that overflowing sanitation facilities create conditions conducive to the rapid spread of communicable diseases. The opposition also linked flooding to environmental policy, alleging that illegal mining—through GoldBod and the Bank of Ghana’s Gold for Reserves program—degrades watersheds and worsens floods, contradicting campaign promises to curb galamsey. Relief operations continue as public health concerns rise in flood-affected Accra.

triage.headline_ja: 少数派NPP、洪水後の疾病リスクに関する保健大臣への説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の感染症リスクについての政治的関心と公衆衛生上の懸念が示されているが、現在のところ具体的な患者発生や疾病確認情報がないため。情報が限定的であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの有無を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患が「Unknown Illness」と特定されておらず、現在のところ実際の患者発生や確認された疾病アウトブレイクは報告されていない。記事は洪水後の感染症リスク懸念と予防・監視の必要性について政治的圧力を述べているものである。サニテーション施設の溢流による感染症伝播リスク、被災者の長期曝露、感染しやすい状況が指摘されているが、具体的な疾病発生確認がないため、より多くの情報が必要な段階（WATCH）と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Everywhere Insiders 55: Iran, Russia, Israel, Ebola, and Europe's Security Failures
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is highlighted as part of a broader discussion of cascading crises. The interview notes an ongoing DRC Ebola outbreak, without detailing case counts or laboratory confirmation, and links this health emergency to wider accountability, preparedness, and policy failures across Western democracies. Against this backdrop, the dialogue analyzes Iran’s pressure in the Strait of Hormuz, U.S. diplomacy with Gulf partners, and Europe’s migration-security debates. It emphasizes that strategic disagreements—over safe passage rules and Iran’s demand for routing that recognizes its coastal-state status—reflect deeper governance gaps. While Ebola is the only explicit disease mention, the piece situates the outbreak within a matrix of geopolitical challenges, including Russian escalation rhetoric and Israel’s political crisis, illustrating interconnected risks to public health and security.

triage.headline_ja: インサイダー55号：イラン、ロシア、イスラエル、エボラ、ヨーロッパの安全保障の失敗
triage.triage_reason: エボラの記事掲載は政治分析が中心であり、具体的な症例数や検査確認がない。DRC でのエボラ発生は言及されているが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクの詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ を地政学的危機の背景要素として扱っており、具体的なエボラ情報（症例数、死亡数、確認日）が記載されていない。DRC でのエボラの言及は確認されるが、詳細不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Aligarh News|Major Communicable Disease Control Campaign Begins|Aligarh Today News | Aligarh News: संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान की शुरुआत, महापौर ने दिलाई स्वच्छता की शपथ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aligarh News | Major Communicable Disease Control Campaign Begins | Aligarh Today News | Aligarh News: Launch of the Communicable Disease Control Campaign, the Mayor administered the cleanliness pledge.
article.articleSummary: Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh launches a month-long Communicable Disease Control Campaign during the monsoon to curb rising fever, malaria, diarrhea, filariasis, leprosy, and tuberculosis. From July 1–31, ASHA and Anganwadi workers will conduct house-to-house surveillance to identify fever cases, malaria, filariasis, leprosy, tuberculosis, diarrhea, and malnourished children, ensuring timely treatment. A city-wide fogging and insecticide spray program will be implemented. Mayor Prashant Singhal also led residents in a cleanliness pledge and flag-off of an awareness rally from Malakh Singh District Hospital, urging cleanliness and prevention of waterlogging to reduce mosquito breeding; posters, banners, and leaflets will educate the public. The rally traversed Raslganj and Hakeem ki Sarai before returning to the hospital. Attendance included the Health Department, Municipal Corporation, and other agencies.

triage.headline_ja: アリガル発信 主要な感染症制御キャンペーン開始 アリガルニュース：感染症制御キャンペーンの開始、市長が衛生誓約を実施
triage.triage_reason: 既知の感染症（らい病、結核、マラリア）に対する定期的な公衆衛生対策キャンペンであり、新規の異常な流行や未知の疾患の発生ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する要素に乏しい。
triage.notes: 本記事は、インド・ウッタルプラデシュ州アリガルで実施される定期的な感染症制御キャンペーン（モンスーン期の予防対策）に関する報道である。新規の疾患発生や異常な流行の報告ではなく、既知の感染症に対する行政による予防・監視活動の告知である。シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Десятки россиян заразились гонконгским гриппом на Бали - АБН 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Russians contracted the Hong Kong flu in Bali - ABN 24.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian citizens contracted Hong Kong flu in Bali, Indonesia, according to ABN 24 via Baza. Illness began with cold-like symptoms, then progressed to severe headache, high fever, body aches, and cough. The acute phase reportedly lasts about one week, followed by several weeks of persistent headaches and fatigue. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation details or a confirmed infection source, framing the outbreak as travel-associated among tourists in Bali. An unrelated note mentions unusually high heat in Turkey, up to 45°C. Information is current as of 2026-07-01.

triage.headline_ja: 数十人のロシア人がバリでホンコン風邪に感染 - ABN 24
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの旅行関連クラスターとして検出されたが、確定診断の詳細が不明であり、国際的拡大の具体的な証拠が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はバリ（インドネシア）における旅行関連のインフルエンザ集団感染を報告している。ロシア人観光客が数十人感染したと述べられているが、PCR確認などの実験室的確認の詳細が記載されていない。季節性インフルエンザとしては予想内だが、H3N2（ホンコン型）への言及が確認される。トルコの高温についての言及は本イベントと無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 2.660 Warga Tasikmalaya Positif TB, 28 Diantaranya Mengidap TB MDR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,660 Tasikmalaya residents test positive for TB, 28 of them have MDR-TB.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Tasikmalaya Regency, Indonesia, screening identified 2,660 residents positive for tuberculosis (TB). Of these, 28 cases are multidrug-resistant TB (TB MDR), i.e., resistant to two standard antibiotics. The 28 MDR-TB patients are being treated with isoniazid and rifampicin, while 2,632 other TB patients receive conventional TB treatment. Symptoms among MDR-TB patients include fever, coughing blood, chest pain, night sweats, loss of appetite, weight loss, fatigue, chills, and shortness of breath; MDR-TB is typically associated with no improvement or worsening despite treatment. Authorities note the majority of TB transmission occurs among the productive-age population and is rising. Public health guidance urges disciplined healthy living, avoiding contact with TB or TB MDR cases, maintaining immunity through balanced diet and exercise, and regular health checks to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤ地域で2,660人のTB陽性者、うち28人がMDR-TB
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで2,660人のTB患者（うち28人がMDR-TB）が検出された。MDR-TB増加と労働年齢人口への蔓延拡大が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、および管理可能性の懸念により、IHR基準2つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 大規模なTB集団発生（2,660人）とMDR-TB症例の出現は異常。労働年齢人口への蔓延拡大傾向と治療抵抗性の報告から、一次治療薬への耐性化を含む重大な懸念がある。記事サマリーでは国家レベルの公衆衛生指導が示されており、当局による対応と監視が進行中と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak could cost Africa $3.6 bn, says UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) with 1,333 cases and 399 deaths confirmed, 189 recovered, WHO figures. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo species of the viral haemorrhagic fever, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The epicentre is Ituri; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. UNDP warns the outbreak could trigger a regional crisis affecting DR Congo and neighbours notably Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan, costing Africa up to $3.6 billion and pushing about 985,000 into poverty, with women disproportionately affected. Real GDP losses in DRC could exceed $1 billion and 55,000 jobs lost; continental GDP could fall $2.37 billion due to trade restrictions and border delays. While public health actions like quarantines are needed, broader restrictions are harming economies and informal livelihoods. UNDP recommends cash transfers, targeted screening, and emergency financing to maintain maternal, reproductive, and infant healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の流行はアフリカに36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性がある、とUN
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。確認症例1,333件、死亡399件、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ確認、ルワンダ・南スーダンへのリスク指摘）。ワクチンなし、地域的危機の警告あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州）を主要な発生地として記述。ウガンダは20確認症例と記載されているため国際的拡大の初期段階を示唆。ルワンダ・南スーダンについては「リスク」言及であり確認症例の記述はないため、現時点ではDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。Bundibugyo種で治療法・ワクチンなし、経済的影響（36億ドル、98.5万人が貧困化）の重大性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: تفشى إيبولا قد يكلف أفريقيا ما يصل إلى 3.6 مليار دولار وفقدان 328 ألف وظيفة |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: An Ebola outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and the loss of 328,000 jobs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) with no licensed vaccine or proven treatment has infected 1,307 people and caused 377 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Uganda has far fewer cases, while experts warn of potential spillover to neighboring countries such as South Sudan. A United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) analysis outlines three scenarios. In the best case, the outbreak remains confined to the DRC and Uganda, with Congo suffering about $1 billion in GDP losses. In more severe scenarios, transmission could reach Rwanda and Angola, and Africa’s economy could shrink by up to $3.6 billion with 328,000 jobs lost, exacerbated by higher fuel costs tied to the Iranian crisis. Damian Mama, UNDP’s resident representative in Congo, says containment is possible with adequate resources and swift action to avert a deeper, regional development crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカに最大36億ドルの経済損失と32万8000人の失業をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。既に1,307人感染、377人死亡の実績と、複数国への拡大懸念。
triage.notes: DRCが主要な流行地であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、アンゴラ、南スーダンの名前が出ているが、ウガンダも記事で「症例が少ない」と述べられており、実際の流行の中心はDRC。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため除外。医療資源不足、ワクチン・治療法なし、地域経済への甚大なリスク、UN が支援を強調する点など、全段階でのリスク信号が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Nova morte por gripe é confirmada em Campinas; total chega a 16 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New influenza death confirmed in Campinas; total reaches 16 cases.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports one more influenza-associated SRAG death, raising this year’s SRAG toll to 16. The victim, an 82-year-old woman with comorbidities who was vaccinated, died June 12 (disclosed June 30). This year shows 16 SRAG deaths; last year 69, 54 of which were unvaccinated. Over 302,000 vaccine doses have been administered since late March. Among National Vaccination Calendar targets, elderly have 123,056 doses (55.01%), children 6 months–under 6 years 29,772 (43.57%), and pregnant women 5,581 (64.90%). On June 1, vaccination expanded to all residents aged six months and older; the vaccine protects against H1N1 and H3N2 and can be given with other vaccines. Vaccination sites include health centers and Church Divino Salvador in Cambuí; no appointment needed; bring photo ID and vaccination card if possible. Preventive measures: handwashing, ventilation, hydration, healthy diet; mask for symptomatic individuals. Symptoms vary by age: adults variable; children higher fever; elderly milder or absent.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスで新たなインフルエンザ死亡が確認、累計16件
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザ関連SRAG死亡が報告されており、予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。ただし年間死亡数（16件）は前年（69件）より少なく、重症度の判断が限定的であり情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事はカンピナス地域でのインフルエンザ死亡報告であり、ブラジルが主題。年間16件の死亡は前年69件より低く、既存のワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。国内対応が進行中であり、国際的な懸念は低い。スクリーニング基準「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、重症度や長期曝露のリスクが明確でないため、WATCH段階で経過観察の継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: J. P. Nadda Chairs High-Level Review Meeting on Dengue Preparedness in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Delhi dengue preparedness was reviewed by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda in a high-level meeting focused on prevention, surveillance, vector control, and hospital readiness. Incidence is currently low with a mortality rate of 0.11%; authorities urged continued vigilance in coming months. The National Strategy for Prevention and Control of Dengue, the 'Octalogue', guides eight pillars: surveillance, case management, vector management, outbreak response, capacity building, behaviour change communication, inter-sectoral coordination, and monitoring & supervision. Actions include intensified vector control, entomological and fever surveillance, hospital readiness with dedicated wards, beds, diagnostics, and drugs; rapid response teams on standby. Mandatory timely reporting via IHIP-VBD from all hospitals, including private ones, and daily district-level review meetings. A strong IEC drive during July's 'Anti Dengue Month' will engage Ward Commissioners, RWAs, schools, and community groups to promote prevention.

triage.headline_ja: J. P. Nadda がデリーでのデング熱備災に関する高官級レビュー会議を主宰
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は風土病で現在の患者数は低い。ただし当局が行政的準備を強化していることから、今後のシグナル動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで風土病であり、現在の死亡率は0.11%と低い。記事は備災強化に関する行政対応を報じたもので、アウトブレイクの通知ではない。しかし、高レベルの政府関心と「Anti Dengue Month」キャンペーンの実施が注目される。今後の患者数急増や重症例増加の報告があれば即座にアップグレードが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情重創非洲　聯合國警告恐損失1150億元 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak deals a severe blow to Africa; UN warns of losses of up to 115 billion yuan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in the northeast Ituri province amid ongoing conflict, has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths per WHO data. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific antiviral. The UN Development Programme warns the crisis extends beyond health, driving a socio-economic crisis: Africa could face up to $3.6 billion in GDP losses and as many as 9.85 million additional people into poverty if regional/global spillovers worsen, with nearly 1 million already impoverished. In the DRC, GDP losses exceed $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs could be lost; travel and trade restrictions risk further economic damage. If border controls and reduced consumer confidence persist, Africa-wide GDP could shrink by about $2.37 billion. The outbreak’s epicenter is northeast Ituri, where conflict-affected conditions complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカに深刻な打撃、国連は1150億元の損失を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は確認症例1,333名、死亡399名に達しており、公衆衛生上極めて重大な影響がある。国際的な流行と経済的影響が懸念されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC北東部イトゥリ州で発生中のエボラ出血熱。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行で、ワクチンと特異的抗ウイルス薬がない。紛争影響下での封じ込めが困難。経済的影響が極めて大きく国連が警告を発出している。国際的な支援と流行監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher viaja para a Índia e anos mais tarde descobre que tem 38 parasitas no cérebro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman travels to India and, years later, discovers that she has 38 parasites in her brain.
article.articleSummary: British woman develops neurocysticercosis after a three-month trip to India, later found to have 38 Taenia solium larvae in the brain. Neurocysticercosis is a central nervous system parasitic infection acquired from ingesting eggs via contaminated food or water, sometimes through undercooked pork. The first sign appeared in 2010 when she noticed a tapeworm in a restaurant bathroom; fecal tests were normal. About a year later she experienced severe headaches and her first seizure. After toxoplasmosis was ruled out, imaging (CT and MRI) diagnosed 38 brain parasites. Treated with antiparasitics and steroids, she subsequently fainted at work and developed neuropsychiatric symptoms, including distrust, anxiety, paranoia, and psychosis, requiring six weeks in a neuropsychiatric hospital. She is now recovering; parasites have calcified without surgery, and she remains on epilepsy medication. The case was discussed by specialists in Great Britain and the United States as highly unusual.

triage.headline_ja: 女性がインドに旅行し、数年後に脳内に38匹の寄生虫がいることを発見
triage.triage_reason: 単一例の神経嚢虫症・トキソプラズマ症の輸入感染症報告。異常性は高いが、公衆衛生的影響は限定的（個人例）で国際的拡大のリスクは低い。情報不足により保留判定。
triage.notes: 記事は英国女性のインド渡航後の単一輸入感染症例（神経嚢虫症）を報道。神経症状の重症性は高いが、患者が既に治療中で流行・拡大のシグナルではない。記事では米国・英国の専門家による検討が言及されているが、公式な公衆衛生上の警告・対応は明記されていない。発生地域フィールドに米国・英国が含まれているが、記事の主題は「インド滞在中の感染」であり、米国・英国での発生事例ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Jaraguá do Sul monitora casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department of Jaraguá do Sul Monitors Cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) activity in Santa Catarina and Jaraguá do Sul as of 1 July 2026. The state has reported over 5,000 hospitalizations and 269 deaths due to SARI in 2026. Jaraguá do Sul records 142 cases: 36 influenza, 9 COVID-19, 57 from other viruses, and 40 unspecified; peaks were May (44), March (36) and April (34). Winter conditions—low temperatures and indoor, poorly ventilated spaces—facilitate transmission, especially among children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases. Common mild symptoms include runny nose, sore throat, sneezing, cough, headache, and body aches; for guidance contact Saúde Online Jaraguá at 0800 888 8754. Alarm signs: shortness of breath, fever >39°C, chest wheeze, or productive cough with yellow/green mucus—seek care at a UBS or urgent care. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, ventilation, and influenza vaccination. So far, 35,659 doses have been administered (56.53% of a 63,071 target) with vaccines at UBS vaccination rooms; Secretary Rogério Luiz da Silva urges vaccination to reduce severe illness and hospitalizations.

triage.headline_ja: ジャラグアドスール保健部門が重症急性呼吸器症候群の症例を監視
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）におけるSARI関連の重症感染症アウトブレイク。2026年に州全体で5,000件以上の入院と269件の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのサンタカタリーナ州ジャラグアドスール市におけるSARI活動を扱っている。2026年上半期にインフルエンザとCOVID-19を含む重症急性呼吸器感染症が流行しており、冬季条件下での換気不良な屋内環境が感染拡大の要因と指摘されている。死亡数269件、入院5,000件以上という数字は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。

article.articleHeadline: ระยอง ประกาศ 2 อำเภอ เป็นเขตโรคระบาดชั่วคราว หลังพบสัตว์ติด "พิษสุนัขบ้า"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rayong declares two districts as temporary outbreak zones after detecting animals infected with rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak declared in Rayong Province, Thailand, after infected animals were detected in Klaeng and Nikhom Phatthana districts. A temporary outbreak zone covers Moo 3, 6, 7, 8 and 11 Ban Na sub-district, plus adjacent areas in Moo 8 Chamkhot, Khao Chamao District, within a 5-km radius, active 29 June–28 July. Three residents in Ban Na Moo 7 were bitten by rabid dogs and received post-exposure vaccination at Klaeng Hospital; two dogs and two cats exposed were vaccinated, though the biting dog later died. In Nikhom Phatthana, a rabid dog was found in Moo 2 Ban Na; no bite cases reported yet. Authorities urge residents not to move dogs or cats into or out of the outbreak zones without veterinary authorization and to report suspicious mammal behavior or deaths within 12 hours. Do not slaughter or handle suspected carcasses; penalties include up to 2 years’ imprisonment or a 40,000 baht fine.

triage.headline_ja: ラヨーン県が狂犬病感染動物検出後、2つの地区を一時的流行地域として宣言
triage.triage_reason: タイの限定的な狂犬病アウトブレイク。動物から人への伝播リスクがあり異常だが、現在の人間への感染は3例の暴露程度で、国際的拡大のリスクは低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: タイ国内のラヨーン県に限定された狂犬病アウトブレイク。人間感染は3例の咬傷暴露であり重症度は低い。ただし、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク低く、国際的拡大の懸念も低い。定期的な地元当局の対応報告を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mathura News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Mathura News: जागरूकता रैली के साथ विशेष संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान का शुभारंभ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mathura News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Mathura News: Inauguration of the Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign with an Awareness Rally.
article.articleSummary: Mathura district in Uttar Pradesh launched a Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign on July 1, 2026, marked by an awareness rally from the Chief Medical Officer’s office via Rajiv Bhavan, Post Office, Collectorate, Civil Lines and Tehsil, ending with a pledge to prevent infectious diseases. The campaign runs 1–31 July, with the Dastak outreach 11–31 July, across villages and towns in the district. It targets vector-borne diseases, notably dengue, malaria, and chikungunya, with anti-larvae spraying coordinated with the Municipal Corporation. Door-to-door guidance on prevention will be provided by health teams. Household measures urged include covering water containers, preventing stagnation, using mosquito nets, wearing protective clothing, and seeking prompt fever testing at government facilities. Officials present include Dr. Anuj Chaudhary, Dr. Rohitash Tevatia, and Dr. Gopal Garg.

triage.headline_ja: マトゥラ市：特別伝染病管理キャンペーンの認識向上ラリーによる開始
triage.triage_reason: これは既存の疾患に対する予防キャンペーン・啓発活動の発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がなく、シグナルとして識別されない。
triage.notes: 記事はマトゥラ地区で7月1日に開始された伝染病予防キャンペーンの公式発表である。デング熱、マラリア、チクングニアをターゲットとした既知疾患への対策活動であり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。政府の公衆衛生活動の一環として認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Mandima, la nouvelle zone de santé touchée dans la province de l'Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mandima, the newly affected health zone in Ituri Province - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Mandima health zone in Ituri newly affected. A Ministry of Health epidemiological update covering 26–28 June places Ituri as the epidemic’s epicenter, with 23 health zones affected, including Mandima and Aru, Aungba, Bambu, Bunia, Damas, Drodro, Gety, Kilo, Komanda, Lita, Logo, Mambasa, Mangala, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Nyankunde, Rimba, Rwampara, Tchomia, Kambala, Nia-Nia, and Fataki. North Kivu reports 11 affected zones; South Kivu has 1. Cumulatively, 1,307 confirmed cases, 615 in isolation, 180 recoveries, and a case fatality rate of 28.8%; contact tracing completion stands at 81.3%. Symptoms include sudden fever, intense fatigue, vomiting, and diarrhea. Figures reflect surveillance through late June 2026, with Kinshasa reporting on 1 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：イトゥリ州の新たに影響を受けた保健地域マンディマ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行を示す。DRCで1,307件の確定症例、致死率28.8%、複数の州での拡大が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多くの非関連地域を返しているが（Romania、Costa Rica、Australia等）、記事サマリーと発生地域の座標から、実際の流行はDRC（特にIturi州）に限定されている。Mandima健康地域の新規発症を報告し、累積1,307例の確定症例、致死率28.8%、複数地域での活発な感染伝播を示す。
