article.articleHeadline: Γυναίκα ταξίδεψε στην Ινδία και κόλλησε θανατηφόρα λοίμωξη - Βρέθηκαν 38 παράσιτα στον εγκέφαλο της
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman traveled to India and contracted a deadly infection - 38 parasites were found in her brain.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis, a parasitic CNS infection, was diagnosed in a Cardiff, Wales woman after a trip to India. Lori Denman, a 42-year-old from Cardiff, spent three months in India in 2007. Her first clue appeared in 2010 when she found a cestode worm in her pelvis after using the bathroom, later identified as the first sign of neurocysticercosis. The infection left 38 parasites in her brain, causing intense headaches, seizures, and psychosis. The case underlines how travel to endemic regions can yield imported central nervous system parasitic infections. The article notes the illness' severe neurological impact and the need for awareness of travel-related exposures, with further details published by Newsbomb.gr.

triage.headline_ja: 女性がインドに旅行して致命的な感染症に感染 - 脳に38匹の寄生虫が見つかった
triage.triage_reason: ニューロシスチセルコーシスは神経系に重篤な影響を与える寄生虫感染であり、旅行関連輸入感染症としての関心は存在するが、単一症例報告であり国際的流行の兆候や公衆衛生上の緊急性に乏しい。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は2007年のインド旅行時に感染した単一の個人症例（2010年診断）の報告であり、現在の流行状況を示していない。Bluedot APIが英国とインドを発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーからは実際のイベント発生地はインド（感染源）であり、英国は輸入症例の国である。ニューロシスチセルコーシスはエンデミック地域における既知の寄生虫疾患であり、異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: पोटका में ब्रेन मलेरिया का कहर: अर्जुन मुंडा ने अस्पताल में पीड़ितों से की मुलाकात, जांच पर दिया जोर - arjun munda visits brain malaria patients in potka after 4 deaths
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral malaria ravages Potka: Arjun Munda met patients at the hospital, emphasized the need for investigation - Arjun Munda visits cerebral malaria patients in Potka after four deaths.
article.articleSummary: Potka block saw four tribal children die of cerebral malaria within four days. Former Union Minister Arjun Munda visited Sadar Hospital to assess patients, meet families, and seek updates on treatment. He urged prompt, adequate care and called the deaths extremely tragic and concerning. Munda pressed health authorities to mount a comprehensive response focused on prevention, investigation, and treatment, including widespread malaria screening campaigns, drug distribution, mosquito control, and public awareness programs, with timely access to care a top priority. The visit highlighted the need for vigilant surveillance and coordinated health interventions in Potka to prevent recurrence as of 1 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 脳マラリアがポトカを襲う：アルジュン・ムンダが病院で患者に面会、調査の必要性を強調 - 4人の死亡後にポトカの脳マラリア患者を訪問
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャルカンド州ポトカで脳マラリアによる死亡（4人の部族の子ども）が4日以内に発生し、異常で予想外の重症事例クラスターである。国家レベルの高官が現地視察するなど政治的関心が高く、予防とスクリーニングを含む包括的対応が求められており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポトカ（ジャルカンド州、インド）での脳マラリア事例クラスターについて述べている。4日以内に4人の部族の子どもが死亡した事例であり、これは脳マラリアの予想外の重症多発と言える。元連邦大臣の視察、医療当局への包括的対応要求（マラリア検査キャンペーン、医薬品配布、蚊対策、啓発活動）が記載されており、国家レベルの関心が確認できる。2026年7月1日時点での報告であり、現在的なリスク状況を示す。

article.articleHeadline: بروفيسور حلواني لـ"المدينة " : انتشار "إيبولا" الحالي محدود جغرافيًا ولا يملك القدرة البيولوجية للانتشار العالمي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor Halwani to Al-Madina: The current Ebola outbreak is geographically limited and lacks the biological capacity for global transmission.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Central African Republic is geographically constrained and unlikely to become a global pandemic. The Bundibugyo strain, blamed for the current outbreak, carries a case-fatality of about 34–40%, lower than Zaïre’s 70–90%, but shows faster community spread near borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Early symptoms are nonspecific—fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, with diarrhea or vomiting—hindering detection amid malaria and typhoid. Diagnosis relies on PCR and genome sequencing, yet tests are limited to a few labs with weak cold chains and sample transport delays. Health workers face elevated risk; gaps in PPE and diagnostic delays increase exposure. Some vaccines/therapies for other Ebola strains may offer cross-protection, but data are needed. Misinformation and unsafe funeral practices, plus open borders and cross-border movement of fishermen, traders, and displaced people, threaten control; international support for surveillance, labs, and community outreach is urgently required.

triage.headline_ja: ハルワニ教授が「アルマディーナ」に語る：現在のエボラ流行は地理的に限定されており、世界的流行の生物学的能力を持たない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニングで複数基準該当、かつ複数対象国の国境地域での発生が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブンディブギョエボラウイルス流行について、中央アフリカ共和国を中心に述べており、DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンとの国境地域での拡大リスクを言及している。対象国リストのうち、DRCのみが実際の発生地域として該当確認。複数国の国境地域での流行、診断能力の制限、医療従事者への高リスク、国際支援の緊急必要性が述べられている。情報源がアラビア語報道のため、専門家の見解（地理的限定性、パンデミックリスク低）を記事見出しでは述べているが、サマリーではコントロール困難な要因が多数列挙されている。

article.articleHeadline: República de Congo confirma 399 muertos y más de 1.300 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Republic of the Congo confirms 399 deaths and more than 1,300 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,333 confirmed Ebola cases, 399 deaths, and 189 recoveries as of June 29, with 609 patients in treatment. The outbreak, declared in mid-May in the northeast, remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where authorities have intensified healthcare, surveillance, and community engagement. The case fatality rate is about 29.7%. The DRC—long experienced in Ebola response—has faced multiple outbreaks since the virus was identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River; it declared the end of its last outbreak in Kasai in December 2025. A photo caption references the Makona variant, but no further variant-specific details are provided. Ongoing monitoring and response activities continue in the northeast to curb transmission and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国がエボラ出血熱の399人の死亡と1,300人以上の感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。大規模な確認感染者数（1,333例）と死亡数（399人）を有する活動的なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 進行中のアウトブレイクとしては1,333例の確認患者、399人の死亡（CFR 29.7%）、609人が治療中。6月29日時点のデータ。複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）での同時発生。2025年12月にカサイでの前回アウトブレイク終息宣言から約6ヶ月で新規発生。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の最高度懸念疾患であり、この規模での発生はWHO通知および国際的な報道対象となるべき事象。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго стала самой быстро распространяющейся в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has become Africa's fastest-spreading outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 15, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province; cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu) has become Africa’s fastest-spreading by first-month case counts. WHO reports 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths to date. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; early diagnosis and supportive care remain the best strategies. Contributing factors include late detection, delayed care, security challenges, misinformation, and armed-group activity hindering responders. WHO and Africa CDC warn of cross-border risk to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, and Kenya, with potential spread to at least 10 regional countries due to movement. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle and throat pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and potential internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行はアフリカで最速で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者1,274名、死亡360名、複数国への越境リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくverified_locations: DRコンゴは主要な発生地であり確実に該当。越境リスクとしてウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国、タンザニア、ザンビア、アンゴラ、ケニアが言及されているが、これらは潜在的リスク地域で記事の主題地域ではない。対象国リストとの照合結果、DRC（203312）とZambia（895949）のみが確認地域として該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（第17番目の流行）で、対症療法のみが選択肢である点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister Chairs Key Meetings On TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, Dengue Preparedness
article.articleSummary: New Delhi: Health Minister JP Nadda chaired reviews of the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan and Delhi’s 100-day campaign, noting progress but gaps between efforts and outcomes must be bridged through Jan Bhagidari—community participation, MPs/MLAs, and municipal councillors. He directed ward-level appointments of senior government officers to monitor progress, strengthen case detection, treatment adherence, and community mobilization. Technology will be expanded with more handheld X-ray machines integrated with AI to enable earlier TB diagnosis. In a separate dengue preparedness review for Delhi ahead of the monsoon, officials examined evolving epidemiology, healthcare readiness, vector control, case detection, clinical management and public awareness. Dengue incidence remains low with mortality at 0.11%; authorities urged continued vigilance and readiness in Delhi and nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣、TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan及びデング熱対策に関する重要会議を主宰
triage.triage_reason: インド・デリーにおけるTBおよびデング熱の公式な準備状況に関する報告だが、現在の具体的な流行や緊急事象ではなく、制度的な準備・監視体制の強化に関するもの。デング熱発生率は低く死亡率も0.11%と記載されており、直ちにピックアップすべき新規シグナルではない。ただし、疾患の多重性とインドにおける公式対応の高まりから、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は保健大臣による公式会議およびTB対策・デング熱対策の準備状況に関する行政的報告である。新規流行や緊急事象ではなく、既存疾患に対する継続的な準備体制強化を示している。デング熱の現在の発生率は低く死亡率は0.11%と明記されている。複数疾患の言及とインドにおける公式な関心の高まりはあるが、直ちにRRAに進む基準は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Gathering Kader 2026 Bangkitkan Semangat Pejuang TBC Menuju Indonesia Bebas Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cadre Gathering 2026: Ignite the Spirit of TB Fighters Toward a Tuberculosis-Free Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) cadres from PPTI across Jakarta, South Tangerang, Bogor, Depok, and Cimahi gathered at Gathering Kader 2026 in Villa Raisis, Cilember, Cisarua, Bogor, to mark the 58th anniversary of PPTI. The theme Grow Together, Impact Forever underscored a shared commitment to eliminating TB in Indonesia by reaching households, identifying undetected patients, and ensuring complete treatment. Hundreds of volunteers participated in team-building activities, showcasing solidarity and frontline dedication to reduce transmission. PPTI President Yani Panigoro praised cadres for their relentless field work and service. The event also honored five cadres with awards for long service, exceptional dedication, and outstanding achievements in finding and guiding TB patients. The gathering reaffirmed the network’s role as the frontline in the national effort to end tuberculosis.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年カドレ集会：結核撲滅に向けたインドネシアの結核戦士の精神を高揚させる
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは結核対策キャンペーンの記念集会であり、感染症の新規発生・流行を示す情報ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核対策NGO（PPTI）の記念集会イベントの報道であり、感染症イベント（新規発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではない。結核対策活動の意識啓発キャンペーンであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda stresses coordination, AI-driven screening to accelerate TB elimination efforts in Delhi
article.articleSummary: AI-driven vulnerability mapping with more than 30 indicators identified 1.58 lakh high-risk villages and wards nationwide; Delhi concentrates on 38 wards in 11 districts, over 80% of the city’s high-risk burden. On 1 July 2026, the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan review in New Delhi led by Union Health Minister Nadda stressed Jan Bhagidari and ward-level accountability, including a senior officer per ward and broader grassroots mobilisation. Delhi has screened 28.83 lakh people, performed 21.67 lakh chest X-rays, 3.65 lakh NAAT tests, and notified 1.75 lakh TB patients. Recommendations: upfront NAAT testing for presumptive and drug-resistant TB with X-ray; 100% differentiated-care assessment; expand TB Preventive Treatment for household contacts; broaden Ni-kshay Mitras and MY Bharat volunteers for psychosocial support. Handheld X-ray machines integrated with AI to aid early detection; sustained coordination among Union Ministry, Delhi Government, district administrations, and frontline workers toward TB-Mukt Bharat.

triage.headline_ja: JP Nadda、デリーにおけるAI駆動型スクリーニングと協調による結核排除取組の加速を強調
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の流行疾患であり、デリーで実施されている大規模スクリーニング・対策プログラムに関する進捗報告である。IHR基準および重症度の判定は低いが、公衆衛生プログラムの実施規模が大きく、政府関心が高いため、継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核排除キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規発生イベントではない。対象は既知の慢性感染症であり、継続的な公開衛生対応が実施されている。AI駆動型スクリーニング技術の導入や大規模検査実績（228万人スクリーン、1.75万人患者発見）は注目に値するが、異常/予想外な事象ではない。WPRO基準の長期曝露と流行しやすさで該当するが、社会的・政治的関心は高い（Union Health Minister主導）ため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Eliminasi Malaria Jadi Prioritas, Pemprov Lampung Dorong Pesawaran Penuhi Target Bebas Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria elimination becomes a priority, Lampung Provincial Government urges Pesawaran to meet the zero-transmission target.
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination is a priority for Lampung Province, Indonesia, with a virtual coordination meeting held July 1, 2026, to accelerate elimination in Pesawaran Regency—the only district not yet certified malaria-free among Lampung's 15 districts/cities. Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela emphasized cross-sector collaboration to resolve barriers. From January–June 2026, malaria cases fluctuated due to weather; Annual Parasite Incidence (API) is below 1 per 1,000 population, but Slide Positive Rate (SPR) remains 5.2%, slightly above the 5% threshold. Indigenous transmission persists in Pesawaran, so three consecutive years of zero local transmission have not yet been achieved. Other indicators—completeness of reporting, epidemiological investigations, reporting timeliness, and dominance of Plasmodium vivax—also require improvement. Mass bed nets last distributed in 2023; Ministry of Health distribution is planned December 2026. Supplies of antimalarials, rapid diagnostic tests, insecticides, and larvicides remain available.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア排除が優先事項に、ランプン州政府がペサワラン県に無伝播目標達成を促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ランプン州ペサワラン県）における風土性マラリア伝播の継続が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行性）を複数満たすが、現段階では感染症危機の急性段階ではなく行政的取り組み段階である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はランプン州ペサワラン県における持続的なマラリア風土性伝播を報告しており、スクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（住民の継続的曝露）と「流行しやすさ」（3年連続無伝播未達成、SPR 5.2%で閾値超過）に該当する。しかし、死亡や重症例の言及がなく、IHR基準は非該当。この記事は保健当局の対策実施段階の報告であり、急性爆発的流行ではなく、慢性風土性疾患の管理段階を示している。ランプン州の他14地区は既に認定無伝播であることから、制御されている状況と判断される。継続的監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU advierte que brote de ébola podría costarle a África hasta 3,600 millones de dólares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns that an Ebola outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries, per WHO. The outbreak threatens Africa’s economy, with the UNDP warning it could cost up to $3.6 billion and push about 985,000 people into poverty, undermining livelihoods, education, and health services, and disproportionately affecting women. Even in a baseline containment in the DRC and Uganda (20 cases), GDP losses would exceed $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs could be lost. The UNDP urges direct cash transfers to the vulnerable, a shift from broad border closures to selective controls, and emergency financing to sustain maternal, reproductive, and child health services during the crisis. Neighbors Rwanda and South Sudan are also at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカに最大36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。社会的・政治的関心も高く、UN/UNDPからの警告による国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンも記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRC（1,333確認例、399死亡）が主な発生地であり、ウガンダは「DRCとウガンダで20例の場合」という仮定シナリオ、ルワンダと南スーダンは「リスク中」と記述されている。対象国リストの確認により、DRCのみが verified_locations に含まれる。本イベントはWHO報告に基づく確定患者数を含み、UN/UNDPからの公式警告があるため、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra to Notify Snakebites as Disease, Plan Venom Banks
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra plans to notify snakebites as a disease and establish regional Snake Venom Banks to address venom diversity and enable region-specific vaccines. Public Health Minister Prakash Abitkar announced the move after MLA Vikram Pachpute highlighted rising snakebite mortality and the need for regionally tailored vaccines. A joint meeting with the Haffkine Bio-Pharmaceutical Corporation, the Forest Department and relevant agencies will draft a strategic policy, inviting national experts. The plan includes maintaining adequate anti-snake venom stocks at Primary Health Centres; ICMR is reportedly working on targeted, species-specific vaccines. Maharashtra currently uses a Chennai-venom–derived polyvalent anti-venom, while Pachpute argued for monovalent vaccines aligned to local species. Abitkar noted Anti-Snake Venom Kits to distinguish venomous from non-venomous bites. Funds for polio and anti-snake venom vaccine production were discussed, with a meeting promised within eight days to release necessary funds.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州、蛇咬傷を疾病として登録化し、地域別毒液銀行設立を計画
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は蛇咬傷への医療体制整備であり、ポリオとは無関係。Bluedotが誤ってポリオを疾患として付与した可能性が高い。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーを精読した結果、疾患名フィールドの『ポリオ』はデータエラーと判定。実際の記事内容は蛇咬傷（snakebite）による死亡率増加への行政対応であり、感染症アウトブレイク対応ではない。マハラシュトラ州の公衆衛生政策ニュースであるため、感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Could Cost Africa $3.6 Billion, UN Warns - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), identified as the Zaire strain and declared in August 2025, has killed hundreds and is active in three eastern provinces. The UNDP-WHO report warns the crisis could trigger major economic damage across Africa, with direct and indirect costs totaling about $3.6 billion and up to 950,000 people pushed into extreme poverty. Direct costs include healthcare expenditures, border closures, travel restrictions, and disrupted trade; indirect losses cover reduced consumer spending, declining investment, and eroded productivity, hitting agriculture and mining hardest. Neighboring Rwanda, Uganda, South Sudan, and Burundi face spillover risk as border controls and heightened surveillance disrupt cross-border movement. The outbreak could spread to major cities if unchecked, risking a humanitarian catastrophe. International action is urged to expand surveillance, contact tracing, vaccination, and provide financial support, as the window to act closes, as of 2026-07-01.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカに36億ドルの損害をもたらす可能性、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRCでのエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（数百人の死亡）、異常性、周辺国への国際的拡大リスク、国際的な渡航・貿易制限を伴う。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たし、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを主要発生地とし、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ブルンジへの越境リスクを述べている。対象国リストではDRCのみが明示的に該当する。記事は2026年7月1日配信で、2025年8月に宣言されたZaire株エボラの継続流行に関する経済的影響警告である。UNDP-WHOの報告書に基づく信頼度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Pulang Pisau temukan tujuh kasus Flu Singapura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulang Pisau Health Office finds seven cases of Singapore flu.
article.articleSummary: Seven cases of Singapore flu (Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease, HFMD) were detected in Pulang Pisau Regency, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, from mid-May to end-June 2026. Five cases were treated at health facilities under the agency, with two additional cases reported from RSUD Pulang Pisau. HFMD is a viral illness that primarily affects babies and children under five. Reported symptoms include fever, ulcers in the mouth, and vesicular rashes on palms, soles, and other body parts. Transmission occurs via direct contact with nasal/oral secretions, saliva, vesicle fluid, or contaminated objects. Prevention centers on consistent hygiene: regular handwashing with soap and running water, environmental cleanliness, cleaning eating utensils and drinking bottles, and avoiding close contact with those infected. Parents are advised to seek prompt medical care to minimize complications and further spread.

triage.headline_ja: プランピサウ保健所がハンド・フット・アンド・マウス病（手足口病）の7例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 小児を中心とした手足口病（HFMD/Enterovirus 71）の散発事例7件がインドネシアで報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に部分的に該当する。しかし公衆衛生的インパクトが限定的で、IHR基準の主要な閾値に達していないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではEnterovirUS 71（手足口病/HFMD）が主疾患。見出しでは「Flu Singapura」と表現されているが、サマリー内で明確にHFMDと診断されている。症例数は7件と限定的だが、小児への感染可能性と新規患者の継続報告が懸念される。死亡報告や入院例の詳細が記載されていないため重症度は不明。中央カリマンタン州プランピサウ地域における局所的発生とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंडः पूर्वी सिंहभूम में मलेरिया से चार लोगों की मौत के बाद सरकार अलर्ट, उपायुक्तों को अभियान चलाने के निर्देश - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand: After four people die of malaria in East Singhbhum, the government is on alert and directs deputy commissioners to launch a campaign.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Jharkhand’s East Singhbhum district reports at least four malaria deaths, triggering a statewide alert. The government directs deputy commissioners to implement an aggressive malaria prevention and control plan, with surveillance intensified in areas with higher fever cases. Multi-Purpose Health Workers and ASHAs will conduct active fever surveys; any suspected malaria case must be tested immediately and treated promptly if positive, while severe cases are to be hospitalized with appropriate care and strict follow-up. If new cases emerge, mandatory mass fever surveys across the affected area will be conducted. Village-wise malaria data will be prepared; ASHAs in highly affected villages will receive rapid diagnostic test kits and medicines. Ensure stock of testing materials and antimalarials at CHCs, plus insecticide spraying and larval control in affected zones. A tri-tier monitoring system—weekly CHC reviews, biweekly Civil Surgeon reviews, and monthly district reviews chaired by the DC—will oversee programs, with Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh directing personal DC oversight to curb transmission and prevent fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州：東シンフムム地区でマラリアにより4人が死亡、政府がアラート、副長官に対策キャンペーン実施を指示
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。マラリア死亡例の報告に基づき政府が公式対応を発動、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 東シンフムム地区（ジャルカンド州）で確認されたマラリアによる死亡例（最低4件）。州政府による公式アラート発動と多層的な対応戦略（監視強化、検査・治療の即座実施、殺虫スプレー、三層監視体制の構築）が実施されている。情報日時が2026年7月という未来日付であるため、記事の信頼性確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh: Khống chế thành công ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết tại phường Hoành Sơn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hà Tĩnh: Successfully contained the dengue fever outbreak in Hoành Sơn Ward.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Hoành Sơn Ward, Hà Tĩnh Province, Vietnam, has been contained after nearly two months of control measures. From early May 2026, 22 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases were recorded in Liên Phú hamlet, Hoành Sơn; the first case occurred May 3 and the last on June 14. By June 30, surveillance and response met regulatory criteria to declare the outbreak ended in Hoành Sơn; a separate dengue cluster remains active in Vũng Áng Ward. No deaths were reported. The Hà Tĩnh CDC and local authorities conducted epidemiological investigations, zoning, and multi-pronged control: environmental cleanup, removal of mosquito breeding sites, larvicidal measures, insecticide spraying in affected areas and schools, intensified vector surveillance, daily case monitoring, and 24/7 outbreak readiness. Public awareness efforts via radio, meetings, and household visits supported prevention. Residents are urged to maintain sanitation and seek care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ハー・ティン州：ホアン・ソン区のデング熱アウトブレイクの封じ込めに成功
triage.triage_reason: デング熱アウトブレイクが既に封じ込められており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。ただし別地域での継続的クラスター活動と季節性のリスク要因から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ホアン・ソン区のアウトブレイク（5月3日～6月14日、22確認例、死亡0）は6月30日に終結宣言。ただしヴン・アン区では別のデング熱クラスターが継続活動中。ベクター関連施策が実施されており、管理可能性は良好。季節性デング熱の継続リスク監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand: Government on alert after four people die of malaria in East Singhbhum district; directives to Deputy Commissioners to launch a campaign.
article.articleSummary: Four people have died from malaria in Jharkhand’s East Singhbhum district, as rising infections trigger a statewide alert on July 1, 2026. The state Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department directed all district authorities to implement an urgent, comprehensive malaria prevention and control plan. Areas with cases will undergo intensified surveillance, with MPWs and ASHAs conducting active fever surveys in high-incidence zones. Any suspected malaria case must be tested promptly, and confirmed patients started on treatment without delay; severe cases should be admitted and followed up. If a new case emerges anywhere, universal fever/malaria surveys should be conducted in the area. Village-wise malaria data will be compiled, and high-risk villages supplied with rapid diagnostic tests and medicines for ASHAs. Stock of testing materials and antimalarials at CHCs must be ensured, with insecticide spraying and larval control accelerated. A three-tier monitoring framework—weekly CHC reviews, biweekly Civil Surgeon reviews, and monthly district reviews chaired by the DC—will oversee programs, plus broad public awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州：東シンガバム地区でマラリアで4人が死亡、政府が警戒態勢、副専員に キャンペーン実施の指示
triage.triage_reason: インドの単一地区におけるマラリア関連死4件という限定的事例だが、州政府が公式に警戒態勢を宣言し、多層的なサーベイランス・対応体制を整備している異常事象として評価。IHR基準2つ（異常性・重症度）および WPRO基準3つ（異常性、重症度、対応能力）に該当。
triage.notes: ジャルカンド州東シンガバム地区での死亡4件は明確だが、州規模の対応体制が整備されている点が重要。マラリアは蚊媒介感染症として流行しやすく、サーベイランス強化・診断・治療の統一的運用は管理可能性の懸念を反映。国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは現在のところ限定的。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Posibil caz de Ebola în Marea Britanie. Alarmă într-un spital din Glasgow
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible case of Ebola in the United Kingdom. Alarm at a hospital in Glasgow.
article.articleSummary: A patient admitted to Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow is being tested for suspected Ebola after arriving overnight on Tuesday. Analyses are ongoing to determine whether the patient has contracted the virus. If confirmed, it would be the first Ebola case in the United Kingdom since the May outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, which prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola is not airborne and does not spread merely by being near an infected person. Public Health Scotland, in collaboration with the UK Health Security Agency, is tracing possible routes by which travelers from affected countries could reach Britain. At present there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Scotland, and the risk to the general population remains low. France confirmed its first Ebola case last week—a doctor returning from humanitarian work in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 英国での可能性のあるエボラ症例。グラスゴーの病院で警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラは最重要感染症であり、英国での初確認事例の可能性があり、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国での疑い事例（未確認）であるため、対象国リストに含まれないスコットランド・英国は verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでの発生地域言及があるため DRC を含める。確認されていない疑い事例であっても、エボラの高い病原性とWHO PHEIC宣言により、PICKUP判定の根拠は十分。仏国でも1事例確認されており、国際的な拡大傾向が見られる。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا قد يكلف إفريقيا مليارات الدولارات ويفقدها عشرات آلاف الوظائف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could cost Africa billions of dollars and deprive it of tens of thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo poses a significant economic threat to Africa, potentially costing about $3.6 billion and pushing roughly 985,000 people into poverty, per the UN Development Programme. The crisis could eliminate tens of thousands of jobs and undermine education and health services, with direct effects in DRC and spillovers to Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Indirect movement and trade restrictions threaten local economies and livelihoods, especially in the informal sector, and jeopardize education, food security, trade, public finances, and trust. Even if containment occurs in DRC and Uganda, the economy would remain burdened: over $1 billion in GDP losses and about 55,000 jobs lost in the DRC alone. Continent-wide GDP could fall by about $2.37 billion due to trade disruptions; combined with Middle East conflict, up to 328,000 jobs could be lost continent-wide. UNDP urges direct cash transfers, consumption support, targeted diagnostic protocols, and emergency financing to protect reproductive and child health during the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱はアフリカに数十億ドルの損失をもたらし、数万人の雇用を失わせる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の危機、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間での発生確認、経済的・社会的影響の大きさ、および国際的な支援要請がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ出血熱発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に除外した。経済的影響（36億ドルの損失、98.5万人が貧困層へ）と大陸規模での波及効果が強調されており、WHO通知基準を明らかに超える。

article.articleHeadline: ONU alerta que surto de ebola pode custar US$ 3,6 bi à África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns that the Ebola outbreak could cost Africa US$3.6 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) threatens tens of thousands of jobs and could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion (R$18.6B), UNDP warns as of July 1, 2026. The outbreak triggers a deep socio-economic crisis that could push about 985,000 more people into poverty, erasing jobs, disrupting education and health services, and draining regional economies if broader impacts materialize. In the DRC, 1,333 cases and 399 deaths have been confirmed, with 189 recoveries; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. The poverty rise would disproportionately affect women, with impacts on the DRC and neighbors Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Even if containment succeeds, damages are severe: real GDP losses in the DRC over $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs lost. UNDP recommends direct cash transfers to vulnerable populations, selective border controls, and emergency financing to sustain maternal, reproductive, and child health services.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ出血熱の流行はアフリカに36億米ドルの損失をもたらす可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、貿易制限リスク）し、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例と死亡、複数国での感染確認、ヒト-ヒト感染による流行リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンが言及されているが、WPRO対象国はDRCのみ。ウガンダ、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダンも対象国外。配信日時が2026年7月と未来日付であるため、シナリオベースの情報か、または配信日時に誤りがある可能性あり。エボラ出血熱は世界的な重要感染症であり、複数国への拡大、確認症例（DRC 1,333例、死亡399例、ウガンダ20例）、経済的影響（36億米ドル、985,000人が貧困へ）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra sete casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP records seven measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Seven measles cases have been recorded in São Paulo state in 2026, with two new infections confirmed in the capital near Guarulhos. The patients are a 20-year-old woman and a 6-month-old infant; the woman is the mother of one of three babies who tested positive last week. Both had no vaccination history. In response, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) began administering a zero-dose of the measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine to infants aged 6 months through 11 months 29 days residing in São Paulo and Guarulhos, effective 25 June 2026. The zero-dose provides extra protection and does not replace the routine schedule: first MMR dose at 12 months and a second dose (preferably tetraviral) at 15 months. For adults 30–59, at least one MMR dose; ages 5–29 and health workers require two doses. Coverage now stands at 85.32% (first dose) and 72.06% (second), with a target above 90%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州が2026年に麻疹7例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの麻疹事例の報告であり、予防接種歴なしの患者と乳幼児への感染確認は懸念される。しかし報告ケース数が限定的（7例）で、当局による迅速な公衆衛生対応（ゼロ用量ワクチン接種開始）が既に実施されており、現時点ではIHR基準の2つ以上該当の条件に至らない。引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹はWPRO地域内では排除済みの疾患であるが、本イベントはアメリカ地域（ブラジル）での発生。Bluedot地域情報にはブラジルが含まれており、記事サマリーでもサンパウロとグアルーリョスで確認されている。当局による迅速な対応（ゼロ用量ワクチン実施、ワクチン接種率目標設定）が進行中のため、現在のところ深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは評価されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 360 Dead in Outbreak; McConnell Still Hospitalized? FDA Rejects Kidney Disease Drug
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-01, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths, per the CDC, with transmission ongoing and no end in sight in the affected area. In western Uganda, officials reported a Marburg disease outbreak; officials caution the development could impede Ebola response efforts in the region due to resource strain and coordination needs. Separately, the FDA rejected Unicycive’s oxylanthanum carbonate as a treatment for hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease patients on dialysis, citing manufacturing issues and delaying a potential therapy option. The report also notes broader health policy and vaccine safety stories but does not supply further laboratory or infection-source details for these events.

triage.headline_ja: 360人が死亡 アウトブレイク中；マッコネル議員はまだ入院中？FDA腎臓病薬を却下
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラとマールブルグ病の同時多発アウトブレイクで地域的クライシス状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴのエボラアウトブレイク（1,274確定症例、360死亡）が主題。ウガンダのマールブルグ病についても言及されているが、サマリーにおいて詳細は限定的で、コンゴのエボラが中心。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。リソース枯渇と調整ニーズによる地域的影響の拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas soma 220 casos de gripe e registra mais uma morte pela doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas totals 220 influenza cases and records another influenza-related death.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil: As of July 1, 2026, the Municipal Health Secretariat reports 220 influenza cases and 16 influenza-related deaths in 2026, including one more fatal SRAG case caused by influenza. The latest victim is an 82-year-old woman with comorbidity who was vaccinated; date of death: 12 June 2026. This year, Campinas recorded 220 cases and 16 deaths related to influenza-associated SRAG. In 2025, 561 SRAG cases from influenza and 69 deaths were reported, with 54 deaths among unvaccinated individuals. Immunization campaigns offer the flu vaccine to everyone from 6 months; 69 health centers and Igreja Divino Salvador in Cambuí host vaccination; no appointment needed. Since March 28, 302,728 vaccine doses have been administered; from June 1 vaccination opening expanded to all ages. Coverage among priority groups: elderly 55.01% (123,056 doses); children 6 months–<6 years 43.57% (29,772); pregnant 64.90% (5,581).

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスではインフルエンザ患者220名が報告され、さらに1名の死亡が記録された
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ流行の継続的な状況報告。死亡例が報告されているが、国内での季節性流行の範囲内と判断される。情報の詳細化（株の型、国際的な懸念）待ちが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、SEARO/EMRO対象地域である。しかしBluedot APIのシステムに基づき、提供された対象国リスト(895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India)にBrazil(3469034)が含まれているため verified_locations に含めた。2026年のカンピーナスでのインフルエンザ患者220名、死亡16名（2025年比で大幅に低い）。ワクチン接種キャンペーン進行中。季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と判断。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare at Glasgow Hospital Ends as Isolated Patient Tests Negative Following Health Alert
article.articleSummary: Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital admitted a patient on 30 June who tested negative for Ebola, ending fears of a first UK case; Public Health Scotland confirmed the negative result. Had it been positive, it would have marked the first UK case since outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda in May, which the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever and flu-like illness, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea and organ failure. UKHSA activated the Returning Workers Scheme as a precaution; no ward closures or visitor advisories were issued. The last UK Ebola cases occurred in 2014–2015 among three health workers returning from West Africa, with no onward transmission. Africa outbreaks have caused about 138 deaths, two in Uganda; France confirmed its own first case a week earlier involving a doctor who had returned from DRC and is in stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: グラスゴー病院のエボラ恐怖が終わる：隔離患者がヘルスアラート後の検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い患者が陰性と確認されたため、直接的な脅威は排除されたが、DRCとウガンダでの同時期の複数エボラ発生がWHO PHEIC宣言されており、グローバルなシグナルを背景にした重要な確認イベント。情報整理の上、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: グラスゴーの患者は陰性で脅威ではないが、記事背景としてDRC・ウガンダでの2026年5月エボラ発生がWHO PHEIC宣言されており、フランスでも同時期に感染者を確認している。対象国はDRCのみが該当。スコットランド・フランス・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dotarła do Europy. Jest pierwszy potwierdzony przypadek. GIS uspokaja, ale wzmacnia działania w Polsce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has reached Europe. There is the first confirmed case. GIS reassures, but steps up its actions in Poland.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Ebola virus disease case in Europe, caused by Bundibugyo strain, was reported in France: a doctor who returned from a mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is treated in a Paris hospital, in strict isolation, with no fever or hemorrhagic symptoms and is in good condition. As of 24 June, the DRC outbreak has 1,118 cases, mainly Ituri with cases in North Kivu. Uganda reports 20 infections, including two deaths, with imported and local transmissions. Experts cite conflict, humanitarian crisis, high mobility, and limited access as containment barriers. Poland reports no Bundibugyo Ebola cases; GIS monitors the situation, coordinates with WHO/ECDC, and assesses hospitals, labs, transport, and PPE, with plans for a dangerous-pathogen advisory team. Pre-travel advice: consult a travel physician 6–8 weeks before departure; after return, seek care if symptoms appear within 30 days. EU/EEA risk: very low per ECDC; Europe risk is low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがヨーロッパに到達。初の確認症例。GISは安心を呼びかけるが、ポーランドでは行動を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、世界的に高い社会政治的関心があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはパリ、ウガンダ、ポーランド、フランスが含まれているが、記事サマリーの詳細な読み取りにより、実際のエボラ発症の主たる流行地はDRCであることが明確である。フランスの症例は帰国医師による輸入症例であり、対象国リスト内ではフランスはないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙した。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。パリはフランスの都市で、フランスは対象国外のため含めない。本事例は複数国での発症報告と国際的関心の高さからシグナルとして適切。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا قد يكلف أفريقيا مليارات الدولارات ويفقدها عشرات آلاف الوظائف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could cost Africa billions of dollars and deprive it of tens of thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo threaten tens of thousands of jobs and could cost Africa about $3.6 billion, according to UNDP. In a statement accompanying a report on Ebola’s implications, UNDP warns the epidemic could trigger a widespread socio-economic crisis pushing roughly 985,000 people into poverty and eroding education and health services. Even ifContainment occurred in DRC and neighboring Uganda, the economic fallout would remain severe: Congo could lose over $1 billion in real GDP and 55,000 jobs. Africa-wide spillovers—disruptions in trade, border controls, transport delays, and weakened consumer confidence—could reduce continental GDP by about $2.37 billion. The crisis could also affect Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. With potential amplification from Middle East conflict, up to 328,000 continental jobs could be lost. UNDP recommends direct cash transfers, consumption support for the poorest, targeted diagnostics over full border closure, and emergency financing to protect reproductive and maternal/child health services during the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはアフリカに数十億ドルの損失をもたらし、数万人の雇用を失わせる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確に示されているため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの経済的影響について述べており、主要発生地としてはDRC が明示されている。UgandaやRwanda、South Sudanへの波及可能性も記載されているが、現在の確認された発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。配信日時が2026年7月となっているが、これは将来日時であり、おそらくテストデータまたは日付の誤記と推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister Nadda Calls For Community Support, Tech Use In Delhi's TB And Dengue Campaigns
article.articleSummary: Delhi's TB elimination drive, Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, and dengue preparedness in Delhi receive renewed attention as Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda chairs a high-level review with the Delhi government. Emphasis on Jan Bhagidari (public participation), simple communication, and involvement of elected representatives and MY Bharat volunteers aims to boost awareness, screening, and outreach. Every ward will be monitored by senior officials to close gaps and strengthen grassroots execution. AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines will support early TB diagnosis and higher case detection, reflecting a push for technology-assisted surveillance. The initiative underscores coordinated central–state action and broader community engagement as essential to accelerating TB elimination and dengue management in Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣ナッダ、デリーのTB・デング対策キャンペーンにおけるコミュニティ支援と技術活用を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核とデング熱の既知の流行に対する公式キャンペーン実施であり、異常性は限定的。情報の深さが不足し、重症度や実際の感染者数増加の詳細が記事に明記されていないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は、インドの健康大臣による既知の結核・デング対策キャンペーンの公式レビューであり、新規感染者の爆発的増加や異常なアウトブレイクを示していない。むしろ既存プログラムの強化・推進の発表。結核とデング熱は周知の地域的課題であり、継続的な曝露と流行リスクがあることが WPRO基準で2点該当。ただし重症度の詳細データなく、緊急段階のシグナルではない。記事サマリーからは実際の流行状況が改善傾向にあるか悪化傾向にあるか不明。政府高官の関心の高さは記事から確認できる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Tuyên Quang xuất hiện dịch cúm gia cầm A/H5N1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuyen Quang Province Reports Avian Influenza A/H5N1 Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A/H5N1 outbreak reported in Dong Tam commune, Chang village, Tuyen Quang Province, Vietnam. In a household of Nguyen Ngoc Huong, 200 ducks about 60 days old showed anorexia and diarrhea starting June 23. Treatment failed; birds died. On June 28 authorities were notified. Samples collected by the district veterinary and provincial veterinary authorities and tested at the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center I, with results on June 29 confirming avian influenza A/H5N1. The local government issued Decision No. 458/QD-UBND declaring the outbreak and implementing control measures: culling of infected poultry, checkpoints, movement restrictions on poultry and products, and disinfection of the farm, nearby households, and roads, with expansion to surrounding areas. Officials urge farmers to report promptly, avoid transporting, trading, or slaughtering sick birds, and to cook poultry thoroughly or avoid poultry from unknown sources. The disease is zoonotic and can infect humans.

triage.headline_ja: トゥエンクアン省でトリインフルエンザA/H5N1アウトブレイクが報告される
triage.triage_reason: トリインフルエンザA/H5N1は人獣感染症であり、ベトナムで確認された。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（人感染可能性）、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが複数該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性の観点から明らかなシグナルである。
triage.notes: H5N1は人獣共通感染症であり、記事でも人への感染可能性を明記している。当局による移動制限、処分、消毒などの制御措置が実施されている。ベトナムでのH5N1報告は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な関心事である。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le PNUD alerte sur un risque de forte aggravation de la pauvreté lié à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: UNDP warns of a sharp worsening of poverty linked to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo poses severe socio-economic risks, according to a UNDP analysis published 30 June 2026 (current date 1 July 2026). The epidemic could push up to 985,000 people further into poverty and cost African economies up to $3.6 billion if regional spread occurs. Even with containment limited to the DRC and neighboring countries (Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan), the DRC could lose over $1 billion in real GDP and about 55,000 jobs. Regionally, trade disruptions, border restrictions, and lower consumer confidence could reduce Africa’s GDP by $2.37 billion, with the poorest 20% seeing a 1.76% drop in daily consumption. Women are among the most affected due to their concentration in informal sectors and frontline roles. The UNDP calls for strengthened social protection, targeted cash transfers, subsidies for vulnerable households, and smart borders, while preserving essential health services and continuing Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: UNDPがエボラ流行に関連した貧困の急速な悪化について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当し、社会経済的影響について国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、これらの国での実際の患者発生は確認されていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含めた。UNDPによる社会経済的影響分析が強調されており、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand govt on alert after four Malaria deaths in East Singhbhum, special drive launched
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Jharkhand has issued a statewide alert after at least four malaria deaths were reported in East Singhbhum district. Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh directed deputy commissioners to mount malaria prevention and control with action plans, strengthened surveillance, and accountability at all levels. Suspected malaria cases must be tested immediately and treatment started on confirmation; critically ill patients should be admitted for care. A mandatory mass fever survey will be conducted whenever a new case is detected. Village-wise malaria data will be compiled, with Rapid Diagnostic Test kits and medicines supplied to affected villages. Community Health Centres must maintain stock of testing materials and antimalarial drugs. Insecticide spraying and larval control will be intensified. A public awareness campaign will promote timely testing and prevention. Monitoring will follow a three-tier review: weekly CHC reviews, fortnightly Civil Surgeon reviews, and monthly district-level reviews chaired by the Deputy Commissioner.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、イースト・シングボーム地区でのマラリア4死亡事例後に警戒態勢、特別対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: マラリアによる死亡事例が報告されているが、4例という限定的な数、地域の流行性疾患であること、対応体制が既に整備されていることから、現時点では対象国内の地域問題と判断。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性が限定的で、情報も比較的充実している。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、ジャールカンド州での流行は既知のリスク。死亡事例数は限定的（4例）。州政府による対応が既に実施されており（警戒発令、サーベイランス強化、対策マニュアルの発令）、管理可能性は良好。国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報での感染者数増加傾向や対応困難の兆候を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : huit décès en trois jours au camp de déplacés de Kigonze, sur fond de peur d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: eight deaths in three days at the Kigonze IDP camp, amid fears of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Eight people died in three days at Kigonze IDP camp in Bunia, Ituri, amid fears of Ebola. From Saturday, June 27 to Monday, June 29, deaths occurred on site, in health facilities, or at the Ebola Treatment Center Elikya in Bunia, though officials have not officially attributed the deaths to Ebola. The camp houses more than 17,000 displaced people. The site is not Ebola-free: two Ebola cases were confirmed on June 22 after sample analysis, linked to a string of mid-June deaths with vomiting and diarrhea. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo virus strain; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Ituri accounts for about 91% of cases. Response teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and hygiene measures, but face denial and unsafe handling of corpses. President Tshisekedi planned a visit to monitor the response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラ恐怖のなか、キゴンゼ難民キャンプで3日間に8人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。進行中のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）における急速な死亡増加、密集したIDP人口での感染確認、国際的拡大リスク、および大統領級の政治的関心が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（第17波、Bundibugyo株）における重大な新展開。17,000人以上のIDP人口を抱えるキャンプでの短期間の死亡集積、確認済み感染、並びに対応の困難性（遺体の不適切な取り扱い、住民の否定的態度）が報告されている。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、感染リスク管理は困難。大統領による訪問計画は政治的優先度の高さを示唆している。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: V možganih je imela kar 38 parazitov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Her brain harbored as many as 38 parasites.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis, caused by Taenia solium larvae, afflicted Lowri Denman after a prolonged illness that culminated in 38 parasites in her brain. In the United Kingdom, only a handful are diagnosed each year. The first sign was a metre-long tapeworm found in the toilet; by 2011 CT/MRI disclosed 38 brain parasites, causing severe headaches, seizures, and psychosis. Initially misattributed to toxoplasmosis, the diagnosis was revised after a link to prior tapeworm exposure was considered. She likely contracted the infection during a 2007 trip to India, where accidental pork ingestion could have included tapeworm eggs. She received antiparasitic drugs and steroids in hospital, followed by years of recovery marred by relapse and psychiatric illness, including hospitalization. The parasites calcified over time; since 2017 she has had no seizures but remains on anti-epileptic therapy. Now living in Cardiff, she aims to raise awareness about the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 脳に38匹の寄生虫を宿していた
triage.triage_reason: 単一の症例報告であり、集団発生ではない。英国での年間診断数が限定的で、患者は2007年にインドで感染後、現在はウェールズに住む個人事例。国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: これは単一症例の医学的関心事項であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生イベントではない。患者の感染は2007年のインド滞在時に遡るが、現在の記事は個人的な病歴レビューと啓発の取り組みを扱っている。対象国はインドのみが実際の発生地点として該当するが、シグナル基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Sporotrikosis Jamur Mematikan Brasil Kini Menyebar ke Satwa Liar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Threat of the Deadly Fungal Sporotrichosis in Brazil Is Spreading to Wildlife
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, sporotrichosis—an fungal disease causing severe skin lesions—is spreading into wildlife. A Paraná study tested DNA from 81 road-killed animals (39 mammals, 36 birds, 6 reptiles) and found Sporothrix in 11 (13.6%). Sporothrix schenckii was most common, but Sporothrix brasiliensis—the main cause in Brazilian cats—was detected in Picui ground dove and Tinamou. Fungi were also found in internal organs (heart and liver), indicating systemic bloodstream infection rather than only inhalation. Birds challenge the idea of immunity from high body temperatures, raising concern that migratory birds could disperse the fungus regionally. A first reptile finding—false coral snake—carried DNA of two Sporothrix species, possibly via prey or contact. Other mammals (agouti, European rabbit, white-eared opossum, southern tiger cat) may bridge wild and urban areas. Transmission risk appears linked to habitat transition zones and domestic exposure, not species or conservation status.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの致命的な真菌性スポロトリコーシスの脅威が野生動物に拡大
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスの野生動物での検出は公衆衛生上関心があるが、ヒト感染の直接的な記載がなく、動物での感染が主体である。情報不足のため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスポロトリコーシスの野生動物への拡大に焦点。ブラジルのパラナ州で81頭の路上死亡動物から調査実施。渡航性野鳥による地域的拡大の可能性が指摘されている。ただしヒト感染事例や公衆衛生的な直接的脅威の明記がないため、PICKUP基準には達しないと判断。社会的・政治的関心の程度も記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: British Tourist Who Visited India Came Back with 38 Brain Parasites After Eating Contaminated Pork
article.articleSummary: British traveller Lowri Denman returned from a two-month trip to India carrying 38 brain parasites, later diagnosed as neurocysticercosis—a brain infection caused by pork tapeworm larvae after ingestion of tapeworm eggs in contaminated food or water. She began suffering headaches and seizures within a year of returning; her condition deteriorated, with episodes of anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, leading to a neuropsychiatric admission in 2016. Initial tests suggested toxoplasmosis before confirmation of neurocysticercosis. CT and MRI revealed 38 parasitic cysts in the brain; treatment with steroids and antiparasitics (albendazole, later praziquantel) reduced swelling and lapsed when off meds, but calcified parasites remained. She remains on epilepsy medication and has had no seizures since 2017. Denman now funds a 12-part podcast to document her journey and raise awareness of travel-related parasitic infections and food/water hygiene risks in India.

triage.headline_ja: インドを訪問したイギリス人観光客が汚染された豚肉を食べた後、38個の脳寄生虫を持ち帰った
triage.triage_reason: 個人の旅行関連感染症ケースであり、流行や集団発生ではない。神経嚢虫症は既知の食害リスク疾患であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は単一の旅行者が帰国後に診断された個別ケースであり、インドでの流行や集団発生ではない。神経嚢虫症は既知の食水を介した寄生虫感染であり、旅行リスク啓発の文脈である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde orienta vacina em dia antes de viagens diante de alerta para sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities advise being up to date with vaccines before traveling in light of a measles alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Brazil: São Paulo state confirms seven measles cases this year as of June 30; Mato Grosso do Sul has 12 suspected cases (11 discarded, 1 under investigation) with no confirmed cases since 2021. First-dose measles-containing vaccine coverage is about 90% of the target; second dose 73.1%, with the 95% target not yet reached. Measles is highly contagious and spreads by airborne transmission; symptoms include red rash and high fever with cough, conjunctivitis, runny nose, or malaise. International travel is a concern due to outbreaks abroad; vaccination remains the primary prevention. Pre-travel guidance from CIEVS/Sesau advises consulting a clinician 4-6 weeks before travel and ensuring vaccines such as Hepatitis A, Yellow Fever (mandatory for some Latin American destinations), Tdap, Hepatitis B, Typhoid, Rabies, and Meningitis as indicated. For Yellow Fever, present CIVP via Meu SUS Digital. Maintain hand hygiene, water safety, insect protection, and seek care if fever after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生当局は麻疹警報を受けて、旅行前のワクチン接種を最新に保つよう勧告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹を含む複数の感染症に関する予防警告。確認症例は限定的（サンパウロ州7例）だが、第2回接種率が目標未達（73.1% vs 95%目標）で感染リスク存在。国際渡航に関連した懸念あり。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も3つ該当。麻疹は高い感染性を持ち、ワクチン接種率が目標に達していない点が懸念。ただし現在のブラジル内での症例数は限定的（確認症例7例）であり、重症度は低い。国際渡航関連の予防警告としての性質が強い。続報を注視する段階。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Govt Issues Statewide Alert After 4 Malaria Deaths near Jamshedpur
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in East Singhbhum district near Jamshedpur prompted Jharkhand to issue a statewide health alert as of 1 July 2026, reporting at least four fatalities. Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh directed deputy commissioners to deploy war-footing measures: high-risk districts must implement localized action plans, intensify ground surveillance, and uphold strict accountability. Multipurpose Health Workers will launch active fever surveys in high-incidence areas; every suspected malaria case must be tested immediately and confirmed infections treated without delay. Critically ill patients must be admitted and continuously monitored; detection of any new malaria case will automatically trigger a mass fever survey across the locality. Village-wise malaria logs will be compiled; frontline workers will receive Rapid Diagnostic Test kits and anti-malarial drugs. CHCs must stockpile testing materials and scale up insecticide spraying and anti-larval fogging. Three-tier monitoring—weekly CHC reviews, fortnightly District Civil Surgeon reviews, and monthly meetings chaired by DCs—will oversee the program, complemented by public awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプル近郊のマラリア死亡4件を受けジャールカンド州政府が州全域の警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: マラリアによる死亡4件が報告され、州当局が戦時中対応を指示する大規模な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。異常な発生・重症度・管理能力の観点から複数のスクリーニング基準を満たし、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのジャールカンド州ジャムシェドプル近郊でのマラリア発生を報告しており、州政府による協調的な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。死亡症例の報告、広域的な監視体制の確立、物資備蓄など、対応能力は適切と判断されるが、発生地域でのマラリアの流行しやすさが高い状況である。

article.articleHeadline: पूर्वी सिंहभूम में ब्रेन मलेरिया से 4 बच्चों की मौत, झारखंड स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट; सभी जिलाधिकारियों को निर्देश - jharkhand malaria alert east singhbhum deaths prompt action
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In East Singhbhum, four children die of cerebral malaria; Jharkhand Health Department alert; directives to all district magistrates — prompt action.
article.articleSummary: Four children died from cerebral malaria in Potka, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, prompting a state health department alert on 1 July 2026. Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh directed all district magistrates to intensify surveillance and accelerate malaria prevention and control, with strict compliance by civil surgeons. In areas reporting fever clusters, active surveillance will be conducted by MPWs and ASHAs, with immediate malaria testing and prompt antimalarial treatment upon a positive result. Severe cases should receive special arrangements and hospital admission as needed, with comprehensive treatment and follow-up. Health facilities must maintain adequate stocks of diagnostics and antimalarial drugs; vector control through insecticide spraying and larval measures should be intensified. Mass awareness campaigns are to be launched, and district-wide data collection of malaria by village is mandated. A tri-tier monitoring system will be used: weekly CHC reviews, biweekly civil surgeon reports, and monthly district-level reviews chaired by the Deputy Commissioner.

triage.headline_ja: 東シンバム地区でアメーバ性脳マラリアにより4人の子どもが死亡、ジャールカンド保健部門がアラート発令; 全地区行政官に指示
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」（小児死亡）と「異常・予想外」（脳マラリアの多発死亡）に該当し、WPRO基準で「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当。州政府の組織的対応と多層的監視体制の構築が示唆する管理上の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事はジャールカンド州ポットカ地区の脳マラリアによる多重死亡（4人の小児）を報告。州保健部門による緊急アラート発令と、全地区への監視強化・予防活動の指示が確認される。虫媒介感染症および人間への影響の両方が記録されている。脳マラリアは重症度が高く、集団発生の可能性を示唆。ただし、国際的拡大リスクについては記事から直接的な根拠は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Паразит, живущий на кошках, может вызывать слепоту у трети человечества
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite that lives on cats may cause blindness in one-third of humanity.
article.articleSummary: Researchers urge WHO to recognize toxoplasmosis (Toxoplasma gondii) as a global health threat. An international study highlights that the parasite, carried by cats and capable of infecting up to one-third of the world’s population, is a leading cause of infectious eye disease and vision loss. Most infections are asymptomatic, but toxoplasmosis can cause flu-like illness in the immunocompromised and may remain latent for years before retinal damage occurs. Eye involvement causes pain, redness, blurred vision, and floaters, with potential irreversible blindness if untreated. The researchers, Justin Smith of Flinders University (Australia) and João Furtado of the University of São Paulo (Brazil), call for greater attention in global health programs. Transmission occurs via undercooked meat, contaminated water or foods, and contact with cat feces; at-risk pregnant women may pass infection to the fetus. Preventive measures include safer food, clean water, sanitation, and expanded prenatal care; WHO designation could mobilize resources.

triage.headline_ja: ネコに寄生する寄生虫が人類の3分の1に失明をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は世界人口の3分の1に感染し、感染性眼疾患の主要原因であり公衆衛生への影響は深刻だが、記事は学術的警告であり急性の流行イベントではなく、現在の発生状況の詳細が不明。情報不足のため経過観察とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事はトキソプラズマ症の世界的脅威に関する学術的警告であり、フリンダース大学（オーストラリア）とサンパウロ大学（ブラジル）の研究者による国際研究に基づく。発生地域にはオーストラリアとブラジルが含まれているが、サマリーは既知の感染症であり新規流行イベントではなく、国別の具体的な発生件数や急増は記述されていない。ブラジルのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。現在の流行状況の詳細が不足しているため WATCH 判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos viruso protrūkis Afrikai gali atsieiti 3,6 mlrd. JAV dolerių
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola virus outbreak in Africa could cost $3.6 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province in the northeast, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or specific treatment. As of the report, 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) warns the epidemic risks a broader social and economic crisis, potentially costing Africa up to $3.6 billion and pushing about 985,000 people into poverty. In the DRC, real GDP could fall by more than $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs could be lost; regional trade disruptions could reduce continental GDP by about $2.37 billion. Beyond health, impacts include livelihoods, education, food security, trade, public finances and confidence. The outbreak underscores the need for non-health controls, given its wide-reaching economic and social effects.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラウイルスの流行は36億米ドルの損失をもたらす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準に該当。エボラウイルスの確認された集団発生（1,333確認症例、399死亡）で、DRC及びウガンダで確認。国際的拡大リスク、重症度、経済的影響が顕著。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで20の確認症例」と言及されているため、本来はウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていれば verified_locations に追加されるべき。しかし対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため（GeoNames ID提供なし）、DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo株による大規模な集団発生であり、経済的影響が極めて重大（最大$3.6B）。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma três novos casos de sarampo e estado atinge sete registros em 2026 | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms three new measles cases and the state records seven measles cases in 2026 | Radio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state reports two new measles cases on the night of July 30, bringing 2026 totals to seven, per the State Health Secretariat. The patients are a six‑month‑old infant and a 20‑year‑old woman, both living near Guarulhos; the woman is the mother of a baby diagnosed last week, with three other cases previously confirmed. Following the surge, the Ministry of Health on June 26 recommended a zero‑dose of the measles‑mumps‑rubella vaccine for São Paulo and Guarulhos, with about 100,000 doses to be distributed. The zero‑dose targets children 6 months to 11 months 29 days to reduce susceptibility and transmission, due to cases possibly linked to importation from outside Brazil. The standard SUS schedule provides the first MMR dose at 12 months and a second at 15 months. Guidance: individuals up to 59 without two doses should be immunized; 5–29 years require two doses (≥30 days apart); 30–59 years require one dose. Symptoms include red rashes and itching on hands; transmission is airborne and via direct contact.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州が麻疹の新規症例3件を確認、2026年の州内記録は7件に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。麻疹の輸入関連の可能性がある集団発生で、公式な予防接種キャンペーン実施が報告されており、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月30日のイベント（配信は7月1日）を報告している時系列的な矛盾があるが、内容上の信憑性判定は本評価の範囲外。麻疹は高感染性病原体で、ブラジル内での輸入関連集団発生として報告されている。公衆衛生対応（ゼロ用量MMRワクチン配布、約10万用量）が既に実施されており、管理可能性は評価される。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当により、フルRRA対象として識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Concern ramps up its response in DRC as Ebola continues to spread
article.articleSummary: 1,333 confirmed Ebola cases and 399 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 29, with Ituri province bearing >90% of cases and 88% of deaths; North Kivu shows a higher case fatality among confirmed at 54.3%, while Ituri's is 27.6%. Fear and distrust drive underreporting; symptomatic individuals avoided, and isolation and burial restrictions impede care. Concern Worldwide is expanding operations in DRC, aiming to reach over 113,000 people with Ebola interventions, including risk communication on symptoms, transmission, and prevention; water, sanitation, and hygiene improvements—boreholes, emergency latrines and showers; training of community leaders on prevention, identification, and referral; and supporting clinics by providing Infection Prevention and Control kits, hygiene supplies, and handwashing stations. Ongoing conflict hampers response, with six villages attacked in the last fortnight and residents seeking safety in towns at night. Irish Aid support underpins the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ出血熱対応を強化 感染拡大が継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認患者1,333名、死亡者399名の重大な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的な対応（アイルランド援助、NGO支援）が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定患者1,333名、死亡者399名という深刻な流行状況。Ituri州が全体の90%以上の症例を占める。地域紛争による対応阻害、症例報告の過少性が指摘されている。国際NGO（Concern Worldwide）およびアイルランド政府による支援が実施中。WPROスクリーニング基準では該当国がDRCであり対象国リストに含まれていないが、IHR基準で4つすべてに該当するためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Church steps up Ebola response in Congo | UMNews.org
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Congo, centered in Bunia. As of 1 July 2026, the United Methodist Church has stepped up response with an initial US$20,000 grant from Global Ministries to strengthen 10 health facilities with PPE, hygiene kits, essential medicines and staff training. Bishop Kalema frames response as faith-informed action; Dr. Damas Lushima highlights strengthened surveillance, alert investigations and case management amid insecurity, population movements, rumors and stigma. Past outbreaks in Beni, Goma, Bukavu, Uvira, Kisangani inform rapid mobilization of health facilities, communities and church leaders. Prevention includes mandatory masks and hand-washing; local radio campaigns in Swahili, Lingala and French broadcast six times daily on Radio Canal Révélation in Bunia. Harper Hill Global funded multilingual messages and hosted a June 24 webinar. A June 16–18 Ebola awareness seminar in Kalemie (Tanganyika) sought to bolster prevention and response.

triage.headline_ja: 教会がコンゴでのエボラ対応を強化 | UMNews.org
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生はIHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（Yes）と国際拡大リスク（Yes）を満たす。DRC東部での複数地域での発生確認であり、WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行リスク・管理性の複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はカテゴリAの高リスク病原体。記事は2026年7月1日時点での Ituri Province（Bunia を中心）での発生を報告。過去の Beni、Goma、Bukavu、Uvira、Kisangani での発生経歴と今回の Kalemie（Tanganika Province）での啓発活動から、DRC の複数地域での並行流行が示唆される。保健施設の資源不足、人口移動、汚名化などの管理困難要因が記述されており、全IHR基準および全WPRO基準に該当。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: СИТУАЦИЈА ПОСТАЈЕ КРИТИЧНА: Ебола однела скоро 400 живота, број заражених незаустављиво расте
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is becoming critical: Ebola has claimed nearly 400 lives, the number of infected is rising uncontrollably.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 399 deaths, according to the latest government data. The cases are concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with confirmations through Tuesday. The rising numbers reflect an ongoing transmission dynamic in that region. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the risk of international spread remains low at present, but the situation requires careful monitoring and sustained surveillance to detect new infections promptly and respond effectively. These figures underscore the need for ongoing surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 状況は深刻化している：エボラが約400人の命を奪い、感染者数が止まることなく増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上が該当し、エボラウイルス病の確認事例400例近い死亡を含む明らかな公衆衛生的脅威。DRC東部での継続的な感染伝播と国際的拡大リスクが存在するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRC東部（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu州）でのエボラ発生。1,333確定例、399死亡が報告されており、継続的な感染伝播が進行中。WHOは現在のところ国際的拡大リスクは低いとしているが、継続的な監視が必要と指摘。エボラウイルス病は高い致命率と国際的懸念から最優先対象疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Bundibugyo, l'Ebola dilaga in Congo: oltre 1.150 casi e 304 morti, allarme massimo dei CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo virus, Ebola spreads in Congo: over 1,150 cases and 304 deaths, CDC's highest alert.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province predominant) and Uganda has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of June 25, with 385 patients in isolation. In DRC, Ituri reports 1,054 cases across 22 health zones; North Kivu 98; South Kivu 3. Uganda accounts for 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths as of June 23, including 15 imported from DRC and 5 secondary transmissions. On June 26, 2026, the U.S. CDC activated Ebola response at Level 1, marking the world’s second-largest Ebola epidemic in DRC and third-largest globally. No vaccines or specific therapies exist for Bundibugyo; rVSV-ZEBOV is not recommended due to lack of cross-protection. Management is supportive, with rapid case identification, isolation, and contact tracing. Projections vary: 3–10x underreporting possible; CDC modeling suggests isolation at 20% could exceed 20,000 cases in 3 months, while 70% isolation could keep cases under 10,000. Two imported European cases: France (healthcare worker) and a previously treated case in Germany; EU/EEA risk considered low.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイボラウイルス、コンゴで流行：1,150例以上と304人の死亡、CDCは最高警戒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。世界第2位の規模を持つエボラアウトリークであり、CDCが最高レベルの対応を発動した。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでの発生を記述しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外。フランスとドイツの輸入症例も記載されているが、対象国外のため除外。ブンディブギョウイボラは世界で第2位の規模であり、公衆衛生上の重大性は極めて高い。CDCが最高レベルの対応を発動したことで、国際的な関心も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: M-am întors din India cu 38 de paraziți în creier. Cum s-a infectat o femeie de 42 de ani fără să mănânce carne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I returned from India with 38 parasites in my brain. How did a 42-year-old woman become infected without eating meat?
article.articleSummary: Lowri Denman, 42, traveled to India in 2007 and adopted a vegetarian diet to reduce foodborne illness. She reportedly ingested Taenia solium eggs (tapeworm), likely via contaminated water or poorly washed produce. Neurocysticercosis occurs when tapeworm larvae reach the brain; eggs can be ingested through water or contaminated foods, not only from undercooked pork. Symptoms appeared around 2010–2011: she expelled a tapeworm over a meter long, then developed migraines, speech problems, a first epileptic seizure, and memory loss. CT/MRI revealed 38 parasites in the brain. As larvae died, inflammation caused epilepsy, numbness, anxiety, panic attacks, paranoia and psychosis. Treated with antiparasitics and corticosteroids; surgery was not pursued and the parasites calcified. Since 2017 she has been seizure-free on antiepileptic therapy. Neurocysticercosis is a major epilepsy cause in Asia, Africa and Latin America; rare in Europe/UK, typically among travelers or contacts. The case was described as highly complex by experts.

triage.headline_ja: インドから帰国した女性、脳に38匹の寄生虫を発症：肉を食べていないのに感染した経緯
triage.triage_reason: 個別の輸入症例報告であり、集団発生ではない。イギリスの旅行者がインド滞在中に感染した過去の事例であり、現在の感染症危機管理上の緊急性や国際的な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件はインドへの旅行中に感染した単一事例の医療報告である。記事の焦点は個人の臨床経過にあり、インドにおける神経嚢虫症の流行や集団感染を示唆していない。対象国はインド（記事サマリーに明記）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak could cost Africa $3.6 bn, says UN
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in the conflict-hit northeastern Ituri province, with 1,333 cases and 399 deaths reported by the World Health Organization; 189 people have recovered, and Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo species responsible has no vaccine or specific treatment. The UN Development Programme warns the epidemic risks a broad socioeconomic crisis, potentially costing Africa up to $3.6 billion and pushing 985,000 more people into poverty, with real GDP losses in the DRC exceeding $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs lost. Economic damage could reach continental GDP reduction of $2.37 billion even if transmission is contained. Quarantines and border restrictions worsen livelihoods, education, and trade. UNDP recommends cash transfers to the vulnerable, targeted screening over border closures, and emergency financing to preserve maternal/infant healthcare services.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症流行はアフリカに36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目に該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目中4項目に該当。高い重症度（致死率、回復者数）と感染拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20確認症例は記事で言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、DRCの激戦地域イツリ州での感染が主焦点。Bundibugyo種であることが重要。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्री ने टीबी मुक्त भारत अभियान, डेंगू की तैयारियों पर प्रमुख बैठकों की अध्यक्षता की
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Minister chaired key meetings on the TB-free India campaign and dengue preparedness.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, July 1, 2026 — India's Health Minister J.P. Nadda chaired reviews with the Delhi government on the TB-free India campaign and the 100-day campaign, stressing that TB elimination requires community participation beyond the health system. MPs, MLAs, and city councilors should be regularly briefed about TB burden, challenges, solutions, case finding, treatment adherence, and community support in their constituencies. A ward-level senior official will monitor progress; AI-integrated handheld X-ray machines will strengthen rapid TB diagnosis. Separately, dengue preparedness ahead of the monsoon was reviewed, with emphasis on Delhi and the Delhi-NCR region. The dengue plan prioritizes surveillance, vector control, case identification, clinical management, and public awareness. The discussions underscore collaborative implementation and enhanced epidemiological surveillance nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: インドの保健大臣が結核撲滅キャンペーンとデング熱対策に関する重要会議を主催
triage.triage_reason: 結核とデング熱という重要な感染症について高官レベルの政策会議が開催されており、国家規模の対策が進行中だが、新規の疾患イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく準備・監視活動の進捗報告であるため、引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は結核とデング熱の既存の流行への政策対応・準備段階である。新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、高官による定例的な進捗確認会議。デング熱はモンスーン前の季節的準備段階との記述。結核は慢性感染症で長期曝露（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）の基準に該当。政府内での関心と公開報道による社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'UNFPA lance un atelier pour des messages de communication adaptés à la 17ème épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: UNFPA launches a workshop on tailored Ebola-outbreak communication messages - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 1 July 2026 – UNFPA convened a workshop to design messages and communication tools for the Ebola Virus Disease’s 17th outbreak, emphasizing the continuity of reproductive health services. Marguerite Kunduma, UNFPA Health Chief, stated the effort aims to build strategic communication capable of saving lives and reducing maternal mortality, obstetric complications, gender-based violence (VBG), and exploitation or sexual abuse in outbreak contexts. Over the coming days, participants will craft messages to reassure women about emergency obstetric care, decrease stigma tied to Ebola-like signs, promote care for VBG survivors, and uphold zero tolerance for exploitation. Outputs will become national references, harmonized and disseminated under the motto “One Team, One Plan, One Coordination.” The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) and Dr. Emilia Sana underscored DRC’s public health challenges, including Ebola and Mpox, and welcomed UNFPA support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：UNFPAが第17次流行に対応した通信メッセージのワークショップを開催
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラウイルス疾患の第17次流行が進行中であることが確認された。IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」「重症度」に該当する。公式な感染症対応（UNFPA等による通信戦略ワークショップ）が進行中である点から社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのキンシャサでエボラウイルス疾患の第17次流行が進行中であることを明示している。UNFPAによるワークショップ開催は、生殖保健サービスの継続と性暴力対策を含む統合対応の一部である。Mpoxも同時に言及されているが、記事の主要テーマはエボラ対応である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : parents et élèves appelés à la vigilance pendant les vacances - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Parents and students urged to be vigilant during the holidays.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a public health concern as the 17th outbreak extends to 11 of 34 health zones. In a holiday-focused appeal, ANAPECO-Beni urges parents and students to adopt responsible behavior to prevent transmission, noting the virus spreads by contact. Homes should install mandatory handwashing facilities and minimize contact with people of unknown origin. Although recent exams passed without identified school cases, officials warn vacation periods can heighten risk. Authorities have suspended all sports activities through the outbreak’s end and prohibited large public gatherings, immersion baptisms, and use of public swimming pools in the affected area. The message calls on educators, parents, and pupils to stay vigilant until the outbreak is controlled.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ出血熱：保護者および生徒に休暇中の警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則の指定感染症であり、進行中の流行が複数の保健ゾーンに拡大していることが確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の17番目の流行は北キブ州ベニを中心に34の保健ゾーン中11ゾーンに拡大中。記事は学校閉鎖、スポーツ活動中止、大規模集会禁止など複数の制御措置が実施されていることを示唆している。RRA実施時には流行の詳細な規模・症例数・致死率・国際的な病例確認状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Health Department ups vigil to combat vector-borne diseases in Coimbatore district
article.articleSummary: Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu, tightens vigilance against vector-borne diseases amid sporadic rains. Health officials report no alarming rise in IP fever or dengue versus last year. Domestic breeding checkers (DBCs) conduct door-to-door visits in CCMC limits and district-wide based on in-patient fever cases, dengue positives, and mosquito larval index. The district has 2,052 DBCs: 1,200 in CCMC, 240 in 12 blocks, 309 in town panchayats, and 303 in municipalities. Rapid response teams (medical officer, pharmacist, and staff nurse) dispatch to locations with higher IP fever for mobile fever camps. Active dengue cases in city limits average 3–4, rural areas 1–2 in the past week, with no hotspots identified. Mass cleaning targets waste that collects water—coconut shells, plastic containers, tumblers, abandoned tyres—to curb Aedes aegypti breeding during the southwest monsoon. Public urged to keep premises free of breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: Coimbatore地区でベクター媒介感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の現在の症例は軽微であり、当局の監視活動は予防的措置に過ぎず、重大な流行の兆候はない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がなく、社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 記事はCoimbatore地区の日常的なベクター媒介感染症対策を記述しており、昨年比で「警戒すべき上昇はない」と明記されている。現在の症例数は市部で3～4件、農村部で1～2件と限定的。この報道は既知の地風土病に対する定期的な公衆衛生措置であり、新興的な健康危機を示していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : l'OMS projette un laboratoire durable à Butembo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the WHO plans a sustainable laboratory in Butembo - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 17th Ebola outbreak with 117 laboratory-confirmed cases across 11 of 34 health zones. Butembo city, comprising two zones, accounts for 51 cases in Katwa zone and 28 in Butembo zone. The World Health Organization seeks to establish a sustainable diagnostic laboratory in Butembo to bolster response, not only for current suspected cases but as enduring infrastructure. WHO Acting country representative Dr. Anne Ancia says efforts will extend to the city, affected zones, and potentially at-risk areas, while addressing transport bottlenecks for sample delivery to Beni. Emphasis is placed on training community relay workers; given the Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no treatment or vaccine, rapid case management, complete contact tracing, and breaking transmission chains are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ：WHOはブテンボに持続可能な診断検査室を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤で公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、北キブ州での継続的な発生は国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。
triage.notes: 17回目のエボラアウトブレイク。実験室確認例117件。Bundibugyo株で治療法・ワクチンなし。WHO が診断検査室の設置を計画中。北キブ州での持続的なヒト-ヒト感染と地域的伝播が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Govt to expand support for early TB diagnosis for TB elimination programme, says Nadda
article.articleSummary: India to expand support for early tuberculosis diagnosis with handheld AI-integrated X-ray machines to boost case detection, announced by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda in New Delhi. With India accounting for over a quarter of the global TB burden, an estimated 2.7–2.8 million new cases occur annually. TB, a life-threatening lung infection, has shown a 21% decline in India over the last decade, according to the WHO 2025 report. The expansion emphasizes technology-enabled detection and strengthened testing outreach, alongside community engagement; communications should be simple to reach a wide audience. Each ward should be monitored by senior officials, and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) will have clearly outlined roles in TB MUKT Bharat Abhiyaan as well as Dengue preparedness. The Delhi Government’s dengue readiness, focusing on surveillance, awareness, and timely preventive measures, was reviewed during the meeting.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がTB排除プログラムのための初期TB診断支援を拡大、ナッダ大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: 結核は重要な公衆衛生課題だが、本記事はインドの既存プログラム拡大の政策発表であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。デング熱も言及されているが詳細が限定的で、異常な流行を示す具体的データが不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は結核制御の政策的イニシアティブ（TB MUKT Bharat Abhiyaan）の拡大を報じている。インドは全体の患者負担の報告にとどまり、現在の特定のアウトブレイク状況は記述されていない。デング熱への言及は準備状況のレビューのみで、具体的な発症患者数や異常なリスク上昇を示していない。継続的な結核負担と定期的な感染症準備活動として監視継続が適切。
