article.articleHeadline: ভারত ভ্রমণে গিয়ে মস্তিষ্কে ৩৮টি পরজীবী নিয়ে ফিরলেন ব্রিটিশ মিডিয়াকর্মী - parbattanews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: British media worker returns with 38 brain parasites after a trip to India.
article.articleSummary: British media worker Lori Denman developed Neurocysticercosis after a trip to India, with 38 parasitic brain cysts identified in 2011. At age 42, she reported first discovering a nearly one-meter tapeworm in a toilet in 2010; stool tests yielded no abnormalities. Within a year she began experiencing severe headaches and seizures; CT and MRI confirmed 38 intracranial parasites. Neurocysticercosis results from ingestion of Taenia solium eggs (pork tapeworm), likely acquired during a 2007 India trip via contaminated food, despite abstaining from meat during travel. Two weeks of antiparasitic therapy and steroids led to initial improvement, but chronic inflammation around dead parasites caused confusion, numbness, anxiety, panic attacks, and psychosis, forcing her to withdraw from work and undergo about six weeks of neuropsychiatric care. Since 2017, seizures ceased; parasites are calcified and inert, controlled with lifelong anticonvulsants; no surgery required.

triage.headline_ja: インド旅行で帰国した英国メディアワーカーが脳内に38個の寄生虫を持って戻る
triage.triage_reason: 個別の症例報告であり、流行や集団発生ではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響がなく、国際的な拡大リスクも示唆されない。
triage.notes: 記事は2010-2011年に発生した個別症例（英国人メディアワーカー）のインド旅行後の感染事例の報告である。現在は発症から15年以上が経過しており、患者の状態は安定している（2017年以降発作なし）。流行や複数事例の報告ではなく、既往の個別症例の背景情報提供であるため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Government pressed on Ebola outbreak preparedness
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,274 confirmed cases with 360 related deaths as of 28 June, with a smaller number of cases confirmed in neighbouring Uganda. France identified its first Ebola case in an aid worker who had returned from the DRC, prompting UK preparedness scrutiny. UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) advises clinicians to consider Ebola in acutely unwell patients with fever who have travelled from DRC or Uganda within the past 21 days, and a public-health team was deployed mid-June to support response in the DRC and region. The Health and Social Care Committee, chaired by Layla Moran, has written to public health minister Sharon Hodgson and chief medical officer Sir Chris Whitty seeking information on border preparedness, surveillance/testing, and NHS clinical readiness, and on government collaboration with UKHSA and international partners. A Glasgow suspected case tested negative.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行への備えについて政府に質問が寄せられている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の国際的拡大、複数国での確認、旅行制限の可能性）。対象国のDRCで確認される大規模流行であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCで1,274確定例・360死亡例が報告されており、ウガンダでも確認。フランスで輸入症例1例。UK・スコットランドではGlasgow疑い例が検査で陰性。記事の主題はDRC発生の流行であり、ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。UK・フランス・スコットランドは発生地ではなく輸入症例/備えの話題のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Ituri : mobilisation des transporteurs dans la sensibilisation pour stopper l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Transporters mobilized in awareness-raising to stop the epidemic - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Ituri: In Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, taxi-moto and taxi-bus drivers were mobilized on July 1, 2026, as part of the Risk Communication and Community Engagement (CREC) pillar of the Ebola response. The effort aims to counter beliefs that Ebola does not exist and to disseminate prevention messages. Drivers will serve as community relays to promote handwashing, adherence to infection prevention and control measures, and behaviors to limit transmission. Interpersonal communication sessions will be organized in markets, churches, and other gathering spots, and posters reading 'Stop Ebola' will be placed on motorcycles and taxis to boost visibility and unity against the epidemic. The campaign emphasizes social marketing of response activities and intensified community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ対策：輸送業者の動員による啓発活動で流行を阻止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準で複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）。DRCでの継続的な流行対応のシグナルであり、コミュニティエンゲージメント強化は病況の深刻性を示唆する。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでのエボラ流行継続。記事は2026年7月時点での対応活動を報じており、依然として活動的な流行が進行中であることを示唆している。コミュニティ啓発キャンペーンの強化は疾患の持続的な伝播と公衆衛生当局の対応の必要性を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्री ने टीबी मुक्त भारत अभियान, डेंगू की तैयारियों पर प्रमुख बैठकों की अध्यक्षता की | Health Minister chairs key meetings on TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, dengue preparedness
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister chaired key meetings on TB-free India Campaign and dengue preparedness.
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, India's Health Minister J.P. Nadda chaired reviews with the Delhi government on the TB-free India campaign and its 100-day push, noting substantial strides yet gaps that can only be closed through mass participation. Elimination of TB cannot rely on the health system alone; he urged active involvement of communities, public representatives, and civil society, with MPs, MLAs, and municipal councilors regularly briefed on TB burden, challenges, solutions, case finding, treatment adherence, and needed community support. He directed that every ward appoint a senior government officer to monitor progress and emphasized technology's role, announcing expanded use of AI-integrated handheld X-ray machines to speed diagnosis and case detection. In parallel, Nadda led a high-level dengue preparedness review ahead of the monsoon, focusing on epidemiology, institutional readiness, and nationwide measures, with Delhi-NCR receiving particular emphasis; a comprehensive plan highlighted surveillance, vector management, case identification, clinical management, and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がTB撲滅インド・キャンペーンとデング熱対策の主要会議を主催
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるTB及びデング熱の公衆衛生対策に関する政策レベルの会議報道であり、急性アウトブレイク情報ではなく情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なアウトブレイク情報ではなく、インド政府による結核とデング熱対策の政策会議に関する報道です。両疾患ともに対象国インドでの流行感染性があり、政府当局の関心も高いことが確認されていますが、現在の患者数、死亡数、増加傾向等の具体的なエピデミオロジーデータが記事に含まれていません。今後のアウトブレイク通知または具体的な患者数増加報告について経過観察が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य मंत्री ने टीबी मुक्त भारत अभियान, डेंगू की तैयारियों पर प्रमुख बैठकों की अध्यक्षता की - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Minister chaired key meetings on the TB-Free India Campaign and dengue preparedness - Punjab Kesari.
article.articleSummary: Delhi, July 1, 2026 — Health Minister J.P. Nadda chaired reviews with the Delhi government on the TB-Free India campaign and a 100-day drive, emphasizing that progress hinges on public participation beyond the health system alone. He urged MPs, MLAs, and municipal councillors to be routinely briefed about TB burden, challenges, implemented solutions, and to accelerate case finding, treatment adherence, and community support in their constituencies. An executive directive called for a senior government official in every ward to monitor progress, and he highlighted technology’s role, including AI-integrated handheld X-ray machines to improve rapid diagnosis and case detection. Separately, he led a high-level dengue preparedness review for Delhi ahead of the monsoon, outlining a comprehensive plan for surveillance, vector management, case identification, clinical management, and public awareness, with national dengue readiness and Delhi NCR emphasis.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がTB撲滅インド運動とデング熱対策に関する重要会議を主催
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とTB対策の行政会議であり、疾患の異常な発生や深刻な流行を示唆する具体的情報が記事サマリーに含まれていない。準備・監視強化の政策会合の報道であるため、IHR/WPRO基準の該当が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はデング熱とTBに対する行政レベルの準備・監視強化会議であり、特定の疾患発生や流行の報告ではない。政策会合の性質上、現在のところ具体的な健康危機のシグナルとしては判断されない。ただしデングの流行期（モンスーン期）前の準備状況は監視の価値がある。継続的な情報収集で流行の兆候があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: União realiza estudo amplo para enfrentamento da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Union conducts a comprehensive study to combat dengue.
article.articleSummary: Union, Brazil's Municipal Health Secretariat completed a comprehensive technical-scientific study to combat dengue, integrating environmental and epidemiological surveillance, health service networks, and immunization. The study centers four axes: environmental surveillance analyzing sanitation, urbanization and infrastructure; epidemiological surveillance reviewing the historical case series and refining notifiable disease reporting; entomological surveillance via 16 LIRAa cycles conducted January 2022–February 2026, covering over 11,000 properties; and immunization with monitoring of the 10–14-year-old vaccination program. Findings guided objective criteria to prioritize interventions, mapping zones with worse sanitation, higher population density, and greater socioeconomic vulnerability, where vector control, community mutirões, and active vaccination will be intensified. Vaccination has delivered 1,230 doses across 17 health units, with 91.5% directed to the priority group. The study included capacity building for ACE, ACS, nursing staff, and physicians, with Dr. Gabriel Ferreira providing consultancy.

triage.headline_ja: ウニアン市がデング熱対策の包括的研究を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのウニアン市による既知疾患（デング熱）に対する公衆衛生対応活動の報告。異常性、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響の証拠がなく、地域的な予防・管理施策の進行状況レポートに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのウニアン市における既知のデング熱に対する公衆衛生対応活動の説明であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な流行、または危機的状況を報告していない。予防・管理施策の展開状況の報告に分類される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: मैसेंजर आरएनए वैक्सीनें गंभीर संक्रामक बीमारियों के खिलाफ बेजोड़ ढाल, सुरक्षित और प्रभावी साबित - mrna vaccines safe effective against infectious diseases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: mRNA Vaccines: An Unparalleled Shield Against Serious Infectious Diseases, Proven Safe and Effective.
article.articleSummary: mRNA vaccines are proven safe and highly effective against COVID-19 and other serious diseases, per a Lancet review of billions of doses. Researchers from the University of British Columbia (Canada) and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine evaluated diverse groups—children, pregnant women, and individuals with weaker immunity—finding strong protection with a favorable safety profile. While rare myocarditis cases were noted, benefits in reducing hospitalizations and deaths substantially outweigh risks. Lead author Anna Blakney and co-author Robin Shattock emphasize extensive evidence supporting safety and efficacy and highlight future uses, including influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and cancer vaccines. They stress the need for equitable, locally produced vaccines in low- and middle-income countries to achieve a global public-health benefit, with PTI inputs from New Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: mRNAワクチン：重篤な感染症に対する比類なき盾、安全性と有効性が実証される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はmRNAワクチンの安全性と有効性に関するLancet査読論文の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患増加、または公衆衛生危機を報じるものではない。科学的知見の発表であり、IHRおよびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は新デリーからの報道だがインドで特定の疾患集積や異常発生を報じておらず、ワクチン開発・研究の進展に関する一般的なニュース報道である。COVID-19、インフルエンザ、RSVは疾患タグとして付与されているが、これらの流行事象の報告ではなく、ワクチンの安全性に関するメタ分析の紹介に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola sigue avanzando en RDC: más de 1.300 contagios y 377 fallecidos | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the DRC: more than 1,300 cases and 377 deaths | TN8.ni.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains active in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. As of 28 June 2026, the Ministry of Communications reports 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths, with 615 patients under medical care and 180 recoveries; case fatality rate 28.8%. Ongoing surveillance includes 81.3% of identified contacts under epidemiological monitoring to detect new infections and interrupt transmission. Health authorities continue active case finding, epidemiological monitoring, and community awareness campaigns. Symptoms prompting care include sudden fever, severe weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding. Officials urge people with these symptoms to seek timely medical attention to aid contact tracing, and reinforce preventive measures: regular handwashing, avoiding contact with sick or deceased individuals, and following official health communications. Authorities warn that misinformation could hinder response and delay care, urging public collaboration to curb transmission in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが引き続きDRCで拡大：1,300以上の感染者と377人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。大規模エボラ流行（1,307症例、377死亡、致死率28.8%）により、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが認められ、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則(IHR2005)における通知対象疾患であり、DRCにおける多数の症例と死亡、継続的な地域感染、接触者監視体制の実施を考慮すると、直ちにフルRRA評価が必要。東部地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）における継続的な流行状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO: पोटका में ब्रेन मलेरिया बेकाबू: तीसरे दिन 1193 जांच में 133 संक्रमित मिले; 4 रेफर, गांवों में दहशत - potka brain malaria outbreak 133 cases in a day 4 critical
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO: Cerebral malaria out of control in Potka: 133 infected in 1,193 tests on the third day; 4 referred, panic in villages.
article.articleSummary: Cerebral malaria outbreak in Potka block, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, India, escalates with 133 infections among 1,193 people screened on the third day of active surveillance (24 health teams). CHC Potka treats 9 cerebral malaria patients; 4 are referred for advanced care to Jamshedpur's MGM Medical College and Hospital and Sadar Hospital, while 5 improve and are discharged. Day-1 results: 28/464; Day-2: 51/507; Day-3: 133/1,193, indicating rapid spread. District mobilizes 108 doctors across four blocks, with 17 doctor teams conducting door-to-door blood slides, rapid treatment, and drug distribution. Public-awareness drives promote mosquito-net use, sanitation, and prompt hospital testing for fever. Villagers allege delayed DDT spraying, larva control, and nets distribution contributed to the crisis, fueling anger as authorities push containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ポトカ地区の脳マラリアが制御不能：3日目に1,193件の検査で133件の感染を確認；4件が重症、村々でパニック
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響が該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行可能性が複合的に示唆されている。脳マラリアの急速な拡大と既に4件の重症例が報告されており、インドの対象国である点でもフルRRA実施の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 脳マラリアの急速な増加傾向（Day1: 28, Day2: 51, Day3: 133）、4件の重症例と医療機関への転送、村民によるDDT散布遅延等への不満表明が記事に明記されている。ジャールカンド州ポトカ地区での集中的な調査と対応が進行中だが、複数ブロックでの感染拡大の可能性があり、国内的な管理可能性への懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry of Health Continues to Strengthen National Ebola Virus Disease Plans - The Voice St. Lucia News
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026 under IHR (2005). As of June 22, 2026, DRC reported 1,094 confirmed EVD cases, 277 deaths, and 387 people hospitalized in isolation, up 46 cases and 10 deaths since the last update. Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths by June 24, 2026. France reported one imported case on June 24, 2026; a May 19 US citizen evacuated to Germany was previously reported, both linked to the DRC outbreak. Caribbean risk remains low per CARPHA, but regional surveillance and preparedness are being intensified. Saint Lucia is strengthening national Ebola plans, with ports-of-entry safeguards, 21‑day home quarantine for travelers from high‑risk regions, and dedicated isolation and management wards; CARPHA lab capacity now tests Ebola and coordinates specimen transport.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が全国エボラウイルス病対策計画の強化を継続 - ザ・ボイス セント・ルシア・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005) Annex2の4基準すべてに該当する重大な新興感染症であり、WHO PUBLICが既にPHEICを宣言しており、複数国での確定症例・死亡が報告されている。対象地域のDRC（203,312）での活動的な流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはセント・ルシアの国家計画強化に焦点を当てているが、実際の活動的なEVD流行はDRCとウガンダで発生している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOがすでにPHEICを2026年5月17日に宣言済みで、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は高く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mainpuri News: Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign Starts in District from July 1 | Mainpuri News: संक्रामक रोगों पर वार, जिले में शुरू हुआ विशेष संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainpuri News: War on Communicable Diseases; A Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign Has Started in the District.
article.articleSummary: Mainpuri district launches a July-only special Communicable Disease Control Campaign to curb dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and other infectious diseases. From July 1–31, district authorities flag off awareness vehicles to bolster district-wide efforts. Health teams will go door-to-door in rural and urban areas, promoting sanitation, safe drinking water, elimination of mosquito breeding sites, and personal hygiene; fogging, anti-larval sprays, drain cleaning, and waste disposal will be prioritized. Chief Medical Officer Dr. R.C. Gupta notes this campaign runs three times a year (April, July, October) and lasts one month in July. From July 10, the door-to-door 'Dastak' initiative will screen for fever, TB, and other serious illnesses, linking suspected cases to testing and treatment. Citizens are urged to remove standing water, clean coolers and tanks, wear full-body clothing, use mosquito nets, and seek care at government centers promptly.

triage.headline_ja: Mainpuri News: 伝染病との戦い；特別な伝染病制御キャンペーンが地区で開始
triage.triage_reason: 複数の伝染病（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、結核）を対象とした公式な制御キャンペーンが開始されたことを示すが、新規の疾患発生や異常事態の報告ではなく、予防的な公衆衛生対応であり、現時点では深刻な健康影響の具体的な報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な予防キャンペーンの開始を報告するもので、新規発生件数、死亡、重症例などの具体的な疾患負荷データは含まれていない。インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州Mainpuri地区における地方衛生当局の標準的な対応と判定される。デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、結核はいずれも地域で流行しやすい感染症であり、継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: "إيبولا" يكلف إفريقيا 3.6 مليار دولار ويهدد مئات الآلاف من الوظائف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: "Ebola" costs Africa $3.6 billion and threatens hundreds of thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the United Nations Development Programme warns that an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could trigger wide-ranging economic losses across Africa, totaling up to $3.6 billion and pushing about 985,000 people into poverty if regional spillovers intensify. The epidemic could erase tens of thousands of jobs and undermine education, health, and broader livelihoods in the DRC and neighboring countries, notably Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Even with containment within the DRC and Uganda, losses in the DRC's GDP could exceed $1 billion and about 55,000 jobs may be lost. Disruptions to trade, border closures, and waning consumer confidence could add roughly $2.37 billion in continental GDP losses, with combined pressures from regional conflicts potentially pushing up to 328,000 African jobs at risk. Recommendations include direct transfers, targeted diagnostic protocols, and emergency health-financing mechanisms rather than blanket border closures.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：「エボラ」はアフリカに36億ドルの損失をもたらし、数十万の雇用を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響を与え、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、および異常な経済規模の影響を示す。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC がエボラ発生の主要地として記述され、ウガンダ・ルワンダ・南スーダンへのこぼれ落ちリスクが言及されている。対象国リストでは DRC のみが確認されるため、verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。北東アフリカの政治的不安定性との相互作用が経済への大規模な悪影響を強調している。

article.articleHeadline: Research Uncovers Path to Universal Malaria Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Malaria vaccine research identifies liver-stage parasite fragments recognized by T cells, presented via HLA-E, potentially enabling a universal vaccine. The Nature study by Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) and international collaborators links liver infection as the critical bottleneck and shows fragments shared across African strains and detectable in Brazil samples. Nonhuman primate biopsy work confirms hepatic recognition, and first human vaccine candidates are being tested in animal models. Unlike antibody-based vaccines that require boosters, a T cell–based approach could persist for years or decades. Malaria affects hundreds of millions annually and is the leading global cause of childhood death. OHSU work is funded by NIH grants; Gates Foundation support aims to evaluate monoclonal antibodies and vaccine candidates against Plasmodium falciparum. Public release notes no live animal work without IACUC approval.

triage.headline_ja: 研究が汎用マラリアワクチンへの道を明かす
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリアワクチン開発の基礎研究成果報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクやイベントではない。公衆衛生上の緊急性なく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究開発ニュースであり、アウトブレイク検知や感染症危機管理対象の感染症イベントではない。ワクチン候補開発段階であり、実際の疾患流行報告ではない。トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo: Wie geht es weiter?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: What happens next?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to exact a brutal toll in the region hardest hit. Sylvain Timasina, a resident, says Ebola has killed 20 relatives. He reports that yesterday three more family members died from the disease, underscoring the outbreak’s persistent severity at the community level. Among the latest fatalities were an aunt, 62, and a cousin, 32. The article centers on personal loss and the immediate human costs of the outbreak, illustrating how quickly fatalities accumulate within families in the affected area. No additional details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or public-health responses are provided, but the piece underscores the ongoing, locally devastating impact of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行：今後はどうなるのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は致死的な感染症であり、継続的な死亡例が報告されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）の複数項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）も満たす。フルのRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行が報告され、複数の死亡例（家族内での累積死亡）が記載されている。記事はコミュニティレベルでの深刻な影響を強調しており、公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。ただし、詳細な検査確認や感染連鎖、公衆衛生対応についての情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC confirms Marburg virus death, threatening complications to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Marburg virus disease death confirmed in Uganda: an isolated case detected during Ebola outbreak surveillance in western Uganda’s Kyegegwa district; a 1.5-year-old child died. Africa CDC confirms the case, noting that none of the contacts have developed symptoms and there are currently no active Marburg cases in Uganda. Uganda’s health ministry spokesman says they are unaware of a Marburg outbreak. Africa CDC spokesperson Saran Koly said the agency is coordinating with the Ugandan government and cannot confirm additional cases, while standing ready to support verification, risk assessment and response readiness as needed. Two WHO officials told Reuters they were aware of the detection. Uganda’s last Marburg outbreak occurred in 2017. Separately, Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo are facing the fastest-ever Ebola outbreak, with Ituri province as epicentre near South Sudan and Uganda; over 1,000 confirmed cases and about 300 deaths, and potential spread to South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがマールブルグウイルス死亡例を確認、エボラ流行への複雑化の脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致死的な新興ウイルス2種の同時流行で、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。国際支援調整が進行中。
triage.notes: ウガンダでマールブルグ単一症例（1.5歳児死亡）が検出されたが、記事の主題は DRC-Uganda 境界域でのエボラ流行（1,000確認例、300死亡）との複合危機。ウガンダはブルーグ発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダの保健省が「マールブルグ流行を認識していない」と述べており、その国での流行状況は未確認。主要な流行地は DRC のイトゥリ州。対象国リストに Sudan は含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Africa CDC と WHO が調整中で国際的支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: جنيف: 4.8 ألف حالة إصابة بالكوليرا في اليمن و7 وفيات منذ مطلع العام الجاري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Geneva: 4,800 cholera cases in Yemen and 7 deaths since the start of this year.
article.articleSummary: Yemen reported 4,814 new suspected cholera and acute watery diarrhea (AWD) cases from Jan 1 to May 31, 2026, with 7 associated deaths. All reported cases through late April were in areas under the internationally recognized government of Yemen; no data are available from Houthi-controlled regions due to access constraints. Globally, Yemen ranks seventh in cholera outbreaks in the first five months of 2026, after Afghanistan (43,292), the Democratic Republic of Congo (28,567), South Sudan (7,712), Mozambique (7,500), Nigeria (6,860), and Angola (4,852). In the East Mediterranean region, Yemen has the second-highest cholera burden after Afghanistan and the third in deaths after Sudan and Afghanistan, with 52,171 regional cases and 86 deaths since year‑start. In May 2026, government-controlled areas reported 589 new suspected cholera/AWD cases and 1 death. Cumulatively, 114,829 cases and 1,230 deaths in 23 countries across four WHO regions since 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ジュネーブ：イエメンでコレラ患者4,800例、今年初以来7人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。コレラは国際的通知義務疾患であり、複数国での多数症例（114,829例、1,230死亡）と国際的拡大が確認される。
triage.notes: イエメンはサマリーの主題だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC は対象国リストに含まれ、サマリーで28,567例の報告が明記されているため included。グローバルなコレラ集団発生で、複数地域（東地中海地域、アフリカなど）での拡大が報告されている。アクセス制約により Houthi 支配地域からのデータが利用できず、実際の負担は未計測の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 300 cas confirmés, Kinshasa en quarantaine, l'Afrique centrale sous tension - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 300 confirmed cases, Kinshasa in quarantine, Central Africa under tension - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with at least 300 confirmed cases as of 30 June 2026, prompting Kinshasa to impose a 21-day quarantine and ban mass gatherings; flights to Bunia suspended. The broader outbreak reports 1,307 confirmed Ebola cases and 377 deaths, driven by Bundibugyo virus and concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with a case fatality around 29%. Alarmingly, 297 lab‑positive patients are unaccounted for, raising fears of wider spread. Measures include a 21‑day traveler quarantine from affected zones and a ban on large events in Kinshasa. Cross-border concerns include a confirmed case in Uganda and a French doctor returning from mission testing positive. The OMS and Africa CDC are monitoring; health systems face resource constraints, though free care was declared in Ituri and contact tracing is about 81.3%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ：300人の確認症例、キンシャサが隔離、中央アフリカが緊張状態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス感染症であり、死亡率29%と高く、297人の行方不明患者による拡大懸念、複数国での症例確認（ウガンダ、フランス）により即時フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、フランスも記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC における大規模エボラ流行であり、ウガンダとフランスは境界外での2次的な症例確認のため verified_locations に含めない。ただし国際的広がりはIHR基準評価に反映。1,307人の確認症例、377人死亡、行方不明患者297人という管理可能性の低さが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ระยองผวา! พิษสุนัขบ้าระบาด 2 อำเภอ ชาวบ้านถูกกัด 3 ราย เร่งประกาศเขตโรคระบาดชั่วคราว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rayong in panic! Rabies outbreak in two districts; three residents bitten; authorities rush to declare a temporary outbreak zone.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak declared in Rayong Province, Thailand, affecting Klaeng and Nikhom Phatthana districts. Three residents were bitten and hospitalized for immediate rabies vaccination; two dogs and two cats were also bitten, with the index dog dying. A Temporary Outbreak Zone has been proclaimed under the Animal Epidemic Act B.E. 2558 to curb transmission. In Klaeng, the cluster centers at Ban Huai Hin (Moo 3, Ban Na) with extended coverage to Moo 8, Tambon Cham Kho, Amphoe Khao Chamao, and Moo 3, 6, 7, 8, 11 of Ban Na within a 5-km radius, effective 29 Jun 2569–28 Jul 2569. Residents are advised to monitor pets (dogs and cats), report aggressive or ill animals within 7 days, and not move animals in/out of the outbreak area without veterinary approval; violations carry up to 2 years’ imprisonment and fines up to 40,000 baht. In Moo 2, Ban Phananikom, Nikhom Phatthana, dogs are also infected; no human/pet bites reported yet, but vigilance urged.

triage.headline_ja: レヨン県大パニック！狂犬病が2郡で発生、住民3人が咬まれ、当局は一時的な流行地域の宣言を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: タイにおける狂犬病のアウトブレイク報告。人間と動物の両方に影響し、複数地域で確認、当局が臨時的な流行地域宣言を実施。IHR基準「異常/予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、スクリーニング基準「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に複数該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的な人獣共通感染症であり、タイのレヨン県での複数地区での同時発生は公衆衛生上の脅威。当局が臨時流行地域宣言を実施し、移動制限措置を発令。人間3名の咬傷被害と複数動物の感染確認により、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: un cas positif détecté à Kisangani après le transport d'un corps depuis l'épicentre de Niania
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: A positive case detected in Kisangani after the transport of a body from the epicenter of Niania.
article.articleSummary: Positive Ebola case detected in Kisangani after transport of a deceased woman from Niania, epicentre of the 17th outbreak. A sample from the deceased, a six-month pregnant woman, tested positive; virological confirmation is pending at INRB, Kinshasa. Symptoms appeared June 18, hemorrhagic signs June 24, death June 27. The body left Niania June 28 and, after transit through multiple zones, reached Kisangani morgue; authorities warn of transmission risk from non-secure corpse movement and note a post-mortem cesarean request as a major risk factor. In Tshopo, twelve alerts were validated; nine results available; three samples from deceased invalid awaiting re-certification at INRB. Three bodies arrived at an entry point. Contact tracing is ongoing with reinforced controls and secure burial protocols. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, epicentre Ituri; response emphasizes early detection and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ニアニア震源地から遺体搬送後、キサンガニで陽性例を検出
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の確認例が検出され、遺体の不安全な移動による二次感染リスク、接触者追跡が進行中。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）該当、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Republic of Mali」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）内での発生のみを記述しており、マリでの感染は言及されていない。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo Ebola virus による進行中の outbreak（5月15日宣言）であり、複数の州（Tshopo、Ituri）での多地点検出と遺体の不安全な移動による拡散リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: برنامج أممي: "إيبولا" قد يكلف أفريقيا 3.6 مليارات دولار ويفقدها عشرات آلاف الوظائف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A UN program: "Ebola" could cost Africa $3.6 billion and deprive it of tens of thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, the UN Development Programme warns that an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and erase tens of thousands of jobs. AFP cites that the epidemic may trigger a broad social‑economic crisis, pushing about 985,000 people into poverty and undermining education, health services, and food security. Even with containment in DRC and Uganda, regional spillovers could reduce Africa’s GDP by roughly $2.37 billion and eliminate more than 55,000 jobs in the DRC alone, with total GDP losses exceeding $1 billion there. The crisis could be amplified by trade disruptions and regional tensions, potentially risking 328,000 continental jobs if linked to Middle East conflict. Neighboring countries at risk include Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan; the WHO cites a 70% chance of Ebola reaching South Sudan. UNDP recommends direct cash transfers, targeted consumption support, diagnostics‑driven border measures instead of blanket closures, and emergency funding to protect reproductive, maternal, and child health during the response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連プログラム：「エボラ」がアフリカに36億ドルの損失と数万人の失業をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の発生は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、経済・貿易への多大な影響を示唆しており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ発生が主要な主題であるが、対象国リストを参照するとDRC（203312）のみが該当する。ウガンダ（226074）、ルワンダ（49518）、南スーダン（366755）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事は2026年7月1日配信で、すでに発生中の事態に関する経済影響評価である。WHO・UNDP からの公式見解が含まれており、信頼度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Flood victims in Accra to receive free NHIS registration as health authorities warn of disease risk
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, flood-impacted residents of Accra will receive free National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) registration to improve healthcare access amid rising diarrhoea and cholera risk. The National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA) says the measure will cover victims and dependants, removing financial barriers to care as sanitation systems were disrupted and water sources contaminated. NHIA Chief Executive Dr Victor Asare Bampoe emphasizes safeguarding public health and enabling timely treatment during floods. Officials warn of potential diarrhoea and cholera outbreaks in flood-hit communities and urge residents to maintain hygiene and seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop. The article notes no case/death counts, and provides no details on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: アクラの洪水被害者が無料NHIS登録を受け取る一方、保健当局は疾病リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ガーナのアクラで洪水に伴うコレラリスクが警告されているが、現在までに確認された症例がなく、情報が限定的。潜在的なリスクの警告段階であるため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防的な保健当局の警告段階であり、現在までのコレラ確認症例数は報告されていない。洪水によるサニテーション施設破壊と水源汚染により、アウトブレイクリスクが存在。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性（洪水による異常な衛生状況）、長期曝露（継続的な汚染水源）、流行しやすさ（衛生不十分・ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）の3項目に該当。今後の確認症例報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rusaknya Hutan Mangrove Dinilai Jadi Biang Kerok Tingginya Kasus Malaria di Pesawaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Destruction of Mangrove Forests Seen as the Main Culprit Behind the High Incidence of Malaria in Pesawaran
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreaks in Pesawaran, Lampung, are linked to mangrove destruction for tourism projects, with rehabilitation efforts criticized as ceremonial. Since 2007 mangrove loss accelerated and intensified around 2009 after coastal zoning revisions converting mangrove areas into shrimp ponds. Abandoned brackish ponds trap stagnant water, creating ideal habitat for Anopheles larvae and fueling malaria transmission. Workers in shrimp ponds often labored without protection, enabling spread to households when they returned home. The ecological chain was disrupted; mangrove roots host small fish that prey on larvae, reducing vector populations when intact. The situation drew national and international attention, with University of Indonesia medical students conducting field studies and external drug shipments arriving at Puskesmas Hanura to curb mortality. Fatalities included local residents and migrant workers, such as a Bandung-born project worker and the wife of a TNI officer, with health data drawn from a Health Department draft.

triage.headline_ja: マングローブ林の破壊がペサワラン地域のマラリア高症例の主原因と判断
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるマラリア発生が確認されており、スクリーニング基準において異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当する可能性がある。しかし、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行期間などの定量的データが不足しており、現時点では情報収集段階の判定が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事は2007年以降のマラリア発生を述べており、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行のピークなどの定量情報が不足している。ただし、死亡例の存在、医療物資供給、大学による調査活動など国家的関心が示唆されている。マングローブ破壊と媒介蚊ハビタット形成の因果関係が示されており、環境的リスク要因が明確。続報で患者数や流行期間の詳細が得られれば判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : crise majeure
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: A Major Crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are the worst in years, with 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths (case fatality rate 29%). About 297 cases are untraced, raising concerns of broader transmission. Kinshasa has ordered quarantine, bans on gatherings, and suspended flights to Bunia to contain the virus. Ituri Province offers free care, but resources are limited and isolation centers are overwhelmed. The outbreak has crossed borders, with one confirmed case in Uganda and a French clinician infected, highlighting cross-border spread. Central Africa faces strained health facilities and escalating risk of uncontrolled spread unless uncounted infections are curtailed and support improves. Monitoring of the evolving crisis is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：主要な危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、1,307確定例、377死亡（致命率29%）、国際的な越境感染、医療体制の逼迫が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大。キンシャサとイトゥリ州での複数発生地。297例の未追跡例から市中感染の拡大が懸念される。ウガンダとフランスへの越境感染確認。隔離施設の飽和、医療資源の不足が報告されている。フルのリスク評価（RRA）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: H9N2, H5N1, and H5N2 Are All Being Monitored for Human Risk -- Here Is the Honest State of Avian Flu in 2026
article.articleSummary: In mid-2026 three avian influenza strains—H5N1, H5N2, and H9N2—are circulating in birds and monitored for human risk. H5N1, the strain most affecting Americans, has 71 confirmed U.S. human cases through early 2026 with 2 deaths, all linked to direct animal contact; no human-to-human transmission has been confirmed in the United States. Globally, 1,022 cumulative H5N1 cases since 1997, with milder illness observed in the cattle-adapted U.S. clade so far. Real risk is occupational for dairy workers, poultry workers, veterinarians, and others in close contact with cattle or poultry; PPE reduces risk. H5N2 caused a single fatal human case in Mexico in 2024; no further infections, current risk considered low. H9N2 reports five human cases in Q1 2026—four in China, one in Italy (exposed traveler to Senegal); no transmission to close contacts, general population risk remains low. Ongoing surveillance emphasizes the possibility that any strain could mutate to enable human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: H9N2、H5N1、H5N2が全て人間へのリスクについて監視されている――2026年の鳥インフルエンザの本当の状態
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の継続的なヒト感染（71例、死亡2例）とH9N2の複数国での新規ヒト感染報告（中国4例、イタリア1例）により、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。重症度基準も満たし、継続的な国際的監視が必要。

verified_locations.name: Italy (not in target list but noted for H9N2 case)

triage.notes: 記事サマリーの検証：H5N1は米国で71例（対象国外）、H5N2はメキシコで1例（対象国外）。H9N2は中国4例（対象国：1814991）とイタリア1例（対象国外）。対象国に該当するのは中国のみ。ただしH5N1の継続的なヒト感染とグローバルな監視状況、複数菌株の同時循環という特性から、国際的なシグナルとして重要度が高い。イタリアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外するが、感染症の国際的拡大を示す重要な指標。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo já soma 7 casos de sarampo neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The State of São Paulo already has 7 measles cases this year.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo State, Brazil, with seven confirmed cases this year. Two new infections in the capital— a six‑month‑old infant and a 20‑year‑old mother of a previously diagnosed child— detected near Guarulhos. Earlier, three additional cases were reported in São Paulo city, all in children aged six months to one year. Health authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations to identify the infection source and interrupt transmission. To protect vulnerable infants, the state advised parents of 6–11‑month‑olds in São Paulo or Guarulhos to receive the emergency dose (dose zero) of the measles‑mumps‑rubella vaccine; this does not replace the regular doses due at 12 and 15 months. Measles is a highly contagious airborne disease; symptoms include high fever, cough, red eyes, runny nose, malaise, and a red rash. Vaccination is free via SUS; state coverage is 85.32% (first dose) and 72.06% (second dose).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州は今年すでに麻疹の7例を記録している
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生が確認され、6ヶ月から1歳の乳幼児を含む複数の症例が報告されている。ワクチン接種率が低く（第2回投与72.06%）、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高く、公衆衛生上の重症度が懸念される。
triage.notes: 麻疹は極めて感染力が高い空気感染性疾患であり、乳幼児（特に6-11ヶ月児）が脆弱層として特定されている。サンパウロ州保健当局は緊急接種キャンペーン（ゼロ回目）を実施中。ワクチン接種率が目標値以下（第2回投与72.06%）であることが懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : neuf malades d'Ebola en fuite après l'incendie d'un centre de traitement à Niania - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: nine Ebola patients on the run after the fire at a treatment center in Niania - ACP
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola patients fled the Bafwabango Ebola Treatment Center in Niania, Mambasa Territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, after a criminal fire set by a hostile crowd. The center housed two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and seven suspected cases; the nine patients remain unaccounted for, raising fears of further community transmission in northern DRC. The incident followed resistance to handing over the body of a person suspected to have died from Ebola. At PK 51, authorities report around ten deaths, and a body tested positive was removed from its coffin and carried by the crowd, increasing transmission risk, according to Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, the health zone chief. Alexis Mungaki, head of groupement Ngayo, lamented the loss of the healthcare facility, undermining outbreak response in the area and heightening the threat of community spread in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥーリ州：ニアニア地区の治療センター火災後、エボラ患者9人が逃げ出す - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例および疑い例9人が治療施設から脱出し、地域内での二次感染拡大の直接的リスクが存在。IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当し、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）でも重要な懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥーリ州マンバサ地域）での発生を明確に示している。Bluedot APIが「マリ共和国」を発生地域に含めているが、サマリー本文では言及されておらず、実際の感染症イベントはDRCのみで発生している。脱出患者の行方不明と地域社会での遺体搬送による高い感染リスク、および保健施設の喪失による対応能力低下が、直ちの懸念材料となる。
