article.articleHeadline: 38 de larve de tenie găsite în creierul unei femei. S-ar fi infectat după vacanţa mult visată în India
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 38 tapeworm larvae found in a woman's brain. She is believed to have contracted the infection after the long-awaited vacation in India.
article.articleSummary: A Welsh woman, 42-year-old Lowri Denman, developed neurocysticercosis after a three-month trip to India in 2007. CT/MRI later showed 38 Taenia solium larvae in her brain. Symptoms appeared years after travel—severe migraines, speech difficulties, seizures and memory loss—and initial tests in 2010 were inconclusive. The eggs were likely ingested via contaminated water, inadequately washed produce, or poorly hygienic food handling. Neurocysticercosis occurs when larval cysts reach the CNS; eggs in water or food can transmit infection, not only undercooked pork. Treatment combined antiparasitic drugs and corticosteroids; surgery was not pursued and the larvae calcified. Since 2017 she has had no seizures and remains on antiepileptic therapy. WHO notes neurocysticercosis is a major epilepsy cause in Asia, Africa and Latin America; in Europe/UK it is rare and travel-related. Prevention emphasizes safe water, produce washing and hygiene. Specialists call this case highly complex by UK infectious-disease experts, with US input.

triage.headline_ja: 38本の裂頭条虫幼虫が女性の脳から発見。インドの長く待ち望まれていた休暇後に感染したと考えられている。
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症の輸入症例（イギリス・ウェールズ）で、アジアにおける重要な神経感染症として認識されているが、発症が2007年の旅行後で、現在は2026年と既に19年経過しており、新規の流行リスクは限定的。情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2007年のインド渡航後、19年経過した既往症例（患者は英国ウェールズ在住）を報道したもの。インドは神経嚢虫症の感染地として記述されているが、現在のインドにおける流行状況や新規リスクについては情報が不足している。輸入症例として公衆衛生上の関心は認められるが、急性の流行リスクではないため WATCH に分類。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue em Tubarão se intensifica com 628 focos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue in Tubarão intensifies with 628 hotspots.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-01, Tubarão, Brazil reports 628 Aedes aegypti foci identified since January, with locally transmitted dengue evidenced by five autochthonous cases and one hospitalization due to complications. A total of 117 suspected dengue notifications were recorded; 111 were ruled out by laboratory testing, one case awaits results, and five confirmed infections indicate ongoing local transmission. Vector hotspots are widespread, led by Centro (67), Humaitá de Cima (59), Revoredo (52), Vila Moema (50), and Oficinas (44); other areas include Humaitá, Recife, Dehon, and Morrotes. The Aedes aegypti vector also transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Preventive guidance calls for collective action to eliminate standing water, keep water tanks sealed, clean gutters and drains, and inspect yards and cooling-tray areas. Residents can report suspected breeding sites to the municipal Ombudsman at (48) 3621-9051 or [email protected] to guide control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ツバラオ市のデング熱対策が628の蚊の発生源で激化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱、ジカ、チクングニア熱の同時流行リスク。5件の自動輸入症例と入院例が確認され、地域での持続的な伝播が示唆されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストにイタリア（Emilia-Romagna）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのツバラオのみに言及しており、イタリアは除外。デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア熱の3疾患が同時に報告され、蚊の幼虫発生源が628カ所に及ぶなど、ベクター制御の課題が深刻。5件の確認症例と1件の入院例は地域での持続的伝播を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Floods raise cholera risk: GHS urges public to follow health precautions
article.articleSummary: Floodwaters in Ghana's Greater Accra Region heighten the risk of cholera and other waterborne diseases such as typhoid fever and dysentery. Following the rainy season public health alert, the Ghana Health Service (GHS) warns that contaminated floodwaters can taint drinking water and food, accelerating outbreaks if preventive measures are ignored. To mitigate risk, GHS advises residents, especially in flood-affected communities, to drink only treated or safe water, maintain hand hygiene with soap under running water, and ensure proper food preparation and storage. Food vendors should wash and cook thoroughly, protect meals from flies and dust, and use clean water. Public health guidance includes avoiding food or water that may have contacted floodwater, clearing choked drains, eliminating stagnant water, and proper waste disposal. People with severe diarrhoea, vomiting, fever, or dehydration should seek immediate medical care rather than self-medicating. Continued vigilance during the rains is urged.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水がコレラのリスクを増加させる：ガーナ保健局が公衆衛生予防措置を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コレラと腸チフスのリスク警告が発令されており、洪水による水系感染症拡大の懸念がある。ただし現在のところ実際のアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、予防警告段階であるため、情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水シーズンに伴うコレラ・腸チフスのリスク警告で、現在のところ確認されたアウトブレイク数は記載されていない。環境要因（洪水）による継続的な曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性のある水系感染症、対象国（ガーナ）への該当により、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。しかし実患者数や重症度の情報が不足しており、現段階ではWATCHに分類。続報で実患者確認やアウトブレイク報告があればPICKUPに昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Boi: segunda etapa de vacinação do rebanho contra brucelose começa nesta quarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boi: Second phase of herd vaccination against brucellosis begins this Wednesday.
article.articleSummary: Second phase of the brucellosis vaccination campaign in the State of São Paulo, Brazil, begins Wednesday, July 1, and runs through December 31. The Defesa Agropecuária, within the Secretaria de Agricultura e Abastecimento (SAA), urges vaccination of bovine and buffalo calves aged 3 to 8 months during this stage. Because the vaccine is live and can pose an infection risk to handlers, vaccination must be performed by a registered veterinarian who ensures proper administration and issues a vaccination certificate to the producer. The phase aims to strengthen brucellosis control in cattle and buffalo populations across São Paulo state, with implementation coordinated by the state agricultural agency.

triage.headline_ja: ウシ：ブルセラ症に対する畜群ワクチン接種の第2段階が今週水曜日に開始
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症は家畜に対する定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、既知の予防対策の実施。ヒト感染の報告や異常な発生ではなく、通常の公衆衛生措置として分類される。
triage.notes: 本記事はブルセラ症に対する家畜ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進行状況を報じるもの。疾患発生のシグナルではなく、既知の感染症に対する定期的な防疫対策の実施通知。ヒト感染例やアウトブレイクの報告なし。対象国外のイベントのため、トリアージレベルは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Diare di Garut Meningkat selama Musim Kemarau, 17.339 Warga Terjangkit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diarrhea Cases in Garut Increase During the Dry Season, 17,339 Residents Affected
article.articleSummary: Diarrhea cases in Garut Regency, West Java, rose significantly in the first half of 2026, with 17,339 residents infected from January to June. Health officials say the surge aligns with a prolonged dry season, as reduced clean-water supply and poor adherence to Clean Living Behavior (PHBS) drive transmission. Of the total, 4,789 patients (22.8%) were under five years old. Symptoms reported include diarrhea plus cough, fever, flu, and itching or rashes. Dietary triggers and extreme weather are cited as contributing factors, with dehydration a particular risk for children if not promptly treated. Puskesmas staff are intensifying PHBS education, urging handwashing with soap and nutritious diets. Parents are advised to bring children to Puskesmas or the nearest hospital at the first sign of fever, respiratory symptoms, or diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: ガルート地区の下痢症例が乾季中に増加、17,339人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は下痢症（diarrhea）であり、インフルエンザではない。Bluedot APIの疾患名タグが誤っている。下痢症は季節性環境因子（乾季による清潔な水の不足）に関連した予想可能な公衆衛生イベントであり、IHR基準もWPRO基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの疾患名フィールドでInfluenzaがタグ付けされているが、記事サマリーは明確に下痢症（diarrhea）を主題としており、乾季中の水不足と衛生習慣に関連した季節的公衆衛生対応である。地域保健スタッフ（Puskesmas）による標準的な健康教育対応が実施中であり、特段の国際的懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept directs DCs to stay on alert over malaria cases
article.articleSummary: Four cerebral malaria deaths in Potka block, East Singhbhum, triggered Jharkhand’s health department to direct district administrations to stay on alert and implement immediate, comprehensive malaria controls. Additional Chief Secretary (Health) Ajoy Kumar Singh ordered surveys in fever-prone areas, universal testing of suspected malaria cases, and immediate anti-malarial treatment for positives. If any case is detected, a mandatory mass fever survey must be conducted; village-wise malaria data should be compiled; rapid diagnostic test kits and essential anti-malarials must be supplied to community health workers in highly affected villages. Medical officers to conduct weekly CHC reviews; district civil surgeons to hold fortnightly reviews biweekly; deputy commissioners to hold monthly reviews with health officials. Ensure stock of malaria test kits and medicines at CHCs. Jharkhand tallied 12,342 malaria cases Jan–May (8,034 Jan–Apr; 4,308 in May), with West Singhbhum 4,891; East Singhbhum 4,822; and Godda 874 in May.

triage.headline_ja: 保健部門が マラリア症例に対し警戒態勢を指示
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャールカンド州で脳性マラリアによる死亡者が発生し、公衆衛生上の重大な影響があり、州保健部門が緊急対応を指示している。IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ジャールカンド州ポトカ地域での脳性マラリア死亡（4例）が直接的なトリガー。2026年1月～5月間で12,342例のマラリア症例が確認されており、東シングバム地区で4,822例と高い患者数がある。州政府が包括的な対応を指示している。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: El calvario de una inglesa con neurocisticercosis y 38 parásitos en su cerebro tras un viaje a India
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ordeal of an Englishwoman with Neurocysticercosis and 38 Parasites in Her Brain After a Trip to India.
article.articleSummary: An Englishwoman developed neurocysticercosis after a 2007 three-month visit to India, harboring 38 Taenia solium larvae in her brain. Over nearly 20 years she endured epilepsy, psychiatric hospitalization, and erratic behavior; at one point she behaved like a five-year-old. Doctors in the UK called the case unique. Diagnosis and pathophysiology were explained with CDC notes: ingestion of eggs leads to intestinal hatch and larvae traveling to the brain to form cysts. After starting treatment, her condition gradually improved; by 2018 she could live independently after moving to her father’s home, and by 2022 she led a near-normal life. The case is notable as an imported neurocysticercosis case from India and a rare presentation that English clinicians may never see again.

triage.headline_ja: インド旅行後の脳嚢虫症：イギリス人女性の脳内に38匹の寄生虫を保有していた症例
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例報告であり、国際的な公衆衛生危機を示す根拠がない。イギリスでの局所的な臨床教育事例であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド訪問時の感染から19年後のイギリスでの治療経過を扱う個別症例報告である。発生地域にイギリスが含まれているが、実際の感染源はインドであり、イギリスでの流行を示す根拠はない。神経嚢虫症（Neurocysticercosis）は既知の風土病であり、個別の輸入症例はシグナルとして該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: डिप्टी सीएम ने लोहिया संस्थान से संचारी रोग अभियान का किया शुभारंभ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: Deputy Chief Minister inaugurates the communicable disease campaign at Lohia Institute
article.articleSummary: In Lucknow, on July 1, 2026, Deputy Chief Minister Brijesh Pathak inaugurated a communicable disease control and awareness campaign at Lohia Institute. He said dengue and malaria cases have substantially declined, and emphasized that full control requires active public participation. The government conducts three such campaigns annually; residents must keep homes and surroundings clean to prevent transmission. He highlighted preventing mosquito larvae as the most effective measure to avert dengue, malaria, encephalitis, and chikungunya, since dengue can rapidly reduce platelet counts. Pathak interacted with MBBS first-year and BSc nursing students in the institute, asking about meals and hostel facilities, and urged continued attention to nutrition, promising to join a meal with students someday. The program was attended by Amit Kumar Ghosh (Secretary, Health and Medical Education), Health Director General Pawan Kumar Arun, Chief Medical Officer N.B. Singh, and Institute Director Dr. C.M. Singh.

triage.headline_ja: ラッキーノウのニュース：副首相がロヒア研究所で感染症対策キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、脳炎）が言及されており、地域での感染症対策キャンペーンが実施されている。しかし、記事は主に公衆衛生キャンペーン活動の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクの詳細な疫学情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのウッタル・プラデーシュ州ラッキーノウでの感染症対策キャンペーンの公式発表である。デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、脳炎が言及されており、蚊媒介感染症の季節性と継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念が示唆されている。しかし、具体的な患者数、死亡数、または異常な増加の報告がないため、シグナル強度は中程度である。引き続き疾病監視データの更新を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع صادم في الإصابات بإيبولا في الكونغو إلى أكثر من 1300 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking surge in Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to more than 1,300 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths as of July 1, 2026, with infections centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the eastern part of the country. The outbreak, first declared May 15, continues under containment measures by local authorities. The affected area has seen cross-border spillover into Uganda, where the World Health Organization reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; Ugandan officials say the outbreak is under control. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Health authorities in both countries are closely coordinating with WHO and international partners to curb spread and prevent further spread beyond the affected provinces and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者が1,300例を超える急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。大規模で継続中の確認患者数（1,333例、399死亡）、国際的な越境拡大（ウガンダ20例2死亡）、ワクチン・治療法の不在があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの越境拡大（20例2死亡）が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）が主題であり、ワクチン・有効治療法不在の点が管理上の懸念を高める。2026年5月15日に宣言されたアウトブレイクが7月1日時点で1,300例以上に達しており、急速な拡大傾向が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Francia confirma el primer caso de ébola en Europa mientras el brote del Congo se convierte en el más rápido de la historia africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France confirms the first case of Ebola in Europe as the Congo outbreak becomes the fastest in African history.
article.articleSummary: France confirms its first Ebola case in Europe after a healthcare worker returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive and was promptly isolated and hospitalized. The case appears amid a central African outbreak of Ebola virus Bundibugyo—described as the fastest-growing in Africa—triggering a 21-day contact-tracing quarantine for identified contacts. The Congo–Uganda emergency was declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026. As of the prior week, the DRC outbreak totaled 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths, with Ituri Province accounting for 997 cases across 22 health zones, followed by North Kivu (94) and South Kivu (3). Authorities stress that Ebola spreads via bodily fluids, not via air, and emphasize containment measures; there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though candidates are under evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが欧州での初のエボラ症例を確認、一方コンゴのアウトブレイクはアフリカ史上最速に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）既宣言、1000例以上の確定症例と高死亡率、欧州への人的移動による国際的拡大が現実化。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例報告は欧州への拡大を示すが、発生地は依然としてDRCが中心。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーではDRC南キブ州での3例のみ言及され、ウガンダでの発症確認は記載されていないため verified_locations から除外。本イベントは既にWHO PHEICとして認識されており、迅速な国際対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda etapa da campanha de vacinação contra a Brucelose começa nesta quarta-feira (1)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second phase of the brucellosis vaccination campaign begins this Wednesday (1).
article.articleSummary: Second phase of brucellosis vaccination begins July 1, 2026, in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, targeting bovines and buffaloes aged 3–8 months; the campaign runs through December 31, 2026. Vaccines are live, so vaccination must be performed by a registered veterinarian who issues a vaccination certificate to the producer. The vaccination calendar is established by SAA Resolution 78/24 and Portarias 33/24 and 34/24. A list of registered veterinarians is available online. After vaccination, the veterinarian must register the vaccination in GEDAVE within four days; if the herd balance is updated, the system may declare automatically. Discrepancies trigger notifications to the producer and vet by email, requiring correction. Since October 2024, São Paulo uses ear buttons for identification: yellow for B19-vaccinated animals and blue for RB51-vaccinated females; buttons are optional and valid only within São Paulo. If a button is unavailable, identification must follow PNCEBT rules. Keywords: vaccination, brucellosis, São Paulo, Brazil, GEDAVE, PNCEBT.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症予防接種キャンペーンの第2段階が水曜日（1日）に開始
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは動物（ウシ、スイギュウ）を対象とした予防接種キャンペーンであり、人間への感染リスクや公衆衛生上の懸念を示す事象ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブルセラ症の動物ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する公式通知である。動物衛生プログラムの一環であり、人間の感染症発生ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Rientra dall'India con 38 parassiti nel cervello: la storia choc di una 42enne del Galles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back from India with 38 parasites in her brain: the shocking story of a 42-year-old Welsh woman
article.articleSummary: Welsh 42-year-old Lowri Denman developed neurocysticercosis after a three-month trip to India in 2007, ultimately harboring 38 Taenia solium larvae in her brain. The infestation produced severe headaches, epileptic seizures, brain swelling, and psychosis, crippling her autonomy. A stray worm found in a bathroom and subsequent brain imaging led to the diagnosis in 2011, after an initial consideration of toxoplasmosis. The infection—transmitted via ingestion of Taenia solium eggs from contaminated pork, water, or poor hygiene according to the WHO—remains very rare in the United Kingdom. Denman received two weeks of antiparasitic therapy with steroids; for years the treatment appeared to help. Relapses and later brain swelling around the parasites precipitated confusion, sensory and motor difficulties, and a six-week neuropsychiatric hospitalization. Now recovering, she speaks out to raise awareness of neurocysticercosis and its potential, delayed consequences.

triage.headline_ja: インドから帰国後、脳内に38匹の寄生虫：ウェールズの42歳女性の衝撃的な事例
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症は個別症例であり、公衆衛生上の集団感染ではない。インドでの感染後、イギリスで診断された稀な輸入症例であり、現在の流行状況を示すシグナルではない。ただし、稀有疾患の認識向上価値があり情報継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: インドでの感染後、ウェールズ（イギリス）で診断された個別症例の報道。イギリスでの二次感染リスクはなく、稀な輸入症例。サマリーは患者の啓発活動と個人の医学的経験に焦点を当てており、新規流行や集団発生を示していない。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango/Choléra : l'exécutif octroie des médicaments et intrants renforcer la riposte à Popokabaka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwango/Cholera: the government allocates medicines and inputs to reinforce the response in Popokabaka
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Popokabaka territory, Kwango province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts the provincial government to reinforce the response with a large shipment of medicines and health inputs. Governor Willy Bitwisila ordered the emergency on 30 June 2026, less than 24 hours after the outbreak declaration. A convoy from Kenge to Kinshasa retrieved medicines from the National Cholera Elimination and Diarrhoeal Diseases program (PNECHOL-MD) and arrived in Popokabaka on 1 July at about 1:30 a.m., enabling rapid initial actions. The kit comprises 48 lots of medicines, antibiotics, IV fluids, rapid diagnostic tests, chlorine, and other inputs for patient care, contact prophylaxis, household disinfection, and water chlorination. The handover occurred at the Popokabaka Zone de Santé central office with Dr Alain Mboko; Dr Alex Ibanda Matondo, governor’s envoy, supervised transport and highlighted provincial commitment to protecting populations and quickly containing transmission. Deployment to the most affected health areas began the same day.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ州／コレラ：政府がポポカバカでの対応強化に向け医薬品と保健資機材を配分
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国クワンゴ州ポポカバカでのコレラ発生は、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際拡大リスクの2項目以上に該当し、さらにWPRO基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、対応の管理可能性が問題となるシグナルである。
triage.notes: コレラは国際的に報告義務のある疾患であり、DRCでの発生は地域の公衆衛生脅威を示す。政府が緊急対応を発令し医薬品・保健資機材を迅速に展開している点から、既に相応の規模と認識されている。記事サマリーから症例数や死亡数などの重症度の具体的情報は不明だが、これは継続報道で補完される見込み。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी में पशुओं को गलाघोंटू से बचाने के लिए 15 जुलाई तक चलेगा टीकाकरण अभियान, पशुधन मंत्री ने दिए सख्त आदेश - up animal vaccination drive galaghonthu by july 15 fmd soon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination drive to protect animals in Uttar Pradesh from foot-and-mouth disease will run until July 15; Animal Husbandry Minister has issued strict orders.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination in Uttar Pradesh will begin July 22, after a prior drive against hemorrhagic septicemia (HS) runs through July 15. Health minister Dharampal Singh directed officials to strengthen the vaccine cold chain and logistics, and to engage farmers through village outreach. Teams will perform on‑farm health checks and train livestock owners to recognise infectious disease symptoms. The campaign emphasizes biosecurity and timely vaccination, and will be publicized at markets, cattle fairs, and other public spaces. A toll‑free helpline, 1800‑180‑5141, will be promoted to provide information on infectious diseases. HS is a bacterial disease that predominantly affects cattle and buffaloes, often causing death; FMD is a viral disease affecting cattle, buffaloes, goats, sheep, and pigs. No case counts or outbreaks are reported.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州での動物の口蹄疫予防のための予防接種キャンペーンが7月15日まで実施される。動物衛生相が厳格な指示を発出
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の予防接種キャンペーンについて述べた記事であり、具体的な患者発症例やアウトブレイク報告がない。既知疾患の予防活動であり、IHR基準も適用されない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに『患者数やアウトブレイクの報告なし』と明記されており、これは既知疾患に対する定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの公示である。動物疾患に関する記事であるが、公衆衛生的な懸念（異常、重症度、国際拡大リスク）は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 38 wards across 11 districts account for 80 per cent TB burden in Delhi: Officials
article.articleSummary: 38 wards across 11 Delhi districts account for over 80% of the city’s high-risk TB burden, prompting precision-targeted interventions. In a review with Union Health Minister JP Nadda, Delhi officials reported: 28.83 lakh people screened, 21.67 lakh chest X-rays, 3.65 lakh NAAT tests, and 1.75 lakh TB cases notified. Officials urged upfront NAAT testing for presumptive and drug-resistant TB alongside X-ray screening, and 100% TB-patient assessment for differentiated care. They called for expanded TB preventive treatment for household contacts and other eligible vulnerable groups, and broader psychosocial support via Ni-kshay Mitras and MY Bharat volunteers. Strengthened coordination with RWAs, ward committees, and elected representatives was recommended. AI-driven vulnerability mapping identified 1.58 lakh high-risk villages/wards nationally; for Delhi, focus remains on the 38 wards. Nadda urged Jan Bhagidari, with ward-level senior officers and active MY Bharat volunteers driving community mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: デリーの38の区が全市のTB負担の80%を占める：当局者
triage.triage_reason: インドのデリーにおけるTB患者の地理的集中と管理戦略に関する報告。結核は深刻な公衆衛生課題だが、本記事は既知の流行地域における対策の進捗報告であり、新規の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは明示されていない。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーにおけるTB管理プログラムの進捗報告であり、Union Health Ministerが関与しているため政府レベルの関心は確認される。しかし、記事は既知の流行地域における精密ターゲット介入の実施に焦点があり、新規の異常事態（unusual event）は報告されていない。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響）。国際的拡大リスクは記述されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Έως 3,6 δις δολάρια το κόστος από το ξέσπασμα του Έμπολα στην Αφρική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Up to $3.6 billion in costs due to the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province in the northeast, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or specific therapy. As of 2026-07-01, WHO confirms 1,333 confirmed cases, 399 deaths, and 189 recoveries. The UN Development Programme (UNDP) warns the crisis is evolving into a broader socio-economic emergency, risking about 55,000 jobs and more than $1 billion in DRC GDP losses, with Africa-wide GDP potentially contracting by about $2.37 billion even if the outbreak is controlled. The outbreak compounds conflict and humanitarian strain in Ituri, impacting employment, education, food security, trade, public finances, and public trust. UNDP urges immediate actions: direct cash support to the most vulnerable, targeted health screenings instead of blanket border closures, and emergency financing to sustain maternal, reproductive, and child health services.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイクにより最大36億ドルの経済的損失の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な経済・社会的波及、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、高い流行性、管理可能性の懸念）。エボラウイルス疾患の確認症例1,333件、死亡399件という深刻な状況が社会的・政治的関心を喚起している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス疾患の大規模アウトブレイク。DRC北東部Ituri州が震源地。確認症例1,333件、死亡399件、回復189件（2026-07-01現在）。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がない状況。UNDPが経済的影響（GDP損失$1-2.37億ドル）と社会的影響（失業約55,000件）を警告。紛争地帯での対応という複合的な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: The US Built an Ebola Response Network. Why Isn't It the Center of the Current Response? | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: NETEC and the National Emerging Special Pathogens Training and Education Center underpin the US National Special Pathogen System, a tiered network ensuring regional Level 1 RESPTCs with biocontainment capacity and trained staff. Thirteen Level 1 RESPTCs operate nationwide, coordinated by NETEC and funded by Congress. Amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda—1,274 confirmed in the DRC and 20 in Uganda as of June 29—there is no licensed vaccine or antiviral. Yet the federal response appears detached from this network: Title 42 bars foreign nationals who recently visited outbreak areas, while guidance directs exposed citizens abroad for quarantine (Kenya) or evacuates positive cases to a designated safe location with no stated home option; the only US citizen known to test positive was evacuated to Germany. Congress has pressed for a public Ebola response plan naming chain of command and home-treatment protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が構築したエボラ対応ネットワーク。なぜそれが現在の対応の中心になっていないのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaは致死率の高い新興病原体であり、米国市民が感染・国際移送されている。現在の対応枠組みの機能性に関する重要な政策的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の発生地はDRC（1,274確定症例）とウガンダ（20症例）。米国はケースの国際移送地としての登場だが、イベントの地理的焦点はアフリカ域内。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaは新興病原体で、ワクチンなし・抗ウイルス薬なしという治療困難性が強調されている。米国の政策的対応枠組みの不十分性が国家レベルで議論されており、シグナルとしてのピックアップ優先度は高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: What is Ebola and are there cases in the UK?
article.articleSummary: Ebola, a rare but often deadly virus, prompted precautionary testing in Scotland after a patient at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow was suspected of infection. The test result was negative, and Public Health Scotland and NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde said there was no ward closure and no public-health risk. The UK has not had a confirmed case since outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda in May; previously, three health workers were treated in the UK in 2014–2015 with no onward transmission. Background cases include nurse Pauline Cafferkey (2014) and a 2022 Colchester hospital scare that was negative. The Returning Workers Scheme (RWS) was activated to monitor staff travelling to affected areas; travellers undergo contact tracing, clinical assessment and precautionary testing. Incubation is 2–21 days, with early symptoms like fever, headache and tiredness, and progression to vomiting, diarrhoea, organ failure, and possible bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとは何か、そしてUKに症例があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダで確認されたエボラ症例が報告されているが、UKでの疑い患者は陰性確認され、公衆衛生リスクはないとされている。ただし対象国（DRC）での流行の可能性があり、情報収集の継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCおよびウガンダでの5月のアウトブレイク言及があるが、UgandaはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。UKでの疑い患者は陰性確認されており、当該国での公衆衛生リスクは低いと評価される。IHR基準は2つ以上該当するがWPRO基準も複数該当し、DRC流行の詳細情報が不足しているため WATCH 判定。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Žiaurus likimo pokštas: moteris suvalgė užkrėstos kiaulienos ir smegenyse prisiveisė parazitų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Cruel Twist of Fate: A Woman Ate Infected Pork and Parasites Settled in Her Brain
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis from Taenia solium larvae caused by undercooked pork infected during travel led to 38 brain parasites in 42-year-old Lowri Denman of Wales, United Kingdom. After a 2007 trip to India, she developed severe headaches, seizures, and later psychosis. Initial testing misidentified toxoplasmosis; CT/MRI confirmed 38 intracerebral cysts. Treatment included two weeks of antiparasitic drugs and steroids, but relapses followed, with brain swelling and psychiatric decline requiring a six-week neuropsychiatric hospitalization. The parasites calcified without surgical removal. Since 2017 she has had no seizures and will need lifelong antiepileptic medication. This remains a rare imported neurocysticercosis case in the UK. The infection is linked to consumption of contaminated pork, highlighting the global health relevance of Taenia solium exposure (per WHO).

triage.headline_ja: 残酷な運命の転機：女性が感染した豚肉を食べて脳に寄生虫を宿す
triage.triage_reason: 個別の輸入症例であり、2007年の古い感染事例の医学的フォローアップ報道。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないが、稀な神経嚢虫症（neurocysticercosis）の臨床例として公衆衛生上の教育的価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は英国ウェールズの個別症例の臨床経過報告。感染源は2007年のインド旅行中の汚染豚肉摂取。現在の流行状況を示すイベントではなく、医学的に稀な輸入症例の長期フォローアップであるため、IHR通知基準には該当しない。ただし、Taenia solium感染の国際的なリスク啓発として公衆衛生教育的な価値がある。情報は十分だが、流行性・拡大性・管理上の懸念がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Un tercio de la humanidad alberga este parásito sin saberlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One-third of humanity harbors this parasite without knowing it.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasmosis, caused by Toxoplasma gondii, infects about one third of humanity, typically lifelong and asymptomatic. Global prevalence is near 2 billion, with particularly high burden in Brazil’s poor regions (up to 80%) and about 10% in the United States. An international team led by Justine Smith (Flinders University) and João Furtado (University of São Paulo) argues that WHO should classify toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease (NTD) to unlock funding for research, prevention, and public‑health programs. Transmission occurs via cat feces, undercooked meat, and contaminated water/food; congenital infection can cause abortion or permanent fetal brain/eye damage, estimated at about 190,000 congenitally infected births annually (2013). Ocular toxoplasmosis is the most common intraocular infection worldwide, a major cause of vision loss. No vaccine exists; current medicines control but do not eradicate the parasite. Preventive steps include cooking meat thoroughly, washing produce, and hand hygiene, especially in pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: 人類の3分の1がこの寄生虫を知らないまま宿している
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は全人類の3分の1に感染しており、ブラジルでは高い有病率（最大80%）が報告されているが、本記事は主に流行学的啓発と疾病分類提言（NTD化）に焦点を当てており、急性的な感染症アウトブレイクではなく、慢性的な公衆衛生課題である。スクリーニング基準の複数該当は認められるが、情報不足かつ緊急度が低いため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: トキソプラズマ症は既知の風土病であり、本記事は新規発生ではなく、WHO公認のNTD（顧みられない熱帯病）としての分類と研究資金化を呼びかけるアドボカシー記事である。IHR基準2項目該当でWHO通知相当だが、これは慢性的な公衆衛生課題の認識向上キャンペーンであり、急性アウトブレイク対応を要するシグナルではない。ただし、ブラジルでの高有病率（80%）と先天性感染の重篤性（年19万件の先天性感染）は注視する価値がある。記事では米国も言及されているが、有病率10%で医学的な関心レベルであり、特別な感染症制御措置を示唆しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavirus verspreidt zich verder door Congo, vierde provincie bereikt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebolavirus spreads further across Congo; fourth province reached.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Congo reports 1,333 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases and 399 deaths over six weeks, a weekly increase of 294, making it the third-largest outbreak on record. The WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17. The Bundibugyo EBOV variant is involved; there is no vaccine in Congo. Cases have been reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with a possible first case in Haut-Uele near the South Sudan border. The Haut-Uele case involves a contact of an Ituri patient who was isolated but fled; the health ministry has not confirmed. Late detection is cited as fueling spread, according to Isidro Carrion-Martin of MSF. MSF notes that malaria and diarrheal disease burdens affect health-seeking behavior in the region. The African CDC has appealed for $18 million to accelerate experimental therapies; trials began this week in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ全域で拡大、4番目の州に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。1,333確定症例・399死亡、過去6週間で急速拡大、複数州への地理的拡大、WHO緊急事態宣言済み。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にスーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーではHaut-Uele(南スーダン国境近辺)での「可能性のある初例」言及のみであり、スーダンでの確実な発生報告なし。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo EBOV変異体関与、ワクチン未配備、MSF指摘による遅発検出が拡大を加速している。African CDC $1,800万ドル資金要求、実験的治療試験開始。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Health Cuts Spark Concerns Over 'Flesh-Eating' Bacteria
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus, a deadly coastal bacterium nicknamed a 'flesh-eating' threat, has been detected in several New York Long Island locations, prompting Hamptons alerts, while Florida has reported eight infections this year and Mississippi officials have urged precautions. Experts warn the risk to beachgoers is rising as the Trump administration rolls back disease surveillance, including stopping requirements for states in the CDC's FoodNet network to report Vibrio and other pathogens. Critics say reduced monitoring hampers outbreak detection and trend spotting. Former CDC Director Tom Frieden warned defenses are thinning amid increasing microbial threats. The concerns extend beyond Vibrio to screwworm infections in animals and an Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and to U.S. policy shifts—withdrawal from the WHO and cuts to USAID health programs—allegedly weakening early-warning systems. The CDC estimates about 80,000 Vibrio infections occur annually in the U.S., with Vibrio vulnificus among the most dangerous.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権の保健削減が「肉食性」バクテリアへの懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: Vibrio vulnificus感染症が複数の米国沿岸地域で検出され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。同時にDRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクも報告されており、IHR基準および社会政治的関心の両面で閾値を満たしている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはフロリダ、ミシシッピ、ニューヨーク、メイン州など米国内複数地域が含まれるが、評価対象国はDRCのみ。米国内の Vibrio vulnificus 感染拡大、エボラ、ネジロバエ症に関する報道であり、対象国リスト外のため米国は verified_locations に含めない。ただしDRCのエボラアウトブレイク言及により DRC を含める。

article.articleHeadline: Worm warning
article.articleSummary: Two parasitic infections highlighted: in Guangdong province, a patient at Shenzhen People's Hospital had two 10-cm sparganum worms removed from an arm lump, suggesting a skin infection; doctors believe eggs entered via kitchen exposure—knife or cutting board used for live frogs and cold dishes—leading to infection that grew for about a year. In a separate case reported in Emerging Infectious Diseases (EID) and picked up by Fox News, a 60-year-old Spanish man presented with two weeks of severe headaches; brain CTs resembled tumors, but extensive imaging found multiple brain cysts containing tapeworms. Blood tests confirmed neurocysticercosis; he recovered after treatment with albendazole and praziquantel. The report notes possible accidental ingestion of microscopic tapeworm eggs years earlier while working a construction job with migrants from regions where neurocysticercosis is endemic. Transmission can occur via undercooked meat or fecal-oral routes.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫警告
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症は重篤な神経感染症であり、複数国での症例報告が存在する。ただし、現在のところ集団発生の兆候や急速な国際拡大の証拠は明確でなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中国（広東省深圳）とスペインの2ケースが報告されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には中国のみを記載。神経嚢虫症は実際には風土病的性質が強く、現在の情報からは新興感染症的な公衆衛生上の危機とは判断しがたい。IHR基準は2つ該当し理論的にはシグナル条件を満たすが、個別症例報告の性質と対象国の限定性を考慮しWATCH判定とした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Alucinações, psicose e ansiedade: Viagem à Índia deixou mulher com 38 parasitas no cérebro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hallucinations, Psychosis, and Anxiety: A Trip to India Left a Woman with 38 Parasites in Her Brain
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis, a rare brain infection from Taenia solium eggs, was diagnosed in a British woman after a three-month trip to India. In 2010, about three years after the voyage, she found a roughly one-meter tapeworm in her stool; initial stool tests were unremarkable. She then developed severe headaches and a seizure, and brain imaging revealed 38 parasites. Early on, doctors suspected a cat-feces–associated infection, but a subsequent investigation linked exposure to India in 2007. Treatment killed the eggs and the parasites calcified, but she later suffered neuropsychiatric symptoms—paranoia, psychosis, anxiety, panic—requiring six weeks in a neuropsychiatry unit. Although seizures have not recurred since 2017, she remains on anti-epileptic medication. Recovery spanned years, and by 2022 she returned to work; now living in Cardiff, she advocates awareness. The disease is rare in developed countries; WHO notes ingestion of eggs via contaminated food or water as the route.

triage.headline_ja: 幻覚、精神病、不安：インドへの旅が女性の脳に38匹の寄生虫をもたらした
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症は発達途上国では重要な感染症であるが、本事例は2007年のインド渡航による単一症例（イギリス在住の女性）であり、現在の流行・発生クラスターの証拠がない。インドでの現在の疾病負荷状況が不明であるため、情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は2007年のインド渡航が感染源であり、症状発現は2010年、診断・治療は長期間経過後である。単一の旅行関連症例であり、インドにおける現在の疫学的状況（流行、新規クラスター、公衆衛生への脅威）について直接的な証拠がない。記事はメディア関心（個人の稀有な医学ケース）を反映しているが、感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしては重症度基準のみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Doutor Pet: Julho Dourado reforça a importância da prevenção de zoonoses; entenda - Coluna - BN Hall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Pet: Golden July reinforces the importance of preventing zoonoses; learn more - Column - BN Hall.
article.articleSummary: Golden July in Brazil is a nationwide campaign, established by federal law, to raise awareness about animal health, zoonosis prevention, and responsible pet guardianship. The initiative emphasizes that protecting pet health also safeguards human health and strengthens family life with animals. Zoonoses such as rabies, leptospirosis, and leishmaniasis are highlighted as diseases transmitted between animals and people, demanding ongoing attention. Preventive measures—keeping vaccines up to date, regular deworming, flea and tick control, proper nutrition, and periodic veterinary visits—are essential components of preventive veterinary medicine and help reduce societal risk. Many diseases evolve quietly, with subtle early signs, so regular veterinary follow-up enables early detection and tailored care across a pet's life stages. The article underscores July as a focal time for education and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ペットドクター：黄金の7月は人畜共通感染症予防の重要性を強調；詳しく知る - コラム - BN Hall
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの公衆衛生キャンペーン（黄金の7月）に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症の流行・アウトブレイク事例を報告するものではない。教育・予防啓発の内容のみで、実際の患者発生、異常な増加、国際的拡大リスク等は述べられていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は「黄金の7月」という既存の公衆衛生キャンペーンの年間恒例啓発記事であり、シグナル検知対象の感染症イベント（流行・アウトブレイク）ではなく、教育啓発コンテンツである。狂犬病、レプトスピラ症、リーシュマニア症は言及されているが、これらは具体的な患者数増加や異常事象として報告されておらず、予防の重要性を述べる例示に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: "Nous devons arrêter cette épidémie très rapidement"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We must stop this epidemic very quickly.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared 15 May 2026. In Bunia, imminent clinical trials will test a treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis for Bundibugyo—no licensed vaccine or approved therapy exists for this strain. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya notes two therapeutic candidates, MBP 134 and Remdesivir, plus a post-exposure prophylaxis study, each about 4–5 months. A $28 million funding package is sought, with a roughly $10 million gap. In Kinshasa, Presidents Tshisekedi and Ramaphosa met on 2 July to coordinate the continent’s response, with INRB participation and future resource mobilization. Early funding cited includes about $160 million of the $558 million health target and $110 million from African governments; officials aim to secure more by year-end. Ituri origin, with spread to other provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 「この流行を非常に迅速に食い止めなければならない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数州での拡大、国際的な資金動員・対応調整が進行中。治療法・ワクチン不在の新規株による未曾有の流行。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言）。利用可能なワクチン・承認済み治療薬が存在しない新規株。イトゥリ州発生、複数州への拡大確認。臨床試験開始予定。アフリカCDC及びコンゴ政府、南アフリカ大統領による大陸規模の対応調整進行中。資金確保（$28百万パッケージ、$10百万ギャップ）と国際的サポート動員が急務。

article.articleHeadline: US travel alert after eye-bleeding disease in Ebola-stricken region
article.articleSummary: Marburg virus detected in western Uganda, first since 2017, with two cases reported as of Monday; WHO confirmed Uganda’s first Marburg case after notification by Ugandan health authorities. The United States has issued a Level 4 travel advisory for Uganda, and airport screening is in place; travelers should monitor health for 21 days after leaving Uganda. Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo are battling what has become the third-largest Ebola outbreak in Central Africa on record, with more than 1,000 cases across both nations. Marburg spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or the bodies of the dead; traditional burials pose a high transmission risk. Symptoms align with viral hemorrhagic fever, including eye, nose, or mouth bleeding and rapid deterioration. No approved Marburg vaccines or treatments; experimental options in early trials. Diagnostics rely on laboratory confirmation; outbreak currently appears localized.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ流行地でマールブルグ出血熱が検出、米国が渡航警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。致死的なVHF（マールブルグ出血熱）の新規確認、EbolaおよびMachup併行流行、国際渡航制限勧告、WHO確認事例で、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID対象国リストに含まれないため、記事中でウガンダでのマールブルグ検出が主題であるが、DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。米国の渡航警告は二次的情報であり、実イベント発生地ではないため除外。2017年以降初の確認例で2件報告。実験的治療法が開発段階にあり、ワクチンなし。伝統的埋葬による高いヒト-ヒト感染リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Un parásito que altera la cognición ha infectado silenciosamente a un tercio de la humanidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite that alters cognition has silently infected one-third of humanity.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasma gondii, the parasite behind toxoplasmosis, is estimated to infect about one-third worldwide, with some estimates near 2,000 million. Despite its wide reach, the disease receives limited public-health attention, prompting researchers to urge the WHO to designate toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease. Transmission occurs via cat feces, undercooked meat, and contaminated water or food; infection is usually lifelong and asymptomatic, but congenital toxoplasmosis can cause abortion or permanent fetal brain and eye damage, with about 190,000 congenital cases annually. The parasite can also cause retinal inflammation later in life, a leading cause of vision loss. Some evidence links latent infection to behavioral changes and possible schizophrenia, though data are debated. Burden is uneven (US around 10% infected; up to 80% in poor Brazilian communities). No vaccine exists; prevention focuses on cooking meat, washing produce, handwashing after handling raw meat or soil/cat litter, avoiding unpotable water, and pregnancy precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 認知機能を変化させる寄生虫が人類の3分の1を静かに感染させている
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は世界人口の約3分の1に感染している広大な疾病負荷を持つが、記事の焦点は公開討論や啓発の必要性であり、新興の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではない。検証地域（ブラジル）では負担が不均等に分布しているものの、具体的な流行事象や緊急性の指標は記事に記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の慢性感染症に関する啓発・政策提言的な内容であり、新規アウトブレイク事象ではない。トキソプラズマ症の感染率が高く、先天性トキソプラズマ症の年間約19万件の事例が重症度の基準を満たすが、記事は流行の勢いや医療危機の状況を示していない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Sistema que cruza dados do SUS e de farmácias prevê surtos - 01/07/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: System that cross-references data from SUS and pharmacies predicts outbreaks - July 1, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Health is implementing the Syndromic Early Warning System ÆSOP, which integrates Primary Health Care data (SISAB/SUS) and over-the-counter medicine sales (MIP) from IQVIA to detect early outbreak signals. In a study published in npj Digital Public Health, ÆSOP forecasted increases in respiratory-hospitalizations up to three weeks ahead in about 60% of episodes, with mild-case signals appearing earlier. OTC data signaled 1–3 weeks before hospitalizations in 57% of 746 episodes, while Primary Health Care data did so in 60%. The system helps identify mild versus severe surges and enables faster investigations, bed and supply planning, and workforce deployment. Regional performance varied, but roughly three-quarters of Brazil showed good performance from at least one data source. In Brazil, dengue and chikungunya are frequent infections; references to Ebola, Nipah, and Hantavirus illustrate broader pandemic threats. The approach complements lab-confirmed surveillance and supports proactive health responses.

triage.headline_ja: SUSと薬局のデータを組み合わせたシステムが流行を予測する - 2026年7月1日
triage.triage_reason: 記事は流行検知システムの実装と有効性研究の報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではなく、既存の検知インフラの改善に関する情報。社会的関心があるが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる新興感染症危機ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル保健省による早期警戒システムAESOP（疫学的症候群監視システム）の導入と性能に関する報道であり、既知の検知システムの技術的改善の報告である。記事中でEbola、Nipah、Hantavirusが言及されているが、これらは『より広い流行脅威を示すための例示』として述べられており、実際のアウトブレイク事象ではない。ブラジルにおける実際の感染症危機の証拠がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 1 300 cas et 377 morts, une crise sanitaire qui menace toute l'Afrique centrale - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 1,300 cases and 377 deaths, a health crisis that threatens all of Central Africa - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: On 1 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,307 confirmed cases and 377 deaths, making it one of the deadliest Central African outbreaks this decade. The Bundibugyo strain drives a case fatality rate of 28.8%. The outbreak is centered in Ituri with spillover to North Kivu and South Kivu; Kinshasa is in quarantine. Authorities report 615 patients in isolation; 180 have recovered to date, while 138 recovered recently (survivor count noted as 138). Contact tracing stands at 81.3%. Travel from affected zones is restricted by a 21-day quarantine, and care is free in Ituri. An international response plan worth $518 million is underway, though security and logistics hinder delivery. Suspected cases (fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding) should be reported via hotline 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：1,300件の症例と377件の死亡、中央アフリカ全域を脅かす保健危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラウイルス病による大規模アウトブレイク（1,307確定症例、377死亡、CFR 28.8%）であり、国際的拡大リスク、地域的脅威、および国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu地域に集中し、Kinshasa市は隔離中。国際対応計画（5億1,800万ドル）が実施中だが、セキュリティと物流上の課題が存在。接触者追跡率81.3%。中央アフリカ全域への脅威として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Torna da un viaggio con 38 parassiti nel cervello: crisi e mal di testa, poi la scioccante scoperta in bagno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back from a trip with 38 parasites in the brain: seizures and headaches, then the shocking discovery in the bathroom.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis in a 42-year-old Welsh woman, Lowri Denman, developed after a three-month trip to India in 2007. After initial severe headaches and migraines, she found a one-meter tapeworm-like parasite in a bathroom in 2010. Subsequent brain imaging in 2011 revealed 38 parasitic cysts in the brain, causing seizures, cerebral swelling, confusion and psychosis. Initial consideration of toxoplasmosis; final diagnosis: neurocysticercosis, caused by Taenia solium eggs acquired via contaminated food or water or poor hygiene; a rare infection in the UK with few cases annually. Hospitalized two weeks for antiparasitic therapy and steroids; later, brain swelling around the parasites led to neurocognitive decline, paranoia, severe anxiety, and six weeks in a neuropsychiatric unit. After years of recovery, she speaks out to raise awareness and emphasizes valuing life and ongoing vigilance against the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行から帰国後、脳内に38匹の寄生虫：けいれんと頭痛、その後浴室での衝撃の発見
triage.triage_reason: ウェールズ在住者がインドでの感染により神経嚢虫症を発症した症例報告。イギリスでは稀な疾患で、公衆衛生的影響は限定的。インド流行情報としても確実な証拠を欠く。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告（2007年の旅行、2010-2011年に診断）。インドでの流行サーベイランスデータではなく、過去の旅行歴に基づく感染事例。ウェールズ（イギリス）での発症であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドはサマリーで感染源地として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。現時点でアウトブレイク示唆なし。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda finds isolated Marburg virus case, Africa CDC says
article.articleSummary: Uganda has confirmed an isolated Marburg virus disease case in the Kyegegwa district of western Uganda, detected during surveillance for an Ebola outbreak. The patient was a 1-1/2-year-old child who died; authorities report no contacts have developed symptoms and there is currently no active Marburg case in the country. The World Health Organization was notified on 30 June and has informed member states, with ongoing support for case investigation, active case finding, contact tracing and community engagement. Africa CDC spokesperson Saran Koly said, at this stage, reports of any additional case cannot be confirmed. Uganda’s health ministry said it was not aware of a Marburg outbreak. Uganda is also addressing an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak, with 20 Ebola cases and two deaths, linked to neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo; the last Marburg outbreak in Uganda occurred in 2017.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがマールブルグウイルス感染の散発症例を確認、アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラとマールブルグウイルスの同時検出、死亡事例を含む重症度の高い感染症2疾患が複数国で確認されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでマールブルグウイルス感染の散発症例（1.5歳小児、死亡）が確認された。同時にエボラ・ブンディブギョアウトブレイク（20症例、2死亡）が進行中で、DRCとの関連性も指摘されている。WHOとアフリカCDCが既に通知を受け、積極的な監視・接触者追跡・社会動員が開始されている。UgandaはGeoNames ID 226074だが、これは対象国リストに明示されていない（対象国にはDRC=203312のみ）。DRCはリストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands missed in Ebola contact tracing, warns Africa CDC - Juta MedicalBrief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bundibugyo strain; more than 1,100 positives since May and over 250 deaths, with true toll likely higher due to undetected transmission. Health authorities report only about 30% of a confirmed patient’s contacts are being traced, far below the 80% target; urban areas expect about 40 contacts per case, while camps housing roughly one million displaced people could yield ~120 contacts per case. Almost all beds in eastern Congo’s emergency Ebola facilities are occupied (about 95%). Africa CDC plans to recruit 20,000 paid workers to scale contact tracing and safe burials education. Trials include remdesivir for sick patients, and remdesivir plus MBP-134 monoclonal antibody; MBP-134 is expected to arrive in Bunia soon. A mid-July trial will test a 10‑day course of oral obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis in 1,200 participants; if 600 show protection, access could extend to all contacts for the outbreak duration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ接触者追跡で数千人が見落とされていると警告、アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。1,100人以上の感染確認、250人以上の死亡、接触者追跡率が大きく目標を下回る状況は、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は民主共和国（DRC）北東部イトゥリ州を中心としたエボラ出血熱の継続流行を報道。250人以上の死亡、接触者追跡効率の低さ（30%）、避難キャンプでの高リスク、医療施設の飽和状態（95%占有率）は深刻。アフリカCDCが2万人の接触者追跡要員の雇用計画、複数の治療試験進行中。国際的支援と関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hochgefährliche Krankheit: Ebola-Zentrum im Kongo von Anwohnern niedergebrannt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly dangerous disease: Ebola center in the Congo burned down by locals.
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has caused about 400 deaths. The surge is centered in Ituri Province, specifically the village of Bafwabango near Goma. Angry residents set fire to an Ebola treatment center, killing a police officer and injuring two others. Several Ebola patients and individuals with symptoms escaped the facility, complicating containment efforts. District health chief Joseph Pemamakuwe reported the incident, underscoring security challenges facing outbreak response teams. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation or infection sources beyond the ongoing outbreak, nor does it provide information on imported or exported cases. Public health authorities continue efforts to stabilize transmission and protect neighboring communities. Keywords: Ebola, outbreak, Congo, Ituri, Bafwabango, Goma, outbreak response, security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 高リスク感染症：コンゴのエボラ対応センターが住民により焼き払われる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活動的な流行（約400死亡）、国際拡大リスク、治療施設の焼き払いによる封じ込め困難化という異常事態がIHR基準3項目以上に該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部のイトゥリ州およびゴマ周辺に限定されている。治療施設の焼き払いによる患者・疑似患者の逃亡が確認され、通常の感染症管理ではなく、地域の紛争・セキュリティ課題がアウトブレイク対応を著しく困難にしている点が特に懸念される。ラボ確認や輸入例の記載がないため、その点は不明だが、症例数と重症度により基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: إيبولا قد يكبّد إفريقيا خسائر فادحة ويؤدي إلى فقدان مئات آلاف الوظائف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Ebola could inflict heavy losses on Africa and lead to the loss of hundreds of thousands of jobs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is projected to trigger a broader economic and social crisis across Africa as of 2026-07-01. The outbreak in DRC’s Ituri province has reached 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries, per WHO, and Uganda has 20 confirmed cases; cross-border spillovers threaten Rwanda, South Sudan, and other neighbors. The UNDP warns the epidemic could cost African economies up to $3.6 billion and push about 985,000 people into poverty, with tens of thousands of jobs lost and disruptions to education and health services. In Congo, real GDP could fall by over $1 billion and around 55,000 jobs could be lost; Africa-wide GDP could drop by about $2.37 billion, with up to 328,000 potential job losses when linked to regional conflicts. A multi-level plan calls for cash transfers, consumption support, targeted border screening, and emergency financing to protect maternal and child health.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：エボラがアフリカに甚大な損失をもたらし、数十万の雇用喪失につながる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模流行、隣国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。フルRRAへ進行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されている発症地はDRC（Ituri州）とウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ルワンダ・南スーダンは「脅威を受ける隣国」として言及されているが、実際の患者発生は記述されていないため含めない。1,333確定症例・399死亡・経済的影響（最大36億ドル）という深刻な状況、および隣国への越境スピルオーバーリスクはIHR基準とWPRO基準をすべて満たす。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Could Wipe Out Thousands of Jobs, UNDP Warns
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (17th) in Ituri Province driven by Bundibugyo strain with no licensed vaccine; as of June 30, 2026, 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths in the DRC, while Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. UNDP’s Rapid Socioeconomic Assessment calls the crisis a development emergency affecting livelihoods, education, food security, and cross-border trade. The outbreak could push about 985,000 people in the DRC into extreme poverty, threaten thousands of jobs, and trigger over a billion dollars in lost output; Africa-wide effects could reach $2.37B and 90,000 formal jobs, with worst-case up to $3.6B and 328,000 jobs if global shocks occur. Women disproportionately bear burdens due to informal cross-border trade and caregiving. Health-resource diversion could cause 2,520 preventable infant deaths and 34,000–36,000 primary-school dropouts. Recommendations: replace blanket border closures with smart screening; expand cash support; protect maternal/child health; strengthen health systems and resilience; invest in livelihoods and social protection.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ感染症の流行、数千の職を失わせる可能性 - UNDP が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。DRC 17番目のエボラ流行で1,274確定患者、360死亡、ウガンダにも波及。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は Bluedot の発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでの言及は「20例、2死亡」とDRC（1,274例、360死亡）の二次的な情報に過ぎず、主要な発生地はDRCである。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo 株でワクチン非適合、急速な経済・社会への波及効果が報告されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cerca de 400 muertos por ébola en el Congo Democrático
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 400 dead from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of 1 July 2026, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The Ministry of Communications reports 1,333 confirmed cases, 399 deaths, 189 recoveries, and 609 patients in treatment, with 26 new cases and 9 recoveries since the last update, yielding a case fatality rate of 29.7%. The outbreak remains concentrated in the eastern provinces, with strengthened surveillance and health care. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease caused by viruses in the Orthoebolavirus genus (Filoviridae); six species exist, three driving large outbreaks: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, and Bundibugyo virus. Natural reservoirs include fruit bats (Pteropodidae); spillovers occur via close contact with blood, secretions, organs or bodily fluids of infected animals such as fruit bats, chimpanzees, gorillas, and porcupines. Humans become infectious only after symptoms appear; no imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラで約400人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルス感染症は重症度が高く、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 2026年7月1日現在、確定患者1,333人、死亡399人、治癒189人、入院患者609人を報告。東部州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）に集中。致命率29.7%。エボラウイルスは人から人への感染が症状出現後に開始される。国際保健規則（IHR2005）の全基準に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目が該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Now Uganda has suspected Marburg case - Juta MedicalBrief
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, Uganda has a suspected Marburg virus case and has not declared an outbreak, after notifying the World Health Organization. The country faces the ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Uganda reporting 20 Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease cases and 2 deaths, and 15 of the infections imported from the DRC. There is currently no approved Marburg therapy or vaccine; supportive care improves survival, and vaccines, antiviral drugs, and immune therapies are under development per WHO. Uganda previously faced a Marburg outbreak in 2017 (4 cases, 3 deaths). Two fatal Marburg cases outside Africa have been linked to travellers who visited bat-inhabited caves in Uganda (Europe and United States).

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがマールブルグウイルスの疑い例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響：致命的ウイルス、予想外：新規発生、国際的拡大リスク：過去に欧州・米国での輸入例あり）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病も同時流行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダのマールブルグ疑い例を主題としているが、ウガンダはCEPRの対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。同時にDRCで進行中のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（ウガンダへの輸入例含む）が記述されており、DRCは対象国（203312）であるため DRC のみを記載。マールブルグは致命的で、ワクチンなし、過去に国際的移動による輸出例あり、現在のエボラ流行下での発生であるため高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Hochgefährliche Krankheit: Ebola-Zentrum im Kongo von Anwohnern niedergebrannt - Panorama - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly dangerous disease: Ebola center in the Congo burned down by locals - Panorama - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues in Ituri Province, with at least 399 deaths and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases since April; Uganda reports 20 cases. An Ebola treatment center in Bafwabango village, Ituri, was set on fire by angry residents, killing a police officer and injuring two others; patients and those with suspected infection fled. A group blocked safe burial of a presumed Ebola victim amid widespread distrust that hampers aid delivery. Traditional burials are a major transmission risk. Public health measures include limiting indoor gatherings to under 50 people in Ituri; in North Kivu, de facto authorities banned gatherings for watching World Cup football. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific therapy yet, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: 高い危険性のある病気：コンゴのエボラセンター、地元住民によって焼き払われた - パノラマ - ラインツァイトゥング
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行、死亡数399名、確認症例1,333件、ウガンダへの波及、医療施設の破壊による公衆衛生対策の阻害が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は記事で言及されているが、発生事象の中心はDRC Ituri州であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱であり、ワクチン・特異的治療がなく、治療センター破壊、伝統的埋葬の慣行による伝播リスク増加、住民の医療機関への不信感など、複数の懸念要因が存在する。社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Bárbara derruba em 98% a dengue este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Bárbara reduces dengue fever by 98% this year.
article.articleSummary: Santa Bárbara d'Oeste, within the Campinas Regional Health Department area, reports a 97.8% drop in dengue cases in the first half of 2026, from 9,641 cases (Jan–Jun 2025) to 210, with zero dengue deaths in 2026 (vs 25 in Jan–Jun 2025). The reduction (2.1 percentage points above the regional average) follows a mix of factors including prior intense transmission, shifts in circulating serotypes, climate/seasonal effects, vector-density changes, and sustained surveillance and control efforts. Local measures include house-to-house visits to identify and remove breeding sites, continuous entomological monitoring, vehicle-mounted larvicide spraying, and use of EDLs (Larviciding Dissemination Stations) with area nebulization in transmission zones. Public outreach since Oct 2025–Jun 2026 comprised about 100 informational pieces (~500,000 views) across the city site, press releases, social media, and local radio. Residents are urged to maintain vector-control actions and seek care for dengue symptoms or alarm signs promptly.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・バーバラ、今年のデング熱を98%削減
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の大幅な減少を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、または渡航制限の懸念がない。
triage.notes: 本件はデング熱制御の成功事例を報告する記事であり、感染症危機の警告信号ではない。発生地域はブラジル（対象国）だが、症例数の大幅な減少、死亡者数の著減、有効な防御措置により、シグナルトリアージの基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 7 وفيات وقرابة 5 آلاف إصابة بالكوليرا في اليمن منذ بداية العام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7 deaths and about 5,000 cholera cases in Yemen since the start of the year
article.articleSummary: Cholera and acute watery diarrhea: World Health Organization data show Yemen recorded 4,814 suspected cholera/acute watery diarrhea cases from Jan 1 to May 31, 2026, with 7 deaths. In May, government-controlled areas reported 589 new cases and 1 death; information from areas under Houthi control remains incomplete due to access challenges. Yemen ranks seventh globally for cholera cases in Jan–May 2026, behind Afghanistan, DRC, South Sudan, Mozambique, Nigeria, and Angola, and is second in the Eastern Mediterranean Region for cases after Afghanistan, with the region reporting 52,171 cases and 86 deaths in the same period. Globally, WHO lists 114,829 cases and 1,230 deaths across 23 countries in four regions from Jan 1, 2026. The report notes ongoing outbreak conditions in Yemen, with data limited by access, underscoring the need for surveillance and response in conflict-affected settings.

triage.headline_ja: イエメンで2026年初頭からコレラによる死者7人と感染者約5,000人を記録
triage.triage_reason: コレラの多国家にわたる同時流行事象であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（複数国での患者・死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が確認され、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、2026年1月1日～5月31日の期間、グローバルに23カ国4地域で114,829件のコレラ症例と1,230人の死亡が報告されている。イエメンはランキング第7位で、東地中海地域ではアフガニスタンに次ぐ第2位。対象国リストではDRCのみが発生地域に含まれている。その他の記載国（イエメン、スーダン、アンゴラ、モザンビーク、ナイジェリア、アフガニスタン、ギリシャ）は対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo alerta para risco de hepatites na manicure
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July warns of the risk of hepatitis in nail salons
article.articleSummary: July Yellow campaign highlights hepatitis B and C, which can be transmitted in nail salons when instruments are not properly sterilized. Brazilian hepatologist Dr. Patrícia Almeida of Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein warns that contaminated blood on shared tools such as nail nippers and cuticle tools can pass viruses to both professionals and clients. To reduce risk, salons should sterilize instruments in an autoclave, wash hands before and after each service, wear gloves, and avoid reusing nail files, wooden sticks, and exfoliation buffers. Sanitize basins between clients and use clean towels for each client. Conventional ovens are not suitable for sterilization; devices must be used per manufacturer instructions, with pre-sterilization washing, thorough drying, and proper packaging. Clients are advised to bring personal kits (nail clippers, cuticle tool, file, orange stick, towel) when possible.

triage.headline_ja: 7月黄色キャンペーン、ネイルサロンでのB型・C型肝炎感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで報告されたB型肝炎に関する啓発キャンペーン記事。新規流行・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の感染経路に関する予防啓発であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。対象国リストにブラジルが含まれておらず、verified_locationsは空となる。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの定期的な啓発キャンペーン（7月黄色キャンペーン）の一部であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な流行状況の報告ではない。予防措置と感染経路に関する一般向け情報提供が主目的。対象国リストにブラジルが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。
