article.articleHeadline: "Un viaje a la India me dejó con 38 parásitos en mi cerebro": el drama de una mujer que empezó con una tenia de un metro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A trip to India left me with 38 parasites in my brain: the ordeal of a woman who started with a one-meter-long tapeworm.
article.articleSummary: British woman Lowri Denman traveled to India in 2007. In 2010 she discovered a one-meter tapeworm and later developed severe headaches and seizures. MRI revealed 38 parasites in her brain. Initial diagnosis was toxoplasmosis, but subsequent tests confirmed neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium eggs, likely acquired during the India trip despite avoiding meat. She underwent two weeks of inpatient antiparasitic therapy with steroids; though symptoms improved, inflammation around brain parasites recurred, forcing her to quit work. Steroid treatment contributed to significant psychiatric symptoms, including paranoia, psychosis, severe anxiety, and panic attacks, profoundly affecting her mental health and family life. After years of treatment she was seizure-free and able to return to work by 2022, though calcified parasites remain in her brain. She now advocates awareness of neurocysticercosis and travel-related parasitic infections.

triage.headline_ja: インドへの旅が原因で脳に38匹の寄生虫：1メートルの条虫から始まった女性の苦難
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人事例（イギリス人女性）の過去の旅行関連感染症であり、進行中の集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。インド国内での流行やホットスポット情報もなく、国際的な拡大リスクもない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2007年のインド旅行に由来する個人の神経嚢虫症事例の報道であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。患者は2022年までに回復し、現在は啓発活動を行っているとのこと。集団発生、公衆衛生上の脅威、国際的な懸念はいずれも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: How to stay well on holiday when infectious diseases and lethal viruses are on the rise
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination is crucial for travelers to Vietnam and wider Southeast Asia after dog bites or animal contact, as exposure can be fatal if untreated. Dr. Shaw notes Auckland clinics see two–three bite cases weekly from Asia; delays due to weather highlight the need for pre-travel vaccination and up-to-date immunisation. The article urges checking NZ schedules: MMR, TDAP, hepatitis A and B, and polio, plus region-specific vaccines. Measles resurgence, diphtheria outbreaks in Australia’s Northern Territory, and polio activity warrant vigilance. Asia risks include dengue, typhoid, hepatitis A, and rabies; South America risks include yellow fever, rabies, hepatitis, and chikungunya; North America lists West Nile virus and rabies; Africa notes mpox and Ebola; Europe may still face dengue/chikungunya in some areas, with winter flu shots advised. Comprehensive protection should start at least six weeks before travel, alongside food/water precautions and avoidance of wet markets; hantavirus risk is low outside aid settings.

triage.headline_ja: 休暇中に感染症と致命的ウイルスが増加している中、どのように健康を保つか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は旅行者向けの予防接種・健康管理ガイダンスであり、特定の国での実際の感染症の流行・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。複数疾患が列記されているが、これは一般的な地域リスク説明に過ぎず、IHRおよびWPRO基準いずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はニュージーランド発行の旅行ガイドであり、複数地域のリスク要因を一般的に列挙したもの。ベトナムについて狂犬病リスク（動物咬傷）が言及されているが、具体的な流行・アウトブレイクイベントではなく、旅行者への啓発文である。オーストラリア北部準州のジフテリアアウトブレイク言及も同様に一般情報である。シグナル価値なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak, DRC and Region, Situation Report #9, July 1, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of June 29, there were 1,333 confirmed EVD cases and 399 confirmed deaths in the DRC, with 20 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, with confirmed cases also in Haut-Uele, North Kivu and South Kivu. In Uganda, cases are linked to DRC transmission, including imported cases and secondary infections among contacts and healthcare workers. South Sudan faces high outbreak risk due to transient populations and porous borders but has no confirmed cases yet. International Medical Corps response includes case management, infection prevention and control (IPC), screening and triage, risk communication and community engagement (RCCE), and training; supporting 80 facilities, with 53,217 screenings and 314 patients treated (110 confirmed). In DRC, 403 personnel trained on EVD management and prevention. Uganda conducts transit-point screening and RCCE training; South Sudan focuses on health-system readiness and PPE stock.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、DRC及び地域、状況報告書第9号、2026年7月1日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスク事象。確認症例1,333例、死亡399例を記録し、DRC、ウガンダで確認、南スーダンでも高リスク。複数国への拡大リスク、国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ及び南スーダンが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダは輸入症例と二次感染のみ、南スーダンはまだ確認症例なし。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病で、2026年5月15日に宣言された大規模アウトブレイク。複数機関による国際的対応が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de dentista na Serra pode ser a quinta por dengue no Espírito Santo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dentist's death in Serra could be the fifth dengue death in Espírito Santo in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Death of 29-year-old dentist Lorena Nascimento Cardoso from Jacaraípe, Serra, Brazil, on June 30, 2026, after complications of severe dengue; death awaiting confirmation by the Espírito Santo Health Secretariat (Sesa) for official statistics. Sesa dengue bulletin reports four confirmed dengue deaths in 2026 (Vitória, Baixo Guandu, Jerônimo Monteiro, Nova Venécia) with eight deaths under investigation. From January to date, Espírito Santo records 11,768 probable dengue cases, with ongoing Aedes aegypti control efforts. Lorena had two municipal health visits; on the second, deterioration prompted urgent care and transfer to Hospital Estadual Dr. Jayme Santos Neves in Serra. In 2026, Serra recorded 3,549 dengue cases, a 40% reduction versus the same period last year. If the death is confirmed dengue-related, it would be Espírito Santo's fifth dengue death in 2026. Privacy protections limit disclosure of further clinical details.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エスピリトサント州での5番目となる可能性があるデング熱による歯科医の死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡事例の報告であり重症度基準を満たすが、情報が限定的（死亡確定待ち、臨床詳細不開示）であり、また国際拡大リスクが明確でない。続報と確定統計情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年という未来の日付を含む仮想シナリオと思われるが、評価は記事の内容に基づいている。死亡確認待ちの状態であり、公式統計化前の段階。デング熱は当該地域で既知の懸念疾患であり、異常性は低い。ブラジルは本スキームの対象国に含まれるため、picked up対象として考慮可能だが、統計確定・臨床詳細が不開示であり情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: После поездки в Индию у британки обнаружили 38 паразитов в мозге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a trip to India, 38 parasites were found in the brain of a British woman.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium eggs led to 38 brain cysts in a British woman years after a 2007 visit to India. Laurie Denman spent two months in India; four years after returning she developed severe headaches and a generalized seizure. MRI revealed numerous intracerebral cysts, consistent with neurocysticercosis, a leading cause of acquired epilepsy in endemic regions. Treatment posed challenges due to inflammatory edema from parasite death, seizures, and neuropsychiatric symptoms (hallucinations, paranoia). An international expert panel guided care. The regimen included albendazole and praziquantel, high-dose glucocorticoids, methotrexate to dampen inflammation, and antipsychotics; ongoing blood chemistry monitoring accompanied therapy. After several years, stabilization occurred, but long-term antiepileptic medication remained necessary. As of 2026-07-01, she remained on long-term antiepileptic treatment, illustrating the complexity of managing neurocysticercosis even with modern therapies and multidisciplinary input.

triage.headline_ja: インド旅行後、イギリス人女性の脳から38匹の寄生虫が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的な流行リスクは限定的。神経嚢虫症は既知の風土病であり、異常性も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2007年のインド訪問に由来する単一の輸入症例の臨床的な経過報告である。発生地域にはイギリスが含まれているが、患者の感染源はインドであり、イギリスは発症地に過ぎない。神経嚢虫症はEndemicな疾患であり、新規の流行イベントではない。単一症例の医学的な重症性は認められるが、感染症の公衆衛生危機としてはピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Leads TB Control Improvement Nationally
article.articleSummary: Gujarat leads India’s TB control improvement in 2025, reporting a 34% reduction in new TB cases and a 37% drop in TB mortality since 2015, per the Centre’s TB-Free India Campaign. In 2024, the state’s estimated TB incidence was 186 per lakh, ranking sixth lowest nationally and fourth among large states. From January–May 2026, Gujarat identified 57,334 TB patients against a pro-rata target of 58,333 (98.3%), with 50,928 (91%) becoming disease-free. During the 100-Day Campaign, 5,012 high-risk villages were surveyed; 23.38 lakh people screened; 15.04 lakh chest X-rays performed; 5.05 lakh NAAT tests conducted; 32,377 new TB patients started treatment. Ni-Kshay Poshan Yojana provided Rs 57.60 crore to 105,238 patients in 2025. Gujarat registered 30,992 Nikshay Mitras, distributing 550,184 nutrition kits; 3,971 gram panchayats were named TB-Free Panchayats (27% of all panchayats).

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州が全国的なTB対策改善で主導
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核対策の成功事例を報じており、疾病発生や危機管理の対象外。疫学的な異常事態、国際的リスク、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はグジャラート州の結核対策における進捗と成功を報じるニュースであり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる感染症イベント（新規発生、異常、危機）ではない。むしろ公衆衛生施策の成果報告である。EBS監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak could cost Africa $3.6bn, says UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, caused by Bundibugyo species (no vaccine or specific treatment). As of WHO, 1,333 cases and 399 deaths confirmed in the DRC, with 189 recovered; Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases. The UN Development Programme warns the crisis could trigger a continental economic hit up to $3.6 billion, including DRC real GDP losses over $1 billion and about 55,000 lost jobs; broader trade disruptions could reduce Africa’s GDP by about $2.37 billion even if transmission is largely contained. The outbreak risks a wider development emergency, affecting livelihoods, education, food security, and public finances, with poverty rising to as many as 985,000 people. Containment includes quarantines; however, travel/border restrictions worsen economies. Recommendations: targeted screening, direct cash transfers to vulnerable groups, and emergency financing to sustain maternal, reproductive, and infant healthcare during the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行はアフリカに36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性がある、と国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確定症例1,333件、死亡399件という深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo種による予想外の発生、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、経済的及び貿易制限リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRC（イトゥリ州）での発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境例報告（20件）も記載されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRCの大規模アウトブレイク。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo種はワクチンなし、治療法なしという極めて深刻な状況。国連による経済的警告が社会的・政治的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis may push 985,000 deeper into poverty, trigger 2,520 infant deaths -- UNDP
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) threatens broader development, UNDP warns. Ongoing transmission could push about 985,000 more people into poverty and trigger up to 2,520 excess infant deaths due to disrupted maternal, reproductive and child health services. Even under best containment, the DRC could lose over $1 billion in real GDP and at least 55,000 jobs; regional and continental shocks could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion. Trade restrictions, border closures, transport delays and shrinking informal markets already hit the poorest households, with the bottom 20% facing a 1.76% drop in daily consumption. Women bear the harshest burden as informal cross-border traders and frontline health workers. The UNDP calls for direct cash transfers, protected maternal/infant healthcare funding, targeted screening instead of blanket closures, and stronger investments in health, social protection and economic resilience to avert a wider humanitarian disaster.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機により985,000人がさらに貧困に陥る可能性、2,520人の乳幼児死亡を引き起こす可能性がある--UNDP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の継続的な流行により、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。国際的な経済・保健への深刻な影響、高い国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行易性が明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの継続的な流行が報告されている。記事はUNDPからの警告として、DRCでの発生に伴う広範な開発・経済への影響と、境界閉鎖・貿易制限などの国際的波及を記述している。乳幼児死亡数、貧困増加、GDP損失など具体的な定量的影響予測が示されており、人道的危機のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Limpeza profissional protege condôminos de surto de VSR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professional Cleaning Protects Condominium Residents from RSV Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Global seasonal influenza remains a major public-health and economic concern, with the World Health Organization estimating about 500 million cases annually and 3–5 million severe illnesses. In Brazil, the 2026 winter has been among the most challenging for the corporate sector. The latest Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin shows a rising incidence of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) nationwide, driven mainly by hospitalizations due to Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and, in several regions, Influenza A and rhinovirus. All Brazilian states report SARI at alert, at-risk, or high-risk levels in recent weeks. In high-traffic settings such as condominiums and corporate complexes, transmission and staff absenteeism may escalate, threatening safety and operations. ABRALIMP stresses that professional cleaning of common areas is a critical health-risk management tool, not cosmetic upkeep. Five strategic pillars encourage hiring specialized firms and employing advanced cleaning technologies to reduce viral spread while supporting workforce health and corporate reputation.

triage.headline_ja: 専門的な清掃がマンション住民をRSVアウトブレイクから保護する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国でSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）が多数州でアラート～高リスク水準にあり、RSV・インフルエンザAによる入院が増加している状況が報告されている。複数地域での同時多発的な呼吸器感染症流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆し、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内でのRSV・インフルエンザAによるSARI増加を主として報告している。Fiocruz InfoGripeの最新データで全州がアラート～高リスク水準にあることが報告され、企業施設・高流動環境での職員欠勤と感染伝播リスクが指摘されている。冬季流行期における同時多発感染症流行であり、適切な対策実施（専門的清掃）が推奨されている点から、現地での感染症管理の課題が存在することが伺える。

article.articleHeadline: 723 diarrhoea cases, 188 typhoid infections reported in Ahmedabad in June
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad municipal health data for June 1–28 report 723 diarrhoea and vomiting cases, 188 typhoid, and 56 jaundice. Vector-borne illnesses remained low, with 25 malaria, 12 dengue, and 1 chikungunya case recorded. Water quality surveillance screened 49,238 samples for chlorine residues; 48 had no chlorine residual, and 7,085 samples were analysed bacteriologically, with 70 deemed unfit for consumption. Complaints of polluted water near Pragatinagar Crossroads, Naranpura, prompted targeted sampling; results showed the affected water fit for consumption, and a medical van was deployed to assess residents. Field surveys found no diarrhoea or vomiting linked to the reported water supply issue, indicating no immediate disease outbreak associated with the complaints.

triage.headline_ja: アーメダバードで6月に下痢症例723件、腸チフス感染188件が報告
triage.triage_reason: 腸チフスと下痢症の複数報告があり異常/予想外である可能性がありますが、ベクター媒介性疾患は低水準で、医当局が水質調査と対応を実施しており管理下にあるため。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、アーメダバード市の衛生当局が6月の疾患監視データを報告。下痢症とチフスの報告数は多いが、水質汚濁の訴えについては調査の結果、その地域の水は消費に適していると判断され、また現地調査では報告された水供給問題に関連した下痢・嘔吐は認められていない。したがって即時的な流行の兆候は確認されていない。医療活動は継続中。ベクター媒介性疾患（マラリア、デング、チクングニア）は低レベルで推移。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados recebe novo lote da vacina contra Chikungunya e retoma imunização - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados receives a new batch of the chikungunya vaccine and resumes immunization - O Progresso
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination resumes in Dourados, Brazil, after a second batch of 1,000 doses arrived from the Ministry of Health. Immunization restarted on June 30 at Basic Health Units (UBSs) and the Medical Care Post (PAM). The Ministry aims to vaccinate at least 27% of the target 18–59-year-olds, about 43,000 doses. The vaccine’s safety and immunogenicity were demonstrated in US and Brazilian studies; about 99% of US volunteers developed neutralizing antibodies. Contraindications include pregnancy or lactation, immunosuppression, congenital immunodeficiency, cancer treatment, recent solid organ or bone marrow transplant, HIV/AIDS, autoimmune diseases, and two chronic conditions (diabetes, hypertension, etc.). Excluded are those with chikungunya in the last 30 days, fever, or recent vaccines (live within 28 days; inactivated within 14 days). Health Secretary Márcio Figueiredo urged eligible residents to get vaccinated, noting 92 notifications in Week 25 versus over 1,200 at the epidemic peak.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラードスがチクングニアワクチンの新しいバッチを受け取り、予防接種を再開 - O PROGRESSO
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア感染症への対応として予防接種再開が報告されており、社会的関心と管理可能性の観点から注視が必要。ただしIHR基準の該当数が不足し、シグナルとしてのピックアップ判定には至らない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（ドゥアラードス市）でのチクングニアワクチン予防接種再開を報告。感染症のアウトブレイク段階ではなく、公衆衛生対応措置（予防接種キャンペーン）の報道。流行性があり住民が継続的に曝露されている状況（Week 25で92件の通知）であることから、WPROスクリーニング基準2項目が該当するが、深刻な健康影響や国際的拡大リスクの兆候は見られず、情報も部分的に限定的であるため、WATCHレベルの経過観察に留める。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda reviews dengue preparedness in Delhi ahead of peak season
article.articleSummary: Delhi dengue preparedness intensifies ahead of the peak season as incidence remains low and mortality stands at 0.11%. Union Health Minister JP Nadda directed authorities to bolster surveillance, hospital readiness, vector control, and an aggressive public awareness campaign. A meeting reviewed Delhi’s and national dengue preparedness, including the National Strategy for Prevention and Control of Dengue (Octalogue) with eight pillars: surveillance, case management, vector management, outbreak response, capacity building, behaviour change communication, inter-sectoral coordination, and monitoring and supervision. The Centre has issued advisories, conducted trainings, provided free diagnostics, and strengthened inter-ministerial coordination with financial support under the National Health Mission. Actions focus on disease surveillance, case detection, clinical management, and IEC. Hospitals should maintain dedicated wards, beds, blood components, diagnostics, medicines, and insecticides; Rapid Response Teams on standby; IHIP-VBD reporting; and daily district reviews. July marks Anti Dengue Month to mobilize schools, RWAs, market associations, and dengue-prone areas for prevention.

triage.headline_ja: JP Nadda、デリーにおけるデング熱対策を流行シーズン前に視察
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の流行ピーク期を前とした予防対策強化の行政レビューであり、現在の発生数は低く死亡率も0.11%と低水準。感染症イベントの異常性や重症性が明確でなく、情報が不足している段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の流行ピーク期を前とした予防対策・準備状況に関する行政レビューである。現在の発生状況は低水準（死亡率0.11%）であり、明らかな異常事象や重症患者の急増ではない。しかし、デング熱は流行しやすい疾患であり、デリーではシーズン毎に定期的に発生する。インド政府による高レベルの関心と公衆衛生対応体制の強化が示唆される。続報で実際の患者数増加やアウトブレイク兆候が報告されるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les efforts de la RDC salués par l'Italie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the Democratic Republic of the Congo's efforts praised by Italy - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in Ituri Province and the eastern DRC, specifically North Kivu and South Kivu, with no case counts provided in the report. On 30 June, amid celebrations of the country’s 66th Independence Day, Italy expressed full solidarity with Congo, the WHO and partners, praising the DRC’s persistent efforts against Ebola. Stefano De Leo, Italy's Director of Foreign Affairs for Africa and the Middle East, stated that Congo has repeatedly triumphed over the disease and is expected to do so again with international support. He emphasized health as a cornerstone of cooperation and highlighted Italy’s readiness to partner in resource valorization through initiatives like the Lobito Corridor, Plan Mattei, and the EU Global Gateway. He also underscored the importance of peace and stability in eastern DRC for durable development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国の取り組みがイタリアに称賛される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での継続的なエボラウイルス病の流行が報告されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、新規発症者情報が記事に示されていない。現在のイベント規模と進行状況の詳細が不明であるため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にイタリアからのコンゴへの支援表明と連帯についての政治的コミュニケーションであり、流行の詳細情報（患者数、重症度、最新の発症状況）は含まれていない。エボラは対象国リストの外のイタリア（Italian Republic）との関連は見出しの文脈上、政治的支援表明であり、実際の発生地ではない。DRCのIturi Province、South Kivu、North Kivu での継続的流行が示唆されているため、より詳細な流行データの取得が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Marcos Oliveira, o Beiçola, descobre infecção no períneo e é internado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marcos Oliveira, a.k.a. Beiçola, discovers a perineal infection and is hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actor Marcos Oliveira, known for the Beiçola character from A Grande Família, is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro after being diagnosed with a perineal infection. He was admitted to Hospital das Clínicas de Jacarepaguá (Zona Oeste) on Tuesday, June 30, and transferred on Wednesday to Hospital São Lucas Copacabana (Zona Sul). On July 1, he remained undergoing tests to determine next steps. Oliveira underwent a hernia repair two months prior, which occurred without complications. He has lived at Retiro dos Artistas since April last year, a facility that provides health coverage to residents; its administrator noted the artist’s difficult period and said they offered support. Since 2022, Oliveira has worn a colostomy bag due to a urethral fistula, and previously had a urological procedure to treat the fistula.

triage.headline_ja: マルコス・オリベイラ（ベイソーラ）、会陰部感染を発見し入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医学的事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団感染イベント（クラスター、アウトブレイク）ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの俳優1名の個人的な医学的状況（会陰部感染の入院治療）を報道したもの。感染症の集団発生、異常なアウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の懸念される事象ではない。Bluedotはセレブリティのヘルスニュースをピックアップしているが、感染症危機管理の対象外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Po kelionės į Indiją britės smegenyse aptikti 38 parazitai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a trip to India, 38 parasites were detected in the brain of a British woman.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis, a central nervous system parasitic infection caused by pork tapeworm eggs, struck a British woman after a three-month trip to India in 2007. Years later, doctors detected 38 parasitic worms in her brain, causing severe headaches, seizures, and psychosis. Earlier stool tests were normal; CT and MRI ultimately confirmed the diagnosis. The case, rare in the United Kingdom, is typically linked to exposures in endemic regions. She spent two weeks in hospital receiving antiparasitic drugs and steroids. Although initial improvement occurred, she later developed substantial brain swelling around the parasites, triggering mood changes and psychosis, followed by six weeks in a psychiatric hospital. The parasites eventually calcified; there was no surgical removal. She will require lifelong antiepileptic medication. The case illustrates a rare imported CNS parasitic infection seen in the UK linked to travel to endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: インド旅行後、イギリス人女性の脳から38匹の寄生虫が検出
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生影響は限定的。発症は2007年で遡及的診断であり、国際的流行リスクなし。
triage.notes: 記事は2007年のインド旅行に起因する個別症例の遡及的診断報告。患者はイギリス国籍だが、記事の主題イベント（感染発生地点）はインド。現在の流行警告や集団発生の証拠なし。医学的に稀な症例として報告されているが、感染症シグナルとしてのシグナル特性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Mob burns Ebola treatment centre in eastern Congo, killing policeman
article.articleSummary: Mob attack destroys Ebola treatment centre in Bafwabango, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, killing one police officer and injuring two. Patients and people with Ebola symptoms fled as angry youths blocked safe burial of a suspected victim; staff remain unsafe and operations have not resumed. Since April, at least 399 Ebola deaths and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported in the outbreak, with true infections likely higher due to under-detection. Twenty cases have been confirmed in neighbouring Uganda. Ebola, a highly lethal disease transmitted through direct contact with infected people and their bodily fluids, spreads partly through traditional burial practices. Transmission continues amid mistrust and attacks on aid workers. WHO notes under-detection; authorities and responders face safety challenges while attempting containment.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴでエボラ治療センターが暴徒に焼かれ、警察官1人が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された多数の死亡・感染例（399死、1,333確認例）と国際的拡大（ウガンダで20例）、治療施設への暴力攻撃による対応能力低下がIHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、予想外の事態、国際的拡大）に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明示するように、主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（東部イトゥリ州）であり、ウガンダの20例は「隣国での確認」として二次的言及。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。治療施設への暴力攻撃、患者の逃散、スタッフの安全脅威により対応能力が著しく低下している点が重大。WHO通知要件を明確に満たす。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ভারত সফরে গিয়ে মস্তিষ্কে ৩৮ পরজীবী নিয়ে ফিরলেন নারী, অতঃপর...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman returns from a trip to India with 38 parasites in her brain, and then...
article.articleSummary: Laurie Denman, a 42-year-old UK resident from Carmarthen, developed neurocysticercosis after a 2007 trip to India, harboring 38 parasitic brain cysts. Exposure likely occurred during travel; years later she noticed a nearly one-meter tapeworm in a toilet but received no diagnosis. By 2010 she suffered severe headaches; in 2011 she had seizures. CT/MRI revealed 38 brain parasites; initial suspicion was toxoplasmosis, but her history of pork tapeworm exposure led to a definitive diagnosis of neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium eggs. Two weeks of antiparasitic therapy with steroids helped at first, but over subsequent years brain inflammation around the parasites triggered confusion, weakness, and psychiatric symptoms. She spent six weeks in a neuropsychiatric hospital; later parasites calcified and became inactive. Since 2017 she has had no seizures, but remains on lifelong antiepileptic medication. As of 2026, she lives in Cardiff and campaigns to raise awareness to prevent similar imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: インド旅行から帰国した女性、脳内に38匹の寄生虫を抱えて帰宅、その後...
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2007年のインド渡航に遡る個別の輸入症例の後方視的報告であり、現在進行中の流行・集団発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威を示さない。2026年時点で患者は症状が安定しており、新規の国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の輸入症例（2007年のインド渡航に遡る）の個人的な医学的経過の物語であり、現在進行中の感染症事象ではない。患者は2026年時点で安定状態にあり、感染症危機管理の対象外。Bluedotの「発生地域」にはウェールズ（Carmarthen、Cardiff）とインド、英国が列挙されているが、実際のイベントはインド渡航時の単一の感染曝露であり、集団発生の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Drive to vaccinate cattle against FMD begins in Vellore, Ranipet
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination drive launched in Vellore and Ranipet districts, Tamil Nadu, under the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP). The vaccine is administered to cattle and other livestock twice yearly at no cost, with sessions running until July 31; routine campaigns typically occur in September and February depending on availability. This season targets about 1.67 lakh cattle in Vellore and 1.90 lakh cattle in Ranipet, with Tiruvannamalai earmarked for 7.86 lakh, and Tirupattur about 1.20 lakh. The drive was launched by Collectors P.S. Leela Alex (Vellore) and N. Priya (Ranipet). Veterinarians note FMD symptoms as high fever, mouth and foot boils, weight loss, and mouth swelling; the infection tends to spread during cold weather and the monsoon, especially November–December. Vaccination aims to boost immunity and prevent dairy income loss.

triage.headline_ja: ベロール地区とラニペット地区での口蹄疫（FMD）ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、異常な発生や危機的状況ではない。予防的な公衆衛生活動であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準にはいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は口蹄疫の発生ではなく、国家動物疾病制御プログラム（NADCP）に基づく定期的・予定的なワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しない。畜産動物への予防的対応であり、人獣共通感染症としての公衆衛生上の緊急性も記事では指摘されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mob burns Ebola treatment centre in eastern Congo, killing policeman
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province). In the village of Bafwabango, a mob set fire to an Ebola treatment centre, killing one police officer and injuring two others; several patients and symptomatic individuals fled the facility. Local health official Joseph Pemamakuwe said the attack followed an attempt to block safe burial of a suspected victim, despite consent from the family, and operations have not resumed amid staff safety fears. Since April, at least 399 people have died and authorities confirmed 1,333 lab-confirmed cases; the World Health Organization says real numbers are likely higher, given weeks of undetected transmission. Twenty cases have been confirmed in neighbouring Uganda. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected people and bodily fluids, with traditional burial practices driving transmission; security and trust challenges hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: 暴徒がコンゴ東部のエボラ治療センターを放火、警察官1人が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,333確認症例、399死亡）、予想外の暴力的事象、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダで20症例確認）、渡航制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダは二次的な拡大国（20症例確認）として記述されており、主要な流行はDRC Ituri州で発生。治療施設への暴力的攻撃は対応を阻害し、感染拡大リスクを増加させる重大な社会的課題。WHOが実際の数字がより高い可能性を指摘している点も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavirus verspreidt zich verder door Congo, vierde provincie bereikt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebolavirus spreads further through Congo, fourth province reached.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now reached a fourth province, with health services unable to bring transmission under control. Since the outbreak emerged six weeks ago, there have been 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, according to a Congolese Ministry of Health update published July 1, 2026. The tally shows an increase of 294 cases in the past week, placing this outbreak as the third largest Ebola outbreak on record. Ebola is a highly deadly virus. There is no vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant currently circulating in Congo. Multiple news agencies reported the development. The health ministry update is dated July 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ全域でさらに拡大、4番目の州に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。過去6週間で1,333確定例、399死亡、4州への拡大、ワクチン未有、制御不能な状況。記録上3番目の規模のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 大規模致死的エボラアウトブレイク。399死亡、1,333確定例、4州に拡大。使用中のBundibugyo変異株に対するワクチンなし。保健当局が制御不能状態。複数の国際メディアが報道。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de norovirus en David aumentan a más de 800 ¿Qué está pasando?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus cases in David rise to more than 800. What's going on?
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak in the David district, Chiriquí Province, Panama continues, with 807 cases reported by the morning of July 1, nearly doubling from about 450 the day before. Of these, 405 are in Ministry of Health facilities; 86 at Rafael Hernández Regional Hospital (CSS); 267 at the Gustavo Ross Polyclinic (CSS); 49 at Hospital Chiriquí (private). Pedregal and Los Algarrobos are among the hardest-hit communities, with cases also in San Pablo, Dolega, Guacá and Gualaca. All patients present mild gastroenteritis—vomiting, diarrhea and abdominal pain, with fever in some; no hospitalizations reported, affecting all ages and genders. Contamination source is under investigation; outbreak remains confined to David district, with support from the Gorgas Memorial Institute. Water quality monitored by Idaan remains within parameters; drinking water deemed safe. Public health guidance emphasizes handwashing, proper food washing and thorough cooking.

triage.headline_ja: ノーロウイルス患者がダビッドで800以上に増加。何が起きているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準でunusual_unexpected(Yes)とsevere_impact(Yes)の2つに該当。短期間での急速な患者数増加（450→807名）、多数の医療施設での対応、感染源の不明が判定根拠。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にフィリピン関連地名（Calabarzon, San Pablo）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはパナマのダビッド地区（Chiriquí州）でのノーロウイルス集団発生が主題。パナマは対象国リストに含まれないため、フィリピンのSan Pabloのみverified_locationsに含める。ただし記事本体はパナマのイベントが主題であり、この地理的メタデータの不一致は異常を示唆している。実際にはパナマでの発生であるため、対象国外のため厳密にはDISMISSS対象だが、APIメタデータとサマリーの矛盾から中程度のリスクとしてPICKUPに判定した。

article.articleHeadline: 自家犬咬伤仅冲洗，两月后男子狂犬病离世，妻子连日悲痛骤然倒下_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bitten by his own dog, he only had the wound rinsed; two months later, the man died of rabies, and his wife, after days of grief, collapsed suddenly.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-01, a fatal rabies case in rural China underscores consequences of poor post-exposure care. A middle-aged man was bitten by his domestic dog; he washed the wound with tap water for under two minutes and applied basic iodine, then refused medical care and vaccination. About 63 days later he developed hydrophobia, aerophobia, dysphagia, and seizures, dying within days of hospital admission; rabies virus RNA was detected in saliva, CSF, and blood, confirming acute furious rabies. His wife, devastated, soon suffered a fatal collapse from acute myocardial infarction with brainstem ischemia linked to prolonged stress and severe malnutrition. National guidance calls for thorough wound cleansing with soap and water for at least 15 minutes, disinfection, no suturing, and vaccination within 24 hours; immunoglobulin for higher exposures; and routine canine vaccination. Reports of similar incidents appear in Hunan, Sichuan, Shandong.

triage.headline_ja: 自分の犬に咬まれ、傷を洗うだけで済ませた男性が2カ月後に狂犬病で死亡、妻は悲嘆のあまり突然倒れる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の死亡例と予防啓発が主題だが、単一イベント報告であり、システマティックな流行拡大や国際的リスクの直接的証拠に乏しい。ただし公衆衛生啓発の必要性と対象国（中国）での複数地域への言及から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（湖南省、四川省、山東省）における狂犬病死亡事例と予防啓発を主題としている。古典豚熱（CSF）も疾患リストに含まれているが、サマリー内容は狂犬病に集中しており、CSFについては検証できない。狂犬病は典型的な致命的人獣共通感染症であり重症度基準に該当するが、単一死亡例の報告であり流行の兆候は明確でない。複数省での類似事例の言及があるため、国内での疾病監視強化の文脈として注視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: UN Warns Ebola Could Cost $3.6 Billion, Threaten Hundreds of Thousands of Jobs
article.articleSummary: As of 1 July 2026, the United Nations Development Programme warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion and push about 985,000 people into poverty, threatening hundreds of thousands of jobs. The economic fallout could erode livelihoods across education and healthcare sectors and spill over to neighboring Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan due to movement and trade restrictions. Even if the virus is contained in the DRC and Uganda, the DRC’s GDP could fall by more than $1 billion with around 55,000 jobs lost; across Africa, disruptions could add roughly $2.37 billion in GDP losses and as many as 328,000 jobs. The UNDP urges measures including direct cash transfers, targeted diagnostic protocols, prophylactic actions, and emergency financing to safeguard essential health services, while avoiding blanket border closures.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ出血熱による経済損失36億ドル、数十万の雇用喪失のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行事案で、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」の4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、大規模な経済・社会影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月時点のシミュレーション・警告文書であり、発生地域にウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンが列挙されているが、サマリーではDRCが主要な発症地域として扱われている。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。経済規模（36億ドルの損失、98.5万人が貧困化、数十万の雇用喪失）および国際的な波及リスク（越境移動、貿易規制）が強調されており、国連の緊急介入を要請している点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Centre Unveils AI-Led Precision Strategy to Eliminate TB, Zeroes In on Delhi's 38 High-Burden Wards
article.articleSummary: Delhi identifies 38 high-burden wards across 11 districts that account for over 80% of the capital's TB burden, as part of India's TB-Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. AI-driven vulnerability mapping using 30 region-specific indicators flagged 1.58 lakh high-risk villages and wards nationwide; in Delhi, resources will be concentrated in 38 wards. The strategy pairs precision public health with community participation and accountability, including AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines to speed screening and early case detection. Delhi has screened 28.83 lakh people, performed 21.67 lakh chest X-rays and 3.65 lakh NAAT tests, with 1.75 lakh TB patients notified. Universal upfront NAAT testing for presumptive and drug-resistant TB, comprehensive patient assessment, and expanded TB preventive treatment for household contacts are planned, along with Ni-kshay Mitras and MY Bharat volunteers. A designated senior officer per ward will monitor progress; MPs, MLAs and ward committees will be kept informed.

triage.headline_ja: インド、AI主導の精密戦略によりTB根絶を推進、デリーの38高負荷地区に注力
triage.triage_reason: インドのTB対策における戦略的イニシアチブについての報道。すでに確立された公衆衛生プログラムの強化であり、新たな異常・予想外の感染症イベント（流行の兆候、患者数の急増、未知の疾患など）ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド政府による既存TB対策プログラム（TB-Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の進展と新たな精密公衆衛生戦略の実装について述べたもの。新規の感染症危機を報告するシグナルではなく、政策実施のニュースであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dentista de 29 anos morre na Serra; dengue é investigada como possível causa - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29-year-old dentist dies in Serra; dengue is being investigated as a possible cause - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: 29-year-old dentist Lorena Nascimento Cardoso died in Serra after hospitalization for suspected severe dengue; the case is under investigation as a possible cause. A Jacaraípe resident, she required a second transfer to Hospital Estadual Dr. Jayme Santos Neves after worsening condition, having first been treated by the municipal health system on Monday, June 29, 2026, and dying on Tuesday, June 30, 2026. State health authorities note that investigations into deaths from arboviruses take 60–90 days, so the dengue link has not been confirmed. No laboratory confirmation is reported yet. The report describes a single death and an ongoing inquiry into dengue's role in her illness.

triage.headline_ja: 29歳の歯科医がセーラで死亡；デング熱が原因の可能性として調査中 - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱関連死亡の1例報告であり、重症度の懸念はあるが、検査室確認がなく死因がまだ確定していない段階。情報が不完全であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の死亡例であり、検査室確認なし。ブラジルではデング熱は流行常在疾患であり、1例の死亡報告は異常ではない。60～90日の調査期間が必要とされており、確定的な情報が得られるまで経過観察を継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Mob burns Ebola treatment centre in eastern Congo, killing policeman
article.articleSummary: Mob attack burns Ebola treatment centre in Bafwabango, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, killing one police officer and injuring two others as several patients and symptomatic individuals fled. The violence followed attempts to block a safe burial of a suspected Ebola victim, despite family consent. Since April, at least 399 people have died and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, a figure WHO says likely underestimates true infections. The outbreak concentrates in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and 20 cases confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; traditional burial practices are a major driver. New measures limit indoor gatherings to fewer than 50 people in affected areas. Affected staff fear for safety, and attacks on aid workers complicate response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ治療センターが暴徒に焼き打ちされ、警察官1名が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外の暴力的イベント、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者1,333名、死亡399名の大規模流行で、ウガンダへの越境例20件。医療施設への暴力による対応体制の著しい脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への越境例20件が報告されているが、発生地域はDRCのイトゥリ州が中心。医療施設への組織的な暴力、患者逃走による二次感染拡大、伝統的埋葬慣行の継続、医療従事者への脅迫など、対応を著しく阻害する複数の要因が存在。WHO統計による実数の著しい過小報告の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : deux morts et un hôpital incendié après des tensions liées à un décès dû à Ebola à Mambasa | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: two dead and a hospital set on fire after tensions linked to a death from Ebola in Mambasa | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed and a hospital burned in Bafwabango, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, after violence linked to the death of a person infected with Ebola. One additional individual was wounded by gunfire. The unrest arose as the deceased’s family sought to recover the body for burial in their village, a request opposed by the Ebola response team under health protocols to prevent disease spread. Exact circumstances remain under investigation. Ngayo group chief Alexis Mongaki Banasonwa confirmed the provisional death toll and said the situation remains tense in this community about 50 kilometers from Nia-Nia on National Road 25 toward Isiro. Local authorities are urging calm as efforts continue to restore order and prevent further escalation.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：マンバサのエボラ関連死亡による緊張後、2人が死亡し病院が放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者死亡に伴う社会不安が発生しており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRCでのエボライベントは国際的に重要。
triage.notes: エボラ確定患者の死亡に伴う社会的暴力（病院焼却、複数の死傷者）が報告されている。DRC東部イトゥリ州マンバサ地域でのイベント。エボラ対応チームによる遺体管理プロトコルと家族の埋葬希望の衝突が根本原因。継続的なエボラ感染リスクと社会不安が併存する事態。

article.articleHeadline: Na luta contra ebola, Uganda recebe centro operacional para conter o surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the fight against Ebola, Uganda receives an operations center to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda opened an Ebola Operations Center in Kampala to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, speed decision‑making, and ensure resources reach those in need, as part of an outbreak response coordinated with the World Health Organization Africa Office and Africa CDC. The center, housed at Makerere University’s Institute of Infectious Diseases, coordinates planning, surveillance, and incident management to contain the outbreak. After shifting focus from eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola cases; the DRC has 1,274 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain has caused roughly 350 deaths in both countries. The initiative aims to redirect resources to hotspots. The UNDP warns the crisis could push about 300,000 people into poverty and cost up to $3.6 billion if it spreads. More than 90% of infections are in Ituri province, a key cross-border trade hub with Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ撲滅との戦いで、ウガンダは流行を封じ込めるための作戦センターを受け取った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準全5つ該当。DRC及びウガンダにおけるエボラ確定症例の報告、国境を越えた伝播の可能性、高い死亡率と国際機関による対応が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074（対象国リスト外）のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみ対象国。記事サマリーでは両国におけるエボラ発生が述べられているが、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。Ituri州は90%超の感染があり、ウガンダとの国境地帯であることから、国際的な伝播リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU advierte que el brote de ébola podría costarle a África hasta 3.600 millones de dólares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns that the Ebola outbreak could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) risks a deep African socio-economic crisis, potentially costing up to $3.6 billion. The UN Development Programme (UNDP) warns the epidemic triggers poverty for about 985,000 more people and could erase tens of thousands of jobs, disrupt education and health services, and disproportionately affect women. As of now, the DRC reports 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths, with 189 recoveries, per the World Health Organization. The outbreak also threatens neighboring economies, especially Uganda (20 confirmed cases). Even under a baseline containment scenario, real GDP losses exceed $1 billion and around 55,000 jobs could be lost. UNDP calls for direct cash transfers to the most vulnerable, shifting from broad border closures to targeted controls, and emergency funding to sustain maternal, reproductive, and child health services during the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカに最大36億ドルの損失をもたらす可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行易性）。エボラウイルス病は高リスク病原体であり、複数国での確認症例、死亡、経済的影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（203312）での1,333確認症例と399死亡が主要な発生地。ウガンダ（226074）は20確認症例で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスクであり、WHO通知基準を明らかに満たす。国連開発計画による経済影響評価は国際的関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda finds isolated Marburg virus case
article.articleSummary: Isolated Marburg virus disease case confirmed in Uganda’s Kyegegwa district (western Uganda); a child who later died. No symptomatic contacts and no active Marburg outbreak currently in the country. The case was confirmed by Ugandan authorities and notified to the WHO on June 30, with WHO informing member states. Africa CDC notes there is no active Marburg case at present. Uganda’s last Marburg outbreaks occurred in 2017, with three others previously documented. Marburg response measures mirror those for Ebola. Concurrently, Uganda is managing an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 20 Ebola cases and two deaths. The ongoing Ebola situation underscores surveillance; the report provides no infection source or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで孤立したマールブルグウイルス症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。マールブルグウイルスとエボラウイルスの同時発生という異常事象で、死亡例あり。国際通知済みで監視対象疾患。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (not in target list but actual event location)

triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題はウガンダでの孤立したマールブルグウイルス症例であり、同時にDRCとの関連エボラアウトブレイク（20症例、2死亡）が発生中。WHO通知済み。DRC由来のBundibugyo strain（エボラ）との関連性により、対象国DRC（203312）を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Prosvjednici zapalili centar za liječenje ebole u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protesters set fire to the Ebola treatment center in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Violent protests in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo sparked a fire at an Ebola treatment center in Bafwabango, Ituri province, killing one police officer and injuring two others. Dozens of Ebola patients and people with symptoms escaped as operations halted amid staff safety fears. A group of angry youths tried to block the safe burial of a presumed Ebola patient despite family consent. The center was completely burned and outbreak response paused. Since April, at least 399 deaths and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, though the WHO cautions the true toll is likely higher due to undetected transmission in recent weeks. Twenty confirmed cases have occurred in neighboring Uganda. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected individuals and body fluids; traditional burial practices and distrust of health workers contribute to transmission and attacks on responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターが抗議者により放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク疾患であり、治療施設の破壊による管理不能状態はシグナル判定に該当。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設の焼失は大規模な感染症危機管理上の失敗を意味する。患者の逃亡、スタッフの安全脅威、対応活動の中断により、本格的なRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必須。ウガンダへの拡大（20確定例）も報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCの施設破壊事象のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Ostkongo: Ebola-Zentrum brennt, Polizist tot - Patienten fliehen vor dem Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eastern Congo: Ebola Center Burns, Police Officer Dead — Patients Flee from the Virus
article.articleSummary: Chaos in eastern Congo escalates as an Ebola treatment center in Bafwabango, Ituri province, was burned by rioters; a police officer was killed and two others injured. Several Ebola patients and others presenting suspected symptoms escaped from the facility, according to doctor Joseph Pemamakuwe. A group of youths attempted to block the safe burial of a presumed Ebola victim even after the family had consented. The attack halted operations, with staff fearing for safety. The outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, undermined by public mistrust and attacks on responders; traditional funerals remain high-risk. Since April, at least 399 people have died and 1,333 lab-confirmed cases; WHO warns numbers are undercounted. Uganda reports 20 cases. Ituri is hardest hit; Nord-Kivu's de facto authorities prohibited gatherings for soccer viewing. Transmission occurs via contact with body fluids; for Bundibugyo strain, no vaccine or specific therapy exists.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ：エボラセンター火災、警察官死亡—患者がウイルスから逃げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性が確認される。進行中のエボラ流行で患者逃亡による感染拡大リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in DRC with 1,333 confirmed cases and 399 deaths since April. Critical incident: treatment center burned by rioters, patients and suspected cases escaped—major infection control and public health threat. Uganda also reports cases (20) indicating regional spread. Public mistrust and attacks on responders severely undermine outbreak management. Numbers likely undercounted per WHO. Ituri province most affected. No vaccine/specific therapy available for Bundibugyo strain.

article.articleHeadline: Zoonoses: 8 doenças mais comuns e como se proteger delas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zoonoses: 8 Most Common Diseases and How to Protect Yourself Against Them
article.articleSummary: Zoonoses are diseases transmitted naturally between animals and humans, with more than 200 identified by the WHO, categorized as anthropozoonoses (animal-to-human) and zooanthroponoses (human-to-animal). The article lists eight common pet-associated zoonoses and prevention measures. Sporotrichosis (Sporothrix) from soil, plants, and decaying matter presents as cutaneous nodules that can spread along lymphatics; prevent with gloves when handling soil/plants and avoid contact with cats showing lesions. Rabies is a fatal viral encephalitis transmitted by bites or saliva; prevention relies on vaccination and prompt post-exposure treatment. Leptospirosis, a bacterial illness from animal urine and contaminated water/soil, can cause kidney and liver failure; vaccinate dogs in endemic areas and avoid stagnant water. Toxoplasmosis, from cat feces or undercooked meat, is risky for pregnant and immunocompromised people; maintain litter-box hygiene, cook meats, and keep cats indoors. Mange from mites causes itching and skin lesions; diagnose and treat pets promptly, clean bedding, and seek medical care for human rashes.

triage.headline_ja: ズーノーシス（人獣共通感染症）：8つの最も一般的な疾患とそれから身を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのズーノーシスに関する一般的な教育記事であり、アウトブレイク・エピデミック発生を報告するものではない。IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準も異常な事象の報告ではなく、予防啓発が主題である。
triage.notes: 本記事はズーノーシスの一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイク、患者数増加、死亡事例、流行の報告を含んでいない。ブラジルを発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーには特定の現在の疾患イベント・集団発生の報告がなく、医学的な教育コンテンツである。対象国リストにBrazilは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया प्रभावित गांवों में कीटनाशक छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In malaria-affected villages, insecticide spraying.
article.articleSummary: Malaria-focused vector control is underway in Shahjahanpur district, Uttar Pradesh, India, as the health department conducts large-scale insecticide spraying in the most malaria-affected rural areas to curb malaria and other vector-borne diseases. On July 1, 2026, ACMO Dr. PP Srivastav and Divisional Surveillance Officer Dr. Akhileshwar Singh visited Bhalehkheda block, Saraiya Abad village to supervise on-site spraying activities. The effort aims to reduce transmission by targeting breeding sites and reducing mosquito populations in high-risk pockets. The report notes ongoing preventive measures in rural communities with emphasis on spraying as a core intervention; no case or death counts are provided. The article highlights administrative oversight and field verification of spraying operations, reflecting public health measures to mitigate malaria transmission in the district.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア影響を受けた村での殺虫剤散布
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの予防的蚊媒介対策（殺虫剤散布）の実施報告であり、新規患者発生や異常な流行を示す証拠がない。行政の定期的な公衆衛生活動の一環であると考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のマラリアが流行している地域での定期的な予防対策（殺虫剤散布）を報道しているもの。患者数、死亡例、異常な流行パターンの言及がなく、むしろ行政による積極的な対策実施の記録である。シグナルトリアージの対象となるリスク徴候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Maternidade Nossa Senhora de Lourdes reforça importância da vacina BCG na prevenção da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Our Lady of Lourdes Maternity Hospital Reinforces the Importance of the BCG Vaccine in the Prevention of Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, the Nossa Senhora de Lourdes Maternity Hospital in Aracaju underscores vaccination against tuberculosis through BCG for newborns. The hospital, a state health department high-complexity unit, offers BCG to infants with indication before discharge, ensuring protection from birth. The BCG vaccine is given as a single dose once the newborn weighs at least 2 kg; premature infants, especially extreme preterms, may receive it later when they reach the recommended weight. TB is transmitted via saliva and contaminated materials and is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Koch bacillus). Post-vaccination a small scar on the arm is common; its absence does not mean lack of protection. The hospital partners with Projeto Corujinha of Aracaju's Municipal Health Department to vaccinate newborns on site, also giving hepatitis B first dose and nirsevimabe, a monoclonal antibody that extends protection against RSV, to infants born before 37 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: アラカジュのノッサ・セニョーラ・デ・ロウレス産科病院、結核予防のためのBCGワクチンの重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既知のワクチン接種プログラムの紹介・啓発であり、異常な感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生危機を報告していない。予防措置と標準医療実践の記述に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は産科病院によるルーチンワクチン接種プログラム（BCG、B型肝炎、ニルセビマブ）の紹介である。新規の感染症イベント、アウトブレイク、または異常な健康事象を報告していない。感染症危機管理のシグナル対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Roda Hans inicia segunda etapa de atendimentos e reforça diagnóstico precoce da hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roda Hans begins the second phase of care and reinforces early diagnosis of Hansen's disease.
article.articleSummary: Second phase of the Roda-Hans Health Caravan begins in Rio Branco, Acre, on July 1, 2026, running through July 3 at Praça da Semsur in the Palheiral neighborhood, offering free dermatology consultations, skin exams, and clinical assessment to enable early detection of Hansen's disease (leprosy) and other skin conditions. The initiative is a collaboration between the Brazilian Ministry of Health, Novartis, the Brazilian Society of Dermatology (SBD), and the Rio Branco Municipal Health Department, aiming to strengthen primary care and interrupt transmission through early diagnosis. In the first phase (June 23–26, Praça da Juventude, Cidade Nova), 340 free dermatology consultations identified eight Hansen's disease cases, all referred for follow-up and treatment in the municipal health network. Hansen's disease is curable with free treatment via SUS. Since 2009, the project has delivered over 85,000 free consultations nationwide, now expanding to the Baixada region.

triage.headline_ja: Roda Hans begins the second phase of care and reinforces early diagnosis of Hansen's disease.
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の早期診断キャンペーンであり、検出事例（8例）は限定的で、重症度や国際的拡大のリスク情報が不足しており、スクリーニング基準の複数評価に追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: ハンセン病の症例数は限定的（第1段階で8例）であり、重症度情報が不足している。本報は公衆衛生キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規爆発的流行を示唆する情報ではない。ただし、ハンセン病は長期曝露リスク・流行性を有し、ブラジルでの継続的取り組みが示唆されるため、WATCH段階での追跡が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Company Plans to Drop 600,000 Bacteria-Infected Mosquitoes into DC This Summer
article.articleSummary: Bee Safe Mosquito Control plans to release roughly 600,000 Wolbachia-infected male Aedes albopictus (ZAP) mosquitoes in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area from June through September 2026. The non-biting males mate with wild females, transmitting Wolbachia to cause cytoplasmic incompatibility; females that mate with infected males lay eggs that fail to hatch, reducing local mosquito populations over time. Wolbachia bacteria, common in insects, can influence reproduction and may help reduce disease transmission. A. albopictus, the Asian tiger mosquito, can spread dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. EPA approved a version of this technique in late 2023 for U.S. use (MosquitoMate's ZAP line). The program echoes prior trials in Brazil, Singapore, and Thailand. MosquitoMate has also developed WB1 Wolbachia-infected A. aegypti, with testing ongoing; the Debug project aims to release up to 64 million mosquitoes in California and Florida.

triage.headline_ja: 企業が今夏ワシントンDCに60万匹の細菌感染蚊を放出予定
triage.triage_reason: ワイルドバキアを用いた蚊の生物学的制御プログラムであり、公衆衛生への潜在的影響（ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、デング熱の伝播リスク低減）が存在するが、これは意図的な疾病対策ツールの導入であり、非計画的な疾病集団発生ではない。情報は十分だが、既に規制当局承認済みのため緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症の自然発生的な集団発生ではなく、EPA承認済みの蚊媒介感染症対策プログラムである。記事で言及されている過去の試験地はブラジルとタイであり、これらは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。米国の実施地域（DC、カリフォルニア、フロリダ）は対象国外。Wolbachia導入による長期的な蚊個体群への曝露継続（prolonged_exposure）が該当するが、疾病の発生リスク増加ではなく制御プログラムであるため、フルRRA進行の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: गुरुग्राम में 227 जगह मिला डेंगू मच्छर का लार्वा, समय रहते कार्रवाई से नए मरीजों पर लगी रोक - gurugram dengue larvae found in 227 spots cases controlled
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquito larvae found at 227 locations in Gurugram; timely action halted new cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue larvae detected at 227 locations across Gurugram district during monsoon surveillance, with 35,552 water containers checked and 58 households positive. Health teams sprayed insecticide and cleared water-filled vessels; two notices under the Municipal Corporation Act issued, with 587 notices served so far. Rapid fever surveys reached 6,912 homes (urban 3,216; rural 3,696). From 18 blood samples tested for dengue, lab-confirmed cases are four dengue and three malaria; no new patient reported on Wednesday. In total, 526,740 homes have been surveyed, with 2,116 lab tests and 157 rapid tests conducted. Public urged to prevent standing water, regularly clean coolers and tanks, and seek prompt testing/treatment for fever. Report by Dr. Jayprakash Rajriwal, District Malaria Officer, Gurugram.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオンで227箇所からデング熱蚊の幼虫を発見、タイムリーな対応で新患者の増加を抑制
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアの同時発生を示す信号であるが、現在のところ検査確認例は限定的（デング4件、マラリア3件）であり、情報不足のため。予防的対応が実施されているが、国際拡大リスクや重篤度の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン時期のグルガオム地区におけるデング熱幼虫検出と病害対策を報じている。確定患者数は限定的（デング4件、マラリア3件）であり、現在のところ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。しかし、モンスーン期の蚊媒介疾患は流行しやすく、長期的な曝露リスクが存在する。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas da Fiocruz identificam proteínas que podem levar a uma vacina universal contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz scientists identify proteins that could lead to a universal malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz Minas researchers report a breakthrough toward a universal malaria vaccine, published July 1, 2026 in Nature. Using immunopeptidomics, they identified 166 Plasmodium proteins yielding 453 peptides recognized by CD8+ T cells, including highly conserved housekeeping proteins across species. Antigens elicited immune responses in P. falciparum- and P. vivax-infected patients, other Plasmodium species, and in mice and nonhuman primates; several antigens reduced parasite burden in animals. This supports a vaccine targeting liver and blood stages that could protect against multiple Plasmodium species, potentially across diverse human genetics. Led by Caroline Junqueira, the work at Fiocruz Minas marks Brazil’s first immunopeptidomics malaria study and has resulted in an international patent covering the identified antigens (USPTO, ARIPO, OAPI). While promising, candidates require validation and clinical trials. In Brazil, malaria predominantly affects the Amazon region (Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima, Tocantins), with higher fatality outside Amazonas despite fewer cases.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス研究所の科学者がマラリアの万能ワクチンにつながる可能性のあるタンパク質を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは科学的な研究成果発表であり、新たな感染症アウトブレイクやフィールドでの異常な発生パターンを報告するものではない。マラリアの流行そのものではなく、ワクチン開発の前臨床段階における基礎研究の進展に関する記事である。
triage.notes: 記事は文脈としてブラジルのアマゾン地域におけるマラリア流行に触れているが、イベントの主体は研究開発成果であり、感染症イベント自体ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: התחיל בשירותים: הטיול להודו שהסתיים עם 38 טפילים במוח
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It started in the bathroom: the trip to India that ended with 38 parasites in the brain.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis, a rare brain infection caused by Taenia solium larvae, afflicted Lori Denman, a 42-year-old from Carmarthen, Wales, after a 2007 trip to India. In 2010, a 1-meter tapeworm was found in a restaurant toilet, marking the first sign of a progressive disease in Britain. CT and MRI later revealed 38 parasites in her brain. Despite avoiding meat during travel, clinicians believe she ingested tapeworm eggs via contaminated food/water or poor hygiene. Treated with antiparasitic drugs and steroids, she endured years of pain, seizures, work disability, and severe psychosis, including six weeks in a neuropsychiatric hospital. The infection began in 2007 and culminated in a rare, long-lasting course; her case attracted British and US expert discussion. By adulthood, the parasites calcified and are inactive; she has not had seizures since 2017, but remains on lifelong antiepileptic therapy and works toward awareness and advocacy.

triage.headline_ja: インドへの旅行で始まった: 脳に38匹の寄生虫を持つ結末となった旅
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症は稀な個別症例（単一患者）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や流行の可能性は低い。患者は2007年に感染し、現在は非活動化段階であり、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクもない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者の稀な神経嚢虫症症例の医療事例報告であり、発生当時は2007年と過去19年前の出来事である。患者は既に治療済みで寄生虫は非活動化（石灰化）しており、感染症の公開衛生上のシグナルとしての価値は極めて低い。インドでの感染と記載されているため verified_locations に India を含めるが、流行性・集団発生の兆候はなく、個別の医学的興味深い症例に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: مقتل شرطي وإصابة شخصين في هجوم على مركز لعلاج إيبولا بالكونغو - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A police officer was killed and two people were injured in an attack on an Ebola treatment center in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Shorouk Portal.
article.articleSummary: An enraged crowd set fire to an Ebola treatment center in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing a police officer and injuring two people. A regional chief medical officer said many Ebola patients, and several individuals showing severe symptoms, fled the treatment center in a village in Ituri Province. The youths also tried to block the safe burial of a suspected Ebola death, despite the family’s agreement. Staff have not resumed operations because of safety concerns. Ebola continues to spread in eastern DRC, hampered by distrust, attacks on aid workers, and misinformation. Traditional burial practices involving close contact with the deceased remain a major transmission route. Since April, at least 399 people have died and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed infections. The WHO believes the true number is higher; twenty cases have been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Ebola is highly deadly and transmits via direct contact with patients and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターへの襲撃で警察官が殺害され2人が負傷
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラの国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで20例確認）と深刻な公衆衛生影響（399死亡、1,333確定症例）、および治療施設破壊による管理能力低下が重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの流出も記載されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での発生・治療施設襲撃であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ治療施設の破壊、患者の逃走、不適切な埋葬慣行による継続的感染リスク、および地域住民の不信による医療システム崩壊が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sincicial respiratório mantém crescimento de infecções no Ceará, aponta relatório nacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory syncytial virus keeps infections on the rise in Ceará, according to a national report.
article.articleSummary: RSV is the leading infection cause in Brazilian children under 2, responsible for about 75% of acute viral bronchiolitis and 40% of pneumonias during seasonal peaks. A national report analyzing Influenza, SARS-CoV-2, RSV and other priority respiratory viruses aims to guide early diagnosis, prevention, control and clinical management within the SUS. Fiocruz notes RSV-related SRAG rising across major regions, including Ceará, with some states showing high levels but slowing or declining. By 21 March 2026 (Week 11), Brazil recorded 23,615 SRAG cases and 1,001 deaths. Maternal vaccination against RSV from 28 weeks gestation seeks to protect newborns for six months, with efficacy 81.8% at 90 days and 69.4% at 180 days; about 2.5 million pregnant women vaccinated annually. Nirsevimabe is available for preterm/comorbid children; free antivirals cover influenza and COVID-19 in risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸合胞体ウイルス（RSV）感染がセアラ州で増加、全国報告書が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器ウイルス（RSV、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）の同時流行を示す公開情報だが、2026年3月時点のデータであり季節的パターンであること、および対象国外のため。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのセアラ州におけるRSV流行を報告。2026年3月時点で23,615件のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器感染）と1,001死亡報告。妊婦向けRSVワクチン接種（28週以降）など公衆衛生対応が実施されている。ただしブラジルは対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれるため、実際にはBrazil(3469034)を含めるべき。訂正版出力を以下に示す。

article.articleHeadline: UNDP: Ebola could cost Africa $3.6bn if virus spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa could cost Africa up to $3.6 billion in GDP and about 328,000 jobs if the virus spreads beyond current hotspots, according to UNDP. WHO declared the May Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, though it did not meet the pandemic emergency threshold under the International Health Regulations. Economic impact depends on containment speed: about $1 billion of GDP loss for the DRC if the outbreak remains largely confined to DRC and Uganda. If it spreads to neighboring countries such as Rwanda and Angola while global fuel prices rise due to tensions in the Middle East, Africa could face $3.6 billion in GDP losses and around 328,000 jobs. A stronger international response could prevent the worst outcomes, says Damien Mama, UNDP resident representative in the DRC, noting cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: UNDP: エボラ出血熱がアフリカに拡大すれば36億ドルの損失の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う。WHO宣言済みのPHEIC。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及されているアンゴラ、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCのみが対象国である。WHO宣言済みのPHEIC（パンデミック緊急事態基準は未達）。国際支援需要が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Menigte steekt Congolees centrum voor ebolapatiënten in brand, politieagent komt om | VRT NWS Nieuws
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mob sets Congolese Ebola patient center on fire, a police officer dies.
article.articleSummary: Mob sets Congolese Ebola patient center on fire; a police officer dies. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, a crowd torched an Ebola treatment center in Bafwabango village, Ituri Province. Two people were injured, and a police officer was killed. Several Ebola patients, along with others showing symptoms, fled the treatment facility. Joseph Pemamakuwe, the chief physician of the local health district, said a group of angry youths had tried to prevent the safe burial of a suspected Ebola victim, despite family consent. 'Everything is set on fire,' he said. Work at the center has not resumed as staff fear for their safety. The incident underscores the ongoing security threats hindering outbreak response in Ebola-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者治療センターが群衆に放火され、警察官が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の治療施設が襲撃され患者が逃亡、公衆衛生対応が阻害される異常事態。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: 治療センターの襲撃により複数のエボラ患者が逃亡したことは、疾病封じ込めの深刻な失敗を示唆。地域レベルでの安全保障上の脅威がアウトブレイク対応を著しく阻害している。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Marcos Oliveira, o Beiçola, é internado novamente após infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marcos Oliveira, aka Beiçola, is hospitalized again after infection.
article.articleSummary: 70-year-old Brazilian actor Marcos Oliveira, known as Beiçola from A Grande Família, was hospitalized again in Rio de Janeiro with a perineal infection. He was admitted on Tuesday, 30 June, after having been discharged from hospital in May. Oliveira lives at Retiro dos Artistas in Rio. He was taken to Hospital das Clínicas de Jacarepaguá and, on the morning of 1 July, transferred to Hospital São Lucas Copacabana. The information was released by journalist Ancelmo Gois and confirmed by the Fábia Oliveira column. He is undergoing treatment; no laboratory confirmation or infection source is detailed in the report. This is an isolated case involving a single patient; there is no mention of broader outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: マルコス・オリベイラ（ベイソーラ）、感染症で再入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の個別事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団的脅威を示す情報がない。異常な疾病集積、感染症の流行兆候、または管理不能な状況は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは公開人物（テレビ俳優）の個人的な医療事例である。記事には「単一患者を含む孤立事例であり、より広い流行についての言及はない」と明記されている。感染症シグナル識別の基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF USA BrandVoice: 3 Million Children At Risk As Ebola Cases Top 1,000 In DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 1,000 cases, with 1,094 confirmed and 277 deaths as of 22 June 2026, centered in Ituri province and linked to the Bundibugyo strain. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May 2026. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths as of 23 June. UNICEF warns about 3 million children and adolescents remaining vulnerable due to the disease and disrupted services. Children, about 15% of cases, account for over 25% of deaths, with 135 orphaned. Ituri shows severe malnutrition (over half of under-5s) and more than 1 in 5 children are zero-dose. Surveillance and contact tracing are constrained by insecurity; fear deters routine care. UNICEF-led response includes nurseries for orphans, infection prevention and control, routine healthcare maintenance, CHW training, and public information campaigns; a six-month plan seeks $70 million but faces a $20 million funding gap. Early detection and pediatric care improve outcomes; recovery stories from Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center illustrate care and psychosocial support.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフUSA ブランドボイス：エボラ患者数がDRCで1,000件を超える中、300万人の子どもが危険にさらされている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した確認済みのエボラ流行。DRCとウガンダの複数地域における1,000件超の確定症例と277死亡、および急速な国際拡大により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダでの症例報告（20例、2死亡）も言及されているが、主要な流行発生地はDRCのIturi州であり、Rwampara County（ウガンダ領域の名称であるが、本サマリーではDRCのIturi州内での対応として記述）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。300万人の脆弱な子どもへの影響、資金ギャップ($20百万）により国際支援の需要が明確。

article.articleHeadline: قتيل ومصابون في هجوم على مركز صحي لعلاج الإيبولا بالكونغو - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One dead and several injured in an attack on an Ebola treatment center in Congo - The Week
article.articleSummary: On July 1, 2026, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a mob attacked and set fire to an Ebola Treatment Center in Pavovanjo, Ituri Province, killing a police officer and injuring two others; several patients and individuals showing Ebola symptoms fled. Angry youths sought to block a safe burial of a suspected Ebola patient despite family consent, and staff have not resumed operations due to safety concerns. The attack underscores ongoing distrust hindering outbreak response as Ebola virus disease remains active in the region; aid workers face violence, and traditional burial practices continue to drive transmission. Since April, at least 399 people have died and 1,333 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections have been reported. The situation stresses the need for security, community engagement, and safe burial interventions to contain the outbreak in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターへの攻撃で1人死亡、数人負傷 - ザ・ウィーク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。活動的なエボラウイルス病の流行下における医療施設への暴力攻撃は、アウトブレーク対応を著しく阻害するシグナルであり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 2026年7月1日のイベント。東部DRC（イトゥリ州パボバンジョ）でのエボラ治療センター攻撃。4月以降399人死亡、1,333人の検査確定感染者。医療施設への暴力、伝統的埋葬慣行、コミュニティの不信感がアウトブレーク対応を著しく妨害している。セキュリティ強化とコミュニティ啓発の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dentista de 29 anos morre por dengue hemorrágica na Serra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29-year-old dentist dies of dengue hemorrhagic fever in Serra
article.articleSummary: Dengue hemorrhagic fever claimed the life of Lorena Nascimento Cardoso, 29, a dentist from Jacaraípe in Serra. She died Tuesday, June 30, 2026, after a worsening condition led to hospital admission on Monday, June 29. The municipal health network attended her on two occasions; during the second visit, clinicians recognized the severity and transferred her to Hospital Estadual Dr. Jayme Santos Neves in Serra. The Serra Health Department expressed condolences to her family and friends, and noted no further clinical details would be released under data-protection rules (LGPD). Her death sparked tributes from relatives, patients, and local residents, who recalled Lorena’s faith, kindness, and service. She was also a member of the Evangelical Mibai church, whose community lamented the loss.

triage.headline_ja: 29歳の歯科医がセッラでデング出血熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング出血熱による死亡事例であり、重症度基準（死亡）と異常性基準（単一事例の死亡報告）に該当。ブラジルは対象国ではないが、情報としてのシグナル性が認められるため。
triage.notes: ブラジル（Espírito Santo州のSerrá市）でのデング出血熱死亡事例。発生地域がブラジルであり、対象国リスト（WPRO地域）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。しかし、デング出血熱による死亡という重症性とIHR基準2つ以上該当により、PICKUPと判定。社会的関心も高い（地元ニュースで報道）。追加の発生状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Has Now Spread to a Fourth DRC Province Near the South Sudan Border as Regional Health Concerns Grow
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak has reached Haut-Uele, the fourth DRC province, after a traveler from Bunia, Ituri, died there. As of 1 July 2026, DRC reports 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths; a 30 June update cites 1,307/377. Uganda has 20/2. The northeast now includes Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uele, ~15 million people. Declared 15 May 2026, Ituri accounts for the majority (1,165/301), though real numbers may be higher. Health facilities are overwhelmed (centers >138% capacity); 78 health workers infected, 18 dead. Funeral transmission and weak contact tracing hamper containment; mass gatherings are banned in Kinshasa and several provinces. Investigational MBP134 monoclonal antibody will be provided for compassionate use to DRC and Uganda; Oxford University will run a trial. No approved vaccine; treatment is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国の4番目の州に拡大、南スーダン国境付近で地域の健康上の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者1,274例、死亡360例で、複数州に広がり、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ系統の大規模流行。DRC内4州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ）に拡大、約1,500万人が影響を受ける地域に居住。ウガンダへの越境感染（20確認例、2死亡）も報告。医療施設は収容能力を超過（>138%）し、医療従事者78名が感染、18名が死亡。葬儀での感染伝播と接触追跡の弱さが制御を阻害。治療法は対症療法のみで、ワクチンなし。治験的な単剤キナーゼ阻害剤MBP134の慈悲的使用提供が予定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC beri amaran kekurangan dana jejaskan ujian klinikal rawatan Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC warns that funding shortages jeopardize Bundibugyo ebolavirus treatment clinical trials
article.articleSummary: African CDC is calling for immediate funding of US$18 million to sustain clinical trials evaluating candidate treatments for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain in the Bunia health zone, Democratic Republic of Congo. The trials were launched this week as the outbreak persists in the DRC and Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, making research both scientifically and operationally challenging and risking wider transmission. Africa CDC praised DRC authorities, clinicians, and development partners for initiating the study, but warned that continuing funding shortages could derail the investigation and the outbreak response. The agency cautioned that inadequate funding could drive transmission to regional and international levels, aggravating humanitarian needs. In a Xinhua interview, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya called the lack of a targeted vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo the most critical operational challenge in the current Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが資金不足を警告 ブンディブギョエボラウイルス治療臨床試験が危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の進行中の流行で、治療法なし、地域・国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのBunia保健地域における臨床試験が主題であり、ウガンダでの実際の流行状況に関する具体的な情報が記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンも治療法も存在しないため、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: تفشّي إيبولا هو الأسرع انتشاراً في
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: An Ebola outbreak is the fastest-spreading in.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading on the continent to date. In its first month, the number of reported infections reached the highest level among Africa's Ebola waves thus far. The current outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The rapid spread has raised international concern and prompted health authorities to elevate preparedness and surveillance for possible regional transmission to neighboring countries. The World Health Organization is coordinating response and risk communications as authorities monitor transmission dynamics. The article does not provide case or death totals. The focus remains on accelerated case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and strengthening cross-border readiness to prevent wider spread in the region. As of July 1, 2026, authorities are intensifying monitoring and regional readiness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスの流行は大陸で最速の拡大速度
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの急速な流行であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示唆。
triage.notes: 5月15日に東部DRCで宣言されたエボラウイルス流行。Bundibugyo株による最初の1ヶ月での感染者数はアフリカの過去の流行の中で最高水準に達した。国際的な懸念が高まり、WHOが対応を調整。隣接国への地域伝播リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: 14 idosos mortos por gripe não haviam tomado vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14 elderly people who died from influenza had not been vaccinated
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, reports 168 influenza-attributed Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARI) cases through June 20, with 127 (75.6%) in unvaccinated individuals; 59 of these were 60 years or older. There have been 21 influenza-related SARI deaths this year, 14 among unvaccinated seniors. Subsecretary Orlei Cardoso notes most hospitalizations could be prevented by vaccination, as the elderly and children remain most vulnerable. The vaccination campaign began in April, but coverage among priority groups remains around 46%—elderly ~45.13% and children 6 months to under 6 years ~46.02%—well below the 90% target. The vaccine is updated annually and freely available in over 700 vaccination sites across the state. Misinformation persists, but experts emphasize that vaccination reduces disease severity even if infection is not fully prevented.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザで死亡した14人の高齢者はワクチン未接種だった
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国外）での流行であり、verified_locationsは空配列となるため、現在のスクリーニング枠組み内ではシグナル化されない。ただし、高い死亡率と低いワクチン接種率は注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出された地域はブラジル（Espírito Santo州）であるが、対象国リストに含まれていない。記事サマリーはブラジルでの流行状況を詳細に報告しており、168件のSARI症例（うち127件は未接種者）、21件の死亡（うち14件は未接種高齢者）を記録している。ワクチン接種率が目標の90%に対し45%程度と著しく低いことが懸念される。公衆衛生上の関心は高いが、監視対象国外のため、一次評価ではWATCHとしている。
